children.text: anavarata-dhanur jyā-āsphālana-krūra-pūrva ravi-kiraṇa-sahiṣṇu sveda-leśair abhinam /
apacitam api gātraṃ vyāyatatvād alakṣyaṃ giri-cara iva nāgaḥ prāṇa-sāraṃ bibharti //
(upetya) jayatu jayatu svāmī / gṛhītaśvāpadam araṇyam / kim anyatrāvasthīyate /
children.translated_text: (Approaching) Victory, victory to the lord! The forest, its beasts captured, awaits. Why does he linger elsewhere?

children.text: (upetya) jayatu jayatu svāmī / gṛhīta-śvā-padam araṇyam / kim anyatra-avasthīyate /
rājā  mandotsāhaḥ kṛto 'smi mṛgayāpavādinā mādhavyena /
children.translated_text: King: My enthusiasm has been dampened by <s>Mādhavya</s>, the critic of hunting.

children.text: rājā -- manda-utsāhaḥ kṛto 'smi mṛgayā-apavādinā mādhavyena /
senāpati  (janāntikam) sakhe sthirapratibandho bhava / ahaṃ tāvat svāminaś cittavṛttim anuvartiṣye / (prakāśam) pralapatv eṣa vaidheyaḥ / nanu prabhur eva nidarśanam /
children.translated_text: General: (Aside to <s>Mādhavya</s>) Friend, hold firm in your opposition. I shall meanwhile follow the lord's inclination. (Aloud) Let this obedient servant prattle on! The master himself is the example—

children.text: senāpati -- (janāntikam) sakhe sthira-pratibandho bhava / ahaṃ tāvat svāminaś citta-vṛttim anuvartiṣye / (prakāśam) pralapatv eṣa vaidheyaḥ / nanu prabhur eva nidarśanam /
medaśchedakṛśodaraṃ laghu bhavaty utthānayogyaṃ vapuḥ
sattvānām api lakṣyate vikṛtimac cittaṃ bhayakrodhayoḥ /
children.translated_text: even the altered minds of creatures in fear and anger are observed;
The body becomes lean-bellied from the cutting of fat, light and fit for rising;

children.text: utkarṣaḥ sa ca dhanvināṃ yad iṣavaḥ sidhyanti lakṣye cale
mithyā eva vyasanaṃ vadanti mṛgayām īdṛg vinodaḥ kutaḥ //
children.translated_text: They falsely call the hunt a vice—for where else is such sport?
and this is the supreme excellence of archers—that their arrows find the mark in moving targets.

children.text: medaś-cheda-kṛśa-udaraṃ laghu bhavaty utthāna-yogyaṃ vapuḥ
sattvānām api lakṣyate vikṛtimac cittaṃ bhaya-krodhayoḥ /
utkarṣaḥ sa ca dhanvināṃ yad iṣavaḥ sidhyanti lakṣye cale
mithyā eva vyasanaṃ vadanti mṛgayām īdṛg vinodaḥ kutaḥ //
vidu  apehi re utsāhahetuka / atrabhavān prakṛtim āpannaḥ / tvaṃ tāvad aṭavīto 'ṭavīm āhiṇḍamāno naranāsikālolupasya jīrṇaṛkṣasya kasya api mukhe patiṣyasi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Away with you, instigator of enthusiasm! His honor has returned to his natural state. You, wandering from forest to forest, will surely fall into the jaws of some decrepit bear greedy for human noses!

children.text: vidu -- apehi re utsāha-hetuka / atra-bhavān prakṛtim āpannaḥ / tvaṃ tāvad aṭavīto 'ṭavīm āhiṇḍamāno nara-nāsikā-lolupasya jīrṇa-ṛkṣasya kasya api mukhe patiṣyasi /
rā  bhadra senāpate āśramasaṃnikṛṣṭe sthitāḥ smaḥ / atas te vaco nābhinandāmi / adya tāvat /
children.translated_text: King: Good general, we are encamped near the hermitage. Therefore I do not approve of your words. For today—

children.text: rā -- bhadra senā-pate āśrama-saṃnikṛṣṭe sthitāḥ smaḥ / atas te vaco na abhinandāmi / adya tāvat /
gāhantāṃ mahiṣā nipānasalilaṃ śṛṅgair muhus tāḍitam
chāyābaddhakadambakaṃ mṛgakulaṃ romantham abhyasyatu /
children.translated_text: let the deer-herds, gathered in clusters beneath the shade, practice their cud-chewing;
Let the buffaloes plunge into the pool-water repeatedly struck by their horns;

children.text: viśrabdhaṃ kriyatāṃ vahāratatibhir mustākṣatiḥ palvale
viśrāmaṃ labhatām idaṃ ca śithitalajyābandham asmaddhanuḥ //
children.translated_text: and let this bow of mine rest with its bowstring loosened!
let the boars freely dig up the <s>mustā</s> roots in the marsh with their rows of tusks;

children.text: gāhantāṃ mahiṣā nipāna-salilaṃ śṛṅgair muhus tāḍitam
chāyā-baddha-kadambakaṃ mṛga-kulaṃ romantham abhyasyatu /
viśrabdhaṃ kriyatāṃ vahāra-tatibhir mustā-kṣatiḥ palvale
viśrāmaṃ labhatām idaṃ ca śithitala-jyā-bandham asmad-dhanuḥ //
senāpati  yat prabhaviṣṇave rocate /
children.translated_text: General: As pleases the sovereign.

children.text: senāpati -- yat prabhaviṣṇave rocate /
rā  tena hi nivartaya pūrvagatān vanagrāhiṇaḥ / yathā na me sainikās tapovanam uparundhanti tathā niṣeddhavyāḥ / paśya /
children.translated_text: King: Therefore call back the beaters who went ahead. And my soldiers must be restrained so they do not disturb the hermitage. See—

children.text: rā -- tena hi nivartaya pūrva-gatān vana-grāhiṇaḥ / yathā na me sainikās tapo-vanam uparundhanti tathā niṣeddhavyāḥ / paśya /
śamapradhāneṣu tapodhaneṣu gūḍhaṃ hi dātātmakam asti tejaḥ /
children.translated_text: In ascetics devoted to tranquility, there lies hidden a fiery energy of a giving nature;

children.text: sparśānukūleva sūryakāntās tadanyatejo 'bhibhavād vamanti //
children.translated_text: like sun-stones, smooth to the touch, they emit fire when overwhelmed by another's energy.

children.text: śama-pradhāneṣu tapo-dhaneṣu gūḍhaṃ hi dāta-ātmakam asti tejaḥ /
sparśa-anukūla īva sūrya-kāntās tad-anya-tejo 'bhibhavād vamanti //
senā  yad ājñāpayati svāmī /
children.translated_text: General: As the lord commands.

children.text: senā -- yad ājñāpayati svāmī /
vidu  vidhvaṃsatāṃ te utsāhavṛttāntaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: May your enthusiasm-story be destroyed!

children.text: vidu -- vidhvaṃsatāṃ te utsāha-vṛtta-antaḥ /
(niṣkrāntaḥ senāpatiḥ)
children.translated_text: (Exit general.)

children.text: (niṣkrāntaḥ senā-patiḥ)
rājā  (parijanaṃ vilokya) apanayantu bhavatyo mṛgayāveśam / raivataka tvam api svaṃ niyogam aśūnyaṃ kuru /
children.translated_text: King: (Looking at his attendants) Remove my hunting attire. <s>Raivataka</s>, you too attend to your own duty.

children.text: rājā -- (parijanaṃ vilokya) apanayantu bhavatyo mṛgayā-veśam / raivataka tvam api svaṃ niyogam aśūnyaṃ kuru /
parijana  yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: Attendants: As the lord commands. (They exit.)

children.text: parijana -- yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
vidu  kṛtaṃ bhavatā nirmakṣikam / sāṃpratam etasmin pādapachāyāviracitavitānasanāthe śilātale niṣīdatu bhavān yāvad aham api sukhāsīno bhavāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Good, you have cleared the flies! Now let your honor sit upon this stone slab, graced with a canopy of tree-shade, while I too seat myself comfortably.

children.text: vidu -- kṛtaṃ bhavatā nirmakṣikam / sāṃpratam etasmin pādapa-chāyā-viracita-vitāna-sanāthe śilā-tale niṣīdatu bhavān yāvad aham api sukha-āsīno bhavāmi /
rājā  gacchāgrataḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Go ahead.

children.text: rājā -- gaccha agrataḥ /
vidu  etu bhavān /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Come, sir.

children.text: vidu -- etu bhavān /
(ity ubhau parikramyopaviṣṭau )
children.translated_text: (Both walk around and sit down.)

children.text: (ity ubhau parikramya upaviṣṭau )
rā  mādhavya anavāptacakṣuḥ phalo 'si / yena tvayā darśanīyaṃ na dṛṣṭam /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mādhavya</s>, you have not yet obtained the fruit of your eyes, for you have not seen what is worth seeing.

children.text: rā -- mādhavya anavāpta-cakṣuḥ phalo 'si / yena tvayā darśanīyaṃ na dṛṣṭam /
vidu  nanu bhavān agrato me vartate /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: But is your honor not right before my eyes?

children.text: vidu -- nanu bhavān agrato me vartate /
rā  sarvaḥ kāntam ātmīyaṃ paśyati / ahaṃ tu tām āśramalalāmabhūtāṃ śakuntalām adhikṛtya bravīmi /
children.translated_text: King: Everyone considers what is dear to them beautiful. But I speak of <s>Śakuntalā</s>, the ornament of the hermitage.

children.text: rā -- sarvaḥ kāntam ātmīyaṃ paśyati / ahaṃ tu tām āśrama-lalāma-bhūtāṃ śakuntalām adhikṛtya bravīmi /
vidu  (svagatam) bhavatu / asyāvasaraṃ na dāsye /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (Aside) Very well! I shall not give him an opening.

children.text: vidu -- (svagatam) bhavatu / asya avasaraṃ na dāsye /
(prakāśam) bho vayasya te tāpasakanyakābhyarthanīyā dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: (Aloud) My friend, that hermit's daughter seems to be one worth courting by you.

children.text: (prakāśam) bho vayasya te tāpasa-kanyaka ābhyarthanīyā dṛśyate /
rā  sakhe na parihārye vastuni pauravāṇāṃ manaḥ pravartate /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, the mind of the <s>Paurava</s> dynasty does not turn to improper objects.

children.text: rā -- sakhe na parihārye vastuni pauravāṇāṃ manaḥ pravartate /
surayuvatisaṃbhavaṃ kila muner apatyaṃ tad ujjhitādhigatam /
children.translated_text: The offspring of the sage, born of a celestial nymph, was abandoned and then found;

children.text: arkasyopari śithilaṃ cyutam iva navamālikākusumam //
children.translated_text: like a fresh <s>mālikā</s> jasmine blossom fallen loosely from atop the <s>arka</s> plant.

children.text: sura-yuvati-saṃbhavaṃ kila muner apatyaṃ tad ujjhita-adhigatam /
arkasya upari śithilaṃ cyutam iva nava-mālikā-kusumam //
vidu  )vihasya) yathā kasya api piṇḍakharjūrair udvejitasya tiṇḍyām (tintiṇyām) abhilāṣo bhavet tathā strīratnaparibhogiṇaḥ bhavata iyam abhyarthanā /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (Laughing) Just as one tormented by date-palm lumps might develop a craving for tamarind, so is this courtship of yours, you who are accustomed to the enjoyment of jewels among women!

children.text: vidu -- )vihasya) yathā kasya api piṇḍa-kharjūrair udvejitasya tiṇḍyām (tintiṇyām) abhilāṣo bhavet tathā strī-ratna-paribhogiṇaḥ bhavata iyam abhyarthanā /
rā  na tāvad enāṃ paśyāmi yenaivam avādīḥ /
children.translated_text: King: You say this because you have not yet seen her.

children.text: rā -- na tāvad enāṃ paśyāmi yena evam avādīḥ /
vidu  tat khalu ramaṇīyaṃ yad bhavato 'pi vismayam utpādayati /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: It must be truly beautiful if it astonishes even you.

children.text: vidu -- tat khalu ramaṇīyaṃ yad bhavato 'pi vismayam utpādayati /
rā  vayasya kiṃ bahunā /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, what more can I say?

children.text: rā -- vayasya kiṃ bahunā /
citre niveśye parikalpitasattvayogā
rūpoccayena manasā vidhinā kṛtā nu /
children.translated_text: fashioned by the Creator deliberately with an abundance of beauty—
Placed as if in a painting, endowed with an imagined perfection of form,

children.text: strīratnasṛṣṭir aparā pratibhāti sā me
dhātur vibhutvam anucintya vapuś ca tasyāḥ //
children.translated_text: contemplating the Creator's omnipotence and her form, I marvel.
she appears to me as another creation of a jewel among women;

children.text: citre niveśye parikalpita-sattva-yogā
rūpa-uccayena manasā vidhinā kṛtā nu /
strī-ratna-sṛṣṭir aparā pratibhāti sā me
dhātur vibhutvam anucintya vapuś ca tasyāḥ //
vidu  yady evaṃ pratyādeśa idānīṃ rūpavatīnām /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: If that is so, then it is a rebuke to all other beautiful women.

children.text: vidu -- yady evaṃ pratyādeśa idānīṃ rūpavatīnām /
rā  idaṃ ca me manasi vartate /
children.translated_text: King: And this too occupies my mind—

children.text: rā -- idaṃ ca me manasi vartate /
anāghrātaṃ puṣpaṃ kisalayam alūnaṃ kararuhair anāviddhaṃ ratnaṃ madhu navam anāsvāditarasam /
children.translated_text: An unsmelled flower, a shoot unplucked by fingernails, an unpierced gem, fresh honey of untasted flavor,

children.text: akhaṇḍaṃ puṣyānāṃ phalam iva ca tadrūpam anaghaṃ na jāne bhoktāraṃ kam iha samupasthāsyati vidhiḥ //
children.translated_text: the undiminished fruit of merit, flawless in form—I know not to what enjoyer fate will present her.

children.text: anāghrātaṃ puṣpaṃ kisalayam alūnaṃ kara-ruhair anāviddhaṃ ratnaṃ madhu navam anāsvādita-rasam /
akhaṇḍaṃ puṣyānāṃ phalam iva ca tad-rūpam anaghaṃ na jāne bhoktāraṃ kam iha samupasthāsyati vidhiḥ //
vidu  tena hi laghu paritrāyatām enāṃ bhavān / mā kasya api tapasvina iṅgudītairacikkaṇaśīrṣasya haste patiṣyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Then rescue her quickly, lest she fall into the hands of some ascetic with a head slippery with <s>iṅgudī</s> oil!

children.text: vidu -- tena hi laghu paritrāyatām enāṃ bhavān / mā kasya api tapasvina iṅgudī-taira-cikkaṇa-śīrṣasya haste patiṣyati /
rā  paravatī khalu tatrabhavatī / na ca saṃnihito 'tra gurujanaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: She is under another's authority, and her guardians are not present here.

children.text: rā -- paravatī khalu tatra-bhavatī / na ca saṃnihito 'tra guru-janaḥ /
vidu  atha bhavantam antareṇa kīdṛśas tasyā dṛṣṭirāgaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: But what was the nature of her amorous glance toward you?

children.text: vidu -- atha bhavantam antareṇa kīdṛśas tasyā dṛṣṭi-rāgaḥ /
rājā  nisargād evāpragalbhas tapasvikanyājanaḥ / tathāpi tu
children.translated_text: King: By nature, the daughters of ascetics are not forward. And yet—

children.text: rājā -- nisargād eva apragalbhas tapasvi-kanyā-janaḥ / tatha āpi tu
abhimukhe mayi saṃhṛtam īkṣitaṃ hasitam anyanimitakṛtodayam /
children.translated_text: When I stood before her, she withdrew her gaze; her smile arose under the pretext of some other cause;

children.text: vinayavāritavṛttir atas tayā na vivṛto madano na ca saṃvṛtaḥ //
children.translated_text: her behavior restrained by modesty—thus love was by her neither revealed nor concealed.

children.text: abhimukhe mayi saṃhṛtam īkṣitaṃ hasitam anya-nimita-kṛta-udayam /
vinaya-vārita-vṛttir atas tayā na vivṛto madano na ca saṃvṛtaḥ //
vidu  na khalu dṛṣṭamātrasya tavāṅkaṃ samārohati /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Surely at first sight she did not climb onto your lap!

children.text: vidu -- na khalu dṛṣṭa-mātrasya tava aṅkaṃ samārohati /
rājā  mithaḥ prasthāne punaḥ śālīnatayā api kāmam āviṣkṛto bhāvas tatrabhavatyā / tathā hi /
children.translated_text: King: When we parted, she revealed her feelings despite her reserve. For—

children.text: rājā -- mithaḥ prasthāne punaḥ śālīnatayā api kāmam āviṣkṛto bhāvas tatra-bhavatyā / tathā hi /
darbhāṅkureṇa caraṇaḥ kṣata ity akhāṇḍe tanvī sthitā katicid eva padāni gatvā /
children.translated_text: "My foot is wounded by a <s>darbha</s>-grass sprout," she said, and the slender one stood still after walking only a few steps;

children.text: āsīd vivṛttavadanā ca vimocayantī śākhāsu valkalam asaktam api drumāṇām //
children.translated_text: and she turned her face back to free her bark garment from the tree branches, though it was not really caught.

children.text: darbha-aṅkureṇa caraṇaḥ kṣata ity akhāṇḍe tanvī sthitā katicid eva padāni gatvā /
āsīd vivṛtta-vadanā ca vimocayantī śākhāsu valkalam asaktam api drumāṇām //
vidu  tena hi gṛhītapātheyo bhava / kṛtaṃ tvayopavanaṃ tapovanam iti paśyāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Well then, stock up provisions! I see you have made the hermitage into a pleasure-garden.

children.text: vidu -- tena hi gṛhīta-pātheyo bhava / kṛtaṃ tvaya ūpavanaṃ tapo-vanam iti paśyāmi /
rā  sakhe tapasvibhiḥ kaiścit parijñāto 'smi / cintaya tāvat kenāpadeśena punar āśramapadaṃ gacchāmaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, some of the ascetics have recognized me. Think of some pretext by which we may visit the hermitage again.

children.text: rā -- sakhe tapasvibhiḥ kaiścit parijñāto 'smi / cintaya tāvat kena apadeśena punar āśrama-padaṃ gacchāmaḥ /
vidu  ko 'paro 'padeśo yuṣmākaṃ rājñām / nīvāraṣaṣṭhabhāgam asmākam upaharantv iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: What other pretext do you kings need? "Let them offer us the sixth part of their wild rice"—that will do!

children.text: vidu -- ko 'paro 'padeśo yuṣmākaṃ rājñām / nīvāra-ṣaṣṭha-bhāgam asmākam upaharantv iti /
rā  mūrkha anyam eva bhāgadheyam ete tapasvino nirvapanti yo ratnarāśīn api vihāyābhinandyate / paśya /
children.translated_text: King: Fool! These ascetics bestow a different kind of fortune — one that is cherished even when heaps of jewels are set aside. Behold:

children.text: rā -- mūrkha anyam eva bhāga-dheyam ete tapasvino nirvapanti yo ratna-rāśīn api vihāya abhinandyate / paśya /
yad uttiṣṭhati varṇebhyo nṛpāṇāṃ kṣayi tat phalam /
children.translated_text: The fruit that arises from the [warrior] classes for kings is perishable;

children.text: tapaḥṣaḍbhāgam akṣayyaṃ dadaty āraṇyakā hi naḥ //
children.translated_text: but the forest-dwelling sages give us an imperishable sixth share of their ascetic merit.

children.text: yad uttiṣṭhati varṇebhyo nṛpāṇāṃ kṣayi tat phalam /
tapaḥ-ṣaḍ-bhāgam akṣayyaṃ dadaty āraṇyakā hi naḥ //
(nepathye)
children.translated_text: (From behind the scenes:)

children.text: (nepathye)
hanta siddhārthau svaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Ah, our purpose is accomplished!'

children.text: hanta siddha-arthau svaḥ /
rā  (karṇaṃ dattvā) aye dhīrapraśāntasvarais tapasvibhir bhavitavyam /
children.translated_text: King: (Lending his ear) Ah, these must be ascetics, to judge by the calm, composed tone of their voices.

children.text: rā -- (karṇaṃ dattvā) aye dhīra-praśānta-svarais tapasvibhir bhavitavyam /
(praviśya)
children.translated_text: (Entering:)

children.text: (praviśya)
jayatu jayatu bhartā / etau dvau ṛṣikumārau pratīhārabhūmim upasthitau /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Victory, victory to the lord! Two young hermit-students have arrived at the audience-chamber.

children.text: jayatu jayatu bhartā / etau dvau ṛṣi-kumārau pratīhāra-bhūmim upasthitau /
rājā  tena hy avilambitaṃ praveśaya tau /
children.translated_text: King: Then admit them without delay.

children.text: rājā -- tena hy avilambitaṃ praveśaya tau /
dauvārika  eṣa praveśayāmi / (iti niṣkramya rṣikumārābhyāṃ saha praviśya)
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: I shall admit them. (He exits and re-enters with the two hermit-youths.)

children.text: dauvārika -- eṣa praveśayāmi / (iti niṣkramya rṣi-kumārābhyāṃ saha praviśya)
(ubhau rājānaṃ vilokayataḥ)
children.translated_text: (Both look at the king.)

children.text: (ubhau rājānaṃ vilokayataḥ)
prathamaḥ  aho dīptimato 'pi viśvasanīyatayāsya vapuṣaḥ / athavā upapannam etad asminn ṛṣibhyo nātibhinne rājani / kutaḥ
children.translated_text: First: Ah, what a trustworthy appearance this majestic personage has! But then, this is fitting in a king not greatly different from sages. For —

children.text: prathamaḥ -- aho dīptimato 'pi viśvasanīyataya āsya vapuṣaḥ / athavā upapannam etad asminn ṛṣibhyo na atibhinne rājani / kutaḥ
adhyākrāntā vasatir amunā apy āśrame sarvabhogye
rakṣāyogād ayam api tapaḥ pratyahaṃ saṃcinoti /
children.translated_text: by the observance of protection [of subjects], he too accumulates ascetic merit daily;
Though he dwells in a palace affording every luxury,

children.text: asyāpi dyāṃ spṛśati vaśinaś cāraṇadvandvagītaḥ
puṇyaḥśabdo munir iti muhuhḥ kevalaṃ rājapūrvaḥ //
children.translated_text: only preceded by the title 'king' [rather than] 'sage.'
and the holy fame of this self-controlled one, sung by pairs of celestial bards, touches the sky —

children.text: adhyākrāntā vasatir amunā apy āśrame sarva-bhogye
rakṣā-yogād ayam api tapaḥ pratyahaṃ saṃcinoti /
asya api dyāṃ spṛśati vaśinaś cāraṇa-dvandva-gītaḥ
puṇyaḥ-śabdo munir iti muhuhḥ kevalaṃ rāja-pūrvaḥ //
dvitīyaḥ  gautama ayaṃ sa balabhit sakho duṣyantaḥ /
children.translated_text: Second: <s>Gautama</s>, this is that <s>Duṣyanta</s>, the friend of <s>Balabhit</s> (<s>Indra</s>).

children.text: dvitīyaḥ -- gautama ayaṃ sa balabhit sakho duṣyantaḥ /
prathama  atha kim /
children.translated_text: First: Naturally!

children.text: prathama -- atha kim /
dvitīyahḥ  tena hi
children.translated_text: Second: Therefore —

children.text: dvitīyahḥ -- tena hi
naitac citraṃ yad ayam udadhiśyāmasīmāṃ dharitrīm ekaḥ kṛtsnāṃ nagaraparighaprāṃśubāhur bhunakti /
children.translated_text: It is no wonder that he alone, whose arms are tall as city-ramparts, enjoys this entire earth bounded by the dark-blue ocean;

children.text: āśaṃsante samitiṣu surā baddhavairā hi daityair asyādhijye dhanuṣi vijayaṃ pauruhūte ca vajre //
children.translated_text: for the gods, at enmity with the <s>Daityas</s>, expect victory from his bow when strung, as from the thunderbolt of <s>Pauruhūta</s> (<s>Indra</s>) in battle.

children.text: na etac citraṃ yad ayam udadhi-śyāma-sīmāṃ dharitrīm ekaḥ kṛtsnāṃ nagara-parigha-prāṃśu-bāhur bhunakti /
āśaṃsante samitiṣu surā baddha-vairā hi daityair asya adhijye dhanuṣi vijayaṃ pauruhūte ca vajre //
ubhau  (upagamya) vijayasva rājan /
children.translated_text: Both: (Approaching) Victory to the king!

children.text: ubhau -- (upagamya) vijayasva rājan /
rā  (āsanād utthāya) abhivādaye bhavantau /
children.translated_text: King: (Rising from his seat) I salute you both.

children.text: rā -- (āsanād utthāya) abhivādaye bhavantau /
ubhau  svasti bhavate / (iti phalāny upaharataḥ)
children.translated_text: Both: Blessings upon you! (They offer fruits.)

children.text: ubhau -- svasti bhavate / (iti phalāny upaharataḥ)
rā  (sapraṇāmaṃ parigṛhya) ājñāpayitum icchāmi /
children.translated_text: King: (Accepting with a bow) I wish to receive your command.

children.text: rā -- (sapraṇāmaṃ parigṛhya) ājñāpayitum icchāmi /
ubhau  vidito bhavān āśramasadām ihasthaḥ / tena bhavantaṃ prārthayante /
children.translated_text: Both: You are known to the hermitage-dwellers present here. Therefore they entreat you:

children.text: ubhau -- vidito bhavān āśrama-sadām ihasthaḥ / tena bhavantaṃ prārthayante /
rā  kim ājñāpayanti /
children.translated_text: King: What do they command?

children.text: rā -- kim ājñāpayanti /
ubhau  tatrabhavataḥ kaṇvasya maharṣer asāṃnidhyād rakṣāṃsi neṣṭivighnam utpādayanti / tat katipayarātraṃ sārathidvitīyena bhavatā sanāthīkriyatām āśrama iti /
children.translated_text: Both: In the absence of the revered great sage <s>Kaṇva</s>, demons are creating obstacles to the sacrificial rites. Therefore, let the hermitage be protected for a few nights by your Lordship, accompanied only by your charioteer.

children.text: ubhau -- tatra-bhavataḥ kaṇvasya maharṣer asāṃnidhyād rakṣāṃsi na iṣṭi-vighnam utpādayanti / tat katipaya-rātraṃ sārathi-dvitīyena bhavatā sanāthī-kriyatām āśrama iti /
rā  anugṛhīto 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: I am honored.

children.text: rā -- anugṛhīto 'smi /
vidu  (apavārya) eṣā idānīm anukūlā te 'bhyarthanā /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: (Aside) Now this is a request suited to your wishes!

children.text: vidu -- (apavārya) eṣā idānīm anukūlā te 'bhyarthanā /
rā  (smitaṃ kṛtvā) raivataka madvacanād ucyatāṃ sārathiḥ / sabāṇāsanaṃ ratham upasthāpaya iti /
children.translated_text: King: (Smiling) <s>Raivataka</s>, tell the charioteer on my behalf: 'Bring the chariot ready with bow and arrows.'

children.text: rā -- (smitaṃ kṛtvā) raivataka mad-vacanād ucyatāṃ sārathiḥ / sabāṇa-āsanaṃ ratham upasthāpaya iti /
dau  yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: As the lord commands. (He exits.)

children.text: dau -- yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
ubhau  (saharṣam)
children.translated_text: Both: (With delight)

children.text: ubhau -- (saharṣam)
anukāriṇi pūrveṣāṃ yuktarūpam idaṃ tvayi /
children.translated_text: 'This is fitting for you who follow in the footsteps of your ancestors —

children.text: āpannābhayasatreṣu dīkṣitāḥ khalu pauravāḥ //
children.translated_text: the <s>Pauravas</s> are indeed consecrated in the perpetual rite of granting refuge to the distressed.'

children.text: anukāriṇi pūrveṣāṃ yukta-rūpam idaṃ tvayi /
āpanna-abhaya-satreṣu dīkṣitāḥ khalu pauravāḥ //
rā  (sapraṇāmam) gacchatāṃ puro bhavantau / aham apy anupadam āgata eva /
children.translated_text: King: (With a bow) Go ahead, both of you. I shall follow immediately.

children.text: rā -- (sapraṇāmam) gacchatāṃ puro bhavantau / aham apy anupadam āgata eva /
ubhau  vijayasva (iti niṣkrāntau)
children.translated_text: Both: Victory to you! (They exit.)

children.text: ubhau -- vijayasva (iti niṣkrāntau)
rā  mādhavya apy asti śakuntalādarśane kutūhalam /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mādhavya</s>, is there still curiosity to see <s>Śakuntalā</s>?

children.text: rā -- mādhavya apy asti śakuntalā-darśane kutūhalam /
vidu  prathamaṃ saparivāham āsīt / idānīṃ rākṣasavṛttāntena bindur api nāvaśeṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: At first it was overflowing. But now, with this talk of <s>Rākṣasas</s>, not even a drop remains!

children.text: vidu -- prathamaṃ saparivāham āsīt / idānīṃ rākṣasa-vṛtta-antena bindur api na avaśeṣitaḥ /
rā  mā bhaiṣīḥ / nanu matsamīpe vartiṣyase /
children.translated_text: King: Do not fear! You will be staying near me, after all.

children.text: rā -- mā bhaiṣīḥ / nanu mat-samīpe vartiṣyase /
vidu  eṣa rākṣasād rakṣito 'smi /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: Then I am protected from the <s>Rākṣasas</s>!

children.text: vidu -- eṣa rākṣasād rakṣito 'smi /
(praviśya)
children.translated_text: (Entering:)

children.text: (praviśya)
dau  sajjo ratho bhartur vijayaprasthānam apekṣate / eṣa punar nagarād devīnāṃ jñaptiharaḥ karabhaka āgataḥ
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: The chariot is ready and awaits the lord's departure for victory. And here, from the city, <s>Karabhaka</s> has arrived as the bearer of a message from the queens.

children.text: dau -- sajjo ratho bhartur vijaya-prasthānam apekṣate / eṣa punar nagarād devīnāṃ jñapti-haraḥ karabhaka āgataḥ
rā  (sādaram) im ambābhiḥ preṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (Respectfully) Ah, he has been sent by the mothers?

children.text: rā -- (sādaram) im ambābhiḥ preṣitaḥ /
dau  atha kim /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Indeed.

children.text: dau -- atha kim /
rā  nanu praveśyatām /
children.translated_text: King: Then let him be admitted.

children.text: rā -- nanu praveśyatām /
dau  tathā / (iti niṣkramya karabhakeṇa saha praviśya) eṣa bhartā / upasarpa /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Very well. (He exits and re-enters with <s>Karabhaka</s>.) Here is the lord. Approach.

children.text: dau -- tathā / (iti niṣkramya karabhakeṇa saha praviśya) eṣa bhartā / upasarpa /
karabhaka  jayatu jayatu bhartā / devy ājñāpayati / āgāmini caturthadivase pravṛttapāraṇo me upavāso bhaviṣyati / tatra dīrghāyuṣāvaśyaṃ saṃbhāvanīyeti /
children.translated_text: <s>Karabhaka</s>: Victory, victory to the lord! The queen commands: 'On the fourth day hence, my fast with its concluding rites will take place. There, the long-lived one must certainly attend with honor.'

children.text: karabhaka -- jayatu jayatu bhartā / devy ājñāpayati / āgāmini caturtha-divase pravṛtta-pāraṇo me upavāso bhaviṣyati / tatra dīrgha-āyuṣa āvaśyaṃ saṃbhāvanīya īti /
rā  itas tapasvikāryam / ito gurujanājñā / dvayam apy anatikramaṇīyam / kim atra pratividheyam /
children.translated_text: King: On one hand, the duty to the ascetics; on the other, the command of an elder. Both are not to be transgressed. What remedy is there?

children.text: rā -- itas tapasvi-kāryam / ito guru-jana-ājñā / dvayam apy anatikramaṇīyam / kim atra pratividheyam /
vidu  triśaṅkur ivāntarā tiṣṭha /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: Stand in between, like <s>Triśaṅku</s>!

children.text: vidu -- triśaṅkur iva antarā tiṣṭha /
rā  satyam ākulībhūto 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: Truly, I am perplexed.

children.text: rā -- satyam ākulī-bhūto 'smi /
kṛtyayor bhinnadeśatvād dvaidhībhavati me manaḥ /
children.translated_text: My mind is divided in two by the different locations of the two duties,

children.text: puraḥ patihataṃ śaile srotaḥ srotovaho yathā //
children.translated_text: like a river's current striking a rock and splitting before it.

children.text: kṛtyayor bhinna-deśatvād dvaidhī-bhavati me manaḥ /
puraḥ patihataṃ śaile srotaḥ sroto-vaho yathā //
(vicintya) sakhe tvam ambayā putra iti pratigṛhītaḥ / ato bhavān itaḥ pratinivṛtya tapasvikāryavyagramānasaṃ mām āvedya tatrabhavatīnāṃ putrakṛtyam anuṣṭhātum arhati /
children.translated_text: (Reflecting) Friend, you have been accepted by my mother as a son. Therefore, please return from here and, informing the reverend ladies that my mind is occupied with the ascetics' business, fulfill the filial duty to them on my behalf.

children.text: (vicintya) sakhe tvam ambayā putra iti pratigṛhītaḥ / ato bhavān itaḥ pratinivṛtya tapasvi-kārya-vyagra-mānasaṃ mām āvedya tatra-bhavatīnāṃ putra-kṛtyam anuṣṭhātum arhati /
vidu  na khalu māṃ rakṣobhīrukaṃ gaṇayasi /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: Surely you do not count me as one who is afraid of demons?

children.text: vidu -- na khalu māṃ rakṣo-bhīrukaṃ gaṇayasi /
rā  (sasmitam) katham etad bhavati saṃbhāvyate /
children.translated_text: King: (With a smile) How can such a thing be supposed of you?

children.text: rā -- (sasmitam) katham etad bhavati saṃbhāvyate /
vidu  yathā rājānujena gantavyaṃ tathā gacchāmi /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: Then I shall go as befits a king's younger brother!

children.text: vidu -- yathā rāja-anujena gantavyaṃ tathā gacchāmi /
rā  nanu tapovanoparodhaḥ pariharaṇīya iti sarvān ānuyātrikāṃs tvayaiva saha prasthāpayāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Indeed, to avoid disturbing the penance-grove, I shall send the entire retinue along with you.

children.text: rā -- nanu tapo-vana-uparodhaḥ pariharaṇīya iti sarvān ānuyātrikāṃs tvaya aiva saha prasthāpayāmi /
vidu  (sagarvam) tena hi yuvarājo 'smīdānīṃ saṃvṛttaḥ /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: (Proudly) Then I have now become the crown prince!

children.text: vidu -- (sagarvam) tena hi yuva-rājo 'smi idānīṃ saṃvṛttaḥ /

rā  (svagatam) capalo 'yaṃ baṭuḥ / kadācid asmatprārthanām antaḥpurebhyaḥ kathayet / bhavatu / enam evaṃ vakṣye / (vidūṣakaṃ haste gṛhītvā / prakāśam) vayasya ṛṣigauravād āśramaṃ gacchāmi / na khalu satyam eva tāpasakanyakāyāṃ mamābhilāṣaḥ / paśya /
children.translated_text: King: (Aside) This young man is flighty. He might blurt out my intentions to the ladies of the inner quarters. Very well, I shall say this to him. (Taking the Vidūṣaka by the hand; aloud:) Friend, I go to the hermitage out of reverence for the sages. Truly, I have no desire for the ascetic's daughter. Consider —

children.text: rā -- (svagatam) capalo 'yaṃ baṭuḥ / kadācid asmat-prārthanām antaḥ-purebhyaḥ kathayet / bhavatu / enam evaṃ vakṣye / (vidūṣakaṃ haste gṛhītvā / prakāśam) vayasya ṛṣi-gauravād āśramaṃ gacchāmi / na khalu satyam eva tāpasa-kanyakāyāṃ mama abhilāṣaḥ / paśya /
kva vayaṃ kva parokṣamanmatho mṛgaśāvaiḥ samam edhito janaḥ /
children.translated_text: What have we — and what has a person raised alongside young deer, whose love-passion is unseen?

children.text: parihāsavijalpitaṃ sakhe paramārthena na gṛhyatāṃ vacaḥ //
children.translated_text: Friend, do not take seriously words spoken in jest!

children.text: kva vayaṃ kva parokṣa-manmatho mṛga-śāvaiḥ samam edhito janaḥ /
parihāsa-vijalpitaṃ sakhe parama-arthena na gṛhyatāṃ vacaḥ //
vidu  atha kim /
children.translated_text: Vidūṣaka: Naturally!

children.text: vidu -- atha kim /
(iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
children.translated_text: (All exit.)

children.text: (iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
iti dvitīyo 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus ends the second act.

children.text: tṛtīyo 'ṅkaḥ
children.translated_text: Third Act

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati kuśān ādāya yajamānaśiṣyaḥ)
children.translated_text: (Then enters a pupil of the sacrificer, carrying <s>kuśa</s> grass.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati kuśān ādāya yajamāna-śiṣyaḥ)
śiṣya  aho mahānubhāvaḥ pārthivo duṣyantaḥ / yat praviṣṭamātra evāśramaṃ tatrabhavati nirupadravāṇi naḥ karmāṇi saṃvṛttāni /
children.translated_text: Pupil: Ah, how magnificent is King <s>Duṣyanta</s>! For the moment he entered the hermitage, our rites became free from obstacles.

children.text: śiṣya -- aho mahānubhāvaḥ pārthivo duṣyantaḥ / yat praviṣṭa-mātra evā aśramaṃ tatra-bhavati nirupadravāṇi naḥ karmāṇi saṃvṛttāni /
kā kathā bāṇasaṃdhāne jyāśabdenaiva dūrataḥ /
children.translated_text: What need to speak of fitting an arrow [to the bow]? By the mere twang of the bowstring from afar,

children.text: huṃkāreṇeva dhanuṣaḥ sa hi vighnān apohati //
children.translated_text: as by a mere roar of his bow, he removes all obstacles.

children.text: kā kathā bāṇa-saṃdhāne jyā-śabdena eva dūrataḥ /
huṃkāreṇa iva dhanuṣaḥ sa hi vighnān apohati //

yāvad imān vedisaṃstaraṇārthaṃ darbhān ṛtvigbhya upaharāmi / (parikramyāvalokya ca / ākāśe) priyaṃvade kasya idam uśīrānulepanaṃ mṛṇālavanti ca nalinīpatrāṇi nīyante / (śrutim abhinīya) kiṃ bravīṣi / ātapalaṅghanād balavad asvasthā śakuntalā tasyāḥ śarīranirvāpaṇāyeti /
KSak_3.1a tarhi yatnād upacaryatām / sā khalu bhagavataḥ kaṇvasya kulapater ucchvasitam / aham api tāvad vaitānikaṃ śānty udakam asyai gautamīhaste visarjayiṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: Then let her be attended to with care! She is truly the breath of the revered <s>Kaṇva</s>, the head of the household. Meanwhile, I shall send <s>Gautamī</s> this ritual peace-water for her. (He exits.)

Let me offer these <s>darbha</s> grasses to the priests for strewing on the sacrificial altar. (Walking about and looking; to the air:) <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>, for whom is this <s>uśīra</s> (vetiver) body-ointment and these lotus-leaves with fibers being carried? (Indicating he has heard) What do you say? That <s>Śakuntalā</s> is very unwell from sun-exposure, and these are for cooling her body?

children.text: yāvad imān vedi-saṃstaraṇa-arthaṃ darbhān ṛtvigbhya upaharāmi / (parikramya avalokya ca / ākāśe) priyaṃvade kasya idam uśīra-anulepanaṃ mṛṇālavanti ca nalinī-patrāṇi nīyante / (śrutim abhinīya) kiṃ bravīṣi / ātapa-laṅghanād balavad asvasthā śakuntalā tasyāḥ śarīra-nirvāpaṇāya iti /
KSak_3.1a2 tarhi yatnād upacaryatām / sā khalu bhagavataḥ kaṇvasya kula-pater ucchvasitam / aham api tāvad vaitānikaṃ śānty udakam asyai gautamī-haste visarjayiṣyāmi /
(iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
KSak_3.1a viṣkambhakaḥ /
children.translated_text: Interlude.

children.text: (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
KSak_3.1a4 viṣkambhakaḥ /
(tataḥ praviśati kāmayamānāvastho rājā)
children.translated_text: (Then enters the king, in a state of lovesickness.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati kāmayamāna-avastho rājā)
rājā  (sacintaṃ niḥśvasya)
children.translated_text: King: (Sighing pensively)

children.text: rājā -- (sacintaṃ niḥśvasya)
jāne tapaso vīryaṃ sā bālā paravatīti me viditam /
children.translated_text: I know the power of austerity, and that the maiden belongs to another — this is known to me;

children.text: alam asmi tato hṛdayaṃ tathāpi nedaṃ nivartayitum //
children.translated_text: enough — yet this heart cannot be turned back from her.

children.text: jāne tapaso vīryaṃ sā bālā paravati īti me viditam /
alam asmi tato hṛdayaṃ tatha āpi na idaṃ nivartayitum //
(madanabādhāṃ nirūpya) bhagavan kusumāyudha tvayā candramasā ca viśvasanīyābhyām atisaṃdhīyate kāmijanasārthaḥ / kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: (Displaying the pangs of love) O Lord <s>Kusumāyudha</s> (Flower-armed <s>Kāma</s>), and you, O Moon — both supposed to be trustworthy — the caravan of lovers is being betrayed by you! For —

children.text: (madana-bādhāṃ nirūpya) bhagavan kusuma-āyudha tvayā candramasā ca viśvasanīyābhyām atisaṃdhīyate kāmi-jana-sārthaḥ / kutaḥ /
tava kusumaśaratvaṃ śītaraśmitvam indor
dvayam idam ayathārthaṃ dṛśyate madvidheṣu /
children.translated_text: both are seen to be untrue in the case of those like me;
Your being 'flower-arrowed' and the moon's being 'cool-rayed' —

children.text: visṛjati himagarbhair agnim indur mayūkhais
tvam api kusumabāṇān vajrasārīkaroṣi //
children.translated_text: and you too make your flower-arrows hard as diamond!
the moon, with its frost-bearing rays, shoots fire,

children.text: tava kusuma-śaratvaṃ śīta-raśmitvam indor
dvayam idam ayathā-arthaṃ dṛśyate mad-vidheṣu /
visṛjati hima-garbhair agnim indur mayūkhais
tvam api kusuma-bāṇān vajra-sārī-karoṣi //
athavā /
children.translated_text: Or else —

children.text: athavā /
adya api nūnaṃ harakopavahninas tvayi jvalaty aurva ivāmburāśau /
children.translated_text: Even now, surely, the fire of <s>Hara</s>'s (<s>Śiva</s>'s) wrath burns in you — like the submarine fire in the ocean;

children.text: tvam anyathā manmatha madvidhānāṃ bhasmāvaśeṣaḥ katham ittham uṣṇaḥ //
children.translated_text: otherwise, O <s>Manmatha</s> (Love), how could you, reduced to ashes, be so hot for those like me?

children.text: adya api nūnaṃ hara-kopa-vahninas tvayi jvalaty aurva iva ambu-rāśau /
tvam anyathā manmatha mad-vidhānāṃ bhasma-avaśeṣaḥ katham ittham uṣṇaḥ //
aniśam api makaraketur manaor rujam āvahann abhimato me /
children.translated_text: Even though the Makara-bannered one (<s>Kāma</s>) incessantly brings pain to my heart, he is dear to me —

children.text: yadi madirāyatanayanāṃ tām adhikṛtya praharatīti //
children.translated_text: if he strikes with reference to her of the wine-dark, wide eyes.

children.text: aniśam api makara-ketur manaor rujam āvahann abhimato me /
yadi madira-āyata-nayanāṃ tām adhikṛtya praharati iti //
(sakhedaṃ parikramya) kva nu khalu saṃsthite karmaṇi sadasyair anujñātaḥ khinnam ātmānaṃ vinodayāmi /
KSak_3.4a (niḥśvasya) kiṃ nu khalu me priyādarśanād ṛte śaraṇam anyat /
children.translated_text: (Sighing) What refuge is there for me other than the sight of my beloved?
(Walking about despondently) Where indeed, now that the ritual duties are accomplished and the priests have given leave, may I divert my weary self?

children.text: (sakhedaṃ parikramya) kva nu khalu saṃsthite karmaṇi sadasyair anujñātaḥ khinnam ātmānaṃ vinodayāmi /
KSak_3.4a2 (niḥśvasya) kiṃ nu khalu me priyā-darśanād ṛte śaraṇam anyat /
yāvad enām anviṣyāmi / (sūryam avalokya) imām ugrātapavelāṃ prāyeṇa latāvalayavatsu mālinītīreṣu sasakhījanā śakuntalā gamayati /
KSak_3.4a tatraiva tāvad gacchāmi / (parikramya saṃsparśaṃ rūpayitvā) aho pravātasubhago 'yam uddeśaḥ /
children.translated_text: Let me go there. (Walking about and indicating the sensation of touch) Ah, this is a spot delightful with breezes!

Let me seek her out. (Looking at the sun) In this hour of fierce heat, <s>Śakuntalā</s> probably spends her time with her companions on the banks of the <s>Mālinī</s> river, among the bowers of creepers.

children.text: yāvad enām anviṣyāmi / (sūryam avalokya) imām ugra-ātapa-velāṃ prāyeṇa latā-valayavatsu mālinī-tīreṣu sasakhī-janā śakuntalā gamayati /
KSak_3.4a4 tatra eva tāvad gacchāmi / (parikramya saṃsparśaṃ rūpayitvā) aho pravāta-subhago 'yam uddeśaḥ /
śakyam aravindasurabhiḥ kaṇavāhī mālinītaraṅgāṇām /
children.translated_text: The wind, fragrant with lotuses, carrying the ripples of the <s>Mālinī</s>,

children.text: aṅgair anaṅgataptair aviralam āliṅgituṃ pavanaḥ //
children.translated_text: can be ceaselessly embraced with limbs scorched by the bodiless one (<s>Kāma</s>).

children.text: śakyam aravinda-surabhiḥ kaṇa-vāhī mālinī-taraṅgāṇām /
aṅgair anaṅga-taptair aviralam āliṅgituṃ pavanaḥ //
(parikramyāvalokya ca) asmin vetasaparikṣipte latāmaṇḍape saṃnihitayā śakuntalayā bhavitavyam / tathā hi /
children.translated_text: (Walking about and looking) In this bower of creepers, enclosed by <s>vetasa</s> (cane) plants, <s>Śakuntalā</s> must be present. For —

children.text: (parikramya avalokya ca) asmin vetasa-parikṣipte latā-maṇḍape saṃnihitayā śakuntalayā bhavitavyam / tathā hi /
abnyunnatā purastād avagāḍhā jaghanagauravāt paścāt /
children.translated_text: Raised in front, sunk behind from the heaviness of the hips,

children.text: dvāre 'sya pāṇḍusikate padapaṅktir dṛśyate 'bhinavā //
children.translated_text: a fresh row of footprints is visible in the pale sand at its entrance.

children.text: abnyunnatā purastād avagāḍhā jaghana-gauravāt paścāt /
dvāre 'sya pāṇḍu-sikate pada-paṅktir dṛśyate 'bhinavā //
yāvad viṭapāntareṇāvalokayāmi / (parikramya tathā kṛtvā / saharṣam) aye labdhaṃ netranirvāṇam /
children.translated_text: Let me look through the gaps in the branches. (Walking about and doing so; with delight) Ah, I have found refreshment for my eyes!

children.text: yāvad viṭapa-antareṇa avalokayāmi / (parikramya tathā kṛtvā / saharṣam) aye labdhaṃ netra-nirvāṇam /
eṣā me manorathapriyatamā sakusumāstaraṇaṃ śilāpaṭṭam adhiśayānā sakhībhyām anvāsyate / bhavatu /śroṣyāmy āsāṃ viśrambhakathitāni / (iti vilokayan sthitaḥ)
children.translated_text: Here is she, the beloved of my desires, reclining upon a stone slab strewn with flowers, attended by her two friends. Well then, I shall listen to their intimate conversation. (He stands watching.)

children.text: eṣā me manoratha-priyatamā sakusuma-āstaraṇaṃ śilā-paṭṭam adhiśayānā sakhībhyām anvāsyate / bhavatu /śroṣyāmy āsāṃ viśrambha-kathitāni / (iti vilokayan sthitaḥ)
(tataḥ praviśati yathoktavyāpārā saha sakhībhyāṃ śakuntalā)
children.translated_text: (Then <s>Śakuntalā</s> enters, engaged in the described activity, together with her two friends.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati yathā-ukta-vyāpārā saha sakhībhyāṃ śakuntalā)
sakhyau  (upavījya / sasneham) halā śakuntare api sukhayati nalinīpatravātaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both friends: (Fanning her; affectionately) Dear <s>Śakuntalā</s>, does the breeze from the lotus-leaf bring you comfort?

children.text: sakhyau -- (upavījya / sasneham) halā śakuntare api sukhayati nalinī-patra-vātaḥ /
śaku  kiṃ vījayato māṃ sakhyau /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Do my friends fan me? [Why?]

children.text: śaku -- kiṃ vījayato māṃ sakhyau /
(sakhyau viṣādaṃ nāṭayitvā parasparam avalokayataḥ)
children.translated_text: (The two friends act out dejection and look at each other.)

children.text: (sakhyau viṣādaṃ nāṭayitvā parasparam avalokayataḥ)
rājā  balavadasvasthaśarīrā śakuntalā dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Śakuntalā</s> appears to be in a very unwell condition.

children.text: rājā -- balavad-asvastha-śarīrā śakuntalā dṛśyate /
(savitarkam) tat kim ayam ātapadoṣaḥ syād uta yathā me manasi vartate / (sābhilāṣaṃ nirvarṇya) atha vā kṛtaṃ saṃdehena /
children.translated_text: (Reflectively) Could this be the effect of sunstroke, or is it as it stirs in my mind? (Gazing with longing) Or rather, away with doubt!

children.text: (savitarkam) tat kim ayam ātapa-doṣaḥ syād uta yathā me manasi vartate / (sa-abhilāṣaṃ nirvarṇya) atha vā kṛtaṃ saṃdehena /
stananyastośīraṃ praśithilamṛṇālaikavalayam
priyāyāḥ sābādhaṃ kim api kamanīyaṃ vapur idam /
children.translated_text: this body of my beloved is somehow painfully yet bewitchingly lovely;
With <s>uśīra</s> (vetiver) pressed against her breasts, a single bracelet of loosened lotus-stalks,

children.text: samas tāpaḥ kāmaṃ manasijanidāghaprasarayor
na tu grīṣmasyaivaṃ subhagam aparādhaṃ yuvatiṣu //
children.translated_text: yet the offense against young women is not so charmingly [attributable to] summer alone.
though the cause of distress is equally attributable to the spread of the bodiless one's (<s>Kāma</s>'s) summer heat,

children.text: stana-nyasta-uśīraṃ praśithila-mṛṇāla-eka-valayam
priyāyāḥ sābādhaṃ kim api kamanīyaṃ vapur idam /
samas tāpaḥ kāmaṃ manasija-nidāgha-prasarayor
na tu grīṣmasya evaṃ subhagam aparādhaṃ yuvatiṣu //
priyaṃvadā  (janāntikam) anasūye tasya rājarṣeḥ prathamadarśanārabhya paryutsukeva śakuntalā / kiṃ nu khalv asyās tannimitto 'yam ātaṅko bhavet /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Aside) <s>Anasūyā</s>, ever since that first sight of the royal sage, <s>Śakuntalā</s> has seemed restless. Could this affliction of hers be caused by him?

children.text: priyaṃvadā -- (jana-antikam) anasūye tasya rājarṣeḥ prathama-darśana-ārabhya paryutsuka īva śakuntalā / kiṃ nu khalv asyās tan-nimitto 'yam ātaṅko bhavet /
ana  sakhi mama apīdṛśy āśaṅkā hṛdayasya / bhavatu / pravakṣyāmi tāvad enām (prakāśam) / sakhi praṣṭavyāsi kim api / balavān khalu te saṃtāpaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Friend, such is my heart's suspicion too. Well then, I shall ask her. (Aloud) Friend, there is something I wish to ask you. Your distress is clearly severe.

children.text: ana -- sakhi mama apī idṛśy āśaṅkā hṛdayasya / bhavatu / pravakṣyāmi tāvad enām (prakāśam) / sakhi praṣṭavya āsi kim api / balavān khalu te saṃtāpaḥ /
śaku  (pūrvārdhena śayanād utthāya) halā kiṃ vaktukāmāsi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Half-rising from her reclining position) Friend, what do you wish to say?

children.text: śaku -- (pūrva-ardhena śayanād utthāya) halā kiṃ vaktu-kāma āsi /
ana  halā śakuntale anabhyantare khalv āvāṃ madanagatasya vṛttāntasya / kiṃ tu yādṛśītihāsabandheṣu kāmayamānānām avasthā śrūyate tādṛśīṃ tava paśyāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Dear <s>Śakuntalā</s>, though we are not yet privy to the full account of your love-sickness, the condition I see in you resembles what is described in tales of those who are lovesick.

children.text: ana -- halā śakuntale anabhyantare khalv āvāṃ madana-gatasya vṛtta-antasya / kiṃ tu yādṛśi ītihāsa-bandheṣu kāmayamānānām avasthā śrūyate tādṛśīṃ tava paśyāmi /
kathaya kiṃ nimittaṃ saṃtāpaḥ / vikāraṃ khalu paramārthato 'jñātvānārambhapratīkārasya /
children.translated_text: Tell us the cause of your distress. For without truly knowing the malady, there can be no beginning of a remedy.

children.text: kathaya kiṃ nimittaṃ saṃtāpaḥ / vikāraṃ khalu parama-arthato 'jñātva ānārambha-pratīkārasya /
rājā  anasūyām apy anugato madīyas tarkaḥ / na hi svāmiprāyeṇa me darśanam /
children.translated_text: King: What <s>Anasūyā</s> suggests accords with my own conjecture. For her symptoms are not at all typical of mere [physical illness].

children.text: rājā -- anasūyām apy anugato madīyas tarkaḥ / na hi svāmi-prāyeṇa me darśanam /
śaku  (ātmagatam) balavān khalu me 'bhiniveśaḥ / idānīm api sahasaitayor na śaknomi nivedayitum /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) My attachment is indeed powerful. Even now I cannot bring myself to confide in these two suddenly.

children.text: śaku -- (ātma-gatam) balavān khalu me 'bhiniveśaḥ / idānīm api sahasa aitayor na śaknomi nivedayitum /
priyaṃvadā  sakhi śakuntale suṣṭhu eṣā bhaṇati / kim ātmana ātaṅkam upekṣase / anudivasaṃ khalu parihīyase 'ṅgaiḥ / kevalaṃ lāvaṇyamayī chāyā tvāṃ na muñcati /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Friend <s>Śakuntalā</s>, she speaks well. Why do you neglect your own affliction? Day by day you are wasting away in body. Only the shadow of your beauty — that essence of grace — does not leave you.

children.text: priyaṃvadā -- sakhi śakuntale suṣṭhu eṣā bhaṇati / kim ātmana ātaṅkam upekṣase / anudivasaṃ khalu parihīyase 'ṅgaiḥ / kevalaṃ lāvaṇyamayī chāyā tvāṃ na muñcati /
rājā  avitatham āha priyaṃvadā / tathā hi
children.translated_text: King: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s> speaks truly. For indeed —

children.text: rājā -- avitatham āha priyaṃvadā / tathā hi
kṣāmakṣāmakapolam ānanam uraḥ kāṭhinyam uktastanam
madhyaḥ klāntataraḥ prakāmavinatāv aṃsau chaviḥ pāṇḍurā /
children.translated_text: her waist more languid, her shoulders drooping with abandon, her complexion pallid —
Her face with cheeks grown thin and gaunt, her breast whose firmness has softened,

children.text: śocyā ca priyadarśanā ca madanakliṣṭeyam ālakṣyate
patrāṇām iva śoṣaṇena marutā spṛṣṭā latā mādhavī //
children.translated_text: like a <s>mādhavī</s> (spring jasmine) creeper touched by the drying wind, with its leaves withering.
she is to be pitied and yet lovely to behold — this one afflicted by <s>Manmatha</s> (Love) is perceived

children.text: kṣāma-kṣāma-kapolam ānanam uraḥ kāṭhinyam ukta-stanam
madhyaḥ klāntataraḥ prakāma-vinatāv aṃsau chaviḥ pāṇḍurā /
śocyā ca priya-darśanā ca madana-kliṣṭa īyam ālakṣyate
patrāṇām iva śoṣaṇena marutā spṛṣṭā latā mādhavī //
śaku  sakhi kasya vānyasya kathayiṣyāmi / kiṃtv āyāsayitrīdānīṃ vāṃ bhaviṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Friend, to whom else would I tell it? But I shall only be a burden to you both now.

children.text: śaku -- sakhi kasya va ānyasya kathayiṣyāmi / kiṃtv āyāsayitri īdānīṃ vāṃ bhaviṣyāmi /
ubhe  ata eva khalu nirbandha / snigdhajanasaṃvibhaktaṃ hi duḥkhaṃ sahyavedanaṃ bhavati /
children.translated_text: Both: That is precisely why [we] insist! For sorrow shared with loving friends becomes bearable in its pain.

children.text: ubhe -- ata eva khalu nirbandha / snigdha-jana-saṃvibhaktaṃ hi duḥkhaṃ sahya-vedanaṃ bhavati /
rājā
children.translated_text: King:

children.text: rājā --
pṛṣṭā janena samaduḥkhasukhena bālā
neyaṃ na vakṣyati manogatam ādhihetum /
children.translated_text: will surely not fail to reveal the heart's desire that is the cause of her affliction;
When asked by companions who share equally in her joys and sorrows, this maiden

children.text: dṛṣṭo vivṛtya bahuśo 'py anayā satṛṣṇam
atrāntare śravaṇakātaratāṃ gato 'smi //
children.translated_text: in the meanwhile, I have reached a state of eager anticipation.
though often she has looked at me, opening [her eyes] wide with longing —

children.text: pṛṣṭā janena sama-duḥkha-sukhena bālā
na iyaṃ na vakṣyati mano-gatam ādhi-hetum /
dṛṣṭo vivṛtya bahuśo 'py anayā satṛṣṇam
atra-antare śravaṇa-kātaratāṃ gato 'smi //
śaku  sakhi yataḥprabhṛti mama darśanapatham āgataḥ sa tapovanarakṣitā rājarṣiḥ (ity arthokte lajāṃ nāṭayati)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Dear friend, ever since that royal sage, the protector of the ascetic grove, came within my sight — (At this half-spoken meaning, she mimes bashfulness.)

children.text: śaku -- sakhi yataḥ-prabhṛti mama darśana-patham āgataḥ sa tapo-vana-rakṣitā rājarṣiḥ (ity artha-ukte lajāṃ nāṭayati)
ubhe  kathayatu priyasakhī /
children.translated_text: Both: Let our dear friend tell us!

children.text: ubhe -- kathayatu priya-sakhī /
śaku  tata ārabhya tadgatenābhilāṣeṇa etad avasthāsmi saṃvṛttā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: From that time onwards, I have been brought to this condition by desire directed toward him.

children.text: śaku -- tata ārabhya tadgatena abhilāṣeṇa etad avastha āsmi saṃvṛttā /
rājā  (saharṣam) śrutaṃ śrotavyam /
children.translated_text: King: (With joy) I have heard what was worth hearing!

children.text: rājā -- (saharṣam) śrutaṃ śrotavyam /
smara eva tāpahetur nirvāpayitā sa eva me jātaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Smara</s> (Love) himself, the very cause of torment, has now become my relief —

children.text: divasa ivābhraśyāmas tapātyaye jīvalokasya //
children.translated_text: just as the day, which darkens with clouds, [becomes] the reviver of the living world when the heat has passed.

children.text: smara eva tāpa-hetur nirvāpayitā sa eva me jātaḥ /
divasa iva abhra-śyāmas tapa-atyaye jīva-lokasya //
śaku  tad yadi vām anumataṃ tathā vartethāṃ yathā tasya rājarṣer anukampanīyā bhavāmi / anyathāvaśyaṃ siñcata me tilodakam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Then, if you both approve, act in such a way that I become an object of compassion to that royal sage. Otherwise, you must surely pour the libation of sesame-water upon me [i.e., I shall die].

children.text: śaku -- tad yadi vām anumataṃ tathā vartethāṃ yathā tasya rājarṣer anukampanīyā bhavāmi / anyatha āvaśyaṃ siñcata me tila-udakam /
rājā  saṃśayachedi vacanam /
children.translated_text: King: Her words dispel all doubt!

children.text: rājā -- saṃśaya-chedi vacanam /
priyaṃvadā  (janāntikam) anasūye dūragatamanmathākṣameyaṃ kālaharaṇasya /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Aside) <s>Anasūyā</s>, she is far gone with love and cannot endure delay.

children.text: priyaṃvadā -- (jana-antikam) anasūye dūra-gata-manmatha ākṣama īyaṃ kāla-haraṇasya /
yasmin baddhabhāvaiṣā sa lalāmabhūtaḥ pauravāṇām / tad yuktam asyā abhilāṣo 'bhinanditum /
children.translated_text: He to whom she has given her heart is the ornament of the <s>Puru</s> dynasty. Therefore it is fitting that her desire be encouraged.

children.text: yasmin baddha-bhāva aiṣā sa lalāma-bhūtaḥ pauravāṇām / tad yuktam asyā abhilāṣo 'bhinanditum /
ana  tathā yathā bhaṇasi /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: It shall be as you say.

children.text: ana -- tathā yathā bhaṇasi /
pri  (prakāśam) sakhi diṣṭyānurūpas te 'bhiniveśaḥ / sāgaram ujjhitvā kutra vā mahānady avatarati / ka idānīṃ sahakāram antareṇātimuktalatāṃ pallavitāṃ sahate /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Aloud) Dear friend, fortunately your attachment is worthy [of you]! Where else would a great river flow, having passed by the ocean? Who indeed could endure seeing the <s>atimukta</s> (jasmine) creeper blossoming beside any tree other than the mango?

children.text: pri -- (prakāśam) sakhi diṣṭya ānurūpas te 'bhiniveśaḥ / sāgaram ujjhitvā kutra vā mahā-nady avatarati / ka idānīṃ sahakāram antareṇa atimukta-latāṃ pallavitāṃ sahate /
rājā  kim atra citraṃ yadi viśākhe śaśāṅkalekhām anuvartete /
children.translated_text: King: What wonder in this, if the twin stars of <s>Viśākhā</s> follow the crescent moon?

children.text: rājā -- kim atra citraṃ yadi viśākhe śaśa-aṅka-lekhām anuvartete /
ana  kaḥ punar upāyo bhaved yenāvilambitaṃ nibhṛtaṃ ca sakhyā manorathaṃ saṃpādayāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: But what means could there be by which we may swiftly and secretly fulfil our friend's heart's desire?

children.text: ana -- kaḥ punar upāyo bhaved yena avilambitaṃ nibhṛtaṃ ca sakhyā manorathaṃ saṃpādayāvaḥ /
pri  nibhṛtam iti cintanīyaṃ bhavet / śīghram iti sukaram /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: 'Secretly' requires thought; 'swiftly' is easy.

children.text: pri -- nibhṛtam iti cintanīyaṃ bhavet / śīghram iti sukaram /
ana  katham iva /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: How so?

children.text: ana -- katham iva /
pri  nanu sa rājarṣir asyāṃ snigdhadṛṣṭyā sūcitābhilāṣa etān divasān prajāgarakṛśo lakṣyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Why, that royal sage, with his affectionate gaze hinting at desire for her, is visibly grown thin from sleeplessness these days.

children.text: pri -- nanu sa rājarṣir asyāṃ snigdha-dṛṣṭyā sūcita-abhilāṣa etān divasān prajāgara-kṛśo lakṣyate /
rājā  satyam itthaṃ bhūta evāsmi / tathā hi
children.translated_text: King: Truly, that is just my state. For indeed —

children.text: rājā -- satyam itthaṃ bhūta eva asmi / tathā hi
idam aśiśirair antastāpād vivarṇam aṇīkṛtam
niśi niśi bhujanyastāpāṅgaprasāribhir aśrubhiḥ /
children.translated_text: [moistened] by the tears that spread night after night from my eyes resting sideways on my arm,
This [golden bracelet], discolored by the inner heat, made thin,

children.text: alabhilulitajyāghātāṅkaṃ muhur maṇibandhanāt
kanakavalayaṃ srastaṃ srastaṃ mayā pratisāryate //
children.translated_text: from the wrist — this golden bracelet is repeatedly pushed back by me.
unmarred by the bowstring's mark, repeatedly slipping, slipping

children.text: idam aśiśirair antas-tāpād vivarṇam aṇī-kṛtam
niśi niśi bhuja-nyasta-apāṅga-prasāribhir aśrubhiḥ /
alabhilulita-jyā-ghāta-aṅkaṃ muhur maṇi-bandhanāt
kanaka-valayaṃ srastaṃ srastaṃ mayā pratisāryate //
pri  (vicintya) halā madanalekho 'sya kriyatāṃ taṃ sumanogopitaṃ kṛtvā devaprasādasyāpadeśena tasya hastaṃ prāpayiṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Thinking) Dear friend, let a love-letter be composed for him. I shall conceal it in a flower-offering and, under the pretext of a temple-gift, deliver it into his hands.

children.text: pri -- (vicintya) halā madana-lekho 'sya kriyatāṃ taṃ sumano-gopitaṃ kṛtvā deva-prasādasya apadeśena tasya hastaṃ prāpayiṣyāmi /
ana  rocate me sukumāraḥ prayogaḥ kiṃ vā śakuntalā bhaṇati /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: I like this delicate stratagem. But what does <s>Śakuntalā</s> say?

children.text: ana -- rocate me sukumāraḥ prayogaḥ kiṃ vā śakuntalā bhaṇati /
śaku  kiṃ niyogo vāṃ vikalpyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: How can your plan be questioned?

children.text: śaku -- kiṃ niyogo vāṃ vikalpyate /
pri  tena hy ātmana upanyāsapūrvaṃ cintaya tāvat kim api lalitapadabandhanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Then, beginning with your own declaration, compose some verse of graceful words.

children.text: pri -- tena hy ātmana upanyāsa-pūrvaṃ cintaya tāvat kim api lalita-pada-bandhanam /
śaku  halā cintayāmy aham / avadhīraṇābhīrukaṃ punar vepate me hṛdayam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Dear friend, I shall try. But my heart trembles with the fear of rejection.

children.text: śaku -- halā cintayāmy aham / avadhīraṇā-bhīrukaṃ punar vepate me hṛdayam /
rājā  (saharṣam)
children.translated_text: King: (With joy)

children.text: rājā -- (saharṣam)
ayaṃ sa te tiṣṭhati saṃgamotsuko
viśaṅkase bhīru yato 'vadhīraṇām /
children.translated_text: yet you, timid one, fear rejection from him!
Here he stands, eager for union with you —

children.text: labheta vā prārthayitā na vā śriyam
śriyā durāpaḥ katham īpsito bhavet //
children.translated_text: how could the one desired by <s>Śrī</s> herself be hard to win?
Whether the suitor obtains <s>Śrī</s> (Fortune) or not —

children.text: ayaṃ sa te tiṣṭhati saṃgama-utsuko
viśaṅkase bhīru yato 'vadhīraṇām /
labheta vā prārthayitā na vā śriyam
śriyā durāpaḥ katham īpsito bhavet //
sakhyau  ayi ātmaguṇāvamānini ka idānīṃ śarīranirvāpayitrī śāradīṃ jyotsnāṃ paṭāntena vārayati /
children.translated_text: Both friends: O you who disparage your own virtues! Who indeed wards off the soothing autumnal moonlight with the edge of a cloth?

children.text: sakhyau -- ayi ātma-guṇa-avamānini ka idānīṃ śarīra-nirvāpayitrī śāradīṃ jyotsnāṃ paṭa-antena vārayati /
śaku  (sasmitam) niyojitedānīm asmi / (ity upaviṣṭāṃ cintayati)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (With a smile) I am under your orders now. (She sits down and thinks.)

children.text: śaku -- (sasmitam) niyojita īdānīm asmi / (ity upaviṣṭāṃ cintayati)
rājā  sthāne khalu vismṛta+nimeṣeṇa cakṣuṣā priyām avalokayāmi / yataḥ
children.translated_text: King: Rightly indeed do I gaze upon my beloved with unblinking eyes. For —

children.text: rājā -- sthāne khalu vismṛta+nimeṣeṇa cakṣuṣā priyām avalokayāmi / yataḥ --
unnamitaikabhrūlatam ānanam asyāḥ padāni racayantyāḥ /
children.translated_text: Her face, as she composes [the verse], with one eyebrow-creeper raised,

children.text: kaṇṭakitena prathayati may anurāgaṃ kapolena //
children.translated_text: reveals my love to me through her cheek, bristling with goosebumps.

children.text: unnamita-eka-bhrū-latam ānanam asyāḥ padāni racayantyāḥ /
kaṇṭakitena prathayati may anurāgaṃ kapolena //
śaku  halā cintitaṃ mayā gītavastu / asaṃnihitāni punar lekhanasādhanāni /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Dear friend, I have thought of the substance of a song, but I have no writing materials at hand.

children.text: śaku -- halā cintitaṃ mayā gīta-vastu / asaṃnihitāni punar lekhana-sādhanāni /
pri  etasmiñ śukodarasukumāre nalinīpatre nakhair nikṣiptavarṇaṃ kuru /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Inscribe it with your nails on this lotus leaf, tender as a parrot's belly.

children.text: pri -- etasmiñ śuka-udara-sukumāre nalinī-patre nakhair nikṣipta-varṇaṃ kuru /
śaku  (yathoktaṃ rūpayitvā) halā śṛṇutam idānīṃ saṃgatārthaṃ na veti /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Doing as directed) Dear friends, listen now [and tell me] whether the meaning holds together or not.

children.text: śaku -- (yathā-uktaṃ rūpayitvā) halā śṛṇutam idānīṃ saṃgata-arthaṃ na va īti /
ubhe  avahite svaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: We are attentive.

children.text: ubhe -- avahite svaḥ /
śaku  (vācayati)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Reading aloud:)

children.text: śaku -- (vācayati)
tava na jāne hṛdayaṃ mama punaḥ kāmo divā api rātrāv api /
children.translated_text: I do not know your heart; but mine — <s>Kāma</s> (Love), by day and by night,

children.text: nirghṛṇa tapati balīyas tvayi vṛttamanorathāyā aṅgāni //
children.translated_text: mercilessly scorches with overwhelming [heat] the limbs of me whose longings are centered on you.

children.text: tava na jāne hṛdayaṃ mama punaḥ kāmo divā api rātrāv api /
nirghṛṇa tapati balīyas tvayi vṛtta-manorathāyā aṅgāni //
rājā  (sahasopasṛtya)
children.translated_text: King: (Approaching suddenly)

children.text: rājā -- (sahasa ūpasṛtya)
tapati tanugātri madanas tvām aniśaṃ māṃ punar dahaty eva /
children.translated_text: Love scorches you, O slender-limbed one, unceasingly — but me he burns utterly;

children.text: glapayati yathā śaśāṅkaṃ na tathā hi kumudvatīṃ divasaḥ //
children.translated_text: for the day withers the moon, but not so the <s>kumudvatī</s> (night-lotus pond).

children.text: tapati tanu-gātri madanas tvām aniśaṃ māṃ punar dahaty eva /
glapayati yathā śaśa-aṅkaṃ na tathā hi kumudvatīṃ divasaḥ //
sakhyau  (vilokya saharṣam utthāya) svāgatam avilambino manorathasya /
children.translated_text: Both friends: (Looking up and rising with joy) Welcome to the swift fulfilment of a heart's desire!

children.text: sakhyau -- (vilokya saharṣam utthāya) svāgatam avilambino manorathasya /
(śakuntalābhyutthātum icchati)
children.translated_text: (<s>Śakuntalā</s> wishes to rise.)

children.text: (śakuntala ābhyutthātum icchati)
rājā  alam alam āyāsena /
children.translated_text: King: Enough, enough with exertion!

children.text: rājā -- alam alam āyāsena /
saṃdaṣṭasukumaśayanāny āśuktāntabisabhaṅgasurabhīṇi /
children.translated_text: Your limbs, pressed upon their tender bed, fragrant with the breaking of lotus-stalks within,

children.text: guruparitāpāni na te gātrāṇy upacāram arhanti //
children.translated_text: burdened by intense heat — they deserve care, not effort.

children.text: saṃdaṣṭa-sukuma-śayanāny āśukta-anta-bisa-bhaṅga-surabhīṇi /
guru-paritāpāni na te gātrāṇy upacāram arhanti //
ana  itaḥ śilātalaikadeśam alaṃkarotu vayasyaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Let our friend adorn one side of this stone-slab. (The King sits down. <s>Śakuntalā</s> stands bashfully.)

children.text: ana --- itaḥ śilā-tala-eka-deśam alaṃkarotu vayasyaḥ /
(rājopaviśati / śakuntalā salajjā tiṣṭhati)
(rāja ūpaviśati / śakuntalā salajjā tiṣṭhati)
pri  dvayor api yuvayor anyonyānurāgaḥ pratyakṣaḥ / sakhīsnehaḥ punar māṃ punar uktavādinīṃ karoti /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: The mutual love of you both is manifest. Yet friendship's affection makes me speak again though it makes me repetitive.

children.text: pri -- dvayor api yuvayor anyonya-anurāgaḥ pratyakṣaḥ / sakhī-snehaḥ punar māṃ punar ukta-vādinīṃ karoti /
rājā  bhadre naitat parhāryam / vivakṣitaṃ hy anuktam anutāpaṃ janayati /
children.translated_text: King: Good lady, do not leave it unsaid — for what one wishes to say but leaves unspoken causes regret.

children.text: rājā -- bhadre na etat parhāryam / vivakṣitaṃ hy anuktam anutāpaṃ janayati /
pri  āpannasya viṣayanivāsino janasyārtihareṇa rājñā bhavitavyam ity eṣa vo dharmaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: It is the duty of a king to relieve the suffering of people dwelling in his domain who have fallen into distress.

children.text: pri -- āpannasya viṣaya-nivāsino janasyā arti-hareṇa rājñā bhavitavyam ity eṣa vo dharmaḥ /
rājā  nāsmāt param /
children.translated_text: King: Nothing surpasses [that duty].

children.text: rājā -- na asmāt param /
pri  tena hīyam āvayoḥ priyasakhī tvām uddiśya idam avasthāntaraṃ bhagavatā madanenāropitā / tad arhasy abhyupapattyā jīvitam asyā avalambitum /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Then this dear friend of ours has been brought by the blessed god of love to a different state, with you as its object. You should therefore sustain her life by your acceptance.

children.text: pri -- tena hi iyam āvayoḥ priya-sakhī tvām uddiśya idam avasthā-antaraṃ bhagavatā madanenā aropitā / tad arhasy abhyupapattyā jīvitam asyā avalambitum /
rājā  bhadre sādhāraṇo 'yaṃ praṇayaḥ / sarvathānugṛhīto 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: Good lady, this love is shared [by both of us]. I am the one who has been favored in every way.

children.text: rājā -- bhadre sādhāraṇo 'yaṃ praṇayaḥ / sarvatha ānugṛhīto 'smi /
śakuntalā  (priyaṃvadām avalokya) halā kim antaḥpuravirahaparyutsukasya rājarṣer uparodhena /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Looking at <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>) Dear friend, why do you trouble the royal sage, who must be longing for the separation from his inner chambers?

children.text: śakuntalā -- (priyaṃvadām avalokya) halā kim antaḥ-pura-viraha-paryutsukasya rājarṣer uparodhena /
rājā  sundari
children.translated_text: King: Fair one —

children.text: rājā -- sundari
idam ananyaparāyaṇam anyathā hṛdayasaṃnihite hṛdayaṃ mama /
children.translated_text: This heart of mine, with no other refuge, placed near your heart — if you, O wine-eyed one, should think otherwise,

children.text: yadi samarthayase madirekṣaṇe madanabāṇahato 'smi hataḥ punaḥ //
children.translated_text: then I, struck by <s>Madana's</s> (Love's) arrows, am struck again!

children.text: idam ananya-parāyaṇam anyathā hṛdaya-saṃnihite hṛdayaṃ mama /
yadi samarthayase madira-īkṣaṇe madana-bāṇa-hato 'smi hataḥ punaḥ //
ana  vayasya bahuvallabhā rājānaḥ śrūyante / yathā nau priyasakhī bandhujanaśocanīyā na bhavati tathā nirvāhaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Friend, kings are heard to have many beloveds. Act in such a way that our dear friend does not become a cause of sorrow to her kinsmen.

children.text: ana -- vayasya bahu-vallabhā rājānaḥ śrūyante / yathā nau priya-sakhī bandhu-jana-śocanīyā na bhavati tathā nirvāhaya /
rājā  bhadre kiṃ bahunā
children.translated_text: King: Good lady, in brief —

children.text: rājā -- bhadre kiṃ bahunā
parigrahabahutve 'pi dve pratiṣṭhe kulasya me /
children.translated_text: Though my household is large, two are the mainstays of my family:

children.text: samudrarasanā corvī sakhī ca yuvayor iyam //
children.translated_text: the ocean-girdled earth, and this friend of yours.

children.text: parigraha-bahutve 'pi dve pratiṣṭhe kulasya me /
samudra-rasanā ca urvī sakhī ca yuvayor iyam //
ubhe  nirvṛte svaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: We are satisfied.

children.text: ubhe -- nirvṛte svaḥ /
pri  (sadṛṣṭikṣepam) anasūye eṣa itodattadṛṣṭir utsuko mṛgapotako mātaram anviṣyati / ehi / saṃyojayāva enam / (ity ubhe prasthite)
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (With a side-glance) <s>Anasūyā</s>, look — this eager little fawn, looking this way, is searching for its mother. Come, let us unite them. (Both start to leave.)

children.text: pri -- (sadṛṣṭi-kṣepam) anasūye eṣa ito-datta-dṛṣṭir utsuko mṛga-potako mātaram anviṣyati / ehi / saṃyojayāva enam / (ity ubhe prasthite)
śaku  halā aśaraṇāsmi / anyatarā yuvayor āgacchatu /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Dear friends, I am without refuge! Let one of you stay!

children.text: śaku -- halā aśaraṇa āsmi / anyatarā yuvayor āgacchatu /
ubhe  pṛthivyāḥ yaḥ śaraṇaṃ sa tava samīpe vartate / (iti niṣkrānte)
children.translated_text: Both: He who is the refuge of the earth stands beside you! (They exit.)

children.text: ubhe -- pṛthivyāḥ yaḥ śaraṇaṃ sa tava samīpe vartate / (iti niṣkrānte)
śaku  kathaṃ gate eva /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: What — have they really gone?

children.text: śaku -- kathaṃ gate eva /
rājā  alam āvegena / nanv ayam ārādhayitā janas tava samīpe vartate /
children.translated_text: King: Do not be anxious! Is not this devoted servant at your side?

children.text: rājā -- alam āvegena / nanv ayam ārādhayitā janas tava samīpe vartate /
kiṃ śītalaiḥ klamavinodibhir ārdravātān
sañcārayāmi nalinīdalatālavṛntaiḥ /
children.translated_text: dispelling your weariness with their coolness?
Shall I waft moist breezes upon you with fans of lotus leaves,

children.text: aṅke nidhāya karabhoru yathāsukhaṃ te
saṃvāhayāmi caraṇāv uta padmatāṃrau //
children.translated_text: shall I massage your lotus-red feet?
Or, placing your plantain-thighed [feet] upon my lap at your ease,

children.text: kiṃ śītalaiḥ klama-vinodibhir ārdra-vātān
sañcārayāmi nalinī-dala-tāla-vṛntaiḥ /
aṅke nidhāya karabha-ūru yathā-sukhaṃ te
saṃvāhayāmi caraṇāv uta padma-tāṃrau //
śaku  na mānanīyeṣv ātmānam aparādhayiṣye / (ity utthāya gantum icchati)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: I shall not disgrace myself before those whom I must respect. (She rises, wishing to leave.)

children.text: śaku -- na mānanīyeṣv ātmānam aparādhayiṣye / (ity utthāya gantum icchati)
rājā  sundari anirvāṇo divasaḥ iyaṃ ca te śarīrāvasthā /
children.translated_text: King: Fair one, the day is not yet spent, and this is the state of your body —

children.text: rājā -- sundari anirvāṇo divasaḥ iyaṃ ca te śarīra-avasthā /
utsṛjya kusumaśayanaṃ nalinīdalakalpitastanāvaraṇam /
children.translated_text: leaving behind your flower-bed with its lotus-leaf breast-covering,

children.text: katham ātape gamiṣyasi paribādhāpelavair aṅgaiḥ //
children.translated_text: how will you walk in the heat with limbs tender as petals?

children.text: utsṛjya kusuma-śayanaṃ nalinī-dala-kalpita-stana-āvaraṇam /
katham ātape gamiṣyasi paribādhā-pelavair aṅgaiḥ //
(iti balād enāṃ nivartayati)
children.translated_text: (He forcibly turns her back.)

children.text: (iti balād enāṃ nivartayati)
śaku  paurava rakṣa vinayam / madanasaṃtaptā api na khalv ātmanaḥ prabhavāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: <s>Paurava</s>, preserve your propriety! Though tormented by love, I am truly not my own mistress.

children.text: śaku -- paurava rakṣa vinayam / madana-saṃtaptā api na khalv ātmanaḥ prabhavāmi /
rājā  bhīru alaṃ gurujanabhayena / dṛṣṭvā te viditadharmā tatrabhavān nātra doṣaṃ grahīṣyati kulapatiḥ / paśya /
children.translated_text: King: Timid one, enough of fearing your elders! The venerable patriarch, knowing the <s>dharma</s>, will see no fault in this. Consider —

children.text: rājā -- bhīru alaṃ guru-jana-bhayena / dṛṣṭvā te vidita-dharmā tatra-bhavān na atra doṣaṃ grahīṣyati kula-patiḥ / paśya /
gāndharveṇa vivāhena bahvyo rājarṣikanyakāḥ /
children.translated_text: Many royal-sage maidens are heard to have been married

children.text: śrūyante pariṇītās tāḥ pitṛbhiś cābhinanditāḥ //
children.translated_text: by the <s>Gāndharva</s> rite, and their fathers approved of it.

children.text: gāndharveṇa vivāhena bahvyo rājarṣi-kanyakāḥ /
śrūyante pariṇītās tāḥ pitṛbhiś ca abhinanditāḥ //
śaku  muñca tāvan mām / bhūyo 'pi sakhījanam anumānayiṣye /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Release me for now! I must consult my friends once more.

children.text: śaku -- muñca tāvan mām / bhūyo 'pi sakhī-janam anumānayiṣye /
rājā  bhavatu / mokṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Very well, I shall release you.

children.text: rājā -- bhavatu / mokṣyāmi /
śaku  kadā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: When?

children.text: śaku -- kadā /
rājā
children.translated_text: King:

children.text: rājā --
aparikṣatakomalasya yāvat kusumasyeva navasya ṣaṭpadena /
children.translated_text: Just as a bee [sips] from a fresh, uninjured, tender blossom,

children.text: adharasya pipāsatā mayā te sadayaṃ sundari gṛhyate raso 'sya //
children.translated_text: so shall I, thirsting, gently take the nectar of your lip, O fair one.

children.text: aparikṣata-komalasya yāvat kusumasya iva navasya ṣaṭpadena /
adharasya pipāsatā mayā te sadayaṃ sundari gṛhyate raso 'sya //
(iti mukham asyāḥ samunnamayitum icchati / śakuntalā pariharati nāṭyena)
children.translated_text: (He wishes to lift her face. <s>Śakuntalā</s> evades him by dramatic gesture.)

children.text: (iti mukham asyāḥ samunnamayitum icchati / śakuntalā pariharati nāṭyena)
(nepathye)
children.translated_text: (From behind the scenes:)

children.text: (nepathye)
cakravākavadhuke āmantrayasva sahacaram / upasthitā rajanī /
children.translated_text: 'O <s>cakravāka</s>-bride, bid farewell to your companion! Night has come.'

children.text: cakra-vāka-vadhuke āmantrayasva saha-caram / upasthitā rajanī /
śaku  (sasaṃbhramam) paurava asaṃśayaṃ mama śarīravṛttāntopalambhāyāryā gautamī ita evāgacchati / tad viṭapāntarito bhava /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Startled) <s>Paurava</s>, without doubt the venerable <s>Gautamī</s> is coming this way to inquire about my condition. Hide behind the trees!

children.text: śaku -- (sasaṃbhramam) paurava asaṃśayaṃ mama śarīra-vṛtta-anta-upalambhāyā aryā gautamī ita evā agacchati / tad viṭapa-antarito bhava /
rājā  tathā / (ity ātmānam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati)
children.translated_text: King: So be it. (He conceals himself.)

children.text: rājā -- tathā / (ity ātmānam āvṛtya tiṣṭhati)
(tataḥ praviśati pātrahastā gautamī sakhyau ca)
children.translated_text: (Then enters <s>Gautamī</s> with a vessel in hand, and the two friends.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati pātra-hastā gautamī sakhyau ca)
sakhyau  ita ita āryā gautamī /
children.translated_text: The two friends: This way, this way, venerable <s>Gautamī</s>!

children.text: sakhyau -- ita ita āryā gautamī /
gautamī  (śakuntalām upetya) jāte api laghusaṃtāpāni te 'ṅgāni /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: (Approaching <s>Śakuntalā</s>) Child, are your limbs still slightly feverish?

children.text: gautamī -- (śakuntalām upetya) jāte api laghu-saṃtāpāni te 'ṅgāni /
śaku  ārye asti me viśeṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Venerable lady, there is some improvement.

children.text: śaku -- ārye asti me viśeṣaḥ /
gautamī  anena darbhodakena nirābādham eva te śarīraṃ bhaviṣyati / (śirasi śakutalām abhyukṣya) vatse pariṇato divasaḥ / ehi uṭajam eva gacchāmaḥ / (iti prasthitāḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: With this sprinkling of <s>darbha</s>-water, your body will surely be free of distress. (She sprinkles <s>Śakuntalā's</s> head.) Child, the day has ripened. Come, let us go to the cottage. (They start to leave.)

children.text: gautamī -- anena darbha-udakena nirābādham eva te śarīraṃ bhaviṣyati / (śirasi śakutalām abhyukṣya) vatse pariṇato divasaḥ / ehi uṭajam eva gacchāmaḥ / (iti prasthitāḥ)

śaku  (ātmagatam) hṛdaya prthamam eva sukhopanate manorathe kātarabhāvaṃ na muñcasi / sānuśayavighaṭitasya kathaṃ te sāṃprataṃ saṃtāpaḥ / (padāntare sthitvā / prakāśam) latāvalaya saṃtāpahāraka āmantraye tvāṃ bhūyo 'pi paribhogāya / (iti duḥkhena niṣkrāntā śakuntalā sahetarābhiḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) O heart, when the longed-for desire first presented itself easily, you did not abandon your timidity. Now that it has been broken off with regret, how can you bear the torment? (Pausing mid-step, aloud:) O bower of creepers, dispeller of my pain, I bid you farewell — to enjoy your company again! (With sorrow, <s>Śakuntalā</s> exits with the others.)

children.text: śaku -- (ātma-gatam) hṛdaya prthamam eva sukha-upanate manorathe kātara-bhāvaṃ na muñcasi / sānuśaya-vighaṭitasya kathaṃ te sāṃprataṃ saṃtāpaḥ / (pada-antare sthitvā / prakāśam) latā-valaya saṃtāpa-hāraka āmantraye tvāṃ bhūyo 'pi paribhogāya / (iti duḥkhena niṣkrāntā śakuntalā saha itarābhiḥ)
rājā  (pūrvasthānam upetya / saniḥśvāsam) aho vighnavatyaḥ prāthitārthasiddhayaḥ / mahā hi
children.translated_text: King: (Returning to his former place, with a sigh) Ah, how full of obstacles are the fulfilments of one's desires! For indeed —

children.text: rājā -- (pūrva-sthānam upetya / saniḥśvāsam) aho vighnavatyaḥ prāthita-artha-siddhayaḥ / mahā hi
muhur aṅgulisaṃvṛtādharauṣṭhaṃ pratiṣedhākṣaraviklavābhirāmam /
children.translated_text: Her lower lip repeatedly covered by her finger, her face charmingly confused with syllables of refusal,

children.text: mukham aṃsavivarti pakṣmalākṣyāḥ katham apy unnamitaṃ na cumbitaṃ tu //
children.translated_text: the face of the long-lashed one, turned aside over her shoulder, was somehow raised — but not kissed.

children.text: muhur aṅguli-saṃvṛta-adhara-oṣṭhaṃ pratiṣedha-akṣara-viklava-abhirāmam /
mukham aṃsa-vivarti pakṣma-lākṣyāḥ katham apy unnamitaṃ na cumbitaṃ tu //
kva nu khalu saṃprati gacchāmi / athavā ihaiva priyāparibhuktamukte latāvalaye muhūrtaṃ sthāsyāmi /
children.translated_text: Where shall I go now? Or rather, I shall stay right here a moment in this creeper-bower enjoyed by my beloved.

children.text: kva nu khalu saṃprati gacchāmi / athavā iha eva priyā-paribhukta-mukte latā-valaye muhūrtaṃ sthāsyāmi /
(sarvato 'valokya)
children.translated_text: (Looking all around)

children.text: (sarvato 'valokya)
tasyāḥ puṣpamayī śarīralulitā śayyā śilāyām iyam
klānto manmathalekha eṣa nalinīpatre nakhair arpitaḥ /
children.translated_text: here is the weary love-letter, inscribed with her nails on a lotus-leaf;
Here on the stone is her flower-bed, pressed by her body;

children.text: hastād bhraṣṭam idaṃ bisābharaṇam ity āsajyamānekṣaṇo
nirgantuṃ sahasā na vetasagṛhāc chaknomi śūnyād api //
children.translated_text: and I cannot bring myself to leave this reed-hut, even though it is empty.
here is this lotus-fiber bracelet fallen from her hand — my gaze clings [to each],

children.text: tasyāḥ puṣpamayī śarīra-lulitā śayyā śilāyām iyam
klānto manmatha-lekha eṣa nalinī-patre nakhair arpitaḥ /
hastād bhraṣṭam idaṃ bisa-ābharaṇam ity āsajyamāna-īkṣaṇo
nirgantuṃ sahasā na vetasa-gṛhāc chaknomi śūnyād api //
(ākāśe) rājan
children.translated_text: (From the sky:) O King —

children.text: (ākāśe) rājan --
sāyaṃtane sadanakarmaṇi saṃpravṛtte
vediṃ hutāśanavatīṃ paritaḥ prayastāḥ /
children.translated_text: around the fire-altar with its sacred flame,
As the evening rites have begun at the altar,

children.text: chāyāś caranti bahudhā bhayam ādadhānāḥ
saṃdhyāpayodakapiśāḥ piśitāśanānām //
children.translated_text: tawny as twilight clouds, the flesh-eaters [prowl].
shadows wander in many forms, inspiring fear —

children.text: sāyaṃtane sadana-karmaṇi saṃpravṛtte
vediṃ huta-aśanavatīṃ paritaḥ prayastāḥ /
chāyāś caranti bahudhā bhayam ādadhānāḥ
saṃdhyā-payoda-kapiśāḥ piśita-aśanānām //
rājā  ayam aham āgacchāmi / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: King: Here I come. (He exits.)

children.text: rājā -- ayam aham āgacchāmi / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
tṛtīyo 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: End of Act Three.

children.text: caturtho 'dhyāyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Act Four.

children.text: (tataḥ praviśataḥ kusumāvacayaṃ nāṭayantyau sakhyau /
children.translated_text: (Then enter the two friends, miming the gathering of flowers.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśataḥ kusuma-avacayaṃ nāṭayantyau sakhyau /
ana  halā priyaṃvade yady api gāndharveṇa vidhinā nirvṛttakalyāṇā śakuntalānurūpabhartṛgāminī saṃvṛtteti nirvṛtaṃ me hṛdayaṃ tathāpy etāvac cintanīyam /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Dear <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>, although my heart is gladdened that <s>Śakuntalā</s>, wedded by the <s>Gāndharva</s> rite, has attained a husband worthy of her, still there is this much to ponder.

children.text: ana -- halā priyaṃvade yady api gāndharveṇa vidhinā nirvṛtta-kalyāṇā śakuntala ānurūpa-bhartṛ-gāminī saṃvṛtta īti nirvṛtaṃ me hṛdayaṃ tatha āpy etāvac cintanīyam /
pri  katham iva /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: What is it?

children.text: pri -- katham iva /
ana  adya sa rājarṣir iṣṭiṃ parisamāpya+ṛṣibhir visarjita ātmano nagaraṃ praviśyāntaḥpurasamāgata ito+gataṃ vṛttāntaṃ smarati vā na veti /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Today, that royal sage, having completed the sacrifice and been dismissed by the sages, will enter his own city and rejoin the inner chambers. Whether he will remember what happened here or not —

children.text: ana -- adya sa rājarṣir iṣṭiṃ parisamāpya+ṛṣibhir visarjita ātmano nagaraṃ praviśya antaḥ-pura-samāgata ito+gataṃ vṛtta-antaṃ smarati vā na va īti /
pri  visrabdhā bhava / na tādṛśā ākṛtiviśeṣā guṇavirodhino bhavanti / tāta idānīm imaṃ vṛttāntaṃ śrutvā na jāne kiṃ pratipatsyata iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Be confident! Those of such distinguished appearance are not at odds with [their] virtues. But what father will decide when he hears of this matter, I do not know.

children.text: pri -- visrabdhā bhava / na tādṛśā ākṛti-viśeṣā guṇa-virodhino bhavanti / tāta idānīm imaṃ vṛtta-antaṃ śrutvā na jāne kiṃ pratipatsyata iti /
