ana  yathāhaṃ paśyāmi tathā tasyānumataṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: As I see it, he would approve.

children.text: ana -- yatha āhaṃ paśyāmi tathā tasya anumataṃ bhavet /
pri  katham iva /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: How so?

children.text: pri -- katham iva /
ana  guṇavate kanyakā pratipādanīyā ity ayaṃ tāvat prathamaḥ saṃkalpaḥ / taṃ yadi daivam eva saṃpādayati nanv aprayāsena kṛtārtho gurujanaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: A daughter is to be given to a man of virtue — that is the first principle. If destiny itself accomplishes this, then the elders are fulfilled without effort.

children.text: ana -- guṇavate kanyakā pratipādanīyā ity ayaṃ tāvat prathamaḥ saṃkalpaḥ / taṃ yadi daivam eva saṃpādayati nanv aprayāsena kṛta-artho guru-janaḥ /
pri  (puṣpabhājanaṃ vilokya) sakhi avacitāni balikarmaparyāptāni kusumāni /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Looking at the flower-basket) Dear friend, we have gathered enough flowers for the offering-rite.

children.text: pri -- (puṣpa-bhājanaṃ vilokya) sakhi avacitāni bali-karma-paryāptāni kusumāni /
ana  nanu sakhyāḥ śakuntalāyāḥ saubhāgyadevatārcanīyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Indeed, the goddess of good fortune of our friend <s>Śakuntalā</s> is to be worshipped!

children.text: ana -- nanu sakhyāḥ śakuntalāyāḥ saubhāgya-devata ārcanīyā /
pri  yujyate / (iti tad eva karmābhinayataḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: It is fitting. (She mimes performing the same act.)

children.text: pri -- yujyate / (iti tad eva karma abhinayataḥ)
(nepathye)
children.translated_text: (From behind the scenes:)

children.text: (nepathye)
ayam ahaṃ bhoḥ /
children.translated_text: Here I am, sirs!

children.text: ayam ahaṃ bhoḥ /
ana  (karṇaṃ dattvā) sakhi atithīnām iva niveditam /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: (Listening) Friend, it sounds as if guests have been announced!

children.text: ana -- (karṇaṃ dattvā) sakhi atithīnām iva niveditam /
pri  nanūṭajasaṃnihitā śakuntalā /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: <s>Śakuntalā</s> is close by the cottage, is she not?

children.text: pri -- nanu uṭaja-saṃnihitā śakuntalā /
ana  adya punar hṛdayenāsaṃnihitā / alam etāvadbhiḥ kusumaiḥ / (iti prasthite) (nepathye)
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: But today her heart is elsewhere! Enough of these flowers for now. (As she prepares to leave:) (From behind the scenes:)

children.text: ana -- adya punar hṛdayena asaṃnihitā / alam etāvadbhiḥ kusumaiḥ / (iti prasthite) (nepathye)
āḥ atithiparibhāvini
children.translated_text: Ah, you who slight a guest!

children.text: āḥ atithi-paribhāvini --
vicintayantī yam ananyamānasā
tapodhanaṃ vetsi na mām upasthitam /
children.translated_text: do not perceive me, the ascetic, who has arrived —
You who, absorbed in thought of him alone, with mind on no other,

children.text: smariṣyati tvāṃ na sa bodhito 'pi san
kathāṃ pramattaḥ prathamaṃ kṛtām iva //
children.translated_text: as one intoxicated [fails to recall] a tale told long ago!
He shall not remember you, even when prompted,

children.text: vicintayantī yam ananya-mānasā
tapo-dhanaṃ vetsi na mām upasthitam /
smariṣyati tvāṃ na sa bodhito 'pi san
kathāṃ pramattaḥ prathamaṃ kṛtām iva //
pri  hā dhig ghā dhik / apriyam eva saṃvṛttam / kasminn api pūjārhe 'parāddhā śūnyahṛdayā śakuntalā / (puro 'valokya)
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Alas! Alas! Something dreadful has happened! The empty-hearted <s>Śakuntalā</s> has offended someone worthy of reverence! (Looking ahead:)

children.text: pri -- hā dhig ghā dhik / apriyam eva saṃvṛttam / kasminn api pūjā-arhe 'parāddhā śūnya-hṛdayā śakuntalā / (puro 'valokya)
na khalu yasmin kasminn api / eṣa durvāsāḥ sulabhakopo maharṣiḥ / tathā śaptvā vegabalotphullayā durvārayā gatyā pratinivṛttaḥ /
children.translated_text: Not just anyone indeed! It is the great sage <s>Durvāsas</s>, easily angered! Having cursed her thus, he has turned back with an irresistible stride, forceful in the vehemence of his departure!

children.text: na khalu yasmin kasminn api / eṣa durvāsāḥ sulabha-kopo maharṣiḥ / tathā śaptvā vega-bala-utphullayā durvārayā gatyā pratinivṛttaḥ /
ana  ko 'nyo hutavahād dagdhuṃ prabhavati / gaccha / pādayoḥ praṇamya nivartaya enaṃ yāvad aham arghodakam upakalpayāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Who else but fire has the power to burn? Go! Fall at his feet and turn him back, while I prepare the water-offering for the guest!

children.text: ana -- ko 'nyo huta-vahād dagdhuṃ prabhavati / gaccha / pādayoḥ praṇamya nivartaya enaṃ yāvad aham argha-udakam upakalpayāmi /
pri  tathā (iti niṣkrāntā)
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: So be it. (She exits.)

children.text: pri -- tathā (iti niṣkrāntā)
ana  (padāntare skhalitaṃ nirūpya) aho āvegaskhalitayā gatyā prabhraṣṭaṃ mamāgrahastāt puṣpabhājanam / (iti puṣpoccayaṃ rūpayati)
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: (Noticing a stumble mid-step) Oh! In my haste, having stumbled in my agitated gait, the flower-basket has fallen from my hand! (She mimes gathering the flowers.)

children.text: ana -- (pada-antare skhalitaṃ nirūpya) aho āvega-skhalitayā gatyā prabhraṣṭaṃ mama agra-hastāt puṣpa-bhājanam / (iti puṣpa-uccayaṃ rūpayati)
(praviśya)
children.translated_text: (Entering:)

children.text: (praviśya)
pri  sakhi prakṛtivakraḥ sa kasyānunayaṃ pratigṛhṇāti / kim api punaḥ sānukrośaḥ kṛtaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Friend, he is crooked by nature — whose entreaties would he accept? Yet he has been made somewhat compassionate.

children.text: pri -- sakhi prakṛti-vakraḥ sa kasya anunayaṃ pratigṛhṇāti / kim api punaḥ sānukrośaḥ kṛtaḥ /
ana  (sasmitam+tasmin bahv etad api / kathaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: (With a smile) Even that much is a great deal from him. Tell me.

children.text: ana -- (sasmitam+tasmin bahv etad api / kathaya /
pri  yadā nivartituṃ necchati tadā vijñāpito mayā /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: When he refused to turn back, I implored him thus:

children.text: pri -- yadā nivartituṃ na icchati tadā vijñāpito mayā /
bhagavan prathama iti prekṣyāvijñātatapaḥprabhāvasya duhitṛjanasya bhagavataiko 'parādho marṣayitavya iti /
children.translated_text: 'Venerable sir, considering her the first [offense] — the daughter of one whose power of austerity is unknown — pray forgive this single transgression of the maiden, O blessed one.'

children.text: bhagavan prathama iti prekṣya avijñāta-tapaḥ-prabhāvasya duhitṛ-janasya bhagavata aiko 'parādho marṣayitavya iti /
ana  tatas tataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: And then? And then?

children.text: ana -- tatas tataḥ /
pri  tato na me vacanam anyathā+bhavitum arhati kiṃ tv abhijñānābharaṇadarśanena śāpo nivartiṣyata iti mantrayamāṇa evāntarhitaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Then [he said]: 'My word cannot be otherwise; however, the curse shall be lifted upon the showing of the recognition-token (<s>abhijñāna</s>) ornament' — and murmuring this, he vanished.

children.text: pri -- tato na me vacanam anyathā+bhavitum arhati kiṃ tv abhijñāna-ābharaṇa-darśanena śāpo nivartiṣyata iti mantrayamāṇa eva antarhitaḥ /
ana  śakyam idānīm āśvasitum / asti tena rājarṣiṇā saṃprasthitena svanāmadheyāṅkitam aṅgulīyakaṃ smaraṇīyam iti svayaṃ pinaddham / tasmin svādhīnopāyā śakuntalā bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Now we can breathe easy. That royal sage (<s>rājarṣi</s>), upon his departure, himself placed on [her finger] a ring inscribed with his own name, saying 'Let this be a remembrance.' <s>Śakuntalā</s> will have the remedy in her own hands.

children.text: ana -- śakyam idānīm āśvasitum / asti tena rājarṣiṇā saṃprasthitena sva-nāmadheya-aṅkitam aṅgulīyakaṃ smaraṇīyam iti svayaṃ pinaddham / tasmin sva-adhīna-upāyā śakuntalā bhaviṣyati /
pri  sakhi ehi / devakāryaṃ tāvad asyā nirvartayāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Friend, come! Let us first complete the offering to the deity for her.

children.text: pri -- sakhi ehi / deva-kāryaṃ tāvad asyā nirvartayāvaḥ /
(iti parikrāmataḥ)
children.translated_text: (They walk about.)

children.text: (iti parikrāmataḥ)
pri  (vilokyānasūye paśya tāvat / vāmahastopahitavadanā ālikhiteva priyasakhī / bhartṛgatayā cintayātmānam api naiṣā vibhāvayati / kiṃ punar āgantukam /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Looking) <s>Anasūyā</s>, look! Our dear friend, with her face resting on her left hand, is as if painted in a picture. Lost in thought about her husband, she does not even perceive herself — much less a newcomer!

children.text: pri -- (vilokya anasūye paśya tāvat / vāma-hasta-upahita-vadanā ālikhita īva priya-sakhī / bhartṛ-gatayā cintayā ātmānam api na eṣā vibhāvayati / kiṃ punar āgantukam /
ana  priyaṃvade dvayor eva nau mukhe eṣa vṛttāntas tiṣṭhatu / rakṣitavyā khalu prakṛtipelavā priyasakhī /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>, let this matter remain on the lips of us two alone. Our dear friend, tender by nature, must be protected.

children.text: ana -- priyaṃvade dvayor eva nau mukhe eṣa vṛtta-antas tiṣṭhatu / rakṣitavyā khalu prakṛti-pelavā priya-sakhī /
pri  ko nāma uṣṇodakena navamālikāṃ siñcati /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Who indeed waters a <s>navamālikā</s> (jasmine) with hot water?

children.text: pri -- ko nāma uṣṇa-udakena navamālikāṃ siñcati /
(iti niṣkrānte)
children.translated_text: (They exit.)

children.text: (iti niṣkrānte)
viṣkambhakaḥ /
children.translated_text: End of the Interlude.

children.text: viṣkambhakaḥ /
(tataḥ praviśati suptotthitaḥ śiṣyaḥ)
children.translated_text: (Then enters a pupil, having just risen from sleep.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati supta-utthitaḥ śiṣyaḥ)

śiṣya  velopalakṣaṇārtham ādiṣṭo 'smi tatrabhavatā pravāsād upāvṛttena kāśyapena / prakāśaṃ nirgatas tāvad avalokayāmi kiyad avaśiṣṭaṃ rajanyā iti / (parikramyāvalokya ca) hanta prabhātam / tathā hi /
children.translated_text: Pupil: I was instructed by the reverend <s>Kāśyapa</s>, who has returned from his journey, to observe the time. Let me go outside and see how much of the night remains. (Walking about and looking:) Ah, it is dawn! For indeed —

children.text: śiṣya -- velā-upalakṣaṇa-artham ādiṣṭo 'smi tatra-bhavatā pravāsād upāvṛttena kāśyapena / prakāśaṃ nirgatas tāvad avalokayāmi kiyad avaśiṣṭaṃ rajanyā iti / (parikramya avalokya ca) hanta prabhātam / tathā hi /
yāty ekato 'staśikharaṃ patir oṣadhīnām
āviṣkṛtāruṇapuraḥsara ekato 'rkaḥ /
children.translated_text: on the other, the sun, preceded by the revealed redness of dawn, [rises] —
On one side, the lord of herbs (the moon) sinks toward the western peak;

children.text: tejodvayasya yugapadvyasanodayābhyām
loko niyamyata ivātmadaśāntareṣu //
children.translated_text: the world is governed, as it were, in the intervals of its own states.
by the simultaneous setting and rising of these two luminaries,

children.text: yāty ekato 'sta-śikharaṃ patir oṣadhīnām
āviṣkṛta-aruṇa-puraḥsara ekato 'rkaḥ /
tejo-dvayasya yugapad-vyasana-udayābhyām
loko niyamyata ivā atma-daśa-antareṣu //
antarhite śaśini saiva kumudvatī me
vṛṣṭiṃ na nandayati saṃsmaraṇīyaśobhā /
children.translated_text: delights me — [only] its beauty remains, worthy of remembrance;
When the moon has disappeared, that very bed of <s>kumuda</s> (night-lotuses) no longer

children.text: iṣṭapravāsajanitāny abalājanasya
duḥkhāni nūnam atimātrasuduḥsahāni //
children.translated_text: are surely exceedingly hard to endure.
the sorrows of women-folk, born from the absence of a beloved,

children.text: antarhite śaśini sa aiva kumudvatī me
vṛṣṭiṃ na nandayati saṃsmaraṇīya-śobhā /
iṣṭa-pravāsa-janitāny abalā-janasya
duḥkhāni nūnam atimātra-suduḥsahāni //
(praviśyāpaṭīkṣepeṇa)
children.translated_text: (Entering, as if pushing aside a curtain:)

children.text: (praviśya apaṭī-kṣepeṇa)
ana  yady api nāma viṣayaparāṅmukhasya janasyaitan na viditaṃ tathāpi tena rājñā śakuntalāyām anāryam ācaritam /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Even though the common people, averse to sensory objects, may not know it — still, that king has behaved dishonorably toward <s>Śakuntalā</s>.

children.text: ana -- yady api nāma viṣaya-parāṅmukhasya janasya etan na viditaṃ tatha āpi tena rājñā śakuntalāyām anāryam ācaritam /
śiṣya  yāvad upasthitā homavelāṃ gurave nivedayāmi /
children.translated_text: Pupil: I shall now inform the master that the time for the fire-oblation has arrived.

children.text: śiṣya -- yāvad upasthitā homa-velāṃ gurave nivedayāmi /
(iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: (He exits.)

children.text: (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)

ana  pratibuddhā api kiṃ kariṣyāmi / na ma uciteṣv api nijakaraṇīyeṣu hastapādaṃ prasarati / kāma idānīṃ sakāmo bhavatu yenāsatyasaṃdhe jane śuddhahṛdayā sakhī padaṃ kāritā / athavā durvāsaḥ śāpa eṣa vikārayati /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Though awake, what can I do? My hands and feet do not move even for my own proper duties. Let <s>Kāma</s> (Love) now be pleased with his desire, since he has led my pure-hearted friend into the hands of one false to his promises! Or perhaps it is the curse of <s>Durvāsas</s> that is producing this change.

children.text: ana -- pratibuddhā api kiṃ kariṣyāmi / na ma uciteṣv api nija-karaṇīyeṣu hasta-pādaṃ prasarati / kāma idānīṃ sakāmo bhavatu yena asatya-saṃdhe jane śuddha-hṛdayā sakhī padaṃ kāritā / athavā durvāsaḥ śāpa eṣa vikārayati /
anyathā kathaṃ sa rājarṣis tādṛśāni mantrayitvaitāvataḥ kālasya lekhamātram api na visṛjati /
children.translated_text: Otherwise, how could that royal sage (<s>rājarṣi</s>), after having spoken such [promises], for all this time not even send so much as a letter?

children.text: anyathā kathaṃ sa rājarṣis tādṛśāni mantrayitva aitāvataḥ kālasya lekha-mātram api na visṛjati /

tad ito 'bhijñānam aṅgulīyakaṃ tasya visṛjāvaḥ / duḥkhaśīle tapasvijane ko 'bhyarthyatām / nanu sakhīgāmī doṣa iti vyavasitā api na pārayāmi pravāsapratinivṛttasya tātakāśyapasya duṣyantapariṇītām āpannasattvāṃ śakuntalāṃ nivedayitum / itthaṃ gate 'smābhiḥ kiṃ karaṇīyam /
children.translated_text: Then let us send the recognition-ring to him. But in [our] suffering community of ascetics, who could be asked? Though we have resolved that 'the fault would be ours for having been accomplices,' we are still unable to inform father <s>Kāśyapa</s>, who has returned from abroad, that <s>Śakuntalā</s> has been married to <s>Duṣyanta</s> and is with child. In this state of affairs, what should we do?

children.text: tad ito 'bhijñānam aṅgulīyakaṃ tasya visṛjāvaḥ / duḥkha-śīle tapasvi-jane ko 'bhyarthyatām / nanu sakhī-gāmī doṣa iti vyavasitā api na pārayāmi pravāsa-pratinivṛttasya tāta-kāśyapasya duṣyanta-pariṇītām āpanna-sattvāṃ śakuntalāṃ nivedayitum / itthaṃ gate 'smābhiḥ kiṃ karaṇīyam /
(praviśya)
children.translated_text: (Entering:)

children.text: (praviśya)
pri  (saharṣam) sakhi tvarasva tvarasva śakuntalāyāḥ prasthānakautukaṃ nivartayitum /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Joyfully) Friend, hurry, hurry! The preparations for <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s departure are to be completed!

children.text: pri -- (saharṣam) sakhi tvarasva tvarasva śakuntalāyāḥ prasthāna-kautukaṃ nivartayitum /
ana  sakhi katham etat /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Friend, how is this?

children.text: ana -- sakhi katham etat /
pri  śṛṇu / idānīṃ sukhaśayitapṛcchikā śakuntalāsakāśaṃ gatāsmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Listen! Just now I went to <s>Śakuntalā</s> to ask after her comfortable rest.

children.text: pri -- śṛṇu / idānīṃ sukha-śayita-pṛcchikā śakuntalā-sakāśaṃ gata āsmi /
ana  tatas tataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: And then? And then?

children.text: ana -- tatas tataḥ /

pri  tāvad enāṃ lajjāvanatamukhīṃ pariṣvajya tātapāśyapenaivam abhinanditam / diṣṭyā dūmākulitadṛṣṭer api yajamānasya pāvaka evāhutiḥ patitā / vatse suśiṣyaparidattā vidyeva aśocanīyāsi saṃvṛttā / adyaiva ṛṣirakṣitāṃ tvāṃ bhartuḥ sakāśaṃ visarjayāmīti /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: At that moment, father <s>Kāśyapa</s>, embracing her whose face was bowed with modesty, congratulated her thus: 'By good fortune, even as the smoke obscures the sacrificer's vision, the oblation has fallen into the fire itself! O child, you have become, like learning entrusted to a worthy pupil, one for whom there is no cause for grief! Today I shall send you, guarded by sages, to your husband's presence.'

children.text: pri -- tāvad enāṃ lajjā-avanata-mukhīṃ pariṣvajya tāta-pāśyapena evam abhinanditam / diṣṭyā dūma-ākulita-dṛṣṭer api yajamānasya pāvaka evā ahutiḥ patitā / vatse suśiṣya-paridattā vidya īva aśocanīya āsi saṃvṛttā / adya eva ṛṣi-rakṣitāṃ tvāṃ bhartuḥ sakāśaṃ visarjayāmi iti /
ana  atha kena sūcitas tātakāśyapasya vṛttāntaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: But who informed father <s>Kāśyapa</s> of the matter?

children.text: ana -- atha kena sūcitas tāta-kāśyapasya vṛtta-antaḥ /
pri  agniśaraṇaṃ praviṣṭasya śarīraṃ vinā chandomayyā vāṇyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: As he entered the fire-sanctuary — without [any person's] body — by a voice composed in Vedic meter.

children.text: pri -- agni-śaraṇaṃ praviṣṭasya śarīraṃ vinā chandomayyā vāṇyā /
ana  (savismayam) katham iva /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: (With amazement) How so?

children.text: ana -- (savismayam) katham iva /
pri  (saṃskṛtam āśritya)
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Switching to Sanskrit verse:)

children.text: pri -- (saṃskṛtam āśritya)
duṣyantenāhitaṃ tejo dadhānāṃ bhūtaye bhuvaḥ /
children.translated_text: 'Know, O <s>Brāhmaṇa</s>, your daughter, bearing the splendor deposited by <s>Duṣyanta</s> for the prosperity of the earth,

children.text: avehi tanayāṃ brahmann agnigarbhāṃ śamīm iva //
children.translated_text: to be like the <s>śamī</s> tree pregnant with fire.'

children.text: duṣyantenā ahitaṃ tejo dadhānāṃ bhūtaye bhuvaḥ /
avehi tanayāṃ brahmann agni-garbhāṃ śamīm iva //
ana  (priyaṃvadām āśliṣya) sakhi priyaṃ me / kiṃ tv adyaiva śakuntalā nīyata ity utkaṇṭhāsādhāraṇaṃ paritoṣam anubhavāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: (Embracing <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>) Friend, this is delightful to me! Yet I experience a joy mixed with sadness, since <s>Śakuntalā</s> is being taken away this very day.

children.text: ana -- (priyaṃvadām āśliṣya) sakhi priyaṃ me / kiṃ tv adya eva śakuntalā nīyata ity utkaṇṭhā-sādhāraṇaṃ paritoṣam anubhavāmi /
pri  sakhi āvāṃ tāvad utkaṇṭhāṃ vinodayiṣyāvaḥ / sā tapasvinī nirvṛtā bhavatu /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Friend, the two of us shall dispel our sadness in due time. Let the poor dear be happy!

children.text: pri -- sakhi āvāṃ tāvad utkaṇṭhāṃ vinodayiṣyāvaḥ / sā tapasvinī nirvṛtā bhavatu /
tena hy etasmiṃś cūtaśākhāvalambite nālikerasamudgaka etan nimittam eva kālāntarakṣamā nikṣiptā mayā kesaramālikā /
children.translated_text: For this very purpose I had placed a long-lasting <s>kesara</s> (saffron) garland, fit for a future occasion, in a coconut-shell container hanging from this mango branch.

children.text: tena hy etasmiṃś cūta-śākhā-avalambite nāli-kera-samudgaka etan nimittam eva kāla-antara-kṣamā nikṣiptā mayā kesara-mālikā /
tad imāṃ hastasaṃnihitāṃ kuru / yāvad aham api tasyai mṛgarocanāṃ tīrthamṛttikāṃ durvākisalayānīti maṅgalasamālambhanāni viracayāmi /
children.translated_text: Keep it ready at hand! Meanwhile I shall also prepare the auspicious items for her — <s>mṛgarocanā</s> (yellow pigment), <s>tīrthamṛttikā</s> (sacred clay), and <s>dūrvā</s> (grass) sprouts.

children.text: tad imāṃ hasta-saṃnihitāṃ kuru / yāvad aham api tasyai mṛga-rocanāṃ tīrtha-mṛttikāṃ durvā-kisalayāni iti maṅgala-samālambhanāni viracayāmi /
pri  tathā kriyatām / (anasūyā niṣkrāntā / priyaṃvadā nāṭyena sumanaso gṛhṇāti)
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Let it be done. (<s>Anasūyā</s> exits. <s>Priyaṃvadā</s> mimes gathering flowers.)

children.text: pri -- tathā kriyatām / (anasūyā niṣkrāntā / priyaṃvadā nāṭyena sumanaso gṛhṇāti)
(nepathye) gautami ādiśyantāṃ śārṅgaravamiśrāḥ śakuntalānayanāya /
children.translated_text: (From behind the scenes:) O <s>Gautamī</s>, let <s>Śārṅgarava</s> and the others be directed to escort <s>Śakuntalā</s>!

children.text: (nepathye) gautami ādiśyantāṃ śārṅgarava-miśrāḥ śakuntalā-nayanāya /
pri  (karṇaṃ dattvā) anasūye tvarasva tvarasva / ete khalu hastināpuragāmina ṛṣayaḥ śabdāyyante /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Listening) <s>Anasūyā</s>, hurry, hurry! The sages bound for <s>Hastināpura</s> are being summoned!

children.text: pri - (karṇaṃ dattvā) anasūye tvarasva tvarasva / ete khalu hastināpura-gāmina ṛṣayaḥ śabdāyyante /
(praviśya samālambhanahastā)
children.translated_text: (Entering with auspicious items in hand:)

children.text: (praviśya samālambhana-hastā)
ana  sakhi ehi / gacchāvaḥ / (iti parikrāmataḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Friend, come! Let us go! (They walk about.)

children.text: ana -- sakhi ehi / gacchāvaḥ / (iti parikrāmataḥ)
pri  (vilokya) eṣā sūryodaya eva śikhāmajjitā pratīṣṭanīvārahastābhiḥ svastivācanikābhis tāpasībhir abhinandyamānā śakuntalā tiṣṭhati / upasarpāva enām /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Looking) Here stands <s>Śakuntalā</s>, her head bathed at dawn, being blessed with benedictions by the ascetic women — their hands full of auspicious offerings [of parched rice]. Let us approach her.

children.text: pri -- (vilokya) eṣā sūrya-udaya eva śikhā-majjitā pratīṣṭa-nīvāra-hastābhiḥ svasti-vācanikābhis tāpasībhir abhinandyamānā śakuntalā tiṣṭhati / upasarpāva enām /
(ity upasarpataḥ)
children.translated_text: (They approach.)

children.text: (ity upasarpataḥ)
(tataḥ praviśati yathoddiṣṭavyāpārā āsanasthā śakuntalā)
children.translated_text: (Then enters <s>Śakuntalā</s>, seated, occupied with the activities as described.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati yathā-uddiṣṭa-vyāpārā āsanasthā śakuntalā)
tāpasīnām anyatamā  (śakuntalāṃ prati) jāte bhartur bahumānasūcakaṃ mahādevīśabdaṃ labhasva /
children.translated_text: One of the ascetic women: (To <s>Śakuntalā</s>) Child, may you attain the title of '<s>Mahādevī</s>' (Chief Queen), signifying your husband's high esteem!

children.text: tāpasīnām anyatamā -- (śakuntalāṃ prati) jāte bhartur bahumāna-sūcakaṃ mahā-devī-śabdaṃ labhasva /
dvitīyā  vatse vīraprasavinī bhava /
children.translated_text: A second: Child, may you be the mother of a hero!

children.text: dvitīyā -- vatse vīra-prasavinī bhava /
tṛtīyā  vatse bhartur bahumatā bhava /
children.translated_text: A third: Child, may you be greatly honored by your husband!

children.text: tṛtīyā -- vatse bhartur bahumatā bhava /
(ity āśiṣo dattvā gautamīvarjaṃ niṣkrāntāḥ)
children.translated_text: (Having given their blessings, all except <s>Gautamī</s> exit.)

children.text: (ity āśiṣo dattvā gautamī-varjaṃ niṣkrāntāḥ)
sakhyau  (upasṛtya) sakhi sukhamajjanaṃ te bhavatu /
children.translated_text: The two friends: (Approaching) Friend, may your ritual bath be auspicious!

children.text: sakhyau -- (upasṛtya) sakhi sukha-majjanaṃ te bhavatu /
śaku  svāgataṃ me sakhyoḥ / ito niṣīdatam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Welcome to both my friends! Sit here beside me.

children.text: śaku -- svāgataṃ me sakhyoḥ / ito niṣīdatam /
ubhe (maṅgalapātrāṇy ādāya / upaviśya) halā sajjā bhava / yāvat te maṅgalasamālambhanaṃ viracayāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: (Taking the auspicious vessels and sitting down) Dear friend, be ready! We shall now perform the auspicious adornment for you.

children.text: ubhe (maṅgala-pātrāṇy ādāya / upaviśya) halā sajjā bhava / yāvat te maṅgala-samālambhanaṃ viracayāvaḥ /
śaku  idam api bahu mantavyam /durlabham idānīṃ me sakhīmaṇḍanaṃ bhaviṣyati / (iti bāṣpaṃ visṛjati)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Even this much is to be treasured — for henceforth the adornment by my dear friends will be a rare thing. (She sheds tears.)

children.text: śaku -- idam api bahu mantavyam /durlabham idānīṃ me sakhī-maṇḍanaṃ bhaviṣyati / (iti bāṣpaṃ visṛjati)
ubhe  sakhi ucitaṃ na te maṅgalakāle roditum /
children.translated_text: Both: Friend, it is not fitting to weep on an auspicious occasion!

children.text: ubhe -- sakhi ucitaṃ na te maṅgala-kāle roditum /
pri  ābharaṇocitaṃ rūpam āśramasulabhaiḥ prasādhanair viprakāryate /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: Your beauty, fit for [royal] ornaments, is being poorly served by these cosmetics easily found in the hermitage!

children.text: pri -- ābharaṇa-ucitaṃ rūpam āśrama-sulabhaiḥ prasādhanair viprakāryate /
(praviśyopāyanahastāv ṛṣikumārakau)
children.translated_text: (Two young sage-boys enter bearing gifts.)

children.text: (praviśya upāyana-hastāv ṛṣi-kumārakau)
ubhau  idam alaṃkaraṇam / alaṃkriyatām atrabhavatī /
children.translated_text: Both: Here are adornments! Let the noble lady be adorned!

children.text: ubhau -- idam alaṃkaraṇam / alaṃkriyatām atra-bhavatī /
(sarvā vilokya vismitāḥ)
children.translated_text: (All look and are astonished.)

children.text: (sarvā vilokya vismitāḥ)
gautamī  vatsa nārada kuta etat /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Child <s>Nārada</s>, where did these come from?

children.text: gautamī -- vatsa nārada kuta etat /
prathamaḥ  tātakāśyapaprabhāvāt /
children.translated_text: The first: From the power of father <s>Kāśyapa</s>.

children.text: prathamaḥ -- tāta-kāśyapa-prabhāvāt /
gautamī  kiṃ mānasī siddhiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Was it a mental creation (<s>mānasī siddhi</s>)?

children.text: gautamī -- kiṃ mānasī siddhiḥ /
dvitīyaḥ  na khalu / śrūyatām / tatrabhavatā vayam ājñaptāḥ śakuntalāhetor vanaspatibhyaḥ kusumāny āhara iti / tata idānīm
children.translated_text: The second: Not exactly! Listen — the reverend one instructed us: 'Gather flowers from the forest-trees for <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s sake.' Thereupon —

children.text: dvitīyaḥ -- na khalu / śrūyatām / tatra-bhavatā vayam ājñaptāḥ śakuntalā-hetor vanaspatibhyaḥ kusumāny āhara iti / tata idānīm
kṣaumaṃ kenacid indupāṇḍu taruṇā māṅgalyam āviṣkṛtam
niṣṭhyūtaś caraṇopabhogasulabho lākṣārasaḥ kenacit /
children.translated_text: from another, lac-dye, easily available for the service of feet, was exuded;
A silken cloth, moon-white, was revealed as an auspicious [garment] by one tree;

children.text: anyebhyo vanadevatākaratalair āparvabhogotthitair
dattāny ābharaṇāni tatkisalayodbhedapratidvandvibhiḥ //
children.translated_text: ornaments were given — rivaling the beauty of their own unfolding leaf-buds.
from others, by the sprout-like hands of the forest deities, rising [in offering] up to the shoulder,

children.text: kṣaumaṃ kenacid indu-pāṇḍu taruṇā māṅgalyam āviṣkṛtam
niṣṭhyūtaś caraṇa-upabhoga-sulabho lākṣā-rasaḥ kenacit /
anyebhyo vana-devatā-kara-talair āparva-bhoga-utthitair
dattāny ābharaṇāni tat-kisalaya-udbheda-pratidvandvibhiḥ //
priyaṃvadā  (śakuntalāṃ vilokya) halā anayābhyupapattyā sūcitā te bhartur gehe 'nubhavitavyā rājalakṣmīḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: (Looking at <s>Śakuntalā</s>) Dear friend, by this miraculous gift is foretold the royal splendor you shall enjoy in your husband's house!

children.text: priyaṃvadā -- (śakuntalāṃ vilokya) halā anaya ābhyupapattyā sūcitā te bhartur gehe 'nubhavitavyā rāja-lakṣmīḥ /
(śakuntalā vrīḍāṃ rūpayati)
children.translated_text: (<s>Śakuntalā</s> shows modesty.)

children.text: (śakuntalā vrīḍāṃ rūpayati)
prathama  gautama ehy ehi / abhiṣekottīrṇāya kāśyapāya vanaspatisevāṃ nivedayāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: The first: <s>Gautama</s>, come, come! Let us report the forest-trees' service to <s>Kāśyapa</s>, who has completed his ablution.

children.text: prathama -- gautama ehy ehi / abhiṣeka-uttīrṇāya kāśyapāya vanaspati-sevāṃ nivedayāvaḥ /
dvitīyaḥ  tathā /
children.translated_text: The second: Very well.

children.text: dvitīyaḥ -- tathā /
(iti niṣkrāntau)
children.translated_text: (They exit.)

children.text: (iti niṣkrāntau)
sakhyau  aye anupayuktabhūṣaṇo 'yaṃ janaḥ / citrakarmaparicayenāṅgeṣu ta ābharaṇaviniyogaṃ kurvaḥ /
children.translated_text: The two friends: Ah, this person is unaccustomed to ornaments! Through our experience in painting, let us determine the proper placement of ornaments on your limbs.

children.text: sakhyau -- aye anupayukta-bhūṣaṇo 'yaṃ janaḥ / citra-karma-paricayena aṅgeṣu ta ābharaṇa-viniyogaṃ kurvaḥ /
śaku  jāne vāṃ naipunam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: I know your skill.

children.text: śaku -- jāne vāṃ naipunam /
(ubhe nāṭyenālaṃkrutaḥ)
children.translated_text: (Both mime adorning her.)

children.text: (ubhe nāṭyena alaṃkrutaḥ)
(tataḥ praviśati snānottīrṇaḥ kāśyapaḥ)/
children.translated_text: (Then enters <s>Kāśyapa</s>, having completed his ablution.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati snāna-uttīrṇaḥ kāśyapaḥ)/
kāśyaha
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>:

children.text: kāśyaha --
yāsyaty adya śakuntaleti hṛdayaṃ saṃspṛṣṭam utkaṇṭhayā
kaṇṭhaḥ stambhitabāṣpavṛttikaluṣaś cintājaḍaṃ darśanam /
children.translated_text: my throat is choked, turbid with suppressed tears; my gaze is dulled by thought;
'<s>Śakuntalā</s> departs today' — my heart is touched by longing;

children.text: vaiklavyaṃ mama tāvad īdṛśam idaṃ snehād araṇyaukasaḥ
pīḍyante gṛhiṇaḥ kathaṃ nu tanayāviśleṣaduḥkhair navaiḥ //
children.translated_text: how then are householders tormented by the fresh sorrows of separation from a daughter!
if such is my distress, a forest-dweller, from mere affection,

children.text: yāsyaty adya śakuntala īti hṛdayaṃ saṃspṛṣṭam utkaṇṭhayā
kaṇṭhaḥ stambhita-bāṣpa-vṛtti-kaluṣaś cintā-jaḍaṃ darśanam /
vaiklavyaṃ mama tāvad īdṛśam idaṃ snehād araṇya-okasaḥ
pīḍyante gṛhiṇaḥ kathaṃ nu tanayā-viśleṣa-duḥkhair navaiḥ //
(iti parikrāmani)
children.translated_text: (He walks about.)

children.text: (iti parikrāmani)
sakhyau  halā śakuntale avasitamaṇḍanāsi / paridhatsva sāṃprataṃ kṣaumayugalam /
children.translated_text: The two friends: Dear <s>Śakuntalā</s>, your adornment is complete! Now put on the pair of silken garments.

children.text: sakhyau -- halā śakuntale avasita-maṇḍana āsi / paridhatsva sāṃprataṃ kṣauma-yugalam /
(śakuntalotthāya paridhatte)
children.translated_text: (<s>Śakuntalā</s> rises and puts them on.)

children.text: (śakuntala ūtthāya paridhatte)
gautamī  jāte eṣa te ānandaparivāhiṇā cakṣuṣā pariṣvajamāna iva gurur upasthitaḥ / ācāraṃ tāvat pratipadyasva /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Child, here is your father, his eyes overflowing with tears of joy, standing as if embracing you. Show him due respect.

children.text: gautamī -- jāte eṣa te ānanda-parivāhiṇā cakṣuṣā pariṣvajamāna iva gurur upasthitaḥ / ācāraṃ tāvat pratipadyasva /
śaku  (savrīḍam) tāta vande /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (With modesty) Father, I bow to you.

children.text: śaku -- (savrīḍam) tāta vande /
kāśyapa  vatse / yayāter iva śarmiṣṭhā bhartur bahumatā bhava /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>: Child, like <s>Śarmiṣṭhā</s> to <s>Yayāti</s>, may you be greatly honored by your husband!

children.text: sutaṃ tvam api saṃrājaṃ seva pūrum avāpnuhi //
children.translated_text: May you bear a son who shall be a sovereign emperor — [like <s>Śarmiṣṭhā</s>] attaining <s>Pūru</s>!

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse / yayāter iva śarmiṣṭhā bhartur bahu-matā bhava /
sutaṃ tvam api saṃrājaṃ sa īva pūrum avāpnuhi //
gautamī  bhagavān varaḥ khalv eṣaḥ / nāśīḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Venerable sir, this is indeed a benediction, not merely a blessing!

children.text: gautamī -- bhagavān varaḥ khalv eṣaḥ / nā aśīḥ /
kāśyapa  vatse itaḥ sadyo hutān agnīn pradakṣiṇīkuruṣva /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>: Child, now circumambulate the freshly kindled sacrificial fires on this side.

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse itaḥ sadyo hutān agnīn pradakṣiṇī-kuruṣva /
(sarve parikrāmanti)
children.translated_text: (All walk about.)

children.text: (sarve parikrāmanti)
kāśyapa  (ṛkchandasāśāste)
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>: (Reciting in Ṛk-meter:)

children.text: kāśyapa -- (ṛk-chandasā āśāste)
amī vediṃ paritaḥ kḷptadhiṣṇyāḥ samidvantaḥ prāntasaṃstīrṇadarbhāḥ /
children.translated_text: These sacrificial fires, stationed around the altar, with their fire-pits arranged, blazing with fuel, with <s>darbha</s> grass strewn at the edges,

children.text: apaghnanto duritaṃ havyagandhair vaitānās tvāṃ bahnayaḥ pāvayantu //
children.translated_text: dispelling sin with the fragrance of oblations — may the ritual fires purify you!

children.text: amī vediṃ paritaḥ kḷpta-dhiṣṇyāḥ samidvantaḥ prānta-saṃstīrṇa-darbhāḥ /
apaghnanto duritaṃ havya-gandhair vaitānās tvāṃ bahnayaḥ pāvayantu //
pratiṣṭhasvedānīm / (sadṛṣṭikṣepam) kva te śārṅgaravamiśrāḥ / (praviśya)
children.translated_text: Set forth now. (Looking around) Where are <s>Śārṅgarava</s> and the others? (Entering:)

children.text: pratiṣṭhasva idānīm / (sadṛṣṭi-kṣepam) kva te śārṅgarava-miśrāḥ / (praviśya)
śiṣya  bhagavann ime smaḥ /
children.translated_text: Pupil: Venerable sir, we are here.

children.text: śiṣya -- bhagavann ime smaḥ /
kāśyapa  bhaginyās te mārgam ādeśaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>: Show your sister the way.

children.text: kāśyapa -- bhaginyās te mārgam ādeśaya /
śārṅgarava  ita ito bhavatī / (sarve parikrāmanti)
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: This way, this way, noble lady. (All walk about.)

children.text: śārṅgarava -- ita ito bhavatī / (sarve parikrāmanti)
kāśyapa  bho bhoḥ saṃnihitās tapovanataravaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kāśyapa</s>: Hear me, O trees of the hermitage grove!

children.text: kāśyapa -- bho bhoḥ saṃnihitās tapo-vana-taravaḥ /
pātuṃ na prathamaṃ vyavasyati jalaṃ yuṣmāsv apīteṣu yā
nādatte priyamaṇḍanā api bhavatāṃ snehena yā pallavam /
children.translated_text: she who, though fond of adornment, would not pluck your sprouts, out of affection;
She who would not first drink water before you had been watered;

children.text: ādye vaḥ kusumaprasūtisamaye yasyā bhavaty utsavaḥ
seyaṃ yāti śakuntalā patigṛhaṃ sarvair anujñāyatām //
children.translated_text: that <s>Śakuntalā</s> now goes to her husband's home — let her be given leave by all!
she whose festival it was when the first season of your flowering arrived —

children.text: pātuṃ na prathamaṃ vyavasyati jalaṃ yuṣmāsv apīteṣu yā
nā adatte priya-maṇḍanā api bhavatāṃ snehena yā pallavam /
ādye vaḥ kusuma-prasūti-samaye yasyā bhavaty utsavaḥ
sa īyaṃ yāti śakuntalā pati-gṛhaṃ sarvair anujñāyatām //
(kokilaravaṃ sūcayitvā)
children.translated_text: (Indicating the sound of a <s>kokila</s> [cuckoo]:)

children.text: (kokila-ravaṃ sūcayitvā)
anumatagamanā śakuntalā tarubhir ayaṃ vanavāsabandhubhiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, permitted to depart by these trees, her companions of forest-life,

children.text: paribhṛtavirutaṃ kalaṃ yathā prativacanīkṛtam ebhir īdṛśam //
children.translated_text: has received a reply like this—a sweet chorus of bird-calls.

children.text: anumata-gamanā śakuntalā tarubhir ayaṃ vana-vāsa-bandhubhiḥ /
paribhṛta-virutaṃ kalaṃ yathā prativacanī-kṛtam ebhir īdṛśam //
(ākāśe)
children.translated_text: (In the sky)

children.text: (ākāśe)
ramyāntaraḥ kamalinīharitaiḥ sarobhiś
chāyādrumair niyamitārkamayūkhatāpaḥ /
children.translated_text: with shade-trees softening the heat of the sun's rays;
May her path be pleasant between lakes green with lotuses,

children.text: bhūyāt kuśeśayarajomṛdureṇur asyāḥ
śāntānukūlapavanaś ca śivaś ca panthāḥ //
children.translated_text: and may the wind be gentle, favorable, and the way auspicious!
may the dust be soft as the pollen of water-lilies for her,

children.text: ramya-antaraḥ kamalinī-haritaiḥ sarobhiś
chāyā-drumair niyamita-arka-mayūkha-tāpaḥ /
bhūyāt kuśeśaya-rajo-mṛdu-reṇur asyāḥ
śānta-anukūla-pavanaś ca śivaś ca panthāḥ //
(sarve savismayam ākarṇayanti)
children.translated_text: (All listen with wonder.)

children.text: (sarve savismayam ākarṇayanti)
gautamī  jāte jñātijanasnigdhābhir anujñātagamanāsi tapovanadevatābhiḥ / praṇama bhagavatīḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: My child, you have been given leave to depart by the deities of the hermitage, affectionate as your own kinfolk. Pay your respects to the blessed ones.

children.text: gautamī -- jāte jñāti-jana-snigdhābhir anujñāta-gamana āsi tapo-vana-devatābhiḥ / praṇama bhagavatīḥ /
śaku  (sapraṇāmaṃ parikramya / janāntikam) halā priyaṃvade āryaputradarśanotsukāyā apy āśramapadaṃ parityajantyā duḥkhena me caraṇau purataḥ pravartate /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Walking around with salutations. Aside) Dear <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>, though I am eager to see my noble husband, yet my feet move forward with difficulty as I leave the hermitage.

children.text: śaku -- (sapraṇāmaṃ parikramya / jana-antikam) halā priyaṃvade ārya-putra-darśana-utsukāyā apy āśrama-padaṃ parityajantyā duḥkhena me caraṇau purataḥ pravartate /
pri  na kevalaṃ tapovanavirahakātarā sakhy eva / tvayopasthitaviyogasya tapovanasya api tāvat samavasthā dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Priyaṃvadā</s>: It is not you alone who are distressed at parting from the hermitage, dear friend. See the state of the hermitage itself at the approach of separation from you—

children.text: pri -- na kevalaṃ tapo-vana-viraha-kātarā sakhy eva / tvaya ūpasthita-viyogasya tapo-vanasya api tāvat samavasthā dṛśyate /
udgalitadarbhakavalā mṛgyaḥ parityaktanartanā mayūrāḥ /
children.translated_text: The deer drop the half-chewed mouthfuls of <s>darbha</s> grass; the peacocks cease their dancing;

children.text: apasṛtapāṇḍupatrā muñcanty aśrūṇīva latāḥ //
children.translated_text: the creepers shed their pale leaves as though shedding tears.

children.text: udgalita-darbha-kavalā mṛgyaḥ parityakta-nartanā mayūrāḥ /
apasṛta-pāṇḍu-patrā muñcanty aśrūṇi iva latāḥ //
śaku  (smṛtvā) tāta latābhaginīṃ vanajyotsnāṃ tāvad āmantrayiṣye /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Remembering) Father, let me take leave of my vine-sister, <s>Vanajyotsnā</s>.

children.text: śaku -- (smṛtvā) tāta latā-bhaginīṃ vana-jyotsnāṃ tāvad āmantrayiṣye /
kāśyapa  avaimi te tasyāṃ sodaryāsneham / iyaṃ tāvad dakiṣiṇena /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: I know your sisterly affection for her. Here she is, to the right.

children.text: kāśyapa -- avaimi te tasyāṃ sodaryā-sneham / iyaṃ tāvad dakiṣiṇena /
śaku  (upetya latām āliṅgya) vanajyotsne cūtasaṃgatā api māṃ pratyāliṅgetogatābhiḥ śākhābāhābhiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Approaching and embracing the vine) O <s>Vanajyotsnā</s>, though you are wedded to the mango tree, embrace me too with your branch-arms!

children.text: śaku -- (upetya latām āliṅgya) vana-jyotsne cūta-saṃgatā api māṃ pratyāliṅga-ito-gatābhiḥ śākhā-bāhābhiḥ /
adyaprabhṛti dūraparivartinī te khalu bhaviṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: From this day forth I shall be far distant from you.

children.text: adya-prabhṛti dūra-parivartinī te khalu bhaviṣyāmi /
kāśyapa
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>:

children.text: kāśyapa --
saṃkalpitaṃ prathamam eva mayā tavārthe
bhartāram ātmasadṛśaṃ sukṛtair gatā tvam /
children.translated_text: that you, through your merit, have obtained a husband worthy of yourself.
This was my first wish, conceived for your sake—

children.text: cūtena saṃśritavatī navamālikeyam
asyām ahaṃ tvayi ca saṃprati vītacintaḥ //
children.translated_text: about her and about you, I am now free from anxiety.
This new <s>mālikā</s> jasmine has found shelter in the mango—

children.text: saṃkalpitaṃ prathamam eva mayā tava arthe
bhartāram ātma-sadṛśaṃ sukṛtair gatā tvam /
cūtena saṃśritavatī navamālika īyam
asyām ahaṃ tvayi ca saṃprati vīta-cintaḥ //
itaḥ panthānaṃ pratipadyasva /
children.translated_text: Now set forth upon the road.

children.text: itaḥ panthānaṃ pratipadyasva /
śaku  (sakhyau prati) halā eṣā dvayor yuvayor haste nikṣepaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To her friends) Dear ones, she is a trust placed in your two hands.

children.text: śaku -- (sakhyau prati) halā eṣā dvayor yuvayor haste nikṣepaḥ /
sakhyau  ayaṃ janaḥ kasya haste samarpitaḥ / (iti bāṣpaṃ viharataḥ)
children.translated_text: Friends: And into whose hands has this person been entrusted? (They burst into tears.)

children.text: sakhyau -- ayaṃ janaḥ kasya haste samarpitaḥ / (iti bāṣpaṃ viharataḥ)
kāśyapa  anasūye alaṃ ruditvā / nanu bhavatībhyām eva sthirīkartavyā śakuntalā /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: <s>Anasūyā</s>, enough weeping! It is you who should be strengthening <s>Śakuntalā</s>.

children.text: kāśyapa -- anasūye alaṃ ruditvā / nanu bhavatībhyām eva sthirī-kartavyā śakuntalā /
śaku  tāta eṣoṭajaparyantacāriṇī garbhamantharā mṛgavadhūr yadānaghaprasavā bhavati tadā mahyaṃ kam api priyanivedayitṛkaṃ visarjayiṣyatha /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Father, this pregnant doe that roams around the cottage—when she is safely delivered, please send someone to bring me the happy news.

children.text: śaku -- tāta eṣa ūṭaja-paryanta-cāriṇī garbha-mantharā mṛga-vadhūr yada ānagha-prasavā bhavati tadā mahyaṃ kam api priya-nivedayitṛkaṃ visarjayiṣyatha /
kāśyapa  nedaṃ vismariṣyāmaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: We shall not forget this.

children.text: kāśyapa -- na idaṃ vismariṣyāmaḥ /
śaku  (gatibhaṅgaṃ rūpayitvā) ko nu khalv eṣa nivasane me sajjate / (iti parāvartate )
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Miming a stumble) Who is it that catches at my garment? (She turns back.)

children.text: śaku -- (gati-bhaṅgaṃ rūpayitvā) ko nu khalv eṣa nivasane me sajjate / (iti parāvartate )
kāśyapa
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>:

children.text: kāśyapa --
yasya tvayā vraṇaviropaṇam iṅgudīnām
tailaṃ nyaṣicyata mukhe kuśasūcividdhe /
children.translated_text: the healing <s>iṅgudī</s> oil;
The one on whose thorn-pricked face you used to pour

children.text: śyāmākamuṣṭiparivardhitako jahāti
so 'yaṃ na putrakṛtakaḥ padavīṃ mṛgas te //
children.translated_text: treated as your adopted son, does not abandon your path.
raised on handfuls of <s>śyāmāka</s> grain, this fawn,

children.text: yasya tvayā vraṇa-viropaṇam iṅgudīnām
tailaṃ nyaṣicyata mukhe kuśa-sūci-viddhe /
śyāmāka-muṣṭi-parivardhitako jahāti
so 'yaṃ na putra-kṛtakaḥ padavīṃ mṛgas te //
śaku  vatsa kiṃ sahavāsaparityāginīṃ mām anusarasi / aciraprasūtayā jananyā vinā vardhita eva / idānīm api mayā virahitaṃ tvāṃ tātaś cintayiṣyati / nivartasva tāvat / (iti rudatī prasthitā)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Dear child, why do you follow me who am leaving our life together? You were raised without your mother who died soon after your birth. Now father will look after you, bereft of me too. Go back. (Weeping, she sets out.)

children.text: śaku -- vatsa kiṃ saha-vāsa-parityāginīṃ mām anusarasi / acira-prasūtayā jananyā vinā vardhita eva / idānīm api mayā virahitaṃ tvāṃ tātaś cintayiṣyati / nivartasva tāvat / (iti rudatī prasthitā)
kāśyapa
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>:

children.text: kāśyapa --
utpakṣmaṇor nayanayor uparuddhavṛttim
bāṣpaṃ kuru sthiratayā viratānubandham /
children.translated_text: from your upturned eyelashes, make your sorrow cease with firmness.
Restraining the tears that block their course

children.text: asminn alakṣitanatonnatabhūmibhāge
mārge padāni khalu te viṣamībhavanti //
children.translated_text: your steps will surely become unsteady.
On this path whose uneven and level stretches are indistinct,

children.text: utpakṣmaṇor nayanayor uparuddha-vṛttim
bāṣpaṃ kuru sthiratayā virata-anubandham /
asminn alakṣita-nata-unnata-bhūmi-bhāge
mārge padāni khalu te viṣamī-bhavanti //
śārṅgaravaḥ  bhavagān / odakāntaṃ snigdho jano 'nugantavya iti śrūyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Venerable sir, it is said that a loving person should be accompanied as far as the water's edge.

children.text: śārṅgaravaḥ -- bhavagān / odaka-antaṃ snigdho jano 'nugantavya iti śrūyate /
tad idaṃ sarastīram / atra saṃdiśya pratigantum arhati /
children.translated_text: This is the shore of the lake. Here please give your instructions and turn back.

children.text: tad idaṃ saras-tīram / atra saṃdiśya pratigantum arhati /
kāśyapa  tena hīmāṃ kṣīravṛkṣachāyām āśrayāmaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Then let us rest in the shade of this fig tree.

children.text: kāśyapa -- tena hi imāṃ kṣīra-vṛkṣa-chāyām āśrayāmaḥ /
(sarve parikramya sthitāḥ )
children.translated_text: (All walk around and stand.)

children.text: (sarve parikramya sthitāḥ )
kāśyapa  (ātmagatam) kiṃ nu khalu tatrabhavato duṣyantasya yuktarūpam asmābhiḥ saṃdeṣṭavyam / (iti cintayati)
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: (To himself) What fitting message should we send to his honor <s>Duṣyanta</s>? (He reflects.)

children.text: kāśyapa -- (ātma-gatam) kiṃ nu khalu tatra-bhavato duṣyantasya yukta-rūpam asmābhiḥ saṃdeṣṭavyam / (iti cintayati)
śaku  (janāntikam) halā paśya / nalinīpatrāntaritam api sahacaram apaśyanty āturā cakravākyy aṭati duṣkaram ahaṃ karomīti /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Aside) Look, dear—the <s>cakravākī</s> hen, though concealed behind a lotus leaf, wanders restlessly not seeing her mate. I am doing something just as difficult.

children.text: śaku -- (jana-antikam) halā paśya / nalinī-patra-antaritam api saha-caram apaśyanty āturā cakra-vākyy aṭati duṣkaram ahaṃ karomi iti /
ana  sakhi maivaṃ mantrayasva /
children.translated_text: <s>Anasūyā</s>: Friend, do not speak so—

children.text: ana -- sakhi ma aivaṃ mantrayasva /
eṣā api priyeṇa vinā gamayati rajanīṃ viṣādadīrghatarām /
children.translated_text: She too passes the night without her beloved, a night made longer by grief;

children.text: gurv api virahaduḥkham āśābandhaḥ sāhayati //
children.translated_text: but the bond of hope sustains even heavy sorrow of separation.

children.text: eṣā api priyeṇa vinā gamayati rajanīṃ viṣāda-dīrghatarām /
gurv api viraha-duḥkham āśā-bandhaḥ sāhayati //
kāśyapa  śārṅgarava iti tvayā madvacanāt sa rājā śakuntalāṃ puraskṛtya vaktavyaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>, you are to say this to the king on my behalf, placing <s>Śakuntalā</s> before him:

children.text: kāśyapa -- śārṅgarava iti tvayā mad-vacanāt sa rājā śakuntalāṃ puras-kṛtya vaktavyaḥ /
śārṅgarava  ājñāpayatu bhagavān /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Command, venerable sir.

children.text: śārṅgarava -- ājñāpayatu bhagavān /
kāśyapa
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>:

children.text: kāśyapa --
asmān sādhu vicintya saṃyamadhanān uccaiḥ kulaṃ cātmanas
tvayy asyāḥ katham apy bāndhavakṛtāṃ snehapravṛttiṃ ca tām /
children.translated_text: and this attachment she formed for you through the agency of kinsmen,
"Considering well that we are rich only in ascetic merit, and considering your own high lineage,

children.text: sāmānyapratipattipūrvakam iyaṃ dāreṣu dṛśyā tvayā
bhāgyāyattam ataḥ paraṃ na khalu tadvācyaṃ vadhūbandhubhiḥ //
children.translated_text: what lies beyond that depends on destiny—this much is not for the bride's kinsmen to say."
she should be regarded by you among your wives with the same consideration as others receive;

children.text: asmān sādhu vicintya saṃyama-dhanān uccaiḥ kulaṃ cā atmanas
tvayy asyāḥ katham apy bāndhava-kṛtāṃ sneha-pravṛttiṃ ca tām /
sāmānya-pratipatti-pūrvakam iyaṃ dāreṣu dṛśyā tvayā
bhāgya-āyattam ataḥ paraṃ na khalu tad-vācyaṃ vadhū-bandhubhiḥ //
śārṅgarava  gṛhītaḥ saṃdeśaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: The message is understood.

children.text: śārṅgarava -- gṛhītaḥ saṃdeśaḥ /
kāśyapa  vatse tvam idānīm anuśāsanīyāsi / vanaukaso 'pi santo laukikajñā vayam /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Child, now you must be instructed. Though we dwell in the forest, we know the ways of the world.

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse tvam idānīm anuśāsanīya āsi / vanaukaso 'pi santo laukikajñā vayam /
śārṅgarā  na khalu dhimatāṃ kaścid aviṣayo nāma /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Indeed, nothing is beyond the scope of the wise.

children.text: śārṅgarā -- na khalu dhimatāṃ kaścid aviṣayo nāma /
kāśyapa  sā tvam itaḥ patikulaṃ prāpya
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: You, then, having reached your husband's family—

children.text: kāśyapa -- sā tvam itaḥ pati-kulaṃ prāpya --
śuśrūṣasva gurūn kuru priyasakhīvṛttiṃ sapatnījane
bhartṛviprakṛtā api roṣaṇatayā mā sma pratīpaṃ gamaḥ /
children.translated_text: even if wronged by your husband, do not go against him in anger.
Serve your elders; behave as a dear friend toward your co-wives;

children.text: bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhava dakṣiṇā parijane bhāgyeṣv anutsekinī
yānty evaṃ gṛhiṇīpadaṃ yuvatayo vāmāḥ kulasyādhayaḥ //
children.translated_text: young women who conduct themselves thus attain the rank of mistress of the house; but contrary ones are a bane to the family.
Be generous to servants and not puffed up by good fortune—

children.text: śuśrūṣasva gurūn kuru priya-sakhī-vṛttiṃ sapatnī-jane
bhartṛ-viprakṛtā api roṣaṇatayā mā sma pratīpaṃ gamaḥ /
bhūyiṣṭhaṃ bhava dakṣiṇā parijane bhāgyeṣv anutsekinī
yānty evaṃ gṛhiṇī-padaṃ yuvatayo vāmāḥ kulasyā adhayaḥ //
kathaṃ vā gautamī manyate /
children.translated_text: What does <s>Gautamī</s> think?

children.text: kathaṃ vā gautamī manyate /
gau  etāvān vadhhūjanasyopadeśaḥ / jāte etat khalu sarvam avadhāraya /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: This is the complete instruction for a young bride. My child, remember all this.

children.text: gau -- etāvān vadhhū-janasya upadeśaḥ / jāte etat khalu sarvam avadhāraya /
kāśyapa  vatse pariṣvajasva māṃ sakhījanaṃ ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Child, embrace me and your friends.

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse pariṣvajasva māṃ sakhī-janaṃ ca /
śaku  tāta ita eva kiṃ priyaṃvadānasūye sakhyau nivartiṣyete /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Father, will my friends <s>Priyaṃvadā</s> and <s>Anasūyā</s> also have to turn back from here?

children.text: śaku -- tāta ita eva kiṃ priyaṃvadā-anasūye sakhyau nivartiṣyete /
kāśyapa  vatse ime api pradeye / na yuktam anayos tatra gantum / tvayā saha gautamī yāsyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Child, they too are to be given in marriage. It is not proper for them to go there. <s>Gautamī</s> will go with you.

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse ime api pradeye / na yuktam anayos tatra gantum / tvayā saha gautamī yāsyati /
śaku  (pitaram āśliṣya) katham idānīṃ tātasyāṅkāt paribhraṣṭā malayataṭonmūlitā candanalateva deśāntare jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Embracing her father) How shall I survive in a foreign land, fallen from father's lap, like a sandalwood creeper uprooted from the slopes of <s>Malaya</s>?

children.text: śaku -- (pitaram āśliṣya) katham idānīṃ tātasya aṅkāt paribhraṣṭā malaya-taṭa-unmūlitā candana-lata īva deśa-antare jīvitaṃ dhārayiṣyāmi /
kāśyapa  vatse kim evaṃ kātarāsi /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Child, why are you so faint-hearted?

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse kim evaṃ kātara āsi /
abhijanavato bhartuḥ ślāghye sthitā gṛhiṇīpade
vibhavagurubhiḥ kṛtyais tasya pratikṣaṇam ākulā /
children.translated_text: occupied at every moment with weighty duties of his household,
Established in the glorious rank of wife to a noble-born husband,

children.text: tanayam acirāt prācīvārkaṃ prasūya ca pāvanam
mama virahajāṃ na tvaṃ vatse śucaṃ gaṇayiṣyāmi //
children.translated_text: you will not, my child, count the sorrow born of separation from me.
and soon bearing a sacred son, like the eastern quarter bearing the sun—

children.text: abhijanavato bhartuḥ ślāghye sthitā gṛhiṇī-pade
vibhava-gurubhiḥ kṛtyais tasya prati-kṣaṇam ākulā /
tanayam acirāt prāci īva arkaṃ prasūya ca pāvanam
mama virahajāṃ na tvaṃ vatse śucaṃ gaṇayiṣyāmi //
(śakuntalā pitḥ pādayoḥ patati)
children.translated_text: (<s>Śakuntalā</s> falls at her father's feet.)

children.text: (śakuntalā pitḥ pādayoḥ patati)
kāśyapa  yad icchāmi te tad astu /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: May what I desire for you come to pass.

children.text: kāśyapa -- yad icchāmi te tad astu /
śaku  (sakhyāv upetya) halā dve api māṃ samam eva pariṣvajethām /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Approaching her friends) Dear ones, both of you embrace me together.

children.text: śaku -- (sakhyāv upetya) halā dve api māṃ samam eva pariṣvajethām /
sakhyau  (tathā kṛtvā) sakhi yadi nāma sa rājā pratyabhijñānamantharo bhavet tatas tasmāy idam ātmanāmadheyāṅkitam aṅgulīyakaṃ darśaya /
children.translated_text: Friends: (Doing so) Dear friend, if the king should be slow to recognize you, then show him this ring inscribed with your own name.

children.text: sakhyau -- (tathā kṛtvā) sakhi yadi nāma sa rājā pratyabhijñāna-mantharo bhavet tatas tasmāy idam ātma-nāmadheya-aṅkitam aṅgulīyakaṃ darśaya /
śaku  anena saṃdehena vām ākampitāsmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: This doubt of yours makes me tremble.

children.text: śaku -- anena saṃdehena vām ākampita āsmi /
sakhyau  mā bhaiṣīḥ / atisnehaḥ pāpaśaṅkī /
children.translated_text: Friends: Do not fear! Excessive love is suspicious of evil.

children.text: sakhyau -- mā bhaiṣīḥ / atisnehaḥ pāpa-śaṅkī /
śārṅgarava  yugāntaram ārūḍhaḥ savitā / tvvaratām atrabhavatī /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: The sun has reached the middle of the sky. Let her honor make haste.

children.text: śārṅgarava -- yuga-antaram ārūḍhaḥ savitā / tvvaratām atra-bhavatī /
śaku  (āśramābhimukhī sthitavā) tāta kadā nu bhūyas tapovanaṃ prekṣiṣye /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Standing facing the hermitage) Father, when shall I see the hermitage again?

children.text: śaku -- (āśrama-abhimukhī sthitavā) tāta kadā nu bhūyas tapo-vanaṃ prekṣiṣye /
kāśyapa  śrūyatām /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Listen—

children.text: kāśyapa -- śrūyatām /
bhūtvā cirāya caturantamahīsapatnī
dauṣyantim apratirathaṃ tanayaṃ niveśya /
children.translated_text: and having established a son, <s>Duṣyanta</s>'s heir, whose chariot none can withstand,
Having long been the co-wife of the earth bounded by four oceans,

children.text: bhartrā tadarpitakuṭumbabhareṇa sārdham
śānte kariṣyasi padaṃ punar āśrame 'smin //
children.translated_text: in your old age you shall return to this tranquil hermitage.
together with your husband, the household burden laid upon him,

children.text: bhūtvā cirāya caturanta-mahī-sapatnī
dauṣyantim apratirathaṃ tanayaṃ niveśya /
bhartrā tad-arpita-kuṭumba-bhareṇa sārdham
śānte kariṣyasi padaṃ punar āśrame 'smin //
gautamī  jāte parihīyate gamanavelā / nivartaya pitaram / athavā cireṇa api punaḥ punar eṣaivaṃ mantrayiṣyate / nivartatāṃ bhavān /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: My child, the hour of departure is passing. Send your father back. Or rather, even after long she will keep saying this same thing again and again. Let your honor turn back.

children.text: gautamī -- jāte parihīyate gamana-velā / nivartaya pitaram / athavā cireṇa api punaḥ punar eṣa aivaṃ mantrayiṣyate / nivartatāṃ bhavān /
kāśyapa  vatse uparudhyate tapo 'nuṣṭhānam /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Child, the performance of my austerities is being hindered.

children.text: kāśyapa -- vatse uparudhyate tapo 'nuṣṭhānam /
śaku  (bhūyaḥ pitaram āśliṣya+tapaścaraṇapīḍitaṃ tātaśarīram / tan mātimātraṃ mama kṛta utkaṇṭhasva /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Embracing her father again) Father's body is weakened by the practice of austerities. Do not grieve too much on my account.

children.text: śaku -- (bhūyaḥ pitaram āśliṣya+tapaś-caraṇa-pīḍitaṃ tāta-śarīram / tan ma ātimātraṃ mama kṛta utkaṇṭhasva /
kāśyapa  (saniḥśvāsam)
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: (With a sigh)

children.text: kāśyapa -- (saniḥśvāsam)
śamam eṣyati mama śokaḥ kathaṃ nu vatse tvayā racitapūrvam /
children.translated_text: How will my grief be stilled, my child, when I behold before me

children.text: uṭajadvāravirūḍhaṃ nīvārabaliṃ vilokayataḥ //
children.translated_text: the wild-rice offering grown at the door of the cottage, once prepared by you?

children.text: śamam eṣyati mama śokaḥ kathaṃ nu vatse tvayā racita-pūrvam /
uṭaja-dvāra-virūḍhaṃ nīvāra-baliṃ vilokayataḥ //
gaccha / śivās te panthānaḥ santu /
children.translated_text: Go. May your paths be auspicious.

children.text: gaccha / śivās te panthānaḥ santu /
(niṣkrāntā śakuntalā sahayāyinaś ca)
children.translated_text: (Exit <s>Śakuntalā</s> with her companions.)

children.text: (niṣkrāntā śakuntalā sahayāyinaś ca)
sakhyau  (śakuntalāṃ vilokya) hā dhig ghā dhik / antarhitā śakuntalā vanarājyā /
children.translated_text: Friends: (Looking after <s>Śakuntalā</s>) Alas, alas! <s>Śakuntalā</s> has vanished behind the forest trees!

children.text: sakhyau -- (śakuntalāṃ vilokya) hā dhig ghā dhik / antarhitā śakuntalā vana-rājyā /
kāśyapa  (saniḥśvāsam) anasūye gatavatī vāṃ sahacāriṇī / nigṛhya śokam anugacchataṃ māṃ prasthitam /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: (With a sigh) <s>Anasūyā</s>, your companion has departed. Suppressing your grief, follow me as I return.

children.text: kāśyapa -- (saniḥśvāsam) anasūye gatavatī vāṃ saha-cāriṇī / nigṛhya śokam anugacchataṃ māṃ prasthitam /
ubhe  tāta śakuntalāvirahitaṃ śūnyam iva tapovanaṃ kathaṃ praviśāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: Father, how shall we enter the hermitage that seems empty, bereft of <s>Śakuntalā</s>?

children.text: ubhe -- tāta śakuntalā-virahitaṃ śūnyam iva tapo-vanaṃ kathaṃ praviśāvaḥ /
kāśyapa  snehavṛttir evaṃ darśinī / (savimarśaṃ parikramya) hanta bhoḥ śakuntalāṃ patikulaṃ visṛjya labdham idānīṃ svāsthyam / kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Kaśyapa</s>: Affection is thus revealing of itself. (Walking around thoughtfully) Ah well! Having sent <s>Śakuntalā</s> to her husband's family, I have now obtained peace of mind. For—

children.text: kāśyapa -- sneha-vṛttir evaṃ darśinī / (savimarśaṃ parikramya) hanta bhoḥ śakuntalāṃ pati-kulaṃ visṛjya labdham idānīṃ svāsthyam / kutaḥ /
artho hi kanyā parakīya eva tām adya saṃpreṣya parigrahītuḥ /
children.translated_text: A daughter is indeed another's property. Having dispatched her today to her rightful lord,

children.text: jāto mamāyaṃ viśadaḥ prakāmaṃ pratyarpitanyāsa ivāntarātmā //
children.translated_text: my inner self has become utterly clear, as if a deposit has been restored to its owner.

children.text: artho hi kanyā parakīya eva tām adya saṃpreṣya parigrahītuḥ /
jāto mama ayaṃ viśadaḥ prakāmaṃ pratyarpita-nyāsa iva antar-ātmā //
(iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
children.translated_text: (All exit.)

children.text: (iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
iti caturtho 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: End of Act Four.

children.text: pañcamo 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: Act Five.

children.text: (tataḥ praviśaty āsanasho rājā vidūṣakaś ca)
children.translated_text: (Then enter the king seated, and the <s>Vidūṣaka</s>.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśaty āsanasho rājā vidūṣakaś ca)
vidu  (karṇaṃ dattvā) bho vayasya saṃgītaśālāntare 'vadhānaṃ dehi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (Lending his ear) Friend, give your attention to the interior of the music hall.

children.text: vidu -- (karṇaṃ dattvā) bho vayasya saṃgīta-śāla-antare 'vadhānaṃ dehi /
kalaviśuddhāyā gīteḥ svarasaṃyogaḥ śrūyate / jāne tatrabhavatī haṃsapadikā varṇaparicayaṃ karotīti /
children.translated_text: The melodious combination of notes of a song of perfect beauty in its tones is heard. I know that lady <s>Haṃsapadikā</s> is practicing her music.

children.text: kala-viśuddhāyā gīteḥ svara-saṃyogaḥ śrūyate / jāne tatra-bhavatī haṃsa-padikā varṇa-paricayaṃ karoti iti /
rājā  tūṣṇīṃ bhava / yāvad ākarṇayāmi / (ākāśe gīyate)
children.translated_text: King: Be quiet, so I may listen. (A song is heard offstage.)

children.text: rājā -- tūṣṇīṃ bhava / yāvad ākarṇayāmi / (ākāśe gīyate)
abhinavamadhulolupas tvaṃ tathā paricumbya cūtamañjarīm /
children.translated_text: You, greedy for fresh honey, having thus kissed the mango blossom,

children.text: kamalavasatimātranirvṛto madhukara vismṛto 'sy enāṃ katham //
children.translated_text: O bee, content with merely dwelling in the lotus, how have you forgotten her?

children.text: abhinava-madhu-lolupas tvaṃ tathā paricumbya cūta-mañjarīm /
kamala-vasati-mātra-nirvṛto madhu-kara vismṛto 'sy enāṃ katham //
rājā  aho rāgaparivāhiṇī gītiḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Ah, a song overflowing with passion!

children.text: rājā -- aho rāga-parivāhiṇī gītiḥ /
vidu  kiṃ tāvad gītyā avagato 'kṣarārthaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Has your honor grasped the meaning of the words of the song?

children.text: vidu -- kiṃ tāvad gītyā avagato 'kṣara-arthaḥ /
rā  (smitaṃ kṛtvā) sakṛtkṛtapraṇayo 'yaṃ janaḥ / tad asyā devīṃ vasumatīm antareṇa mahad upālambhanaṃ gato 'smi / sakhe mādhavya madvacanād ucyatāṃ haṃsapadikā / nipuṇam upālabdhāḥ sma iti /
children.translated_text: King: (Smiling) Having once made love to this person, I have now incurred a great reproach on account of Queen <s>Vasumatī</s>. Friend <s>Mādhavya</s>, tell <s>Haṃsapadikā</s> on my behalf: "We have been skillfully rebuked."

children.text: rā -- (smitaṃ kṛtvā) sakṛt-kṛta-praṇayo 'yaṃ janaḥ / tad asyā devīṃ vasumatīm antareṇa mahad upālambhanaṃ gato 'smi / sakhe mādhavya mad-vacanād ucyatāṃ haṃsa-padikā / nipuṇam upālabdhāḥ sma iti /
vidu  yad bhavān ājñāpayati / (utthāya+bho vayasya gṛhītasya tayā parakīyair hastaiḥ śikhaṇḍake tāḍyamānasyāpsarasā vītarāgasyeva nāstīdānīṃ me mokṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: As you command. (Rising) But friend, since I have been seized by her alien hands and am being beaten like a peacock's tail-feather, like a passionless <s>Apsaras</s>, there is no escape for me now.

children.text: vidu -- yad bhavān ājñāpayati / (utthāya+bho vayasya gṛhītasya tayā parakīyair hastaiḥ śikhaṇḍake tāḍyamānasya apsarasā vīta-rāgasya iva na asti idānīṃ me mokṣaḥ /
rā  gaccha / nāgarikavṛttyā saṃjñāpayainām /
children.translated_text: King: Go, convey the message to her with courtly tact.

children.text: rā - gaccha / nāgarika-vṛttyā saṃjñāpaya enām /
vidu  kā gatiḥ / (iti niṣkrāntāḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: What choice do I have? (He exits.)

children.text: vidu -- kā gatiḥ / (iti niṣkrāntāḥ)
rā  (ātmagatam) kiṃ nu khalu gītam evaṃ vidhārtham ākarṇyeṣṭajanavirahād ṛte 'pi balavadutkaṇṭhito 'smi / athavā /
children.translated_text: King: (To himself) Why is it that even apart from separation from a beloved, I am powerfully seized by longing upon hearing a song of this meaning? Perhaps—

children.text: rā -- (ātma-gatam) kiṃ nu khalu gītam evaṃ vidha-artham ākarṇya iṣṭa-jana-virahād ṛte 'pi balavad-utkaṇṭhito 'smi / athavā /
ramyāṇi vīkṣya madhurāṃś ca niśamya śabdān paryutsuko bhavati yat sukhito 'pi jantuḥ /
children.translated_text: When a creature, even while happy, becomes restless upon seeing beautiful sights and hearing sweet sounds,

children.text: tac cetasā smarati nūnam abodhapūrvaṃ bhāvasthirāṇi jananāntarasauhṛdāni //
children.translated_text: surely his heart remembers, though not consciously, the firm friendships of former births.

children.text: ramyāṇi vīkṣya madhurāṃś ca niśamya śabdān paryutsuko bhavati yat sukhito 'pi jantuḥ /
tac cetasā smarati nūnam abodha-pūrvaṃ bhāva-sthirāṇi janana-antara-sauhṛdāni //
(iti paryākulas tiṣṭhati)
children.translated_text: (He stands, agitated.)

children.text: (iti paryākulas tiṣṭhati)
(tataḥ praviśati kañcukī)
children.translated_text: (Then enters the chamberlain.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati kañcukī)
kañcukī  aho nu khalv īdṛśīm avasthāṃ pratipanno 'smi /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: Alas, what a state I have been reduced to!

children.text: kañcukī -- aho nu khalv īdṛśīm avasthāṃ pratipanno 'smi /
ācāra ity avahitena mayā gṛhītā
yā vetrayaṣṭir avarodhagṛheṣu rājñaḥ /
children.translated_text: in the chambers of the king's harem—
This reed-staff, which I grasped with care as a mark of office

children.text: kāle gate bahutithe mama saiva jātā
prasthānaviklavagater avalambanārthā //
children.translated_text: has become my support for walking with faltering steps.
now, after many a long day has passed, the same

children.text: ācāra ity avahitena mayā gṛhītā
yā vetra-yaṣṭir avarodha-gṛheṣu rājñaḥ /
kāle gate bahu-tithe mama sa aiva jātā
prasthāna-viklava-gater avalambana-arthā //
bho kāmaṃ dharmakāryam anatipātyaṃ devasya / tathāpīdānīm eva dharmāsanād utthitāya punar uparodhakāri kaṇvaśiṣyāgamanam asmai notsahe nivedayitum / athavāviśramo 'yaṃ lokatantrādhikāraḥ / kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: Well, the king's religious duty must not be allowed to lapse. Yet, to him who has just risen from the seat of justice, I am reluctant to announce the arrival of <s>Kaṇva</s>'s disciples, which is again an obstruction. But then, this charge of governing the people allows no rest. For—

children.text: bho kāmaṃ dharma-kāryam anatipātyaṃ devasya / tatha āpi idānīm eva dharma-āsanād utthitāya punar uparodha-kāri kaṇva-śiṣya-āgamanam asmai na utsahe nivedayitum / athava āviśramo 'yaṃ loka-tantra-adhikāraḥ / kutaḥ /
bhānuḥ sakṛd yuktaturaṅga eva rātriṃ divaṃ gandhavahaḥ prayāti /
children.translated_text: The sun, once yoked with horses, travels night and day without pause; the wind blows ceaselessly;

children.text: śeṣaḥ sadā evāhitabhūmibhāraḥ ṣaṣṭhāṃśavṛtter api dharma eṣaḥ //
children.translated_text: <s>Śeṣa</s> forever bears the burden of the earth—such is the <s>dharma</s> of those who live on the sixth share of revenue.

children.text: bhānuḥ sakṛd yukta-turaṅga eva rātriṃ divaṃ gandha-vahaḥ prayāti /
śeṣaḥ sadā evā ahita-bhūmi-bhāraḥ ṣaṣṭha-aṃśa-vṛtter api dharma eṣaḥ //
yāvan niyogam anutiṣṭhāmi / (parikramyāvalokya ca) eṣa devaḥ
children.translated_text: Let me carry out my duty. (Walking around and looking) Here is the lord—

children.text: yāvan niyogam anutiṣṭhāmi / (parikramya avalokya ca) eṣa devaḥ --
prajāḥ prajāḥ svā iva tantrayitvā
niṣevate śrāntamanā viviktam /
children.translated_text: his mind weary, he seeks solitude;
Having governed his subjects, each like his own offspring,

children.text: yūthāni saṃcārya raviprataptaḥ
śītaṃ divā sthānam iva dvipendraḥ //
children.translated_text: who seeks a cool daytime resting-place.
like a bull-elephant, scorched by the sun, after leading the herds,

children.text: prajāḥ prajāḥ svā iva tantrayitvā
niṣevate śrānta-manā viviktam /
yūthāni saṃcārya ravi-prataptaḥ
śītaṃ divā sthānam iva dvipa-indraḥ //
(upagamya) jayatu jayatu devaḥ / ete khalu himagirer upatyakāraṇyavāsinaḥ kāśyapasaṃdeśam ādāya sastrīkās tapasvinaḥ saṃprāptāḥ / śrutvā devaḥ pramāṇam /
children.translated_text: (Approaching) Victory, victory to the lord! Here indeed have arrived ascetics from the forest at the foot of the <s>Himālaya</s>, bearing the message of <s>Kaśyapa</s>, accompanied by a woman. Let the lord decide after hearing them.

children.text: (upagamya) jayatu jayatu devaḥ / ete khalu hima-girer upatyaka-araṇya-vāsinaḥ kāśyapa-saṃdeśam ādāya sastrīkās tapasvinaḥ saṃprāptāḥ / śrutvā devaḥ pramāṇam /
rā  (sādaram) kiṃ kāśyapasaṃdeśahāriṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (With respect) What, bearers of <s>Kaśyapa</s>'s message?

children.text: rā -- (sādaram) kiṃ kāśyapa-saṃdeśa-hāriṇaḥ /
kañcukī  atha kim /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: What then?

children.text: kañcukī -- atha kim /

rā  tena hi madvacanād vijñāpyatām upādhyāha somarātaḥ / amūn āśramavāsinaḥ śrautena vidhinā satkṛtya svayam eva praveśayitum arhasīti / aham apy atra tapasvidarśanocite pradeśe sthitaḥ pratipālayāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Then, on my behalf, inform the preceptor <s>Somarāta</s>: "Having honored these hermitage dwellers with the Vedic rites, please personally usher them in." I shall stand here in a place befitting the sight of ascetics and await them.

children.text: rā -- tena hi mad-vacanād vijñāpyatām upādhyāha soma-rātaḥ / amūn āśrama-vāsinaḥ śrautena vidhinā satkṛtya svayam eva praveśayitum arhasi iti / aham apy atra tapasvi-darśana-ucite pradeśe sthitaḥ pratipālayāmi /
kañcukī  yad ājñāpayati devaḥ (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: As the lord commands. (He exits.)

children.text: kañcukī -- yad ājñāpayati devaḥ (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
rā  (utthāya) vetravati agniśaraṇamārgam ādeśaya /
children.translated_text: King: (Rising) <s>Vetravatī</s>, show the way to the sacred fire chamber.

children.text: rā -- (utthāya) vetravati agni-śaraṇa-mārgam ādeśaya /
pratihārī  ita ito devaḥ /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: This way, this way, my lord.

children.text: pratihārī -- ita ito devaḥ /
rā  (parikrāmati / adhikārakhedaṃ nirūpya) sarvaḥ prārthitam artham adhigamya sukhī saṃpadyate jantuḥ / rājñāṃ tu caritārthatā duḥkhottaraiva /
children.translated_text: King: (Walking about, reflecting on the weariness of office) Every creature becomes happy upon attaining the desired object; but for kings, the fulfillment of duty is invariably followed by suffering.

children.text: rā -- (parikrāmati / adhikāra-khedaṃ nirūpya) sarvaḥ prārthitam artham adhigamya sukhī saṃpadyate jantuḥ / rājñāṃ tu carita-arthatā duḥkha-uttara aiva /
autsukyamātram avasāyayati pratiṣṭhā
kliśnāti labdhaparipālanavṛttir eva /
children.translated_text: the very task of maintaining what has been gained causes distress.
Eminence merely brings one's eagerness to rest;

children.text: nātiśramāpanayanāya yathā śramāya
rājyaṃ svahastadhṛtadaṇḍam ivātapatram //
children.translated_text: does not remove fatigue but rather brings weariness.
Kingship, like a parasol held in one's own hand,

children.text: autsukya-mātram avasāyayati pratiṣṭhā
kliśnāti labdha-paripālana-vṛttir eva /
na atiśrama-apanayanāya yathā śramāya
rājyaṃ sva-hasta-dhṛta-daṇḍam ivā atapatram //
vaitālikau  vijayatāṃ devaḥ /
children.translated_text: The bards: Victory to the lord!

children.text: vaitālikau -- vijayatāṃ devaḥ /
prathamaḥ  svasukhanirabhilāṣaḥ khidyase lokahetoḥ
pratidinam athavā te vṛttir evaṃ vidhaiva /
children.translated_text: or rather, such is your daily conduct.
First: Having no desire for your own happiness, you toil for the sake of the people,

children.text: anubhavati hi mūrdhnā padapa tīvram uṣṇam
śamayati paritāpaṃ chāyayā saṃśritānām //
children.translated_text: while relieving with its shade the suffering of those who take shelter beneath it.
For the tree endures fierce heat upon its crown

children.text: prathamaḥ -- sva-sukha-nirabhilāṣaḥ khidyase loka-hetoḥ
pratidinam athavā te vṛttir evaṃ vidha aiva /
anubhavati hi mūrdhnā padapa tīvram uṣṇam
śamayati paritāpaṃ chāyayā saṃśritānām //
dvitīyaḥ
children.translated_text: Second:

children.text: dvitīyaḥ --
niyamayasi vimārgaprasthitān āttadaṇḍaḥ
praśamayasi vivādaṃ kalpase rakṣaṇāya /
children.translated_text: you settle disputes and devote yourself to protection.
You restrain those who have strayed to wrong paths, taking up the rod of justice;

children.text: atanuṣu vibhaveṣu jñātayaḥ santu nāma
tvayi tu parisamāptaṃ bandhukṛtya prajānām //
children.translated_text: but in you alone is fulfilled the duty of a kinsman to the subjects.
Let kinsmen be there for abundant riches, in name only —

children.text: niyamayasi vimārga-prasthitān ātta-daṇḍaḥ
praśamayasi vivādaṃ kalpase rakṣaṇāya /
atanuṣu vibhaveṣu jñātayaḥ santu nāma
tvayi tu parisamāptaṃ bandhu-kṛtya prajānām //
rājā  ete klāntamanasaḥ punar navīkṛtāḥ smaḥ / (iti parikrāmati)
children.translated_text: King: Our weary minds have been refreshed. (He walks about.)

children.text: rājā -- ete klānta-manasaḥ punar navī-kṛtāḥ smaḥ / (iti parikrāmati)
pratihārī  eṣa abhinavasaṃmārjanasaśrīkaḥ saṃnihitahomadhenur agniśaraṇālindaḥ / ārohatu devaḥ /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Here is the portico of the fire chamber, resplendent with fresh sweeping, and the sacrificial cow stands nearby. Let the lord ascend.

children.text: pratihārī -- eṣa abhinava-saṃmārjana-saśrīkaḥ saṃnihita-homa-dhenur agni-śaraṇa-alindaḥ / ārohatu devaḥ /
rā  (āruhya parijanāṃsāvalambī tiṣṭhati) vetravati kim uddiśya bhagavatā kāśyapena matsakāśam ṛṣayaḥ preṣitāḥ syuḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (Having ascended, standing while leaning on an attendant's shoulder) <s>Vetravatī</s>, with what purpose might the venerable <s>Kāśyapa</s> have sent these sages to me?

children.text: rā -- (āruhya parijana-aṃsa-avalambī tiṣṭhati) vetravati kim uddiśya bhagavatā kāśyapena mat-sakāśam ṛṣayaḥ preṣitāḥ syuḥ /
kiṃ tāvad vratinām upoḍhatapasāṃ vighnais tapo dūṣitam
dharmāraṇyacareṣu kenacid uta prāṇiṣv asacceṣṭitam /
children.translated_text: Or has some creature in the <s>dharmāraṇya</s> (sacred forest) committed an offense?
Has the austerity of the ascetics, whose <s>tapas</s> has been carried far, been marred by some obstacle?

children.text: āhosvit prasavo mamāpacaritair viṣṭambhito vīrudhām
ity ārūḍhabahupratarkam aparicchedākulaṃ me manaḥ //
children.translated_text: My mind, having risen to many conjectures, is troubled by uncertainty.
Or perhaps the flowering of the plants has been stunted by my misdeeds?

children.text: kiṃ tāvad vratinām upoḍha-tapasāṃ vighnais tapo dūṣitam
dharma-araṇya-careṣu kenacid uta prāṇiṣv asac-ceṣṭitam /
āhosvit prasavo mama apacaritair viṣṭambhito vīrudhām
ity ārūḍha-bahu-pratarkam apariccheda-ākulaṃ me manaḥ //
pratihārī  sucaritanandina ṛṣayo devaṃ sabhājayitum āgatā iti tarkayāmi /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: I imagine that the sages, delighting in good conduct, have come to pay their respects to the lord.

children.text: pratihārī -- sucarita-nandina ṛṣayo devaṃ sabhājayitum āgatā iti tarkayāmi /
(tataḥ praviśanti gautamī sahitāḥ śakuntalāṃ puraskṛtya munayaḥ / puraś caiṣāṃ kañcukī purohitaś ca)
children.translated_text: (Then enter the sages, led by <s>Śakuntalā</s>, accompanied by <s>Gautamī</s>; before them, the chamberlain and the royal priest.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśanti gautamī sahitāḥ śakuntalāṃ puras-kṛtya munayaḥ / puraś ca eṣāṃ kañcukī purohitaś ca)
kañcukī  ita ito bhavantaḥ /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: This way, this way, sirs.

children.text: kañcukī -- ita ito bhavantaḥ /
śārṅgarava  śāradvata /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: <s>Śāradvata</s>,

children.text: śārṅgarava -- śāradvata /
mahābhāgaḥ kāmaṃ narapatir abhinnasthitir asau
na kaścid varṇānām apatham apakṛṣṭo 'pi bhajate /
children.translated_text: no one among the social orders, even if degraded, departs from the right path.
The great king, to be sure, maintains an impartial conduct;

children.text: tathāpīdaṃ śaśvatparicitaviviktena manasā /
janākīrṇaṃ manye hutavahaparītaṃ gṛham iva //
children.translated_text: I think of this place, crowded with people, as a house surrounded by fire.
Yet still, with a mind perpetually accustomed to solitude,

children.text: mahā-bhāgaḥ kāmaṃ nara-patir abhinna-sthitir asau
na kaścid varṇānām apatham apakṛṣṭo 'pi bhajate /
tatha āpi idaṃ śaśvat-paricita-viviktena manasā /
jana-ākīrṇaṃ manye huta-vaha-parītaṃ gṛham iva //
śāradvata  sthāne bhavān purapraveśād itthaṃ bhūtaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ / aham api
children.translated_text: <s>Śāradvata</s>: Naturally, since entering the city, you have come to feel this way. As for me —

children.text: śāradvata -- sthāne bhavān pura-praveśād itthaṃ bhūtaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ / aham api
abhyaktam api snātaḥ śucir aśucim iva prabuddha iva suptam /
children.translated_text: As one who has bathed views the anointed as impure, as one who is awake views the sleeping,

children.text: baddham iva svairagatir janam iha sukhasaṅginam avaimi //
children.translated_text: as one who moves freely views the bound — so do I perceive the people here, attached to pleasures.

children.text: abhyaktam api snātaḥ śucir aśucim iva prabuddha iva suptam /
baddham iva svaira-gatir janam iha sukha-saṅginam avaimi //
śaku  (nimittaṃ sūcayitvā) aho kiṃ me vāmetaran nayanaṃ visphurati /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Indicating an omen) Oh, why does my right eye twitch?

children.text: śaku -- (nimittaṃ sūcayitvā) aho kiṃ me vāma-itaran nayanaṃ visphurati /
gautamī  jāte pratihatam amaṅgalam /sukhāni te bhartṛkuladevatā vitarantu (iti parikrāmati)
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Child, let the inauspicious be averted! May the deities of your husband's family bestow happiness upon you. (They walk about.)

children.text: gautamī -- jāte pratihatam amaṅgalam /sukhāni te bhartṛ-kula-devatā vitarantu (iti parikrāmati)
purohita  (rājānaṃ nirdiśya+bho bhos tapasvinaḥ asāv atrabhavān varṇāśramāṇāṃ rakṣitā prāg eva muktāsano vaḥ pratipālayati / paśyata enam /
children.translated_text: Royal priest: (Pointing to the king) O ascetics, here is his honor, the protector of the social orders and stages of life. He has already risen from his seat and awaits you. Behold him.

children.text: purohita -- (rājānaṃ nirdiśya+bho bhos tapasvinaḥ asāv atra-bhavān varṇa-āśramāṇāṃ rakṣitā prāg eva mukta-āsano vaḥ pratipālayati / paśyata enam /
śārṅgarava  bho mahābrāhmaṇa kāmam etad abhinandanīyaṃ tathāpi vayam atra madhyasthāḥ / kutaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: O great <s>brāhmaṇa</s>, this is indeed praiseworthy, yet we remain impartial in this matter. For —

children.text: śārṅgarava -- bho mahā-brāhmaṇa kāmam etad abhinandanīyaṃ tatha āpi vayam atra madhyasthāḥ / kutaḥ
bhavanti naṃrās taravaḥ phalāgamair navāmbubhir dūravilambino ghanāḥ /
children.translated_text: Trees bow down when fruit arrives; clouds hang low with fresh rain;

children.text: anuddhatāḥ satpuruṣāḥ samṛddhibhiḥ svabhāva evaiṣa paropakāriṇām //
children.translated_text: noble persons are not puffed up by prosperity — such is the very nature of those who benefit others.

children.text: bhavanti naṃrās taravaḥ phala-āgamair nava-ambubhir dūra-vilambino ghanāḥ /
anuddhatāḥ sat-puruṣāḥ samṛddhibhiḥ svabhāva eva eṣa para-upakāriṇām //
pratīhārī  deva prasannamukhavarṇā dṛśyante / jānāmi viśrabdhakāryā ṛṣayaḥ /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: My lord, the sages appear with serene countenances. I know that their purpose is one that inspires confidence.

children.text: pratīhārī -- deva prasanna-mukha-varṇā dṛśyante / jānāmi viśrabdha-kāryā ṛṣayaḥ /
rājā  (śakuntalāṃ dṛṣṭvā) athātra bhavatī
children.translated_text: King: (Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>) And who is this lady?

children.text: rājā -- (śakuntalāṃ dṛṣṭvā) atha atra bhavatī --
kā svid avaguṇṭhanavatī nātiparisphuṭaśarīralāvaṇyā /
children.translated_text: Who is she, veiled, her bodily grace not fully visible,

children.text: madhye tapodhanānāṃ kisalayam iva pāṇḍupatrāṇām //
children.translated_text: among the ascetics rich in <s>tapas</s>, like a tender shoot among withered leaves?

children.text: kā svid avaguṇṭhanavatī na atiparisphuṭa-śarīra-lāvaṇyā /
madhye tapodhanānāṃ kisalayam iva pāṇḍu-patrāṇām //
pratīhārī  deva kutūhalagarbhaḥ prahito na me tarkaḥ prasarati / nanu darśanīyā punar asyā ākṛtir lakṣyate /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: My lord, curiosity has been aroused in me, but my conjecture does not go further. Indeed, her form appears worthy of beholding.

children.text: pratīhārī -- deva kutūhala-garbhaḥ prahito na me tarkaḥ prasarati / nanu darśanīyā punar asyā ākṛtir lakṣyate /
rājā  bhavatu / anirvarṇanīyaṃ parakalatram /
children.translated_text: King: Enough. Another man's wife should not be scrutinized.

children.text: rājā -- bhavatu / anirvarṇanīyaṃ para-kalatram /
śaku  (hastam urasi kṛtvā / ātmagatam) hṛdaya kim evaṃ vepase / āryaputrasya bhāvam avadhārya dhīraṃ tāvad bhava /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Placing her hand on her heart; to herself) O heart, why do you tremble so? Discern the noble lord's feelings and be steady.

children.text: śaku -- (hastam urasi kṛtvā / ātma-gatam) hṛdaya kim evaṃ vepase / ārya-putrasya bhāvam avadhārya dhīraṃ tāvad bhava /
