purohita  (puro gatvā) ete vidhivad arcitās tapasvinaḥ / kaścid eṣām upādhyāyasaṃdeśaḥ / taṃ devaḥ śrotum arhati /
children.translated_text: Royal priest: (Stepping forward) These ascetics have been duly honored. They bear a message from their preceptor. Let the lord deign to hear it.

children.text: purohita -- (puro gatvā) ete vidhivad arcitās tapasvinaḥ / kaścid eṣām upādhyāya-saṃdeśaḥ / taṃ devaḥ śrotum arhati /
rājā  avahito 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: I am attentive.

children.text: rājā - avahito 'smi /
ṛṣayaḥ  (hastān udyamya) vijayasva rājan /
children.translated_text: Sages: (Raising their hands) Be victorious, O king!

children.text: ṛṣayaḥ -- (hastān udyamya) vijayasva rājan /
rā  sarvān abhivādaye /
children.translated_text: King: I salute you all.

children.text: rā -- sarvān abhivādaye /
ṛṣayaḥ  iṣṭena yujyasva /
children.translated_text: Sages: May you be united with your desires!

children.text: ṛṣayaḥ -- iṣṭena yujyasva /
rā  api nirvighnatapaso munayaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Are the penances of the sages proceeding without obstacle?

children.text: rā -- api nirvighna-tapaso munayaḥ /
ṛṣayaḥ
children.translated_text: Sages:

children.text: ṛṣayaḥ --
kuto dharmakriyāvighnaḥ satāṃ rakṣitari tvayi /
children.translated_text: How can there be an obstacle to sacred rites when you are the protector of the righteous?

children.text: tamas tapati dharmāṃśau katham āvir bhaviṣyati //
children.translated_text: When the sun of <s>dharma</s> shines, how shall darkness become visible?

children.text: kuto dharma-kriyā-vighnaḥ satāṃ rakṣitari tvayi /
tamas tapati dharma-aṃśau katham āvir bhaviṣyati //
rā  arthavān khalu me rājaśabdaḥ / atha bhagavāṃl lokānugrahāya kuśalī kāśyapaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Indeed, the title 'king' is thus made meaningful. And is the venerable <s>Kāśyapa</s> well, for the benefit of the world?

children.text: rā -- arthavān khalu me rāja-śabdaḥ / atha bhagavāṃl loka-anugrahāya kuśalī kāśyapaḥ /
śārṅgaravaḥ  svādhīnakuśalāḥ siddhimantaḥ / sa bhavantam anāmayapraśnapūrvakam idam āha /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Those who are masters of their own welfare are those who have attained perfection. He, after inquiring about your health, says this:

children.text: śārṅgaravaḥ -- svādhīna-kuśalāḥ siddhimantaḥ / sa bhavantam anāmaya-praśna-pūrvakam idam āha /
rā  kim ājñāpayati bhagavān /
children.translated_text: King: What does the venerable one command?

children.text: rā -- kim ājñāpayati bhagavān /
śā  yan mithaḥsamayād imāṃ madīyāṃ duhitaraṃ bhavān upāyaṃsta tan mayā prītimatā yuvayor anujñātam / kutaḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: "Since by mutual agreement you married this daughter of mine, I have gladly given my consent to you both. For —

children.text: śā -- yan mithaḥ-samayād imāṃ madīyāṃ duhitaraṃ bhavān upāyaṃsta tan mayā prītimatā yuvayor anujñātam / kutaḥ
tvam arhatāṃ prāgrasaraḥ smṛto 'si naḥ
śakuntalā mūrtimatī ca satkriyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s> is the embodiment of virtuous conduct.
You are acknowledged by us as the foremost among the worthy;

children.text: samānayaṃs tulyaguṇaṃ vadhūvaram
cirasya vācyaṃ na gataḥ prajāpatiḥ //
children.translated_text: the Creator has not, after long delay, incurred reproach.
By joining bride and groom of equal merit,

children.text: tvam arhatāṃ prāgrasaraḥ smṛto 'si naḥ
śakuntalā mūrtimatī ca satkriyā /
samānayaṃs tulya-guṇaṃ vadhū-varam
cirasya vācyaṃ na gataḥ prajā-patiḥ //
tad idānīm āpannasattveyaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ sahadharmacaraṇāyeti /
children.translated_text: Therefore, let her, who now carries your child, be received as your partner in the duties of <s>dharma</s>."

children.text: tad idānīm āpanna-sattva īyaṃ pratigṛhyatāṃ sahadharma-caraṇāya iti /
gautamī  ārya kim api vaktukāmāsmi / na me vacanāvasaro 'sti / katham iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Sir, I wish to say something, but there is no occasion for my words. How so?

children.text: gautamī -- ārya kim api vaktu-kāma āsmi / na me vacana-avasaro 'sti / katham iti /
nāpekṣito gurujano 'nayā tvayā pṛṣṭo na bandhujanaḥ /
children.translated_text: Your elders were not consulted by her; her kinsmen were not asked by you.

children.text: ekaikasminn eva carite bhaṇāmi kim ekaikam //
children.translated_text: When each action has been done independently, what need to speak of each one separately?

children.text: na apekṣito guru-jano 'nayā tvayā pṛṣṭo na bandhu-janaḥ /
eka-ekasminn eva carite bhaṇāmi kim eka-ekam //
śaku  (ātmagatam) kiṃ nu khalv āryaputro bhaṇati /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) What does the noble lord say?

children.text: śaku -- (ātma-gatam) kiṃ nu khalv ārya-putro bhaṇati /
rā  kim idam upanyastam /
children.translated_text: King: What is the meaning of this proposal?

children.text: rā -- kim idam upanyastam /
śaku  (ātmagatam) pāvakaḥ khalu vacanopanyāsaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) This manner of speaking is indeed like fire.

children.text: śaku -- (ātma-gatam) pāvakaḥ khalu vacana-upanyāsaḥ /
śā  katham idaṃ nāma / bhavanta eva sutarāṃ lokavṛttāntaniṣṇātāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: What is this indeed? You yourselves are thoroughly versed in the ways of the world.

children.text: śā -- katham idaṃ nāma / bhavanta eva sutarāṃ loka-vṛtta-anta-niṣṇātāḥ /
satīm api jñātikulaikasaṃśrayām
jano 'nyathā bhartṛmatīṃ viśaṅkate /
children.translated_text: the world suspects if she is married to another.
Even a virtuous woman, whose sole refuge is her own kin,

children.text: ataḥ samīpe pariṇetur iṣyate /
priyāpriyā vā pramadā svabandhubhiḥ //
children.translated_text: whether she be dear or not to them.
Therefore a bride is given away in the presence of her own relatives,

children.text: satīm api jñāti-kula-eka-saṃśrayām
jano 'nyathā bhartṛmatīṃ viśaṅkate /
ataḥ samīpe pariṇetur iṣyate /
priya āpriyā vā pramadā sva-bandhubhiḥ //
rā  kim atrabhavatī mayā pariṇītapūrvā /
children.translated_text: King: Was this lady previously married to me?

children.text: rā -- kim atra-bhavatī mayā pariṇīta-pūrvā /
śaku  (saviṣādam) hṛdaya sāṃprataṃ te āśaṅkā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (With grief) O heart, now your apprehension [is justified].

children.text: śaku -- (saviṣādam) hṛdaya sāṃprataṃ te āśaṅkā /
śā  kiṃ kṛtakāryadveṣo dharmaṃ prati vimukhatā kṛtāvajñā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Is this aversion to one's accomplished deed? This turning away from <s>dharma</s>? This contempt?

children.text: śā -- kiṃ kṛta-kārya-dveṣo dharmaṃ prati vimukhatā kṛta-avajñā /
rā  kuto 'yam asatkalpanāpraśnaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Whence this question based on a false supposition?

children.text: rā -- kuto 'yam asat-kalpanā-praśnaḥ /
śā
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>:

children.text: śā --
mūrchanty amī vikārāḥ prāyeṇaiśvaryamatteṣu //
children.translated_text: Such corruptions of character increase, as a rule, in those intoxicated with power.

children.text: mūrchanty amī vikārāḥ prāyeṇā eśvarya-matteṣu //
rā  viśeṣeṇādhikṣipto 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: I am especially affronted by this!

children.text: rā -- viśeṣeṇa adhikṣipto 'smi /
gautamī  jāte muhhūrtaṃ mā lajjasva / apaneṣyāmi tāvat te 'vaguṇṭhanam / tatas tvāṃ bhartābhijñāsyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Child, be not ashamed for a moment. Let me remove your veil. Then your husband will recognize you.

children.text: gautamī -- jāte muhhūrtaṃ mā lajjasva / apaneṣyāmi tāvat te 'vaguṇṭhanam / tatas tvāṃ bharta ābhijñāsyati /
rā  (śakuntalāṃ nirvarṇya / ātmagatam)
children.translated_text: King: (Gazing at <s>Śakuntalā</s>; to himself)

children.text: rā -- (śakuntalāṃ nirvarṇya / ātma-gatam)
idam upanatam evaṃ rūpam akliṣṭakānti
prathamaparigṛhītaṃ syān na vety avyavasyan /
children.translated_text: was or was not previously accepted by me,
While I deliberate whether this form presented before me, of effortless beauty,

children.text: bhramara iva vibhāte kundam antastuṣāram
na ca khalu parobhoktuṃ nāpi śaknomi hātum //
children.translated_text: I can neither enjoy her nor indeed abandon her.
like a bee before a jasmine flower with dew still within,

children.text: idam upanatam evaṃ rūpam akliṣṭa-kānti
prathama-parigṛhītaṃ syān na va īty avyavasyan /
bhramara iva vibhāte kundam antas-tuṣāram
na ca khalu parobhoktuṃ na api śaknomi hātum //
(iti vicārayan sthitaḥ)
children.translated_text: (He stands deliberating.)

children.text: (iti vicārayan sthitaḥ)
pratīhārī  (svagatam) aho dharmāpekṣitā bhartuḥ / īdṛśaṃ nāma sukhopanataṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭā ko 'nyo vicārayati /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: (To herself) Oh, what regard the lord has for <s>dharma</s>! Seeing such beauty so readily offered, who else would hesitate?

children.text: pratīhārī -- (svagatam) aho dharma-apekṣitā bhartuḥ / īdṛśaṃ nāma sukha-upanataṃ rūpaṃ dṛṣṭā ko 'nyo vicārayati /
śā  bho rājan kim iti joṣam āsyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: O king, why do you remain silent?

children.text: śā -- bho rājan kim iti joṣam āsyate /
rā  bhos tapodhanāḥ cintayann api na khalu svīkaraṇam atrabhavatyāḥ smarāmi / tat katham imām abhivyaktasattvalakṣaṇāṃ pratyātmānaṃ kṣetriṇam aśaṅkamānaḥ pratipatsye /
children.translated_text: King: O ascetics, even upon reflection I cannot recall having married this lady. How then, suspecting myself to be the father, can I accept her who manifestly bears the marks of pregnancy?

children.text: rā -- bhos tapo-dhanāḥ cintayann api na khalu svīkaraṇam atra-bhavatyāḥ smarāmi / tat katham imām abhivyakta-sattva-lakṣaṇāṃ pratyātmānaṃ kṣetriṇam aśaṅkamānaḥ pratipatsye /
śakuntalā  (apavārya) āryasya pariṇaya eva saṃdehaḥ / kuta idānīṃ me dūrādhirohiṇy āśā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Aside) Even his marriage is in doubt! Alas, where now is my hope that had climbed so high?

children.text: śakuntalā -- (apavārya) āryasya pariṇaya eva saṃdehaḥ / kuta idānīṃ me dūra-adhirohiṇy āśā /
śār  mā tāvat /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Do not say so!

children.text: śār -- mā tāvat /
kṛtābhimarśām anumanyamānaḥ sutāṃ tvayā nāma munir vimānyaḥ /
children.translated_text: Is the sage to be dishonored by you, who consents to his daughter being touched?

children.text: muṣṭaṃ pratigrāhayatā svam arthaṃ pātrīkṛto dasyur ivāsi yena //
children.translated_text: He who makes the other accept stolen goods as a gift — by that act, you are made into a thief, as it were.

children.text: kṛta-abhimarśām anumanyamānaḥ sutāṃ tvayā nāma munir vimānyaḥ /
muṣṭaṃ pratigrāhayatā svam arthaṃ pātrī-kṛto dasyur iva asi yena //
śāradvata  śārṅgarava vimara tvam idānīm / śakuntale vaktavyam uktam asmābhiḥ / so 'yam atrabhavān evam āha / dīyatām asmai pratyayaprativacanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śāradvata</s>: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>, desist now. <s>Śakuntalā</s>, what was to be said has been said by us. Here, his honor speaks thus. Let an answer providing proof be given to him.

children.text: śāradvata -- śārṅgarava vimara tvam idānīm / śakuntale vaktavyam uktam asmābhiḥ / so 'yam atra-bhavān evam āha / dīyatām asmai pratyaya-prativacanam /
śaku  (apavārya) idam avasthhāntaraṃ gate tādṛśe 'nurāge kiṃ vā smāritena / ātmedānīṃ me śocanīya iti vyavasitam etat / (prakāśam)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Aside) When such affection has passed into a different state, what use is there in reminding him? But it is now decided that it is I myself who must be pitied. (Aloud)

children.text: śaku -- (apavārya) idam avasthhā-antaraṃ gate tādṛśe 'nurāge kiṃ vā smāritena / ātma īdānīṃ me śocanīya iti vyavasitam etat / (prakāśam)
paurava yuktaṃ nāma te tathā purāśramapade svabhāvottānahṛdayam imaṃ janaṃ samayapūrvaṃ pratārya sāṃpratam īdṛśair akṣaraiḥ pratyākhyātum /
children.translated_text: O scion of <s>Puru</s>, is it fitting for you — who, at the hermitage formerly, having deceived this person of naturally open heart with a pledge of love — now to reject her with such words?

children.text: paurava yuktaṃ nāma te tathā purā āśrama-pade svabhāva-uttāna-hṛdayam imaṃ janaṃ samaya-pūrvaṃ pratārya sāṃpratam īdṛśair akṣaraiḥ pratyākhyātum /
rājā  (karṇau vidhāya) śāntaṃ pāpam /
children.translated_text: King: (Covering his ears) Let evil be averted!

children.text: rājā -- (karṇau vidhāya) śāntaṃ pāpam /
vyapadeśam āvilayituṃ kim īhase janam imam a pātayitum /
children.translated_text: Why do you seek to cloud your reputation and to bring down this person?

children.text: kūlaṃ kaṣā iva sindhuḥ prasannam ambhas taṭataruṃ ca //
children.translated_text: Like a river that erodes its own bank, while the waters [it carries] are clear, and [destroys] the trees upon the shore.

children.text: vyapadeśam āvilayituṃ kim īhase janam imam a pātayitum /
kūlaṃ kaṣā iva sindhuḥ prasannam ambhas taṭa-taruṃ ca //
śaku  bhavatu / yadi paramārthataḥ paraparigrahaśaṅkinā tvayaivaṃ pravṛttaṃ tad+abhijñānenānena tavāśaṅkām apaneṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Very well! If you have acted thus out of genuine suspicion that I belong to another, then I shall remove your doubt by means of a token of recognition.

children.text: śaku -- bhavatu / yadi parama-arthataḥ para-parigraha-śaṅkinā tvaya aivaṃ pravṛttaṃ tad+abhijñānena anena tavā aśaṅkām apaneṣyāmi /
rājā  udāraḥ kalpaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: An excellent plan!

children.text: rājā -- udāraḥ kalpaḥ /
śaku  (mudrāsthānaṃ parāmṛśya) hā dhig ghā dhik / aṅgulīyakaśūnyā me 'ṅguliḥ / (iti saviṣādaṃ gautamīm avekṣate)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Feeling the place of the ring) Alas! Woe is me! My finger is empty of the ring! (She looks at <s>Gautamī</s> with despair.)

children.text: śaku -- (mudrā-sthānaṃ parāmṛśya) hā dhig ghā dhik / aṅgulīyaka-śūnyā me 'ṅguliḥ / (iti saviṣādaṃ gautamīm avekṣate)
gautamī  nūnaṃ te śakrāvatārābhyantare śacītīrthasalilaṃ vandamānāyāḥ prabhraṣṭam aṅgulīyakam /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: Surely the ring must have slipped off when you were offering homage to the waters at the <s>tīrtha</s> (pilgrimage site) of <s>Śacī</s> near <s>Śakrāvatāra</s>.

children.text: gautamī - nūnaṃ te śakra-avatāra-abhyantare śacī-tīrtha-salilaṃ vandamānāyāḥ prabhraṣṭam aṅgulīyakam /
rājā  (sasmitam) idaṃ tat pratyutpannamati straiṇam iti yad ucyate /
children.translated_text: King: (Smiling) This is what is meant by the saying: 'Women have a ready wit.'

children.text: rājā -- (sasmitam) idaṃ tat pratyutpanna-mati straiṇam iti yad ucyate /
śaku  atra tāvad vidhinā darśitaṃ prabhutvam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: In this at least, fate has shown its dominion.

children.text: śaku -- atra tāvad vidhinā darśitaṃ prabhutvam /
rājā  śrotavyam idānīṃ saṃvṛttam /
children.translated_text: King: Now there is something worth hearing.

children.text: rājā -- śrotavyam idānīṃ saṃvṛttam /
śaku  nanv ekasmin divase navamālikāmaṇḍape nalinīpatrabhājanagatam udakaṃ tava haste saṃnihitam āsīt /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Listen then. One day, in the <s>navamālikā</s> (jasmine) bower, water held in a lotus-leaf cup was in your hand.

children.text: śaku -- nanv ekasmin divase navamālikā-maṇḍape nalinī-patra-bhājana-gatam udakaṃ tava haste saṃnihitam āsīt /
rājā  śṛṇumas tāvat /
children.translated_text: King: Let us hear further.

children.text: rājā -- śṛṇumas tāvat /
śaku  tatkṣaṇe sa me putrakṛtako dīrghāpāṅgo nāma mṛgapotaka upasthitaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: At that moment, my foster-child, the fawn named <s>Dīrghāpāṅga</s> (Long-eyed), came up to you.

children.text: śaku -- tat-kṣaṇe sa me putra-kṛtako dīrgha-apāṅgo nāma mṛga-potaka upasthitaḥ /

tvayāyaṃ tāvat prathamaṃ pibatv ity anukampinopacchandita udakena / na punas te 'paricayād hastābhyāsam upagataḥ / paścāt tasminn eva mayā gṛhīte salile 'nena kṛtaḥ praṇayaḥ / tadā tvam itthaṃ prahasito 'si / sarvaḥ sagandheṣu viśvasiti / dvāv apy atrāraṇyakāv iti /
children.translated_text: You, being compassionate, offered him the water saying, 'Let him drink first.' But he, being unfamiliar with you, would not approach your hand. Afterward, when I held the same water, he drank trustingly. Then you laughed and said: 'Everyone trusts those of the same scent. Both of you are indeed children of the forest.'

children.text: tvaya āyaṃ tāvat prathamaṃ pibatv ity anukampina ūpacchandita udakena / na punas te 'paricayād hasta-abhyāsam upagataḥ / paścāt tasminn eva mayā gṛhīte salile 'nena kṛtaḥ praṇayaḥ / tadā tvam itthaṃ prahasito 'si / sarvaḥ sagandheṣu viśvasiti / dvāv apy atra araṇyakāv iti /
rājā  evam ādibhir ātmakāryanirvartinīnām anṛtamayavān madhubhir ākṛṣyate viṣayiṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: It is thus, with such honey-sweet lies that serve their own purposes, that sensuous persons are ensnared.

children.text: rājā -- evam ādibhir ātma-kārya-nirvartinīnām anṛtamaya-vān madhubhir ākṛṣyate viṣayiṇaḥ /
gautamī  mahābhāga nārhasy evaṃ mantrayitum / tapovanasaṃvardhito 'nabhijño 'yaṃ janaḥ kaitavasya /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: O noble sir, you ought not speak so. This person, raised in the <s>tapovana</s> (hermitage grove), is unacquainted with deceit.

children.text: gautamī -- mahā-bhāga na arhasy evaṃ mantrayitum / tapovana-saṃvardhito 'nabhijño 'yaṃ janaḥ kaitavasya /
rājā  tāpasavṛddhe /
children.translated_text: King: O venerable ascetic lady —

children.text: rājā -- tāpasa-vṛddhe /
strīṇām aśikṣitapaṭutvam amānuṣīṣu
saṃdṛśyate kim uta yāḥ pratibodhavatyaḥ /
children.translated_text: in birds that are not human — how much more in those who possess understanding!
Untaught cunning is observed even

children.text: prāgantarikṣagamanās tvam apatyajātam
anyair dvijaiḥ parabhṛtāḥ khalu poṣayanti //
children.translated_text: have their offspring raised by other birds.
Before they can fly, the cuckoos indeed

children.text: strīṇām aśikṣita-paṭutvam amānuṣīṣu
saṃdṛśyate kim uta yāḥ pratibodhavatyaḥ /
prāg-antarikṣa-gamanās tvam apatya-jātam
anyair dvijaiḥ para-bhṛtāḥ khalu poṣayanti //
śaku  (saroṣam+anārya ātmano hṛdayānumānena prekṣase / ka idānīm anyo dharmakañcukapraveśinas tṛṇachannakūpopamasya tavānukṛtiṃ pratipatsyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (With anger) Ignoble one! You judge by the measure of your own heart! Who else would now imitate you, who enter wearing the cloak of <s>dharma</s> yet are like a well covered with grass?

children.text: śaku -- (saroṣam+anārya ātmano hṛdaya-anumānena prekṣase / ka idānīm anyo dharma-kañcuka-praveśinas tṛṇa-channa-kūpa-upamasya tava anukṛtiṃ pratipatsyate /
rājā  (ātmagatam) saṃdigdhabuddhim āṃ kurvann akaitava ivāsyāḥ kopo lakṣyate / tathā hy anayā
children.translated_text: King: (To himself) Even as she makes me of doubtful mind, her anger appears genuine and without deceit. For indeed —

children.text: rājā -- (ātma-gatam) saṃdigdha-buddhim āṃ kurvann akaitava iva asyāḥ kopo lakṣyate / tathā hy anayā --
mayy eva vismaraṇadāruṇacittavṛttau
vṛttaṃ rahaḥ praṇayam apratipadyamāne /
children.translated_text: do not acknowledge the love we privately shared,
When I, cruel of mind in my forgetfulness,

children.text: bhedād bhruvoḥ kuṭilayor atilohitākṣyā
bhagnaṃ śarāsanam ivātiruṣā smarasya //
children.translated_text: appear like the bow of the god of love, broken in excess of fury.
her furrowed brows and eyes reddened with rage

children.text: mayy eva vismaraṇa-dāruṇa-citta-vṛttau
vṛttaṃ rahaḥ praṇayam apratipadyamāne /
bhedād bhruvoḥ kuṭilayor atilohita-akṣyā
bhagnaṃ śara-āsanam iva atiruṣā smarasya //
(prakāśam) bhadre prathitaṃ duṣyantasya caritam / tathāpīdaṃ na dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: (Aloud) Good lady, the conduct of <s>Duṣyanta</s> is well known. Yet this [claim] is not borne out.

children.text: (prakāśam) bhadre prathitaṃ duṣyantasya caritam / tatha āpi idaṃ na dṛśyate /
śaku  suṣṭhu tāvad atra svacchandacāriṇī kṛtāsmi yāham asya puruvaṃśapratyayena mukhamadhor hṛdayaviṣasya hastābhyāsam upagatā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: How well indeed I have been left to my own devices here — I who, trusting in this man of the <s>Puru</s> dynasty, sweet in face but with poison in his heart, placed myself within reach of his hands!

children.text: śaku -- suṣṭhu tāvad atra svacchanda-cāriṇī kṛta āsmi ya āham asya puru-vaṃśa-pratyayena mukha-madhor hṛdaya-viṣasya hasta-abhyāsam upagatā /
śārṅgarava  ittham ātmakṛtaṃ cāpalaṃ dahati /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Thus does the fickleness of one's own making burn one.

children.text: śārṅgarava -- ittham ātma-kṛtaṃ cāpalaṃ dahati /
ataḥ parīkṣya kartavyaṃ viśeṣāt saṃgataṃ rahaḥ /
children.translated_text: Therefore, one should act with discernment, especially in secret meetings;

children.text: ajñātahṛdayeṣv evaṃ vairībhavati sauhṛdam //
children.translated_text: for in those whose hearts are unknown, friendship turns into enmity.

children.text: ataḥ parīkṣya kartavyaṃ viśeṣāt saṃgataṃ rahaḥ /
ajñāta-hṛdayeṣv evaṃ vairī-bhavati sauhṛdam //
rājā  ayi bhoḥ kim atrabhavatīpratyayād evāsmān saṃyutadoṣākṣaraiḥ kṣiṇutha /
children.translated_text: King: What, sir! Do you reproach us with words charged with blame, trusting solely in the word of this lady?

children.text: rājā -- ayi bhoḥ kim atra-bhavatī-pratyayād eva asmān saṃyuta-doṣa-akṣaraiḥ kṣiṇutha /
śārṅg (sāsūyam) śrutaṃ bhavadbhir adharottaram /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: (With jealous indignation) Listen to this topsy-turvy reasoning!

children.text: śārṅg --(sāsūyam) śrutaṃ bhavadbhir adhara-uttaram /
ā janmanaḥ śāṭhyam aśikṣito yas tasyāpramāṇaṃ vacanaṃ janasya /
children.translated_text: He who from birth has learned no deceit — the word of such a person is not to be trusted!

children.text: parātisaṃdhānam adhīyate yair vidyeti te santu kilāptavācaḥ //
children.translated_text: But let those who study the art of deceiving others be considered trustworthy speakers, forsooth!

children.text: ā janmanaḥ śāṭhyam aśikṣito yas tasya apramāṇaṃ vacanaṃ janasya /
para-atisaṃdhānam adhīyate yair vidya īti te santu kilā apta-vācaḥ //
rājā  bhoḥ satyavādinn abhyupagataṃ tāvad asmābhir evam / kiṃ punar imām atisaṃdhāya labhyate /
children.translated_text: King: Sir, O truthful one, let it be granted by us thus. But what is to be gained by deceiving this lady?

children.text: rājā -- bhoḥ satya-vādinn abhyupagataṃ tāvad asmābhir evam / kiṃ punar imām atisaṃdhāya labhyate /
śārṅg  vinipātaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: Ruin.

children.text: śārṅg -- vinipātaḥ /
rājā  vinipātaḥ pauravaiḥ prārthyata iti na śraddheyam etat /
children.translated_text: King: That ruin should be sought by the <s>Pauravas</s> — this is not credible!

children.text: rājā -- vinipātaḥ pauravaiḥ prārthyata iti na śraddheyam etat /
śārad  śārṅgarava kim uttareṇa / anuṣṭhito guroḥ saṃdeśaḥ / pratinivartāmahe vayam / (rājānaṃ prati)
children.translated_text: <s>Śāradvatā</s>: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>, what is the point of further argument? The master's message has been carried out. Let us return. (To the king)

children.text: śārad -- śārṅgarava kim uttareṇa / anuṣṭhito guroḥ saṃdeśaḥ / pratinivartāmahe vayam / (rājānaṃ prati)
tad eṣā bhavataḥ kāntā tyaja vaināṃ gṛhāṇa vā /
children.translated_text: Here is your wife; abandon her or accept her.

children.text: upapannā hi dāreṣu prabhutā sarvatomukhī //
children.translated_text: For a husband's authority over his wives is absolute in every way.

children.text: tad eṣā bhavataḥ kāntā tyaja va aināṃ gṛhāṇa vā /
upapannā hi dāreṣu prabhutā sarvato-mukhī //
gautami gacchāgrataḥ / (iti prasthitāḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>, go ahead. (They start to leave.)

children.text: gautami gaccha agrataḥ / (iti prasthitāḥ)
śaku  katham anena kitavena vipralabdhāsmi / yūyam api māṃ parityajatha / (ity anupratiṣṭhate)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: What! Deceived by this cheat, do you also abandon me? (She follows them.)

children.text: śaku -- katham anena kitavena vipralabdha āsmi / yūyam api māṃ parityajatha / (ity anupratiṣṭhate)
gautamī  (sthitvā) vatsa śārṅgarava anugacchatīyaṃ khalu naḥ karuṇaparidevinī śakuntalā / pratyādeśaparuṣe bhartari kiṃ vā me putrikā karotu /
children.translated_text: <s>Gautamī</s>: (Stopping) Son <s>Śārṅgarava</s>, our <s>Śakuntalā</s> follows us, weeping piteously. What shall my daughter do when her husband is so harsh in his rejection?

children.text: gautamī -- (sthitvā) vatsa śārṅgarava anugacchati iyaṃ khalu naḥ karuṇa-paridevinī śakuntalā / pratyādeśa-paruṣe bhartari kiṃ vā me putrikā karotu /
śārṅg  (saroṣaṃ nivṛtya) kiṃ purobhāge svātantryam avalambase / (śakuntalā bhītā vepate)
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: (Turning angrily) What! Do you presume to act independently before me? (<s>Śakuntalā</s>, frightened, trembles.)

children.text: śārṅg -- (saroṣaṃ nivṛtya) kiṃ puro-bhāge svātantryam avalambase / (śakuntalā bhītā vepate)
śārṅg  śakutale /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: <s>Śakuntalā</s>!

children.text: śārṅg -- śakutale /
yadi yathā vadati kṣitipas tathā
tvam asi kiṃ pitur utkulayā tvayā /
children.translated_text: what can your father do with you who have disgraced the family?
If you are as the lord of the earth says,

children.text: atha tu vetsi śuci vratam ātmanaḥ
patikule tava dāsyam api kṣamam //
children.translated_text: even servitude in your husband's house is fitting for you.
But if you know your own vow to be pure,

children.text: yadi yathā vadati kṣitipas tathā
tvam asi kiṃ pitur utkulayā tvayā /
atha tu vetsi śuci vratam ātmanaḥ
pati-kule tava dāsyam api kṣamam //
tiṣṭha / sādhayāmo vayam /
children.translated_text: Stay. We shall go about our business.

children.text: tiṣṭha / sādhayāmo vayam /
rājā  bhos tapasvin kim atrabhavatīṃ vipralabhase /
children.translated_text: King: Good ascetic, why do you deceive this lady?

children.text: rājā -- bhos tapasvin kim atra-bhavatīṃ vipralabhase /
kumudāny eva śaśāṅkaḥ savitā bodhayati paṅkajāny eva /
children.translated_text: The moon opens only water-lilies; the sun awakens only lotuses;

children.text: vaśināṃ hi paraparigrahasaṃśleṣaparāṅmukhī vṛttiḥ //
children.translated_text: for the conduct of the self-controlled turns away from embracing another's wife.

children.text: kumudāny eva śaśa-aṅkaḥ savitā bodhayati paṅkajāny eva /
vaśināṃ hi para-parigraha-saṃśleṣa-parāṅmukhī vṛttiḥ //
śārṅg  yadā tu pūrvavṛttam anyasaṅgād vismṛto bhavāṃs tadā katham adharmabhīruḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śārṅgarava</s>: When, having forgotten your past conduct through attachment to another, you call yourself one who fears unrighteousness — how is that?

children.text: śārṅg -- yadā tu pūrva-vṛttam anya-saṅgād vismṛto bhavāṃs tadā katham adharma-bhīruḥ /
rājā  bhavantam evātra gurulāghavaṃ pṛcchāmi /
children.translated_text: King: I put this question of the weightier course to you yourself:

children.text: rājā -- bhavantam eva atra guru-lāghavaṃ pṛcchāmi /
mūḍhaḥ syām aham eṣā vā vaden mithyeti saṃśaye /
children.translated_text: Whether I am the deluded one, or whether she speaks falsely — in this doubt,

children.text: dāratyāgī bhavāmy āho parastrīsparśapāṃsulaḥ //
children.translated_text: should I become an abandoner of my wife, or one defiled by the touch of another's woman?

children.text: mūḍhaḥ syām aham eṣā vā vaden mithya īti saṃśaye /
dāra-tyāgī bhavāmy āho para-strī-sparśa-pāṃsulaḥ //
purohita  (vicārya) yadi tāvad evaṃ kriyatām /
children.translated_text: Priest: (After deliberation) If it may be done thus —

children.text: purohita -- (vicārya) yadi tāvad evaṃ kriyatām /
rājā  anuśāstu māṃ bhavān /
children.translated_text: King: Let your honor instruct me.

children.text: rājā -- anuśāstu māṃ bhavān /

purohita  atrabhavatī tavad āprasavād asmadgṛhe tiṣṭhatu / kuta idam ucyata iti cet / tvaṃ sādhubhir ādiṣṭapūrvaḥ prathamam eva cakravartinaṃ putraṃ janayiṣyasīti / sa cen munidauhitras tallakṣaṇopapanno bhaviṣyati abhinandya śuddhāntam enāṃ praveśayiṣyati / viparyaye tu pitur asyāḥ samīpanayanam avasthitam eva /
children.translated_text: Priest: Let this lady remain in our house until her delivery. Why is this said? Because you have been foretold by holy men that you shall first beget a son who will be a universal monarch (<s>cakravartin</s>). If the sage's granddaughter gives birth to a son bearing those marks, then gladly you shall receive her into the inner chambers. In the contrary case, sending her back to her father remains the settled course.

children.text: purohita -- atra-bhavatī tavad ā-prasavād asmad-gṛhe tiṣṭhatu / kuta idam ucyata iti cet / tvaṃ sādhubhir ādiṣṭa-pūrvaḥ prathamam eva cakra-vartinaṃ putraṃ janayiṣyasi iti / sa cen muni-dauhitras tal-lakṣaṇa-upapanno bhaviṣyati abhinandya śuddha-antam enāṃ praveśayiṣyati / viparyaye tu pitur asyāḥ samīpa-nayanam avasthitam eva /
rājā  yathā gurubhyo rocate /
children.translated_text: King: As it pleases my elders.

children.text: rājā -- yathā gurubhyo rocate /
purohita  vatse anugaccha mām /
children.translated_text: Priest: Child, follow me.

children.text: purohita -- vatse anugaccha mām /
śaku  bhagāti vasudhe dehi me vivaram / (iti rudatī prasthitā / niṣkrāntā saha purodhasā tapasvibhiś ca)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: O Goddess Earth, give me an opening! (Weeping, she exits; she goes out together with the priest and the ascetics.)

children.text: śaku -- bhagāti vasudhe dehi me vivaram / (iti rudatī prasthitā / niṣkrāntā saha purodhasā tapasvibhiś ca)
(rājā śāpavyavahitasmṛtiḥ śakuntalāgatam eva cintayati)
children.translated_text: (The king, his memory obstructed by the curse, keeps thinking about <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s arrival.)

children.text: (rājā śāpa-vyavahita-smṛtiḥ śakuntalā-gatam eva cintayati)
(nepathye) āścaryam āścaryam /
children.translated_text: (Offstage) A marvel! A marvel!

children.text: (nepathye) āścaryam āścaryam /
rājā  (ākarṇya) kiṃ nu khalu syāt /
children.translated_text: King: (Listening) What could that be?

children.text: rājā -- (ākarṇya) kiṃ nu khalu syāt /
(praviśya) purohita  (savismayam) deva adbhutaṃ khalu saṃvṛttam /
children.translated_text: (Entering) Priest: (With astonishment) Your Majesty, a wondrous thing has occurred!

children.text: (praviśya) purohita -- (savismayam) deva adbhutaṃ khalu saṃvṛttam /
rājā  kim iva /
children.translated_text: King: What is it?

children.text: rājā -- kim iva /
purohita  deva parāvṛtteṣu kaṇvaśiṣyeṣu
children.translated_text: Priest: Your Majesty, after <s>Kaṇva</s>'s disciples had turned back,

children.text: purohita -- deva parāvṛtteṣu kaṇva-śiṣyeṣu --
sā nindanī svāni bhāgyāni bālā bāhūtkṣepaṃ krandituṃ ca pravṛttā /
children.translated_text: that young woman, lamenting her fate, began to cry aloud with arms raised up.

children.text: sā nindanī svāni bhāgyāni bālā bāhu-utkṣepaṃ krandituṃ ca pravṛttā /
rājā  kiṃ ca /
children.translated_text: King: And then?

children.text: rājā -- kiṃ ca /
purohita
children.translated_text: Priest:

children.text: purohita --
strīsaṃsthānaṃ cāpsaras tīrtham ārād utkṣipyaināṃ jyotir ekaṃ jagāma //
children.translated_text: A light in the form of a woman — from near the <s>Apsaras</s> bathing-place — snatched her up and vanished.

children.text: strī-saṃsthānaṃ ca apsaras tīrtham ārād utkṣipya enāṃ jyotir ekaṃ jagāma //
(sarve vismayaṃ rūpayanti)
children.translated_text: (All express amazement.)

children.text: (sarve vismayaṃ rūpayanti)
rājā  bhagavan prāg api so 'smābhir arthaḥ pratyādiṣṭa eva / kiṃ vṛthā tarkeṇānviṣyate / viśrāmyatu bhavān /
children.translated_text: King: Reverend sir, that matter was already rejected by us. Why is it vainly investigated by conjecture? Let your honor take rest.

children.text: rājā -- bhagavan prāg api so 'smābhir arthaḥ pratyādiṣṭa eva / kiṃ vṛthā tarkeṇa anviṣyate / viśrāmyatu bhavān /
purohita  (vilokya) vijayasva (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: Priest: (Looking about) May you be victorious. (He exits.)

children.text: purohita -- (vilokya) vijayasva (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
rājā  vetravati paryākulo 'smi / śayanabhūmimārgam ādeśaya /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Vetravati</s>, I am distressed. Show me the way to the bedchamber.

children.text: rājā -- vetravati paryākulo 'smi / śayana-bhūmi-mārgam ādeśaya /
pratīhārī  ita ito devaḥ (iti prasthitaḥ)
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: This way, this way, Your Majesty. (They start to leave.)

children.text: pratīhārī -- ita ito devaḥ (iti prasthitaḥ)
rājā
children.translated_text: King:

children.text: rājā --
kāmaṃ pratyādiṣṭāṃ smarāmi na parigrahaṃ munes tanayām /
children.translated_text: Though I have rejected her, I do not remember accepting the sage's daughter;

children.text: balavat tu dūyamānaṃ pratyāyayatīva māṃ hṛdayam //
children.translated_text: yet my heart, as if painfully burning, seems to convince me otherwise.

children.text: kāmaṃ pratyādiṣṭāṃ smarāmi na parigrahaṃ munes tanayām /
balavat tu dūyamānaṃ pratyāyayati iva māṃ hṛdayam //
(iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
children.translated_text: (All exit.)

children.text: (iti niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
pañcamo 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: End of the Fifth Act.

children.text: ṣaṣṭho 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: The Sixth Act.

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati nāgarikaḥ śyālaḥ paścād baddhaṃ puruṣam ādāya rakṣiṇau ca)
children.translated_text: (Then enter the city magistrate, his brother-in-law, with two guards bringing a man bound from behind.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati nāgarikaḥ śyālaḥ paścād baddhaṃ puruṣam ādāya rakṣiṇau ca)
rakṣiṇau  (puruṣaṃ tāḍaitvā) are kumbhīraka kathaya kutra tvayaitan maṇibandhanotkīrṇanāmadheyaṃ rājakīyam aṅgulīyakaṃ samāsāditam /
children.translated_text: Guards: (Striking the man) Hey, <s>Kumbhīraka</s>! Tell us — where did you obtain this royal signet ring with a name engraved on the gem-setting?

children.text: rakṣiṇau -- (puruṣaṃ tāḍaitvā) are kumbhīraka kathaya kutra tvaya aitan maṇi-bandhana-utkīrṇa-nāmadheyaṃ rājakīyam aṅgulīyakaṃ samāsāditam /
puruṣaḥ  (bhītināṭitakena) prasīdantu bhāvamiśrāḥ / nāham īdṛśakarmakārī /
children.translated_text: Man: (Feigning fear) Have mercy, noble sirs! I am not one who does such deeds!

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- (bhīti-nāṭitakena) prasīdantu bhāva-miśrāḥ / na aham īdṛśa-karma-kārī /
prathamaḥ  kiṃ śobhano brāhmaṇa iti kṛtvā (kalayitvā) rājñā pratigraho dattaḥ /
children.translated_text: First Guard: What, did the king give it to you as a gift, thinking you were a fine Brahmin? (Examining it)

children.text: prathamaḥ -- kiṃ śobhano brāhmaṇa iti kṛtvā (kalayitvā) rājñā pratigraho dattaḥ /
puruṣaḥ  śṛṇutedānīm / ahaṃ śakrāvatārābhyantaravāsī dhīvaraḥ /
children.translated_text: Man: Listen then! I am a fisherman dwelling in the vicinity of <s>Śakrāvatāra</s>.

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- śṛṇuta idānīm / ahaṃ śakra-avatāra-abhyantara-vāsī dhīvaraḥ /
pāṭaccara kim asmābhir jātiḥ pṛṣṭā /
children.translated_text: <s>Pāṭaccara</s> (Second Guard): Did we ask your caste?

children.text: pāṭaccara kim asmābhir jātiḥ pṛṣṭā /
śyālaḥ  sūcaka kathayatu sarvam anukrameṇa / mainam antarā pratibadhnītam /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: <s>Sūcaka</s>, let him tell everything in order! Don't interrupt him.

children.text: śyālaḥ -- sūcaka kathayatu sarvam anukrameṇa / ma ainam antarā pratibadhnītam /
ubhau  yad āvutta ājñāpayati / kathaya /
children.translated_text: Both: As his honor commands! Speak.

children.text: ubhau -- yad āvutta ājñāpayati / kathaya /
puruṣaḥ  ahaṃ jālodgālādibhir matsyabandhanopāyaiḥ kuṭumbabharaṇaṃ karomi /
children.translated_text: Man: I support my family by means of catching fish with nets and other devices.

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- ahaṃ jāla-udgāla-ādibhir matsya-bandhana-upāyaiḥ kuṭumba-bharaṇaṃ karomi /
śyālaḥ  (virahasya) viśuddha idānīm ājīvaḥ /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: (Sarcastically) A pure livelihood indeed!

children.text: śyālaḥ -- (virahasya) viśuddha idānīm ājīvaḥ /
puruṣaḥ  bhartaḥ maivaṃ bhaṇa /
children.translated_text: Man: Master, don't say that —

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- bhartaḥ ma aivaṃ bhaṇa /
sahajaṃ kila yad vininditaṃ na khalu tat karma vivarjanīyam /
children.translated_text: One should not abandon the profession that is condemned yet innate to one's birth;

children.text: paśumāraṇakarmadāruṇo 'nukampāmṛdur eva śrotriyaḥ //
children.translated_text: the sacrificial priest, though cruel in the work of animal-slaughter, is indeed soft with compassion.

children.text: sahajaṃ kila yad vininditaṃ na khalu tat karma vivarjanīyam /
paśu-māraṇa-karma-dāruṇo 'nukampā-mṛdur eva śrotriyaḥ //
śyālaḥ  tatas tataḥ /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: Then what? Go on.

children.text: śyālaḥ -- tatas tataḥ /
puruṣaḥ  ekasmin divase khaṇḍaśo rohitamatsyo mayā kalpitaḥ /
KSak_6.1a yāvat tasyodarābhyantare prekṣe tāvad idaṃ ratnabhāsuram aṅgulīyakaṃ dṛṣṭam /
children.translated_text: And when I looked inside its belly, I found this gem-bright signet ring.
Man: One day I cut up a <s>rohita</s> fish into pieces.

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- ekasmin divase khaṇḍaśo rohita-matsyo mayā kalpitaḥ /
KSak_6.1a3 yāvat tasya udara-abhyantare prekṣe tāvad idaṃ ratna-bhāsuram aṅgulīyakaṃ dṛṣṭam /
paścād aham asya vikrayāya darśayan gṛhīto bhāvamiśraiḥ /
KSak_6.1a5 mārayata vā muñcata vā / ayam asyāgamavṛttāntaḥ /
children.translated_text: Kill me or release me — this is the account of how it came to me.
Afterwards, I was seized by your honors while showing it for sale.

children.text: paścād aham asya vikrayāya darśayan gṛhīto bhāva-miśraiḥ /
KSak_6.1a5 mārayata vā muñcata vā / ayam asyā agama-vṛtta-antaḥ /
śyālaḥ  jānuka visragandhī godhādī matsyabandha eva niḥsaṃśayam /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: <s>Jānuka</s>, this foul-smelling fellow is without doubt a mere fisherman, a catcher of <s>godhā</s>-lizards and fish.

children.text: śyālaḥ -- jānuka visra-gandhī godhādī matsya-bandha eva niḥsaṃśayam /
aṅgulīyakadarśanam asya vimarśayitavyam / rājakulam eva gacchāmaḥ /
children.translated_text: The matter of how this ring was found must be investigated. Let us go to the royal court.

children.text: aṅgulīyaka-darśanam asya vimarśayitavyam / rāja-kulam eva gacchāmaḥ /
rakṣiṇau  tathā / gaccha are granthibhedaka / (sarve parikrāmanti)
children.translated_text: Guards: Indeed. Go, you knot-breaker! (All walk about.)

children.text: rakṣiṇau -- tathā / gaccha are granthi-bhedaka / (sarve parikrāmanti)
śyālaḥ  sūcaka imaṃ gopuradvāre 'pramattau pratipālayataṃ yāvad idam aṅgulīyakaṃ yathāgamanaṃ bhartre nivedya tataḥ śāsanaṃ pratīṣya niṣkrāmāmi /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: <s>Sūcaka</s>, guard him attentively at the gateway while I go inside to report to the master how this ring came to be found, and then come out with his orders.

children.text: śyālaḥ -- sūcaka imaṃ gopura-dvāre 'pramattau pratipālayataṃ yāvad idam aṅgulīyakaṃ yathā āgamanaṃ bhartre nivedya tataḥ śāsanaṃ pratīṣya niṣkrāmāmi /
ubhau  praviśatv āvuttaḥ svāmiprasādāya / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ śyālaḥ)
children.translated_text: Both: Enter, your honor, for the master's pleasure. (The brother-in-law exits.)

children.text: ubhau -- praviśatv āvuttaḥ svāmi-prasādāya / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ śyālaḥ)
prathamaḥ  jānuka cirāyate khalv āvuttaḥ /
children.translated_text: First Guard: <s>Jānuka</s>, his honor is certainly taking long.

children.text: prathamaḥ -- jānuka cirāyate khalv āvuttaḥ /
dvitīyaḥ  nanv avasaropasarpaṇīyā rājānaḥ /
children.translated_text: Second Guard: Well, kings must be approached only when the moment is right.

children.text: dvitīyaḥ -- nanv avasara-upasarpaṇīyā rājānaḥ /
prathamaḥ  jānuka sphurato mama hastāv asya vadhasya sumanasaḥ pinaddhum / (iti puruṣaṃ nirdiśati)
children.translated_text: First Guard: <s>Jānuka</s>, my hands are itching to garland this fellow's death with flowers. (Pointing at the man.)

children.text: prathamaḥ -- jānuka sphurato mama hastāv asya vadhasya sumanasaḥ pinaddhum / (iti puruṣaṃ nirdiśati)
puruṣaḥ  nārhati bhāvo 'kāraṇamāraṇo bhavitum /
children.translated_text: Man: The master should not be disposed to kill without cause.

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- na arhati bhāvo 'kāraṇa-māraṇo bhavitum /
dvitīyaḥ  (vilokya) eṣa nau svāmī patrahasto rājaśāsanaṃ pratīṣyeto+mukho dṛśyate / gṛdhrabalir bhaviṣyasi śuno mukhaṃ vā drakṣyasi / (praviśya)
children.translated_text: Second Guard: (Looking) Here comes our master, letter in hand, his face turned this way, awaiting the royal command. Either you'll become a vulture's offering or you'll see a dog's face. (Entering)

children.text: dvitīyaḥ -- (vilokya) eṣa nau svāmī patra-hasto rāja-śāsanaṃ pratīṣya ito+mukho dṛśyate / gṛdhra-balir bhaviṣyasi śuno mukhaṃ vā drakṣyasi / (praviśya)
śyālaḥ  sūcaka mucyatām eṣa jālopajīvī / upapanna khalv asyāṅgulīyakasyāgamaḥ /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: <s>Sūcaka</s>, release this fisherman! The provenance of his ring has been confirmed.

children.text: śyālaḥ -- sūcaka mucyatām eṣa jāla-upajīvī / upapanna khalv asya aṅgulīyakasyā agamaḥ /
sūcakaḥ  yathāvutto bhaṇati / eṣa yamasadanaṃ praviśya pratinivṛttaḥ / (iti puruṣaṃ parimuktabandhanaṃ karoti)
children.translated_text: <s>Sūcaka</s>: As his honor says. This one has entered the abode of <s>Yama</s> and returned. (He unbinds the man.)

children.text: sūcakaḥ -- yathā-āvutto bhaṇati / eṣa yama-sadanaṃ praviśya pratinivṛttaḥ / (iti puruṣaṃ parimukta-bandhanaṃ karoti)
puruṣaḥ  (śyālaṃ praṇamya) bhartaḥ atha kīdṛśo ma ājīvaḥ /
children.translated_text: Man: (Bowing to the brother-in-law) Master, what then of my livelihood?

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- (śyālaṃ praṇamya) bhartaḥ atha kīdṛśo ma ājīvaḥ /
eṣa bhartrāṅgulīyakamūlyasaṃmitaḥ prasādo 'pi dāpitaḥ / (iti puruṣāya svaṃ prayacchati)
children.translated_text: Here, a reward equal to the value of the master's ring has also been given. (He gives his own gift to the man.)

children.text: eṣa bhartra āṅgulīyaka-mūlya-saṃmitaḥ prasādo 'pi dāpitaḥ / (iti puruṣāya svaṃ prayacchati)
puruṣaḥ  (sapraṇāmaṃ pratigṛhya) bhartaḥ anugṛhīto 'smi /
children.translated_text: Man: (Accepting with a bow) Master, I am favored!

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- (sapraṇāmaṃ pratigṛhya) bhartaḥ anugṛhīto 'smi /
sūcakaḥ  eṣa nāmānugraho yac chūlād avatārya hastiskandhe pratiṣṭhāpitaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sūcaka</s>: This indeed is a favor — being taken down from the stake and set upon the back of an elephant!

children.text: sūcakaḥ -- eṣa nāma-anugraho yac chūlād avatārya hasti-skandhe pratiṣṭhāpitaḥ /
jānuka  āvutt pāritoṣikaṃ kathayati tenāṅgulīyakena bhartuḥ saṃmatena bhavitavyam iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Jānuka</s>: His honor speaks of a reward — that ring must have been dear to the master's heart.

children.text: jānuka -- āvutt pāritoṣikaṃ kathayati tena aṅgulīyakena bhartuḥ saṃmatena bhavitavyam iti /
śyālaḥ  na tasmin mahāarhaṃ ratnaṃ bhartur bahumatam iti tarkayāmi /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: I surmise it is not that the jewel in it was of great value, but that it was highly prized by the master.

children.text: śyālaḥ -- na tasmin mahā-arhaṃ ratnaṃ bhartur bahu-matam iti tarkayāmi /
tasya darśanena bhartrābhimato janaḥ smṛtaḥ / muhūrtaṃ prakṛtigambhīro 'pi paryaśrunayana āsīt /
children.translated_text: At the sight of it, the master remembered a beloved person. For a moment, even he who is naturally deep was on the verge of tears.

children.text: tasya darśanena bhartra ābhimato janaḥ smṛtaḥ / muhūrtaṃ prakṛti-gambhīro 'pi paryaśru-nayana āsīt /
sūcakaḥ  sevitaṃ nāmāvuttena /
children.translated_text: <s>Sūcaka</s>: His honor has served well indeed.

children.text: sūcakaḥ -- sevitaṃ nāma-āvuttena /
jānuka  nanu bhaṇa / asya kṛte mātsyikabhartur iti / (iti puruṣam asūyayā paśyati)
children.translated_text: <s>Jānuka</s>: But I tell you — all this for the sake of a fisherman-master! (He looks at the man with envy.)

children.text: jānuka -- nanu bhaṇa / asya kṛte mātsyika-bhartur iti / (iti puruṣam asūyayā paśyati)
puruṣaḥ  bhaṭṭāraka ito 'rdhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ sumanomūlyaṃ bhavatu /
children.translated_text: Man: My lord, let half of this be the price of your flowers.

children.text: puruṣaḥ -- bhaṭṭāraka ito 'rdhaṃ yuṣmākaṃ sumano-mūlyaṃ bhavatu /
jānuka  etāvad yujyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Jānuka</s>: That much is fitting.

children.text: jānuka -- etāvad yujyate /
śyālaḥ  dhīvara mahattaras tvaṃ priyavayasyaka idānīṃ me saṃvṛttaḥ / kādambarīsākṣikam asmākaṃ prathamasauhṛdam iṣyate / tatśauṇḍikāpaṇam eva gacchāmaḥ /
children.translated_text: Brother-in-law: Fisherman, you have now become my great and dear companion! Our first friendship shall be sealed with <s>Kādambarī</s> wine as witness. Let us go to the tavern!

children.text: śyālaḥ -- dhīvara mahattaras tvaṃ priya-vayasyaka idānīṃ me saṃvṛttaḥ / kādambarī-sākṣikam asmākaṃ prathama-sauhṛdam iṣyate / tat-śauṇḍika-āpaṇam eva gacchāmaḥ /
praveśakaḥ / (tataḥ praviśaty ākāśayānena sānumatī nāmāpsarāḥ)
children.translated_text: Interlude. (Then enters through the sky an <s>Apsaras</s> named <s>Sānumatī</s>.)

children.text: praveśakaḥ / (tataḥ praviśaty ākāśa-yānena sānumatī nāma apsarāḥ)
sānumatī  nirvartitaṃ mayā paryāyanirvartanīyam apsarastīrthasāṃnidhyaṃ yāvat sāhujanasyābhiṣekakāla iti sāṃpratam asya rājarṣer udantaṃ pratyakṣīkariṣyāmi /
KSak_6.1a2 menakāsaṃbandhena śarīrabhūtā me śakuntalā / tayā ca duhitṛnimittam ādiṣṭapūrvāsmi /
children.translated_text: Through my relationship with <s>Menakā</s>, <s>Śakuntalā</s> is like my own flesh. And she had earlier entrusted me with the care of her daughter.

<s>Sānumatī</s>: I have completed my turn-by-turn duty of attendance at the <s>Apsaras</s> bathing-place. Now I shall observe firsthand the news of this royal sage, since it is the hour of ablution for the virtuous.

children.text: sānumatī -- nirvartitaṃ mayā paryāya-nirvartanīyam apsaras-tīrtha-sāṃnidhyaṃ yāvat sāhu-janasya abhiṣeka-kāla iti sāṃpratam asya rājarṣer udantaṃ pratyakṣī-kariṣyāmi /
KSak_6.1a32 menakā-saṃbandhena śarīra-bhūtā me śakuntalā / tayā ca duhitṛ-nimittam ādiṣṭa-pūrva āsmi /
(samantād avalokya) kiṃ nu khalu ṛtūtsave 'pi nirutsavārambham iva rājakulaṃ dṛśyate /
KSak_6.1a4 asti me vibhavaḥ praṇidhānena sarvaṃ parijñātum /
children.translated_text: I have the power to learn everything through concentrated meditation.
(Looking all around) Why does the royal court appear as though bereft of festive preparations, even during the season-festival?

children.text: (samantād avalokya) kiṃ nu khalu ṛtu-utsave 'pi nirutsava-ārambham iva rāja-kulaṃ dṛśyate /
KSak_6.1a34 asti me vibhavaḥ praṇidhānena sarvaṃ parijñātum /
kiṃ tu sakhyā ādaro mayā mānaiyitavyaḥ /
children.translated_text: But the respect due to my friend must be honored by me.

children.text: kiṃ tu sakhyā ādaro mayā mānaiyitavyaḥ /
bhavatu / anayor evodyānapālikayos tiraskariṇīpraticchannā pārśvavartinī bhūtvopalapsye / (iti nāṭyenāvatīrya sthitā) (tataḥ praviśati cūtāṅkuram avalokayantī ceṭī / aparāca pṛṣṭhatas tasyāḥ)
children.translated_text: So be it. I shall stand concealed by the veil of invisibility beside these two garden-keepers and overhear them. (She descends through acting and stands.) (Then enter a maid examining a mango shoot, and another behind her.)

children.text: bhavatu / anayor eva udyāna-pālikayos tiraskariṇī-praticchannā pārśva-vartinī bhūtva ūpalapsye / (iti nāṭyena avatīrya sthitā) (tataḥ praviśati cūta-aṅkuram avalokayantī ceṭī / aparāca pṛṣṭhatas tasyāḥ)
prathamā
children.translated_text: First Maid:

children.text: prathamā --
ātāṃraharitapāṇḍura jīvitasarvaṃ vasantamāsasya (yoḥ) /
children.translated_text: With your coppery-green-pale hue, the very life of the spring month —

children.text: dṛṣṭo 'si cūtakoraka ṛtumaṅgala tvāṃ prasādayāmi //
children.translated_text: I behold you, O mango bud! Auspicious sign of the season, I salute you!

children.text: ātāṃra-harita-pāṇḍura jīvita-sarvaṃ vasanta-māsasya (yoḥ) /
dṛṣṭo 'si cūta-koraka ṛtu-maṅgala tvāṃ prasādayāmi //
dvitīyā  parabhṛtike kim ekākinī mantrayase /
children.translated_text: Second Maid: <s>Parabhṛtikā</s> (Little Cuckoo), what are you whispering to yourself?

children.text: dvitīyā -- parabhṛtike kim ekākinī mantrayase /
prathamā  madhukarike cūtakalikāṃ dṛṣṭvonmattā parabhṛtikā bhavati /
children.translated_text: First Maid: <s>Madhukarikā</s> (Little Bee), the little cuckoo goes mad upon seeing the mango blossom.

children.text: prathamā -- madhukarike cūta-kalikāṃ dṛṣṭva ūnmattā parabhṛtikā bhavati /
dvitīyā  (saharṣaṃ tvarayopagamya) katham upasthito madhumāsaḥ /
children.translated_text: Second Maid: (With delight, approaching hastily) What! Has the honey-month arrived?

children.text: dvitīyā -- (saharṣaṃ tvaraya ūpagamya) katham upasthito madhu-māsaḥ /
prathamā  madhukarike tavedānīṃ kāla eṣa madavibhramagītānām /
children.translated_text: First Maid: <s>Madhukarikā</s>, now is the time for your songs of amorous transport.

children.text: prathamā -- madhukarike tava idānīṃ kāla eṣa mada-vibhrama-gītānām /
dvitīyā  sakhi avalambasva māṃ yāvad agrapādasthitā bhūtvā cūtakalikāṃ gṛhītvā kāmadevārcanaṃ karomi /
children.translated_text: Second Maid: Friend, hold me while I stand on tiptoe, take a mango blossom, and make an offering to <s>Kāmadeva</s> (the God of Love).

children.text: dvitīyā -- sakhi avalambasva māṃ yāvad agra-pāda-sthitā bhūtvā cūta-kalikāṃ gṛhītvā kāma-deva-arcanaṃ karomi /
prathamā  yadi mama api khalv ardham arcanaphalasya /
children.translated_text: First Maid: Only if I too get half the fruit of the offering!

children.text: prathamā -- yadi mama api khalv ardham arcana-phalasya /
dvitīyā  akathite 'py etat saṃpadyate yata ekam eva nau jīvītaṃ dvidhāsthitaṃ śarīram / (sakhīm avalambya sthitā cūtāṅkuraṃ gṛhṇāti)
children.translated_text: Second Maid: That goes without saying, since we two have one life in two bodies. (Standing while leaning on her friend, she takes a mango shoot.)

children.text: dvitīyā -- akathite 'py etat saṃpadyate yata ekam eva nau jīvītaṃ dvidhā-sthitaṃ śarīram / (sakhīm avalambya sthitā cūta-aṅkuraṃ gṛhṇāti)
aye apratibuddho 'pi cūtaprasavo 'tra bandhanabhaṅgasurabhir bhavati (iti kapotahastakaṃ kṛtvā)
children.translated_text: Oh! Even though this mango blossom has not yet opened, it is already fragrant, as if released from its bud. (Making a pigeon-hand gesture)

children.text: aye apratibuddho 'pi cūta-prasavo 'tra bandhana-bhaṅga-surabhir bhavati (iti kapota-hastakaṃ kṛtvā)
tvam asi mayā cūtāṅkura dattaḥ kāmāya gṛhītadhanuṣe /
children.translated_text: I offer you, O mango shoot, to <s>Kāma</s> who has taken up his bow;

children.text: pathikajanayuvatilakṣyaḥ pañcābhyadhikaḥ śaro bhava //
children.translated_text: become his sixth arrow, aimed at young women travelers!

children.text: tvam asi mayā cūta-aṅkura dattaḥ kāmāya gṛhīta-dhanuṣe /
pathika-jana-yuvati-lakṣyaḥ pañca-abhyadhikaḥ śaro bhava //
(iti cūtāṅkuraṃ kṣipati) (praviśya paṭīkṣepeṇa kupitaḥ) /
children.translated_text: (She tosses the mango shoot.) (The chamberlain enters angrily, having flung the curtain aside.)

children.text: (iti cūta-aṅkuraṃ kṣipati) (praviśya paṭī-kṣepeṇa kupitaḥ) /
kañcukī  mā tāvad anātmajñe / devena pratiṣiddhe vasantotsave tvam āṃrakalikābhaṅgaṃ kim ārabhase /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: Stop, you thoughtless girl! The king has forbidden the spring festival, and you dare break the mango blossoms!

children.text: kañcukī -- mā tāvad anātmajñe / devena pratiṣiddhe vasanta-utsave tvam āṃra-kalikā-bhaṅgaṃ kim ārabhase /
ubhe (bhīte) prasīdatv āryaḥ / agṛhītārthe āvām /
children.translated_text: Both: (Frightened) Forgive us, noble sir! We did not know the reason.

children.text: ubhe (bhīte) prasīdatv āryaḥ / agṛhīta-arthe āvām /
kañcukī  na kila śrutaṃ yuvābhyāṃ yad vāsantikais tarubhir api devasya śāsanaṃ pramāṇīkṛtaṃ tadāśrayibhiḥ patribhiś ca / tathā hi
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: Have you two not heard that even the spring trees, along with the birds dwelling upon them, have accepted the king's command as authoritative? For indeed—

children.text: kañcukī -- na kila śrutaṃ yuvābhyāṃ yad vāsantikais tarubhir api devasya śāsanaṃ pramāṇī-kṛtaṃ tad-āśrayibhiḥ patribhiś ca / tathā hi --
cūtānāṃ ciranirgatā api kalikā badhnāti na svaṃ rajaḥ
saṃnaddhaṃ yad api sthitaṃ kurabakaṃ tat korakāvasthayā /
children.translated_text: the <s>kurabaka</s> tree, though prepared, stands still in the state of a bud;
The buds of the mango trees, though long since emerged, do not release their pollen;

children.text: kaṇṭheṣu skhalitaṃ gate 'pi śiśire puṃskokilānāṃ rutam
śaṅke saṃharati smaro 'pi cakitas tūṇārdhakṛṣṭaṃ śaram //
children.translated_text: I suspect that even <s>Kāma</s> (the god of love), alarmed, withdraws the arrow half-drawn from his quiver. //
the call of the male cuckoo, though spring has departed, catches in their throats;

children.text: cūtānāṃ cira-nirgatā api kalikā badhnāti na svaṃ rajaḥ
saṃnaddhaṃ yad api sthitaṃ kurabakaṃ tat koraka-avasthayā /
kaṇṭheṣu skhalitaṃ gate 'pi śiśire puṃs-kokilānāṃ rutam
śaṅke saṃharati smaro 'pi cakitas tūṇa-ardha-kṛṣṭaṃ śaram //
sanumatī  nāsti saṃdehaḥ / mahāprabhāvo rājarṣiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: There is no doubt — the royal sage is of great power.

children.text: sanumatī -- na asti saṃdehaḥ / mahā-prabhāvo rājarṣiḥ /
prathamā  ārya kati divasāny āvayor mitrāvasunā rāṣṭriyeṇa bhaṭṭinīpādamūlaṃ preṣitayoḥ / atra ca nau pramadavanasya pālanakarma samarpitam / tadāgantukatayāśrutapūrva āvābhyām eṣa vṛttāntaḥ /
children.translated_text: First [attendant]: Sir, how many days has it been since we two were sent by the provincial governor <s>Mitrāvasu</s> to the queen's service? And here we have been entrusted with the duty of tending the pleasure-garden. Being newcomers, this matter is something we have not heard of before.

children.text: prathamā -- ārya kati divasāny āvayor mitrāvasunā rāṣṭriyeṇa bhaṭṭinī-pāda-mūlaṃ preṣitayoḥ / atra ca nau pramada-vanasya pālana-karma samarpitam / tad-āgantukataya āśruta-pūrva āvābhyām eṣa vṛtta-antaḥ /
kañcukī  bhavatu / na punar evaṃ pravartitavyam /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: Very well. But you must not behave thus again.

children.text: kañcukī -- bhavatu / na punar evaṃ pravartitavyam /
ubhe  ārya kautūhalaṃ nau / yady anena janena śrotavyaṃ kathayatv āryaḥ kiṃ nimittaṃ bhartrā vasantotsavaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: Sir, we are curious. If it is proper for such persons as us to hear, let your honor tell us — for what reason has the spring festival been prohibited by the lord?

children.text: ubhe -- ārya kautūhalaṃ nau / yady anena janena śrotavyaṃ kathayatv āryaḥ kiṃ nimittaṃ bhartrā vasanta-utsavaḥ pratiṣiddhaḥ /
sānumatī  utsavapriyāḥ khalu manuṣyāḥ / guruṇā kāraṇena bhavitavyam /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Humans are indeed fond of festivals. There must be a weighty reason.

children.text: sānumatī -- utsava-priyāḥ khalu manuṣyāḥ / guruṇā kāraṇena bhavitavyam /
kañcukī  bahulībhūtam etat kiṃ na kathyate / kim atrabhavatyo karṇapathaṃ nāyātaṃ śakuntalāpratyādeśakaulīnam /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: This matter has become widely known — why should it not be told? Have your ladyships not heard of the episode of <s>Śakuntalā</s>'s rejection?

children.text: kañcukī -- bahulī-bhūtam etat kiṃ na kathyate / kim atra-bhavatyo karṇa-pathaṃ nā ayātaṃ śakuntalā-pratyādeśa-kaulīnam /
ubhe  śrutaṃ rāṣṭriyamukhād yāvad aṅgulīyakadarśanam /
children.translated_text: Both: We have heard [the account] from the lips of the governor, up to the point of the discovery of the ring.

children.text: ubhe -- śrutaṃ rāṣṭriya-mukhād yāvad aṅgulīyaka-darśanam /
kañcukī  tena hy alpaṃ kathayitavyam /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: Then there is little to tell.

children.text: kañcukī -- tena hy alpaṃ kathayitavyam /
yadaiva khalu svāṅgulīyakadarśanād anusmṛtaṃ devena satyamūḍhapūrvā me tatrabhavatī rahasi śakuntalā mohāt pratyādiṣṭeti tadāprabhṛty eva paścāt tāpam upagato devaḥ / tathā hi
children.translated_text: From the very moment when, upon seeing his own ring, the king remembered — 'Truly, I had been deluded before; in my delusion I rejected that lady <s>Śakuntalā</s> in private' — from that moment onward, the king has been consumed by remorse. For indeed—

children.text: yada aiva khalu sva-aṅgulīyaka-darśanād anusmṛtaṃ devena satya-mūḍha-pūrvā me tatra-bhavatī rahasi śakuntalā mohāt pratyādiṣṭa īti tadā-prabhṛty eva paścāt tāpam upagato devaḥ / tathā hi --
ramyaṃ dveṣṭi yathā purā prakṛtibhir na pratyahaṃ sevyate
śayyāprāntavivartanair vigamayaty unnidra eva kṣapāḥ /
children.translated_text: he passes sleepless nights tossing on the edge of his bed;
He loathes what is beautiful, as before; he is not attended upon daily by his courtiers in the usual manner;

children.text: dākṣiṇyena dadāti vācam ucitām antaḥpurebhyo yadā gotreṣu
skhalitas tadā bhavati ca vrīḍāvilakṣaś ciram //
children.translated_text: upon their names, he becomes ashamed and embarrassed for a long time. //
when out of courtesy he addresses the fitting word to the ladies of the inner apartments, when he stumbles

children.text: ramyaṃ dveṣṭi yathā purā prakṛtibhir na pratyahaṃ sevyate
śayyā-prānta-vivartanair vigamayaty unnidra eva kṣapāḥ /
dākṣiṇyena dadāti vācam ucitām antaḥ-purebhyo yadā gotreṣu
skhalitas tadā bhavati ca vrīḍā-vilakṣaś ciram //
sānumatī  priyaṃ me /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: This pleases me.

children.text: sānumatī -- priyaṃ me /
kañcukī  asmāt prabhavato vaimanasyād utsavaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: It is because of this sovereign's dejection that the festival has been cancelled.

children.text: kañcukī -- asmāt prabhavato vaimanasyād utsavaḥ pratyākhyātaḥ /
ubhe  yujyate / (nepathye)
children.translated_text: Both: It is fitting. (From offstage:)

children.text: ubhe -- yujyate / (nepathye)
etu etu bhavān /
children.translated_text: 'Let your honor come, come!'

children.text: etu etu bhavān /
kañcukī  (karṇaṃ dattvā) aye / ita evābhivartate devaḥ / svakarmānuṣṭhīyatām /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: (Lending his ear) Ah! The king is approaching from this very direction. Attend to your duties.

children.text: kañcukī -- (karṇaṃ dattvā) aye / ita eva abhivartate devaḥ / sva-karma-anuṣṭhīyatām /
ubhe  tathā /
children.translated_text: Both: So be it.

children.text: ubhe -- tathā /
(tataḥ praviśati paścāttāpasadṛśaveṣo rājā vidūṣakaḥ pratīhārī ca /
children.translated_text: (Then enter the king, in a garb befitting remorse, the <s>Vidūṣaka</s>, and the female door-keeper.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati paścāt-tāpa-sadṛśa-veṣo rājā vidūṣakaḥ pratīhārī ca /
kañcukī  (rājānam avalokya) aho sarvāsv avasthāsu ramaṇīyatvam ākṛtiviśeṣāṇām / evam utsuko 'pi priyadarśane devaḥ / tathā hi
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: (Looking at the king) Ah, how charming is the beauty of distinguished forms in every condition! Even thus afflicted, the king is pleasing to behold. For indeed—

children.text: kañcukī -- (rājānam avalokya) aho sarvāsv avasthāsu ramaṇīyatvam ākṛti-viśeṣāṇām / evam utsuko 'pi priya-darśane devaḥ / tathā hi --
pratyādiṣṭaviśeṣamaṇḍanavidhir vāmaprakoṣṭhārpitam
bibhratkāñcanam ekam eva valayaṃ śvāsoparaktādharaḥ /
children.translated_text: a single golden bracelet, his lip reddened by sighing,
Having abandoned the rite of special adornment, wearing on his left forearm

children.text: cintājāgaraṇapratāntanayanas tejoguṇād ātmanaḥ
saṃskārollikhito mahāmaṇir iva kṣīṇo 'pi nālakṣyate //
children.translated_text: like a great gem, though diminished, he does not appear unpolished, as if refined by an innate luster. //
his eyes wearied by sleepless nights of anxious thought — yet by the inherent quality of his splendor,

children.text: pratyādiṣṭa-viśeṣa-maṇḍana-vidhir vāma-prakoṣṭha-arpitam
bibhrat-kāñcanam ekam eva valayaṃ śvāsa-uparakta-adharaḥ /
cintā-jāgaraṇa-pratānta-nayanas tejo-guṇād ātmanaḥ
saṃskāra-ullikhito mahā-maṇir iva kṣīṇo 'pi nā alakṣyate //
sānumatī  (rājānaṃ dṛṣṭvā) sthāne khalu pratyādeśavimānitā apy asya kṛte śakuntalā klāmyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: (Looking at the king) It is fitting indeed that <s>Śakuntalā</s> pines for his sake, even though she was dishonored by his rejection.

children.text: sānumatī -- (rājānaṃ dṛṣṭvā) sthāne khalu pratyādeśa-vimānitā apy asya kṛte śakuntalā klāmyati /
rājā  (dhyānamandaṃ parikramya)
children.translated_text: King: (Walking slowly, absorbed in thought)

children.text: rājā -- (dhyāna-mandaṃ parikramya)
prathamaṃ sāraṅgākṣyā priyayā pratibodhyamānam api suptam /
children.translated_text: Though awakened by my beloved, the deer-eyed one, the sleeping [heart] at first [would not stir];

children.text: anuśayaduḥkhāya idaṃ hatahṛdayaṃ saṃprati vibuddham //
children.translated_text: now, for the suffering of remorse, this wretched heart has finally awakened. //

children.text: prathamaṃ sāraṅga-akṣyā priyayā pratibodhyamānam api suptam /
anuśaya-duḥkhāya idaṃ hata-hṛdayaṃ saṃprati vibuddham //
sānumatī  nanv īdeśāni tapasvinyā bhāgadheyāni /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Are not such the fortunes of the pitiable woman!

children.text: sānumatī -- nanv īdeśāni tapasvinyā bhāga-dheyāni /
vidūṣaka  (apavārya) laṅghita eṣa bhūyo 'pi śakuntalāvyādhinā / na jāne kathaṃ cikitsitavyo bhaviṣyatīti /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (Aside) He has been struck again by the <s>Śakuntalā</s>-malady. I do not know how he shall be cured.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- (apavārya) laṅghita eṣa bhūyo 'pi śakuntalā-vyādhinā / na jāne kathaṃ cikitsitavyo bhaviṣyati iti /
kañcukī  (upagamya) jayatu jayatu devaḥ / mahārāja pratyavekṣitāḥ pramadavanabhūmayaḥ yathākāmam adhyāstāṃ vinodasthānāni mahārājaḥ /
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: (Approaching) Victory, victory to the lord! Great king, the grounds of the pleasure-garden have been inspected. Let the great king occupy the places of recreation at his pleasure.

children.text: kañcukī -- (upagamya) jayatu jayatu devaḥ / mahā-rāja pratyavekṣitāḥ pramada-vana-bhūmayaḥ yathā-kāmam adhyāstāṃ vinoda-sthānāni mahā-rājaḥ /
rājā  vetravati madvacanād amātyam āryapiśunaṃ brūhi / ciraprabodhān na saṃbhāvitam asmābhir adya dharmāsanam adhyāsitum / yat pratyavekṣitaṃ paurakāryam āryeṇa tat patram āropya dīyatām iti /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Vetravati</s>, convey my words to the minister, the noble <s>Piśuna</s>: 'Having risen late, it is not fitting for me to sit on the seat of justice today. Whatever public business has been reviewed by the noble [minister], let it be written up and handed over.'

children.text: rājā -- vetravati mad-vacanād amātyam ārya-piśunaṃ brūhi / cira-prabodhān na saṃbhāvitam asmābhir adya dharma-āsanam adhyāsitum / yat pratyavekṣitaṃ paura-kāryam āryeṇa tat patram āropya dīyatām iti /
pratīhārī  yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti niṣkrāntā)
children.translated_text: Door-keeper: As the lord commands. (She exits.)

children.text: pratīhārī -- yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti niṣkrāntā)
rājā  vātāyana tvam api svaṃ niyogam aśūnyaṃ kuru /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Vātāyana</s>, you too — fulfill your appointed duty.

children.text: rājā -- vāta-ayana tvam api svaṃ niyogam aśūnyaṃ kuru /
kañcukī  yad ājñāpayati devaḥ / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: Chamberlain: As the lord commands. (He exits.)

children.text: kañcukī -- yad ājñāpayati devaḥ / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
vidūṣakaḥ  kṛtaṃ bhavatā nirmakṣikam / sāṃprataṃ śiśirātapachedaramaṇīye 'smin pramadavanoddeśa ātmānaṃ ramayiṣyasi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: You have cleared the place of flies! Now, in this pleasure-garden precinct, delightful with its cool shade, you shall amuse yourself.

children.text: vidūṣakaḥ -- kṛtaṃ bhavatā nirmakṣikam / sāṃprataṃ śiśira-ātapa-cheda-ramaṇīye 'smin pramada-vana-uddeśa ātmānaṃ ramayiṣyasi /
rājā  vayasya yad ucyate randhropanipātino 'narthā iti tad vyabhicāri vacaḥ / kutaḥ
children.translated_text: King: Friend, the saying 'misfortunes fall upon one through one's weak points' — that is a misleading statement. For—

children.text: rājā -- vayasya yad ucyate randhra-upanipātino 'narthā iti tad vyabhicāri vacaḥ / kutaḥ --
munisutāpraṇayasmṛtirodhinā
mama ca muktam idaṃ tamasā manaḥ /
children.translated_text: that obstructed the memory of love for the sage's daughter —
My mind, which had been freed from the darkness

children.text: manasijena sakhe prahariṣyatā
dhanuṣi cūtaśaraś ca niveśitaḥ //
children.translated_text: a mango-blossom arrow has been fitted to his bow. //
by <s>Manasija</s> (the Love God), O friend, about to strike,

children.text: muni-sutā-praṇaya-smṛti-rodhinā
mama ca muktam idaṃ tamasā manaḥ /
manasijena sakhe prahariṣyatā
dhanuṣi cūta-śaraś ca niveśitaḥ //
vidūṣaka  tiṣṭha tāvat / anena daṇḍakakāṣṭhena kandarpabāṇaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi / (iti daṇḍakāṣṭham udyamya cūtāṅkuraṃ pātayitum icchati)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Wait! With this stick, I shall destroy <s>Kandarpa</s>'s (the Love God's) arrow! (He raises the staff and tries to knock down the mango shoot.)

children.text: vidūṣaka -- tiṣṭha tāvat / anena daṇḍaka-kāṣṭhena kandarpa-bāṇaṃ nāśayiṣyāmi / (iti daṇḍa-kāṣṭham udyamya cūta-aṅkuraṃ pātayitum icchati)
rājā  (sasmitam) bhavatu / dṛṣṭaṃ brahmavarcasam / sakhe kvopaviṣṭaḥ priyāyāḥ kiṃcid+anukāriṇīṣu latāsu dṛṣṭiṃ vilobhayāmi /
children.translated_text: King: (With a smile) Enough! The Brahmanical power has been displayed. Friend, where shall I sit and feast my eyes on the creepers that somewhat resemble my beloved?

children.text: rājā -- (sasmitam) bhavatu / dṛṣṭaṃ brahma-varcasam / sakhe kva upaviṣṭaḥ priyāyāḥ kiṃcid+anukāriṇīṣu latāsu dṛṣṭiṃ vilobhayāmi /
viṣūṣaka  nanv āsannaparicārikā caturikā bhavatā saṃdiṣṭā / mādhavīmaṇḍapa imāṃ velām ativāhayiṣye /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Have you not instructed <s>Caturikā</s>, the maid attending close by, [saying:] 'I shall spend this time in the <s>mādhavī</s>-creeper bower;

children.text: viṣūṣaka -- nanv āsanna-paricārikā caturikā bhavatā saṃdiṣṭā / mādhavī-maṇḍapa imāṃ velām ativāhayiṣye /
tatra me citraphalakagatāṃ svahastalikhitāṃ tatrabhavatyāḥ śakuntalāyāḥ pratikṛtim ānaya iti /
children.translated_text: bring me there the portrait of the lady <s>Śakuntalā</s>, painted by my own hand on a picture-board'?

children.text: tatra me citra-phalaka-gatāṃ sva-hasta-likhitāṃ tatra-bhavatyāḥ śakuntalāyāḥ pratikṛtim ānaya iti /
rājā  īdṛśaṃ hṛdayavinodanasthānam / tat tam eva mārgam ādeśaya /
children.translated_text: King: Such indeed is the solace for my heart. Then show me the way to that very place.

children.text: rājā -- īdṛśaṃ hṛdaya-vinodana-sthānam / tat tam eva mārgam ādeśaya /
vidūṣaka  ita ito bhavān / (ubhau parikramataḥ / sānumaty anugacchati)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: This way, this way, sir! (Both walk around. <s>Sānumatī</s> follows.)

children.text: vidūṣaka -- ita ito bhavān / (ubhau parikramataḥ / sānumaty anugacchati)
vidūṣaka  eṣa maṇiśilāpaṭṭakasanātho mādhavīmaṇḍapa upahāraramaṇīyatayā niḥsaṃśayaṃ svāgateneva nau pratīcchati / tat praviśya niṣīdatu bhavān / (ubhau praveśaṃ kṛtvopaviṣṭau)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Here is the <s>mādhavī</s>-creeper bower, furnished with a gem-stone slab — by the charm of its offerings, it seems to welcome us without doubt. Let your honor enter and sit down. (Both enter and sit down.)

children.text: vidūṣaka -- eṣa maṇi-śilā-paṭṭaka-sanātho mādhavī-maṇḍapa upahāra-ramaṇīyatayā niḥsaṃśayaṃ svāgatena iva nau pratīcchati / tat praviśya niṣīdatu bhavān / (ubhau praveśaṃ kṛtvā-upaviṣṭau)
sānumatī  latāsaṃśritā drakṣyāmi tāvat sakhyāḥ pratikṛtam / tatas tasyai bhartur bahumukham anurāgaṃ nivedayiṣyāmi / (iti tathā kṛtvā sthitā)
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Concealing myself among the creepers, I shall first look upon the portrait of my friend. Then I shall convey to her the many facets of her husband's love. (She does so and stands.)

children.text: sānumatī -- latā-saṃśritā drakṣyāmi tāvat sakhyāḥ pratikṛtam / tatas tasyai bhartur bahu-mukham anurāgaṃ nivedayiṣyāmi / (iti tathā kṛtvā sthitā)
rājā  sakhe sarvam idānīṃ smarāmi śakuntalāyāḥ prathamavṛttāntam / kathitavān asmi bhavate ca /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, now I remember everything — the first events concerning <s>Śakuntalā</s>. I told you about it too.

children.text: rājā -- sakhe sarvam idānīṃ smarāmi śakuntalāyāḥ prathama-vṛtta-antam / kathitavān asmi bhavate ca /
sa bhavān pratyādeśavelāyāṃ matsamīpagato nāsīt /
children.translated_text: But you were not near me at the time of the rejection.

children.text: sa bhavān pratyādeśa-velāyāṃ mat-samīpa-gato nā asīt /
pūrvam api na tvayā kadācit saṃkīrtitaṃ tatrabhavatyā nāma / kaccid aham iva vismṛtavān asi tvam /
children.translated_text: Nor did you ever mention the lady's name before. Had you, like me, forgotten?

children.text: pūrvam api na tvayā kadācit saṃkīrtitaṃ tatra-bhavatyā nāma / kaccid aham iva vismṛtavān asi tvam /
vidūṣaka  na vismarāmi / kiṃ tu sarvaṃ kathayitvāvasāne punas tvayā parihāsavijalpa eṣa na bhūtārtha ity ākhyātam /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: I had not forgotten. But after telling the whole story, you declared at the end: 'This is merely jesting talk, not a real occurrence.'

children.text: vidūṣaka -- na vismarāmi / kiṃ tu sarvaṃ kathayitva āvasāne punas tvayā parihāsa-vijalpa eṣa na bhūta-artha ity ākhyātam /
mayā api mṛtpiṇḍabuddhinā tathaiva gṛhītam / athavā bhavitavyatā khalu balavatī /
children.translated_text: And I too, dull-witted as a lump of clay, took it just so. Or rather, destiny is truly powerful.

children.text: mayā api mṛt-piṇḍa-buddhinā tatha aiva gṛhītam / athavā bhavitavyatā khalu balavatī /
sānumatī  evaṃ nv idam /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: So that is how it was!

children.text: sānumatī -- evaṃ nv idam /
rājā  (dhyātvā) sakhe trāyasva mām /
children.translated_text: King: (Reflecting) Friend, save me!

children.text: rājā -- (dhyātvā) sakhe trāyasva mām /
vidūṣaka  bhoḥ kim etat / anupapannaṃ khalv īdṛśaṃ tvayi / kadā api satpuruṣāḥ śokavāstavyā na bhavanti / nanu pravāte 'pi niṣkampā girayaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Sir! What is this? Such [behavior] is unbecoming in you. Worthy men never succumb to dwelling in sorrow. Mountains stand unshaken even in a gale!

children.text: vidūṣaka -- bhoḥ kim etat / anupapannaṃ khalv īdṛśaṃ tvayi / kadā api sat-puruṣāḥ śoka-vāstavyā na bhavanti / nanu pravāte 'pi niṣkampā girayaḥ /
rājā  vayasya nirākaraṇaviklavāyāḥ priyāyāḥ samavasthām anusmṛtya balavadaśaraṇo 'smi / sā hi
children.translated_text: King: Friend, remembering the condition of my beloved, distressed by my rejection, I am utterly helpless. For she—

children.text: rājā -- vayasya nirākaraṇa-viklavāyāḥ priyāyāḥ samavasthām anusmṛtya balavad-aśaraṇo 'smi / sā hi --
itaḥ pratyādeśāt svajanam anugantuṃ vyavasitā
sthitā tiṣṭha ity uccair vadati guruśiṣye gurusame /
children.translated_text: the guru's disciple, equal to the guru, stopped her, loudly saying 'Stay!';
When, upon my rejection, she resolved to follow her own people,

children.text: punar dṛṣṭiṃ bāṣpaprasarakaluṣām arpitavatī
mayi krūre yat tat saviṣam iva śalyaṃ dahati mām //
children.translated_text: that upon me, the cruel one — it burns me like a poisoned arrow. //
then she cast upon me her gaze, clouded by a flood of tears —

children.text: itaḥ pratyādeśāt sva-janam anugantuṃ vyavasitā
sthitā tiṣṭha ity uccair vadati guru-śiṣye guru-same /
punar dṛṣṭiṃ bāṣpa-prasara-kaluṣām arpitavatī
mayi krūre yat tat saviṣam iva śalyaṃ dahati mām //
sānumatī  aho / īdṛśī svakāryaparatā / asya saṃtāpenāhaṃ rame /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Ah! Such is his absorption in his own [grief]! I delight in his anguish.

children.text: sānumatī -- aho / īdṛśī sva-kārya-paratā / asya saṃtāpena ahaṃ rame /
vidūṣaka  bhoḥ asti me tarkaḥ kenāpi tatrabhavatyākāśacāriṇī nīteti /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Sir! I have a conjecture — the lady was carried away through the sky by someone.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- bhoḥ asti me tarkaḥ kena api tatra-bhavatyā ākāśa-cāriṇī nīta īti /
rājā  kaḥ patidevatām anyaḥ parāmarṣṭum utsaheta / menakā kila sakhyās te janmapratiṣṭheti śrutavān asmi / tatsahacāriṇībhiḥ sakhī te hṛteti me hṛdayam āśaṅkate /
children.translated_text: King: Who else would dare to touch one devoted to her husband? I have heard that <s>Menakā</s> is the one who gave birth to your friend. My heart suspects that she was taken away by her [<s>Menakā</s>'s] companions.

children.text: rājā -- kaḥ pati-devatām anyaḥ parāmarṣṭum utsaheta / menakā kila sakhyās te janma-pratiṣṭha īti śrutavān asmi / tat-sahacāriṇībhiḥ sakhī te hṛta īti me hṛdayam āśaṅkate /
sānumatī  saṃmohaḥ khalu vismayanīyo na pratibodhaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: The delusion is indeed astonishing — not the awakening!

children.text: sānumatī -- saṃmohaḥ khalu vismayanīyo na pratibodhaḥ /
vidūṣaka  yady evam asti khalu samāgamaḥ kālena tatrabhavatyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: If so, then surely in time there will be a reunion with the lady.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- yady evam asti khalu samāgamaḥ kālena tatra-bhavatyā /
rājā  katham iva /
children.translated_text: King: How so?

children.text: rājā -- katham iva /
vidūṣaka  na khalu mātāpitarau bhartṛviyogaduḥkhitāṃ duhitaraṃ ciraṃ draṣṭuṃ pārayataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Surely a mother and father cannot bear to see their daughter suffering from separation from her husband for long.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- na khalu mātā-pitarau bhartṛ-viyoga-duḥkhitāṃ duhitaraṃ ciraṃ draṣṭuṃ pārayataḥ /
rājā  vayasya /
children.translated_text: King: Friend—

children.text: rājā -- vayasya /
svapno nu māyā nu matibhramo nu
kliṣṭaṃ nu tāvat phalam eva puṇyam /
children.translated_text: or was it merely the bitter fruit of past merit?
Was it a dream, or an illusion, or a delusion of the mind,

children.text: asaṃnivṛttyai tad atītam ete
manorathā nāma taṭaprapātāḥ //
children.translated_text: such are wishes, named precipices at the cliff's edge. //
That which has passed is gone beyond return —

children.text: svapno nu māyā nu mati-bhramo nu
kliṣṭaṃ nu tāvat phalam eva puṇyam /
asaṃnivṛttyai tad atītam ete
mano-rathā nāma taṭa-prapātāḥ //
vidūṣaka  maivam / nanv+aṅgulīyakam eva nidarśanam avaśyaṃ bhāvyacintanīyaḥ samāgamo bhavatīti /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Do not [speak] thus! Is not the ring itself the proof? A reunion surely awaits and is to be thought upon.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- ma aivam / nanv+aṅgulīyakam eva nidarśanam avaśyaṃ bhāvya-cintanīyaḥ samāgamo bhavati iti /
rājā  (aṅgulīyakaṃ vilokya) aye idaṃ tāvad asulabhasthānabhraṃśi śocanīyam /
children.translated_text: King: (Looking at the ring) Alas! This [ring] is to be pitied, for it has fallen from a place difficult to attain.

children.text: rājā -- (aṅgulīyakaṃ vilokya) aye idaṃ tāvad asulabha-sthāna-bhraṃśi śocanīyam /
tava sucaritam aṅgulīya nūnaṃ
pratanu mameva vibhāvyate phalena /
children.translated_text: whereas mine alone is shown to be meager by the result;
Surely, O ring, your merit was of high order,

children.text: aruṇanakhamanoharāsu tasyāś
cyutam asi labdhapadaṃ yad aṅgulīṣu //
children.translated_text: with their rosy nails, where you had found your place. //
for you have fallen from her fingers, charming

children.text: tava sucaritam aṅgulīya nūnaṃ
pratanu mama iva vibhāvyate phalena /
aruṇa-nakha-manoharāsu tasyāś
cyutam asi labdha-padaṃ yad aṅgulīṣu //
sānumatī  yady anyahastagataṃ bhavet satyam eva śocanīyaṃ bhavet /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: If it had come into another's hand, then indeed it would be truly pitiable.

children.text: sānumatī -- yady anya-hasta-gataṃ bhavet satyam eva śocanīyaṃ bhavet /
vidūṣaka  bhoḥ iyaṃ nāmamudrā kenodghātena tatrabhavatyā hastābhyāsaṃ prāpitā /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Sir! By what chance did this signet ring come to the lady's hand?

children.text: vidūṣaka -- bhoḥ iyaṃ nāma-mudrā kena udghātena tatra-bhavatyā hasta-abhyāsaṃ prāpitā /
sānumatī  mama api kautūhalenākārita eṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: He has posed the very question my own curiosity would have prompted.

children.text: sānumatī -- mama api kautūhalenā akārita eṣaḥ /
rājā  śrūyatām / svanagarāya prasthitaṃ māṃ priyā sabāṣpam āha kiyaccireṇāryaputraḥ pratipattiṃ dāsyatīti /
children.translated_text: King: Listen! When I was setting out for the capital, my beloved said with tears: 'How long until my noble lord sends [word of] his decision?'

children.text: rājā -- śrūyatām / sva-nagarāya prasthitaṃ māṃ priyā sabāṣpam āha kiyac-cireṇā arya-putraḥ pratipattiṃ dāsyati iti /
vidūṣaka  tatas tataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Then? Then?

children.text: vidūṣaka -- tatas tataḥ /
rājā  paścād imāṃ mudrāṃ tadaṅgulau niveśayatā mayā pratyabhihitā /
children.translated_text: King: Then, placing this signet ring on her finger, I replied:

children.text: rājā -- paścād imāṃ mudrāṃ tad-aṅgulau niveśayatā mayā pratyabhihitā /
ekaikam atra divase divase madīyaṃ
nāmākṣaraṃ gaṇaya gacchasi yāvad antam /
children.translated_text: of my name inscribed herein, until you reach the end;
'Count, one each day, the letters

children.text: tāvat priye madavarodhagṛhapraveśaṃ
netā janas tava samīpam upaiṣyatīti //
children.translated_text: to the entrance of my inner chambers.' //
by then, O beloved, a person shall come to bring you

children.text: ekaikam atra divase divase madīyaṃ
nāma akṣaraṃ gaṇaya gacchasi yāvad antam /
tāvat priye mad-avarodha-gṛha-praveśaṃ
netā janas tava samīpam upaiṣyati iti //
tac ca dāruṇātmanā mayā mohān nānuṣṭhitam /
children.translated_text: But that promise was not fulfilled by me, cruel-natured as I was, out of delusion.

children.text: tac ca dāruṇa-ātmanā mayā mohān na anuṣṭhitam /
sānumatī  ramaṇīyaḥ khalv avadhir vidhinā visaṃvāditaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: A delightful arrangement, indeed — thwarted by fate!

children.text: sānumatī -- ramaṇīyaḥ khalv avadhir vidhinā visaṃvāditaḥ /
vidūṣaka  atha kathaṃ dhīvarakalpitasya rohitamatsyasyodarābhyantara āsīt /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: And how did it come to be inside the belly of a <s>rohita</s> fish, as the fisherman supposed?

children.text: vidūṣaka -- atha kathaṃ dhīvara-kalpitasya rohita-matsyasya udara-abhyantara āsīt /
rājā  śacītīrthaṃ vandamānāyāḥ sakhyās te hastād gaṅgāsrotasi paribhraṣṭam /
children.translated_text: King: While your friend was worshipping at the sacred bathing-place of <s>Śacī</s>, it slipped from her hand into the current of the <s>Gaṅgā</s>.

children.text: rājā -- śacī-tīrthaṃ vandamānāyāḥ sakhyās te hastād gaṅgā-srotasi paribhraṣṭam /
vidūṣaka  yujyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: That makes sense.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- yujyate /
sānumatī  ata eva tapasvinyāḥ śakuntalāyā adharmabhīror asya rājarṣeḥ pariṇaye saṃdeha āsīt /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: For this very reason, the pitiable <s>Śakuntalā</s>, fearing impropriety, had doubt about the marriage with this royal sage.

children.text: sānumatī -- ata eva tapasvinyāḥ śakuntalāyā adharma-bhīror asya rājarṣeḥ pariṇaye saṃdeha āsīt /
athavedṛśo 'nurāgo 'bhijñānam apekṣate / katham ivaitat /
children.translated_text: Or rather — does such love require a token of recognition? How can that be?

children.text: athavā īdṛśo 'nurāgo 'bhijñānam apekṣate / katham iva etat /
rājā  upālapsye tāvad idam aṅgulīyakam /
children.translated_text: King: Let me now reproach this ring.

children.text: rājā -- upālapsye tāvad idam aṅgulīyakam /
vidūṣaka  (ātmagatam) gṛhīto 'nena panthā unmattānām /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (To himself) He has taken the path of madmen.
