children.text: vidūṣaka -- (ātma-gatam) gṛhīto 'nena panthā unmattānām /
rājā  kathaṃ nu taṃ bandhurakomalāṅguliṃ
children.translated_text: King: How could you, having left that hand with its gracefully curved, soft fingers,

children.text: rājā -- kathaṃ nu taṃ bandhura-komala-aṅguliṃ
karaṃ vihāyāsi nimagnam ambhasi /
athavā /
children.translated_text: Or rather —
have sunk into the water?

children.text: acetanaṃ nāma guṇaṃ na lakṣayen
mayaiva kasmād avadhīritā priyā //
children.translated_text: why then was my beloved rejected by me alone? //
An insensate thing, of course, would not recognize virtue;

children.text: karaṃ vihāyāsi nimagnam ambhasi /
athavā /
acetanaṃ nāma guṇaṃ na lakṣayen
mayaiva kasmād avadhīritā priyā //
vidūṣaka  (ātmagatam) kathaṃ bubhukṣayā khāditavyo 'smi /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (To himself) How is it that I am to be devoured by hunger [while he keeps talking]?

children.text: vidūṣaka -- (ātma-gatam) kathaṃ bubhukṣayā khāditavyo 'smi /
rājā  priye akāraṇaparityāgānuśayataptahṛdayas tāvad anukampyatām ayaṃ janaḥ punardarśanena /
children.translated_text: King: O beloved! My heart is scorched by the remorse of having abandoned you without cause — let this person be pitied by granting him the sight of you once more.

children.text: rājā - priye akāraṇa-parityāga-anuśaya-tapta-hṛdayas tāvad anukampyatām ayaṃ janaḥ punar-darśanena /
(praviśyāpaṭīkṣepeṇa citraphalakahastā)
children.translated_text: (Enter [<s>Caturikā</s>], drawing aside a curtain, picture-board in hand.)

children.text: (praviśyā apaṭī-kṣepeṇa citra-phalaka-hastā)
caturikā  iyaṃ citragatā bhaṭṭinī / (iti citraphalakaṃ darśayati)
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: Here is the queen in the painting. (She shows the picture-board.)

children.text: caturikā -- iyaṃ citra-gatā bhaṭṭinī / (iti citra-phalakaṃ darśayati)
vidūṣaka  (vilokya) sādhu vayasya / madhurāvasthānadarśanīyo bhāvānupraveśaḥ / skhalatīva me dṛṣṭir nimnonnatapradeśeṣu /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (Looking) Excellent, friend! The portrayal of emotions is beautiful in its sweet composition. My gaze stumbles, as it were, over the elevated and depressed surfaces.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- (vilokya) sādhu vayasya / madhura-avasthāna-darśanīyo bhāva-anupraveśaḥ / skhalati iva me dṛṣṭir nimna-unnata-pradeśeṣu /
sānumatī  aho eṣā rājarṣer nipuṇatā / jāne sakhy agrato me vartata iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Ah, what skill the royal sage has! I feel as though my friend stands before me.

children.text: sānumatī -- aho eṣā rājarṣer nipuṇatā / jāne sakhy agrato me vartata iti /
rājā
children.translated_text: King:

children.text: rājā --
yad yat sādhu na citre syāt kriyate tat tad anyathā /
children.translated_text: Whatever is not well done in the painting — that is rendered otherwise;

children.text: tathāpi tasyā lāvaṇyaṃ rekhayā kiṃcid anvitam //
children.translated_text: yet even so, something of her grace is captured by the line. //

children.text: yad yat sādhu na citre syāt kriyate tat tad anyathā /
tatha āpi tasyā lāvaṇyaṃ rekhayā kiṃcid anvitam //
sānumatī  sadṛśam etat paścāt+tāpaguroḥ snehasyānavalepasya ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: This befits one burdened with remorse, whose love is free of pride.

children.text: sānumatī -- sadṛśam etat paścāt+tāpa-guroḥ snehasya anavalepasya ca /
vidūṣaka  bhoḥ idānīṃ tisras tatrabhavatyo dṛśyante / sarvāś ca darśanīyāḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Sir! Now I see three ladies there, and all are beautiful to behold.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- bhoḥ idānīṃ tisras tatra-bhavatyo dṛśyante / sarvāś ca darśanīyāḥ /
katamātra tatrabhavatī śakuntalā /
children.translated_text: Which one among them is the lady <s>Śakuntalā</s>?

children.text: katama ātra tatra-bhavatī śakuntalā /
sānumatī  anabhijñaḥ khalv īdṛśasya rūpasya moghadṛṣṭir ayaṃ janaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: This person is truly unfamiliar with such beauty — his eyes see in vain.

children.text: sānumatī -- anabhijñaḥ khalv īdṛśasya rūpasya mogha-dṛṣṭir ayaṃ janaḥ /
rājā  tvaṃ tāvat katamāṃ tarkayasi /
children.translated_text: King: Which one do you take her to be, then?

children.text: rājā -- tvaṃ tāvat katamāṃ tarkayasi /

vidūṣaka  tarkayāmi yaiṣā śithilabandhanodvāntakusumena keśāntenodbhinnasvedabindunā vadanena viśeṣato 'pasṛtābhyāṃ bāhubhyām avasekasnigdhataruṇapallavasya cūtapādapasya pārśva īṣatpariśrāntevālakṣitā sā śakuntalā / itare sakhyāv iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: I take her to be <s>Śakuntalā</s> — the one with her hair-end loosely bound and shedding its flowers, with beads of perspiration on her face, and particularly with both arms hanging languidly at her sides, barely visible as if slightly fatigued, standing beside a mango tree whose young shoots glisten as if freshly watered. The other two are her companions.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- tarkayāmi ya aiṣā śithila-bandhana-udvānta-kusumena keśa-antena udbhinna-sveda-bindunā vadanena viśeṣato 'pasṛtābhyāṃ bāhubhyām avaseka-snigdha-taruṇa-pallavasya cūta-pādapasya pārśva īṣat-pariśrānta īvā alakṣitā sā śakuntalā / itare sakhyāv iti /
rājā  nipuṇo bhavān / asty atra me bhāvacihnam /
children.translated_text: King: You are perceptive! There is indeed a sign of my emotion here:

children.text: rājā -- nipuṇo bhavān / asty atra me bhāva-cihnam /
svinnāṅguliviniveśo rekhāprānteṣu dṛśyate malinaḥ /
children.translated_text: The impression of my sweating fingers is visible, smudged, at the edges of the lines,

children.text: aśru ca kapolapatitaṃ dṛśyam idaṃ varṇikocchvāsāt //
children.translated_text: and a tear that has fallen on the cheek is visible here, from the smearing of the paint.

children.text: svinna-aṅguli-viniveśo rekhā-prānteṣu dṛśyate malinaḥ /
aśru ca kapola-patitaṃ dṛśyam idaṃ varṇikā-ucchvāsāt //
caturike ardhalikhitam etad vinodasthānam / gaccha / vartikāṃ tāvad ānaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>, this pleasure-ground is only half-painted. Go, bring the brush.

children.text: caturike ardha-likhitam etad vinoda-sthānam / gaccha / vartikāṃ tāvad ānaya /
caturikā  ārya mādhavya avalambasva citraphalakaṃ yāvad āgacchāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: Noble <s>Mādhavya</s>, hold the painting board until I return.

children.text: caturikā -- ārya mādhavya avalambasva citra-phalakaṃ yāvad āgacchāmi /
rājā  (niḥśvasya)
children.translated_text: King: (Sighing)

children.text: rājā - (niḥśvasya)
sākṣāt priyām upagatām apahāya pūrvaṃ citrārpitāṃ punar imāṃ bahu manyamānaḥ /
children.translated_text: Having formerly rejected my beloved when she came in person, I now esteem highly this image painted on a board.

children.text: srotovahāṃ pathi nikāmajalām atītya jātaḥ sakhe praṇayavān mṛgatṛṣṇikāyām //
children.translated_text: Having passed by a river full of water on the path, I have, O friend, become enamored of a mirage.

children.text: sākṣāt priyām upagatām apahāya pūrvaṃ citra-arpitāṃ punar imāṃ bahu manyamānaḥ /
sroto-vahāṃ pathi nikāma-jalām atītya jātaḥ sakhe praṇayavān mṛga-tṛṣṇikāyām //
vidūṣaka  (ātmagatam) eṣo 'trabhavān nadīm atikramya mṛgatṛṣṇikāṃ saṃkrāntaḥ / (prakāśam) bhoḥ aparaṃ kim atra lekhitavyam /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (To himself) This fellow has crossed the river and is now attached to a mirage! (Aloud) Well then, what else is to be painted here?

children.text: vidūṣaka -- (ātma-gatam) eṣo 'tra-bhavān nadīm atikramya mṛga-tṛṣṇikāṃ saṃkrāntaḥ / (prakāśam) bhoḥ aparaṃ kim atra lekhitavyam /
rājā  śrūyatām
children.translated_text: King: Listen:

children.text: rājā -- śrūyatām --
kāryā saikatalīnahaṃsamithunā srotovahā mālinī
pātās tām abhito niṣaṇṇahariṇā gaurīguroḥ pāvanāḥ /
children.translated_text: and the sacred slopes of the father of <s>Gaurī</s> (<s>Himālaya</s>), with deer seated about them.
The river <s>Mālinī</s> must be depicted, with pairs of geese resting upon its sandbanks;

children.text: śākhālambitavalkalasya ca taror nirmātum icchāmy adhaḥ
śṛṅge kṛṣṇamṛgasya vāmanayanaṃ kaṇḍūyamānāṃ mṛgīm //
children.translated_text: a doe rubbing her eye against the horn of a black antelope.
And beneath a tree with bark garments hanging from its branches, I wish to paint

children.text: kāryā saikata-līna-haṃsa-mithunā sroto-vahā mālinī
pātās tām abhito niṣaṇṇa-hariṇā gaurī-guroḥ pāvanāḥ /
śākhā-lambita-valkalasya ca taror nirmātum icchāmy adhaḥ
śṛṅge kṛṣṇa-mṛgasya vāma-nayanaṃ kaṇḍūyamānāṃ mṛgīm //
vidūṣaka  (ātmagatam) yathāhaṃ paśyāmi pūritavyam anena citraphalakaṃ lambakūrcānāṃ tāpasānāṃ kadambaiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: (To himself) As I see it, he will fill the painting board with crowds of long-bearded ascetics.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- (ātma-gatam) yatha āhaṃ paśyāmi pūritavyam anena citra-phalakaṃ lamba-kūrcānāṃ tāpasānāṃ kadambaiḥ /
rājā vayasya anyac ca / śakuntalāyāḥ prasādhanam abhipretam atra vismṛtam asmābhiḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, and another thing — an ornament befitting <s>Śakuntalā</s> has been forgotten by me in this [painting].

children.text: rājā -vayasya anyac ca / śakuntalāyāḥ prasādhanam abhipretam atra vismṛtam asmābhiḥ /
vidūṣaka  kim iva /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: What sort of ornament?

children.text: vidūṣaka -- kim iva /
sānumatī  vanavāsasya saukmāryasya vinayasya ca yat sadṛśaṃ bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: It must be something befitting her forest life, her delicacy, and her modesty.

children.text: sānumatī -- vana-vāsasya saukmāryasya vinayasya ca yat sadṛśaṃ bhaviṣyati /
rājā
children.translated_text: King:

children.text: rājā --
kṛtaṃ na karṇārpitabandhanaṃ sakhe śirīṣam āgaṇḍavilambikesaram /
children.translated_text: The <s>śirīṣa</s> flower, with its filaments drooping to the cheek, placed behind the ear as an ornament, has not been drawn, O friend,

children.text: na vā śaraccandramarīcikomalaṃ mṛṇālasūtraṃ racitaṃ stanāntare //
children.translated_text: nor has a fiber of lotus stalk, soft as the rays of the autumn moon, been fashioned upon her bosom.

children.text: kṛtaṃ na karṇa-arpita-bandhanaṃ sakhe śirīṣam āgaṇḍa-vilambi-kesaram /
na vā śarac-candra-marīci-komalaṃ mṛṇāla-sūtraṃ racitaṃ stana-antare //
vidūṣaka  bhoḥ kiṃ nu tatrabhavatī raktakuvalayapallavaśobhināgrahastena mukham avārya cakitacakiteva sthitā / (sāvadhānaṃ nirūpya dṛṣṭvā)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: But why does the lady, covering her face with her hand — beautiful as a red lotus petal — stand as if startled? (Looking carefully) Ah! Here is a bee, that thief of flower-nectar, a son of a slave girl, assaulting the lotus of the lady's face!

children.text: vidūṣaka -- bhoḥ kiṃ nu tatra-bhavatī rakta-kuvalaya-pallava-śobhina āgra-hastena mukham avārya cakita-cakita īva sthitā / (sāvadhānaṃ nirūpya dṛṣṭvā)
āḥ eṣa dāsyāḥ putraḥ kusumarasapāṭaccaras tatrabhavatyā vadanakamalam abhilaṅghate madhukaraḥ /
āḥ eṣa dāsyāḥ putraḥ kusuma-rasa-pāṭaccaras tatra-bhavatyā vadana-kamalam abhilaṅghate madhu-karaḥ /
rājā  nanu vāryatām eṣa dhṛṣṭaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Drive away the impudent creature!

children.text: rājā -- nanu vāryatām eṣa dhṛṣṭaḥ /
vidūṣaka  bhavān evāvinītānāṃ śāsitāsya vāraṇe prabhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: You yourself, the punisher of the insolent, will have the power to ward him off.

children.text: vidūṣaka -- bhavān eva avinītānāṃ śāsita āsya vāraṇe prabhaviṣyati /
rājā  yujyate / ayi bhoḥ kusumalatāpriyātithe kim atra paripatanakhedam anubhavasi /
children.translated_text: King: Right. O guest dear to the flowering vine, why do you undergo the trouble of hovering about here?

children.text: rājā -- yujyate / ayi bhoḥ kusuma-latā-priya-atithe kim atra paripatana-khedam anubhavasi /
eṣā kusumaniṣaṇṇā tṛṣitā api satī bhavantam anuraktā /
children.translated_text: This female bee, seated upon a flower, though thirsty, devoted to you,

children.text: pratipālayati madhukarī na khalu madhu vinā tvayā pibati //
children.translated_text: waits for you — she does not drink the honey without you.

children.text: eṣā kusuma-niṣaṇṇā tṛṣitā api satī bhavantam anuraktā /
pratipālayati madhu-karī na khalu madhu vinā tvayā pibati //
sānumatī  adyābhijātaṃ khalv eṣa vāritaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: What a fitting way to deter him — truly gracious!

children.text: sānumatī -- adya abhijātaṃ khalv eṣa vāritaḥ /
vidūṣaka  pratiṣiddhā api vāmaiṣā jātiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Even when forbidden, this race is perverse!

children.text: vidūṣaka -- pratiṣiddhā api vāma aiṣā jātiḥ /
rājā  evaṃ bho na me śāsane tiṣṭhasi / śrūyatāṃ tarhi saṃprati /
children.translated_text: King: So then, you do not heed my command? Listen now!

children.text: rājā -- evaṃ bho na me śāsane tiṣṭhasi / śrūyatāṃ tarhi saṃprati /
akliṣṭabālatarupallavalobhanīyam
pītaṃ mayā sadayam eva ratotsaveṣu /
children.translated_text: were drunk by me tenderly in the festivities of love.
The lips of my beloved, charming as the tender shoot of a young tree, with effortless beauty,

children.text: bimbādharaṃ spṛśasi ced bhramara priyāyās
tvāṃ kārayāmi kamalodarabandhanastham //
children.translated_text: I shall confine you within the prison of a lotus bud!
If you touch the <s>bimba</s>-fruit lips of my beloved, O bee,

children.text: akliṣṭa-bāla-taru-pallava-lobhanīyam
pītaṃ mayā sadayam eva rata-utsaveṣu /
bimba-adharaṃ spṛśasi ced bhramara priyāyās
tvāṃ kārayāmi kamala-udara-bandhanastham //
vidūṣaka  evaṃ tīkṣṇadaṇḍasya kiṃ na bheṣyati / (prahasya / ātmagatam)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: Who would not fear one with so severe a punishment? (Laughing, to himself)

children.text: vidūṣaka -- evaṃ tīkṣṇa-daṇḍasya kiṃ na bheṣyati / (prahasya / ātma-gatam)
eṣa tāvad unmattaḥ / aham apy etasya saṅgenedṛśavarṇa iva saṃvṛttaḥ / (prakāśam)
children.translated_text: This fellow is truly mad. And I too, by association with him, have taken on the same complexion, as it were. (Aloud)

children.text: eṣa tāvad unmattaḥ / aham apy etasya saṅgenā idṛśa-varṇa iva saṃvṛttaḥ / (prakāśam)
bhoḥ citraṃ khalv etat /
children.translated_text: Friend, it is merely a painting!

children.text: bhoḥ citraṃ khalv etat /
rājā  kathaṃ citram /
children.translated_text: King: How, a painting?

children.text: rājā -- kathaṃ citram /
sānumatī  aham apīdānīm avagatārthā / kiṃ punar yathālikhitānubhāvy eṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Even I now understand the matter. How much more he, who experiences everything as if it were real!

children.text: sānumatī -- aham api idānīm avagata-arthā / kiṃ punar yathā-likhita-anubhāvy eṣaḥ /
rājā  vayasya kim idam anuṣṭhitaṃ paurobhāgyam /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, what excellent service has been performed by you!

children.text: rājā -- vayasya kim idam anuṣṭhitaṃ paurobhāgyam /
darśanasukham anubhavataḥ sākṣād iva tanmayena hṛdayena /
children.translated_text: While I was enjoying the happiness of seeing her, as it were in person, with a heart fully absorbed in her,

children.text: smṛtikāriṇā tvayā me punar api citrīkṛtā kāntā //
children.translated_text: you, who brought back my memory, have once again turned my beloved into a mere picture.

children.text: darśana-sukham anubhavataḥ sākṣād iva tanmayena hṛdayena /
smṛti-kāriṇā tvayā me punar api citrī-kṛtā kāntā //
(iti bāṣpaṃ viharati)
children.translated_text: (He sheds tears.)

children.text: (iti bāṣpaṃ viharati)
sānumatī  pūrvāparavirodhy apūrva eṣa virahamārgaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: This is an extraordinary path of separation, contradictory in its phases.

children.text: sānumatī -- pūrva-apara-virodhy apūrva eṣa viraha-mārgaḥ /
rājā  vayasya katham evam aviśrāntaduḥkham anubhavāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, how is it that I experience such unrelenting sorrow?

children.text: rājā -- vayasya katham evam aviśrānta-duḥkham anubhavāmi /
prajāgarāt khilībhūtas tasyāḥ svapne samāgamaḥ /
children.translated_text: Kept sleepless, the union with her exists only in dreams;

children.text: bāṣpas tu na dadāty enāṃ draṣṭuṃ citragatām api //
children.translated_text: but tears do not allow me to see her even in a painting.

children.text: prajāgarāt khilī-bhūtas tasyāḥ svapne samāgamaḥ /
bāṣpas tu na dadāty enāṃ draṣṭuṃ citra-gatām api //
sānumatī  sarvathā pramārjitaṃ tvayā pratyādeśaduḥkhaṃ śakuntalāyāḥ / (praviśya)
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: In every way you have wiped away the pain that <s>Śakuntalā</s> suffered at being rejected. (Entering)

children.text: sānumatī -- sarvathā pramārjitaṃ tvayā pratyādeśa-duḥkhaṃ śakuntalāyāḥ / (praviśya)
caturikā  jayatu bhartā / vartikākaraṇḍakaṃ gṛhītvetomukhaṃ prasthitāsmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: Victory to the lord! I took the brush-box and set out this way —

children.text: caturikā -- jayatu bhartā / vartikā-karaṇḍakaṃ gṛhītva īto-mukhaṃ prasthita āsmi /
rājā  kiṃ ca /
children.translated_text: King: And then?

children.text: rājā -- kiṃ ca /
caturikā  sa me hastād antarā taralikādvitīyayā devyā vasumatyāham evāryaputrasyopaneṣyāmīti sabalātkāraṃ gṛhītaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: On the way, it was forcibly seized from my hand by Queen <s>Vasumatī</s>, accompanied by <s>Taralikā</s>, saying 'I myself shall take it to the noble prince.'

children.text: caturikā -- sa me hastād antarā taralikā-dvitīyayā devyā vasumatya āham evā arya-putrasya upaneṣyāmi iti sabalāt-kāraṃ gṛhītaḥ /
vidūṣaka  diṣṭyā tvaṃ muktā /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: It is fortunate you escaped!

children.text: vidūṣaka -- diṣṭyā tvaṃ muktā /
caturikā  yāvad devyā viṭapalagnam uttarīyaṃ taralikā mocayati tāvan mayā nirvāhita ātmā /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: While <s>Taralikā</s> was untangling the queen's upper garment from a branch, I made my escape.

children.text: caturikā -- yāvad devyā viṭapa-lagnam uttarīyaṃ taralikā mocayati tāvan mayā nirvāhita ātmā /
rājā  vayasya upasthitā devī bahumānagarvitā ca / bhavān imāṃ pratikṛtiṃ rakṣatu /
children.translated_text: King: Friend, the queen has arrived, puffed up with the pride of her status. You, guard this portrait.

children.text: rājā -- vayasya upasthitā devī bahu-māna-garvitā ca / bhavān imāṃ pratikṛtiṃ rakṣatu /
vidūṣaka  ātmānam iti bhaṇa / (citraphalakam ādāyotthāya ca) yadi bhavān antaḥpurakūṭavāgurāto mokṣyate tadā māṃ meghapratichande prāsāde śabdāyaya / (iti drutapadaṃ niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: You mean 'save yourself!' (Taking the painting board and rising) If you escape from the harem's net of deceit, then signal me at the cloud-roofed palace. (He exits hurriedly.)

children.text: vidūṣaka -- ātmānam iti bhaṇa / (citra-phalakam ādāya utthāya ca) yadi bhavān antaḥ-pura-kūṭa-vāgurāto mokṣyate tadā māṃ megha-pratichande prāsāde śabdāyaya / (iti druta-padaṃ niṣkrāntaḥ)
sānumatī  anyasaṃkrāntahṛdayo 'pi prathamasaṃbhāvanām apekṣate / atiśithilasauhārda idānīm eṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Though his heart has passed to another, he still pays deference to his first wife. His affection is exceedingly feeble now.

children.text: sānumatī -- anya-saṃkrānta-hṛdayo 'pi prathama-saṃbhāvanām apekṣate / atiśithila-sauhārda idānīm eṣaḥ /
(praviśya patrahastā)
children.translated_text: (Entering, with a letter in hand)

children.text: (praviśya patra-hastā)
pratīhārī  jayatu jayatu devaḥ /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Victory, victory to the lord!

children.text: pratīhārī -- jayatu jayatu devaḥ /
rājā  vetravati na khalv antarā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Vetravatī</s>, you did not encounter the queen on the way, did you?

children.text: rājā -- vetravati na khalv antarā dṛṣṭā tvayā devī /
pratīhārī  athakim / patrahastāṃ māṃ prekṣya pratinivṛttā /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Indeed I did! But seeing me with a letter in hand, she turned back.

children.text: pratīhārī -- athakim / patra-hastāṃ māṃ prekṣya pratinivṛttā /
rājā  kāryajñā kāryoparodhaṃ me pariharati /
children.translated_text: King: She understands propriety and avoids obstructing my duties.

children.text: rājā -- kāryajñā kārya-uparodhaṃ me pariharati /
pratīhārī  deva amātyo vijñāpayati / arthajātasya gaṇanābahulatayaikam eva paurakāryam avekṣitaṃ tad devaḥ patrārūḍhaṃ pratyakṣīkarotv iti /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: My lord, the minister reports: 'Due to the multitude of financial matters, only one civic case has been examined. Let the lord review what has been set down in writing.'

children.text: pratīhārī -- deva amātyo vijñāpayati / artha-jātasya gaṇanā-bahulataya aikam eva paura-kāryam avekṣitaṃ tad devaḥ patra-ārūḍhaṃ pratyakṣī-karotv iti /
rājā  itaḥ patraṃ darśaya / (pratihāry upanayati)
children.translated_text: King: Show the letter here. (The doorkeeper presents it.)

children.text: rājā -- itaḥ patraṃ darśaya / (pratihāry upanayati)
rājā  (anuvācya) katham / samudravyavahārī sārthavāho dhanamitro nāma nauvyasane vipannaḥ / anapatyaś ca kila tapasvī /
KSak_6.22a0 rājagāmī tasyārthasaṃcaya ity etad amātyena likhitam / kaṣṭaṃ khalv anapatyatā /
children.translated_text: The minister has written: 'His accumulated wealth reverts to the king.' Alas, childlessness is indeed cruel!
King: (Having read it) What! A merchant engaged in maritime trade named <s>Dhanamitra</s> has perished in a shipwreck! And the unfortunate man has no offspring, it seems.

children.text: rājā -- (anuvācya) katham / samudra-vyavahārī sārtha-vāho dhana-mitro nāma nau-vyasane vipannaḥ / anapatyaś ca kila tapasvī /
KSak_6.22a20 rāja-gāmī tasya artha-saṃcaya ity etad amātyena likhitam / kaṣṭaṃ khalv anapatyatā /
vetravati bahudhanatvād bahupatnīkena tatrabhavatā bhavitavyam /
KSak_6.22a2 vicāryatāṃ yadi kācid āpannasattvā tasya bhāryāsu syāt /
children.translated_text: Let it be investigated whether any of his wives may be with child.
<s>Vetravatī</s>, a man of such great wealth must have had many wives.

children.text: vetravati bahu-dhanatvād bahu-patnīkena tatra-bhavatā bhavitavyam /
KSak_6.22a22 vicāryatāṃ yadi kācid āpanna-sattvā tasya bhāryāsu syāt /
pratīhārī  deva idānīm eva sāketakasya śreṣṭhino duhitā nirvṛttapuṃsavanā jāyāsya śrūyate /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: My lord, it is reported just now that his wife, the daughter of a merchant of <s>Sāketa</s>, has completed the <s>puṃsavana</s> (rite for a male child) [i.e., is pregnant].

children.text: pratīhārī -- deva idānīm eva sāketakasya śreṣṭhino duhitā nirvṛtta-puṃsavanā jāya āsya śrūyate /
rājā  nanu garbhaḥ pitryaṃ riktham arhati / gaccha / evam amātyaṃ brūhi /
children.translated_text: King: Then surely the unborn child is entitled to the paternal inheritance. Go, tell the minister thus.

children.text: rājā -- nanu garbhaḥ pitryaṃ riktham arhati / gaccha / evam amātyaṃ brūhi /
pratīhārī  yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti prasthitā)
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: As the lord commands. (She starts to go.)

children.text: pratīhārī -- yad deva ājñāpayati / (iti prasthitā)
rājā  ehi tāvat /
children.translated_text: King: Come back.

children.text: rājā -- ehi tāvat /
pratīhārī  iyam asmi /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: I am here.

children.text: pratīhārī -- iyam asmi /
rājā  kim anena saṃtatir asti nāstīti /
children.translated_text: King: What does it matter whether there is progeny or not?

children.text: rājā -- kim anena saṃtatir asti na asti iti /
yena yena viyujyante prajāḥ snigdhena bandhunā /
children.translated_text: Whatever dear kinsman from whom the subjects are separated,

children.text: sa sa pāpād ṛte tāsāṃ duṣyanta iti ghuṣyatām //
children.translated_text: let it be proclaimed that <s>Duṣyanta</s> shall be that one to them, except in matters of sin.

children.text: yena yena viyujyante prajāḥ snigdhena bandhunā /
sa sa pāpād ṛte tāsāṃ duṣyanta iti ghuṣyatām //
pratīhārī  evaṃ nāma ghoṣayitavyam /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: It shall be so proclaimed.

children.text: pratīhārī -- evaṃ nāma ghoṣayitavyam /
(niṣkramya / punaḥ praviṣya) kāle praviṣṭam ivābhinanditaṃ devasya śāsanam /
children.translated_text: (Exiting and re-entering) The lord's decree has been welcomed as if it arrived at the right moment.

children.text: (niṣkramya / punaḥ praviṣya) kāle praviṣṭam iva abhinanditaṃ devasya śāsanam /
rājā  (dīrgham uṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvasya) evaṃ bhoḥ saṃtatichedaniravalambānāṃ kulānāṃ mūlapuruṣāvasāne saṃpadaḥ param upatiṣṭhante / mama apy ante puruvaṃśaśriya eṣa eva vṛttāntaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (With a long, hot sigh) Alas! The riches of families whose lineage is cut off and who have no support come to attend upon another at the end of the founding ancestor. Such too will be the fate of the glory of the <s>Puru</s> dynasty after me.

children.text: rājā -- (dīrgham uṣṇaṃ ca niḥśvasya) evaṃ bhoḥ saṃtati-cheda-niravalambānāṃ kulānāṃ mūla-puruṣa-avasāne saṃpadaḥ param upatiṣṭhante / mama apy ante puru-vaṃśa-śriya eṣa eva vṛtta-antaḥ /
pratīhārī  pratihatam amaṅgalam /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: May the inauspicious be averted!

children.text: pratīhārī -- pratihatam amaṅgalam /
rājā  dhin mām upasthitaśreyo 'vamāninam /
children.translated_text: King: Shame on me, who scorned the fortune that had come to me!

children.text: rājā -- dhin mām upasthita-śreyo 'vamāninam /
sānumatī  asaṃśayaṃ sakhīm eva hṛdaye kṛtvā nindito 'nenātmā /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Without doubt, thinking of his friend (<s>Śakuntalā</s>) in his heart, he reproaches himself.

children.text: sānumatī -- asaṃśayaṃ sakhīm eva hṛdaye kṛtvā nindito 'nenā atmā /
rājā
children.translated_text: King:

children.text: rājā --
saṃropite 'py ātmani dharmapatnī tyaktā mayā nāma kulapratiṣṭhā /
children.translated_text: Though my lawful wife had been entrusted to me, I abandoned her — she who was the foundation of my lineage,

children.text: kalpiṣyamāṇā mahate phalāya vasuṃdharā kāla ivoptabījā //
children.translated_text: who would have borne a great fruit, like the earth with seed sown in due season.

children.text: saṃropite 'py ātmani dharma-patnī tyaktā mayā nāma kula-pratiṣṭhā /
kalpiṣyamāṇā mahate phalāya vasuṃdharā kāla iva upta-bījā //
sānumatī  aparichinnedānīṃ te saṃtatir bhaviṣyati /
children.translated_text: <s>Sānumatī</s>: Your lineage shall indeed not be cut off.

children.text: sānumatī -- aparichinna īdānīṃ te saṃtatir bhaviṣyati /
caturikā  (janāntikam) aye anena sārvavāhavṛttāntena dviguṇodvego bhartā / enam āśvāsayituṃ meghapratichandād āryaṃ mādhavyaṃ gṛhītvāgaccha /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: (In a whisper) Alas, by this incident of the merchant, the lord's anxiety has doubled. Go to the cloud-roofed palace, fetch the noble <s>Mādhavya</s>, and bring him to console the lord.

children.text: caturikā -- (jana-antikam) aye anena sārva-vāha-vṛtta-antena dviguṇa-udvego bhartā / enam āśvāsayituṃ megha-pratichandād āryaṃ mādhavyaṃ gṛhītvā āgaccha /
pratīhārī  suṣṭhu bhaṇasi / (iti niṣkrāntā)
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: Well said. (She exits.)

children.text: pratīhārī -- suṣṭhu bhaṇasi / (iti niṣkrāntā)
rājā  aho duṣyantasya saṃśayam ārūḍhāḥ piṇḍabhājaḥ / kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Alas, the ancestors of <s>Duṣyanta</s> who receive the funeral offerings have fallen into uncertainty! For —

children.text: rājā -- aho duṣyantasya saṃśayam ārūḍhāḥ piṇḍa-bhājaḥ / kutaḥ /
asmāt paraṃ bata yathāśruti saṃbhṛtāni
ko naḥ kule nivapanāni niyacchatīti /
children.translated_text: duly prepared according to scriptural injunction?
Hereafter, who shall offer us the ancestral oblations

children.text: nūnaṃ prasūtivikalena mayā prasiktam
dautāśruśeṣam udakaṃ pitaraḥ pibanti //
children.translated_text: with the remnants of tears of grief, poured by me, bereft of offspring.
Surely our fathers drink water that is mixed

children.text: asmāt paraṃ bata yathā-śruti saṃbhṛtāni
ko naḥ kule nivapanāni niyacchati iti /
nūnaṃ prasūti-vikalena mayā prasiktam
dauta-aśru-śeṣam udakaṃ pitaraḥ pibanti //
(iti moham upagataḥ)
children.translated_text: (He falls into a swoon.)

children.text: (iti moham upagataḥ)
caturikā  (sasaṃbhramam avalokya) samāśvasitu samāśvasitu bhartā /
children.translated_text: <s>Caturikā</s>: (Looking with alarm) Let the lord be consoled! Be consoled!

children.text: caturikā -- (sasaṃbhramam avalokya) samāśvasitu samāśvasitu bhartā /
sānumatī  hā dhig ghā dhik / sati khalu dīpe vyavadhānadoṣeṇaiṣo 'ndhakāradoṣam anubhavati /
KSak_6.25a aham idānīm eva nirvṛtaṃ karomi /
children.translated_text: I shall now set things right.
<s>Sānumatī</s>: Alas, alas! Though the lamp exists, through the fault of an obstruction, he suffers from the fault of darkness.

children.text: sānumatī -- hā dhig ghā dhik / sati khalu dīpe vyavadhāna-doṣeṇa eṣo 'ndha-kāra-doṣam anubhavati /
KSak_6.25a4 aham idānīm eva nirvṛtaṃ karomi /
athavā śrutaṃ mayā śakuntalāṃ samāśvāsayantyā mahāindrajananyā mukhād yajñabhāgotsukā devā eva tathānuṣṭhāsyanti yathācireṇa dharmapatnīṃ bhartābhinandiṣyatīti /
KSak_6.25a6 tad yuktam etaṃ kālaṃ pratipālayitum / yāvad anena vṛttāntena priyasakhīṃ samāśvāsayāmi /
children.translated_text: Therefore it is proper to wait for that time. Meanwhile, with this account I shall console my dear friend.

But no — I heard from the mouth of the great mother of <s>Indra</s>, while she was consoling <s>Śakuntalā</s>, that the gods, eager for their share of the sacrifice, will themselves bring it about that the husband will soon rejoice in his lawful wife.

children.text: athavā śrutaṃ mayā śakuntalāṃ samāśvāsayantyā mahā-indra-jananyā mukhād yajña-bhāga-utsukā devā eva tatha ānuṣṭhāsyanti yatha ācireṇa dharma-patnīṃ bhartā-abhinandiṣyati iti /
KSak_6.25a6 tad yuktam etaṃ kālaṃ pratipālayitum / yāvad anena vṛtta-antena priya-sakhīṃ samāśvāsayāmi /
(nepathye) abrahmaṇyam /
children.translated_text: (From backstage) Help! Sacrilege!

children.text: (nepathye) abrahmaṇyam /
rājā  (pratyāgataḥ / karṇaṃ dattvā) aye mādhavyasya ivārtasvaraḥ / kaḥ ko tra bhoḥ / (praviśya)
children.translated_text: King: (Recovering, listening) Ah, that sounds like the distressed voice of <s>Mādhavya</s>! Who is there? (Entering)

children.text: rājā -- (pratyāgataḥ / karṇaṃ dattvā) aye mādhavyasya ivā arta-svaraḥ / kaḥ ko tra bhoḥ / (praviśya)
pratīhārī  (sasaṃbhramam) paritrāyatāṃ devaḥ saṃśayagataṃ vayasyam /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: (With alarm) Let the lord rescue his friend who is in danger!

children.text: pratīhārī -- (sasaṃbhramam) paritrāyatāṃ devaḥ saṃśaya-gataṃ vayasyam /
rājā  kenāttagandho māṇavakaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: By whom has the proud youth been seized?

children.text: rājā -- kenā atta-gandho māṇavakaḥ /
pratīhārī  adṛṣṭarūpeṇa kenāpi sattvenātikramya meghapraticchandasya prāsādasyāgrabhūmim ārophitaḥ /
children.translated_text: Doorkeeper: By some invisible being who has carried him beyond the terrace of the cloud-roofed palace to its upper floor.

children.text: pratīhārī -- adṛṣṭa-rūpeṇa kena api sattvena atikramya megha-praticchandasya prāsādasya agra-bhūmim ārophitaḥ /
rājā  (utthāya) mā tāvat / mama api sattvair abhibhūyante gṛhāḥ / atha vā /
children.translated_text: King: (Rising) To think that even my household is overpowered by supernatural beings! Or rather —

children.text: rājā -- (utthāya) mā tāvat / mama api sattvair abhibhūyante gṛhāḥ / atha vā /
ahany ahany ātmana eva tāvaj jñātuṃ pramādaskhalitaṃ na śakyam /
children.translated_text: Day after day, one is unable to know even one's own lapses due to negligence;

children.text: prajāsu kaḥ ke pathā prayāti ity aśeṣato veditum asti śaktiḥ //
children.translated_text: who then has the power to know completely by which path his subjects proceed?

children.text: ahany ahany ātmana eva tāvaj jñātuṃ pramāda-skhalitaṃ na śakyam /
prajāsu kaḥ ke pathā prayāti ity aśeṣato veditum asti śaktiḥ //
(nepathye) bho vayasya avihā avihā /
children.translated_text: (From backstage) Dear friend! Help, help!

children.text: (nepathye) bho vayasya avihā avihā /
rājā  (gatibhedena parikrāman) sakhe na bhetavyam / (nepathye)
children.translated_text: King: (Walking with quickened pace) Friend, do not fear! (From backstage)

children.text: rājā -- (gati-bhedena parikrāman) sakhe na bhetavyam / (nepathye)
(punas tad eva paṭhitvā) kathaṃ na bheṣyāmi / eṣa māṃ ko 'pi pratyavanataśirodharam ikṣum iva tribhaṅgaṃ karomi /
children.translated_text: (Repeating the same) How shall I not fear? Some being is bending me, head bowed, into a triple curve like a sugarcane!

children.text: (punas tad eva paṭhitvā) kathaṃ na bheṣyāmi / eṣa māṃ ko 'pi pratyavanata-śiro-dharam ikṣum iva tribhaṅgaṃ karomi /
rājā  (sadṛṣṭikṣepam) dhanus tāvat / (praviśya śārṅgahastā)
children.translated_text: King: (Casting a glance) A bow, quickly! (A Greek woman enters with a bow in hand.)

children.text: rājā -- (sadṛṣṭi-kṣepam) dhanus tāvat / (praviśya śārṅga-hastā)
yavanī  bhartaḥ etad hastāvāpasahitaṃ śarāsanam /
children.translated_text: <s>Yavanī</s>: Here is the bow, my lord, together with the arm-guard.

children.text: yavanī -- bhartaḥ etad hasta-āvāpa-sahitaṃ śara-āsanam /
(rājā saśaraṃ dhanur ādatte)
children.translated_text: (The king takes up the bow with an arrow.)

children.text: (rājā saśaraṃ dhanur ādatte)
(nepathye)
children.translated_text: (From backstage)

children.text: (nepathye)
eṣa tvām abhinavakaṇṭhaśoṇitārthī
śārdūlaḥ paśum iva hanmi ceṣṭamānam /
children.translated_text: I shall slay like a beast, as it struggles!
This creature, thirsting for the fresh blood of your throat,

children.text: ārtānāṃ bhayam apanetum āttadhanvā
duṣyantas tava śaraṇaṃ bhavatv idānīm //
children.translated_text: be your refuge now, to dispel the fear of the afflicted!
Let <s>Duṣyanta</s>, bow in hand,

children.text: eṣa tvām abhinava-kaṇṭha-śoṇita-arthī
śārdūlaḥ paśum iva hanmi ceṣṭamānam /
ārtānāṃ bhayam apanetum ātta-dhanvā
duṣyantas tava śaraṇaṃ bhavatv idānīm //
rājā  (saroṣam) kathaṃ mām evoddiśati / tiṣṭha kuṇapāśana / tvam idānīṃ na bhaviṣyasi / (śārṅgam āropya) vetravati sopānamārgam ādeśaya / (sarve satvaram upasarpanti)
children.translated_text: King: (With anger) What, he addresses me! Stand still, corpse-eater! You shall not survive! (Stringing the bow) <s>Vetravatī</s>, show the way to the staircase! (All rush forward.)

children.text: rājā -- (saroṣam) kathaṃ mām eva uddiśati / tiṣṭha kuṇapāśana / tvam idānīṃ na bhaviṣyasi / (śārṅgam āropya) vetravati sopāna-mārgam ādeśaya / (sarve satvaram upasarpanti)
rājā (samantād vilokya) śūnyaṃ khalv idam / (nepathye)
children.translated_text: King: (Looking around) The place is empty! (From backstage)

children.text: rājā (samantād vilokya) śūnyaṃ khalv idam / (nepathye)
avihā / avihā /aham atrabhavantaṃ paśyāmi / tvaṃ māṃ na paśyasi / biḍālagṛhīto mūṣaka iva nirāśo 'smi jīvite saṃvṛttaḥ /
children.translated_text: Help! Help! I see his honor, but you cannot see me! Like a mouse seized by a cat, I have lost all hope of life!

children.text: avihā / avihā /aham atra-bhavantaṃ paśyāmi / tvaṃ māṃ na paśyasi / biḍāla-gṛhīto mūṣaka iva nirāśo 'smi jīvite saṃvṛttaḥ /
rājā  bhos tiraskariṇīgarvita madīyam astraṃ tvāṃ drakṣyati / eṣa tam iṣuṃ saṃdadhe /
children.translated_text: King: Ho, you who pride yourself on your power of invisibility! My weapon shall find you. I fit this arrow —

children.text: rājā -- bhos tiraskariṇī-garvita madīyam astraṃ tvāṃ drakṣyati / eṣa tam iṣuṃ saṃdadhe /
yo haniṣyati vadhyaṃ tvāṃ rakṣyaṃ rakṣiṣyati dvijam /
children.translated_text: which shall slay you who deserve to be slain, and shall protect the <s>brāhmaṇa</s> who deserves protection;

children.text: haṃso hi kṣīram ādatte tanmiśrā varjayaty apaḥ //
children.translated_text: for the swan takes the milk and leaves aside the water mixed with it.

children.text: yo haniṣyati vadhyaṃ tvāṃ rakṣyaṃ rakṣiṣyati dvijam /
haṃso hi kṣīram ādatte tan-miśrā varjayaty apaḥ //
(ity astraṃ saṃdhatte)
children.translated_text: (He fits the divine weapon.)

children.text: (ity astraṃ saṃdhatte)
(tataḥ praviśati vidūṣakam utsṛjya mātaliḥ)
children.translated_text: (Then enters <s>Mātali</s>, releasing the <s>Vidūṣaka</s>.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati vidūṣakam utsṛjya mātaliḥ)
mātaliḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>:

children.text: mātaliḥ --
kṛtā śaravyaṃ hariṇā tavāsurāḥ
śarāsanaṃ teṣu vikṛṣyatām idam /
children.translated_text: Let this bow be drawn against them!
Make the <s>asuras</s> your target, O <s>Hari</s>'s [descendant]!

children.text: prasādasaumyāni satāṃ suhṛjjane
patanti cakṣūṃṣi na dāruṇāḥ śarāḥ //
children.translated_text: with looks soft with grace — not cruel arrows. //
The eyes of the virtuous fall upon friends

children.text: kṛtā śaravyaṃ hariṇā tava asurāḥ
śara-āsanaṃ teṣu vikṛṣyatām idam /
prasāda-saumyāni satāṃ suhṛj-jane
patanti cakṣūṃṣi na dāruṇāḥ śarāḥ //
rājā  (sasaṃbhramam asram upasaṃharan) aye mātaliḥ / svāgataṃ mahāindrasārathe / (praviśya)
children.translated_text: King: (Hastily withdrawing the arrow, with agitation) Ah, <s>Mātali</s>! Welcome, O great charioteer of <s>Indra</s>! (Entering)

children.text: rājā - (sasaṃbhramam asram upasaṃharan) aye mātaliḥ / svāgataṃ mahā-indra-sārathe / (praviśya)
vidūṣaka  ahaṃ yeneṣṭipaśumāraṃ māritaḥ so 'nena svāgatenābhinadyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: The very one by whom I was treated like a sacrificial animal — he is now greeted with words of welcome!

children.text: vidūṣaka -- ahaṃ yena iṣṭi-paśu-māraṃ māritaḥ so 'nena svāgatena abhinadyate /
mātaliḥ  (sasmitam) āyuṣmañ śrūyatāṃ yad artham asmi hariṇā bhavatsakāśaṃ preṣitaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (With a smile) Long-lived one, hear the purpose for which I have been sent to your presence by <s>Hari</s> (<s>Indra</s>).

children.text: mātaliḥ -- (sasmitam) āyuṣmañ śrūyatāṃ yad artham asmi hariṇā bhavat-sakāśaṃ preṣitaḥ /
rājā  avahito 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: I am attentive.

children.text: rājā -- avahito 'smi /
mātaliḥ  asti kālanemiprasūtir durjayo nāma dānavagaṇaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: There is a host of <s>Dānavas</s> (demons) named <s>Durjaya</s> (Unconquerable), born from <s>Kālanemi</s>.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- asti kāla-nemi-prasūtir durjayo nāma dānava-gaṇaḥ /
rājā  asti / śrutapūrvaṃ mayā nāradāt /
children.translated_text: King: So there is — I have heard of it before from <s>Nārada</s>.

children.text: rājā -- asti / śruta-pūrvaṃ mayā nāradāt /
mātaliḥ
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>:

children.text: mātaliḥ --
sakhyus te sa kila śatakrator ajayyas
tasya tvaṃ raṇaśirasi smṛto nihantā /
children.translated_text: you are appointed as their destroyer in the forefront of battle.
That [host], unconquerable by your friend <s>Śatakratu</s> (<s>Indra</s>) —

children.text: ucchettuṃ prabhavati yan na saptasaptis
tannaiśaṃ timiram apākaroti candraḥ //
children.translated_text: that nocturnal darkness the Moon removes. //
What the seven-horsed [Sun] cannot dispel —

children.text: sakhyus te sa kila śata-krator ajayyas
tasya tvaṃ raṇa-śirasi smṛto nihantā /
ucchettuṃ prabhavati yan na sapta-saptis
tan-naiśaṃ timiram apākaroti candraḥ //
sa bhavān āttaśastra evedānīm aindraratham āruhya vijayāya pratiṣṭhatām /
children.translated_text: Therefore, let your honor, having taken up arms, now mount the chariot of <s>Indra</s> and set forth to victory!

children.text: sa bhavān ātta-śastra eva idānīm aindra-ratham āruhya vijayāya pratiṣṭhatām /
rājā  anugṛhīto 'ham anayā maghavataḥ saṃbhāvanayā / atha mādhavyaṃ prati bhavatā kim evaṃ prayuktam /
children.translated_text: King: I am honored by this regard of <s>Maghavat</s> (<s>Indra</s>). But what was done to <s>Mādhavya</s> by you — why was it so?

children.text: rājā -- anugṛhīto 'ham anayā maghavataḥ saṃbhāvanayā / atha mādhavyaṃ prati bhavatā kim evaṃ prayuktam /
mātali  tad api kathyate / kiṃ nimittād api manaḥsaṃtāpād āyuṣmān mayā viklavo dṛṣṭaḥ / paścātkopayitum āyuṣmantaṃ tathā kṛtavān asmi / kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: That too shall be explained. From whatever cause of mental distress, your honor was seen by me to be agitated. Thereafter, I acted thus in order to provoke your honor. For —

children.text: mātali -- tad api kathyate / kiṃ nimittād api manaḥ-saṃtāpād āyuṣmān mayā viklavo dṛṣṭaḥ / paścāt-kopayitum āyuṣmantaṃ tathā kṛtavān asmi / kutaḥ /
jvalati calitendhano 'gnir viprakṛtaḥ pannagaḥ phaṇāṃ kurute /
children.translated_text: Fire blazes when its fuel is stirred; a serpent, when provoked, raises its hood.

children.text: prāyaḥ svaṃ mahimānaṃ kṣobhāt pratipadyate hi janaḥ //
children.translated_text: Generally, a person recovers his own greatness through agitation. //

children.text: jvalati calita-indhano 'gnir viprakṛtaḥ pannagaḥ phaṇāṃ kurute /
prāyaḥ svaṃ mahimānaṃ kṣobhāt pratipadyate hi janaḥ //
rājā  (janāntikam) vayasya anatikramaṇīyā divaspater ājñā /
children.translated_text: King: (Aside) Friend, the command of the Lord of Heaven is not to be transgressed.

children.text: rājā -- (jana-antikam) vayasya anatikramaṇīyā divaspater ājñā /
tad atra parigatārthaṃ kṛtvā madvacanād amātyapiśunaṃ brūhi /
children.translated_text: Therefore, having informed [the minister] of the matter here, tell <s>Piśuna</s> the minister on my behalf:

children.text: tad atra parigata-arthaṃ kṛtvā mad-vacanād amātya-piśunaṃ brūhi /
tvanmatiḥ kevalā tāvat paripālayatu prajāḥ /
children.translated_text: Let your wit alone protect the subjects for now,

children.text: adhijyam idam anyasmin karmaṇi vyāpṛtaṃ ddhanuḥ //
children.translated_text: for this bow, strung and ready, is engaged in another task. //

children.text: tvan-matiḥ kevalā tāvat paripālayatu prajāḥ /
adhijyam idam anyasmin karmaṇi vyāpṛtaṃ ddhanuḥ //
vidūṣaka  yad bhavān ājñāpayati (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Vidūṣaka</s>: As your honor commands. (Exit.)

children.text: vidūṣaka -- yad bhavān ājñāpayati (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
mātaliḥ  āyuṣmān ratham ārohatu /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Let your honor mount the chariot.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- āyuṣmān ratham ārohatu /
(rājā rathārohaṇaṃ nāṭayati)
children.translated_text: (The King mimes mounting the chariot.)

children.text: (rājā ratha-ārohaṇaṃ nāṭayati)
(niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
children.translated_text: (Exeunt all.)

children.text: (niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
ṣaṣṭho 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: End of the Sixth Act.

children.text: saptamo 'ṅkaḥ
children.translated_text: The Seventh Act.

children.text: (tataḥ praviśaty ākāśayānena rathādhirūḍho rājā mātaliś ca)
children.translated_text: (Then enter the King and <s>Mātali</s>, mounted on a chariot moving through the sky.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśaty ākāśa-yānena ratha-adhirūḍho rājā mātaliś ca)
rājā  mātale anuṣṭhitanideśo 'pi maghavataḥ satkriyāviśeṣād anupayuktam ivātmānaṃ samarthaye /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s>, even though I have carried out <s>Maghavat</s>'s command, I consider myself unworthy because of the extraordinary honor bestowed upon me.

children.text: rājā -- mātale anuṣṭhita-nideśo 'pi maghavataḥ satkriyā-viśeṣād anupayuktam ivā atmānaṃ samarthaye /
mātaliḥ  (sasmitam) āyuṣmann ubhayam apy aparitoṣaṃ samarthaye /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (With a smile) Long-lived one, I consider both of you to be dissatisfied.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- (sasmitam) āyuṣmann ubhayam apy aparitoṣaṃ samarthaye /
prathamopakṛtaṃ marutvataḥ pratipattyā laghu manyate bhavān /
children.translated_text: Your honor considers the service rendered by <s>Marutvat</s> (<s>Indra</s>) to be slight, out of modesty,

children.text: gaṇayaty avadānavismito bhavataḥ so 'pi na satkriyāguṇān //
children.translated_text: while he too, amazed at your valor, does not count the honors of his hospitality. //

children.text: prathama-upakṛtaṃ marutvataḥ pratipattyā laghu manyate bhavān /
gaṇayaty avadāna-vismito bhavataḥ so 'pi na satkriyā-guṇān //
rājā  mātale mā maivam / sa khalu manorathānām apy abhūmir visarjanāvasarasatkāraḥ / mama hi divaukasāṃ samakṣam ardhāsanopaveśitasya /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s>, do not say so! For indeed, the honor shown at the time of departure was beyond the reach even of my wishes. For when I was seated on the half-seat in the presence of the celestials —

children.text: rājā -- mātale mā ma aivam / sa khalu manorathānām apy abhūmir visarjana-avasara-satkāraḥ / mama hi divaukasāṃ samakṣam ardha-āsana-upaveśitasya /
antargataprārthanam antikasthaṃ jayantam udvīkṣya hṛtasmitena /
children.translated_text: observing <s>Jayanta</s> standing nearby, who harbored an inner desire, with a stolen smile,

children.text: āmṛṣṭavakṣoharicandanāṅkā mandāramālā hariṇā pinaddhā //
children.translated_text: a garland of <s>Mandāra</s> flowers, bearing marks of <s>Haricandana</s> (divine sandal) paste wiped from his chest, was placed upon me by <s>Hari</s> (<s>Indra</s>). //

children.text: antar-gata-prārthanam antikasthaṃ jayantam udvīkṣya hṛta-smitena /
āmṛṣṭa-vakṣo-hari-candana-aṅkā mandāra-mālā hariṇā pinaddhā //
mātaliḥ  kim iva nāmāyuṣmān amareśvarān nārhati / paśya /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Of what honor is your honor not worthy among the Lords of the Immortals? Behold —

children.text: mātaliḥ -- kim iva nāmā ayuṣmān amara-īśvarān na arhati / paśya /
sukhaparasya harer ubhayaiḥ kṛtaṃ tridivam uddhṛtadānavakaṇṭakam /
children.translated_text: The triple heaven, freed of the thorns of <s>Dānavas</s>, has been made by both for the sake of <s>Hari</s>'s ease:

children.text: tava śarair adhunā nataparvabhiḥ puruṣakesariṇaś ca purā nakhaiḥ //
children.translated_text: now by your arrows with their curved joints, and formerly by the claws of the Man-Lion (<s>Narasiṃha</s>). //

children.text: sukha-parasya harer ubhayaiḥ kṛtaṃ tridivam uddhṛta-dānava-kaṇṭakam /
tava śarair adhunā nata-parvabhiḥ puruṣa-kesariṇaś ca purā nakhaiḥ //
rājā  atra khalu śatakrator eva mahimā stutyaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: In this, indeed, the greatness of <s>Śatakratu</s> (<s>Indra</s>) alone is to be praised.

children.text: rājā -- atra khalu śata-krator eva mahimā stutyaḥ /
sidhyanti karmasu mahatv api yan niyojyāḥ
saṃbhāvanāguṇam avehi tam īśvarāṇām /
children.translated_text: know that to be the quality of esteem belonging to sovereign lords.
Those appointed to great tasks succeed [only because of the one who appoints them] —

children.text: kiṃ vābhaviṣyadaruṇas tamasāṃ vibhettā
taṃ cet sahasrakiraṇo dhuri nākariṣyat //
children.translated_text: if the Thousand-rayed one had not placed him at the helm? //
For would [the Sun] have been the fierce dispeller of darkness

children.text: sidhyanti karmasu mahatv api yan niyojyāḥ
saṃbhāvanā-guṇam avehi tam īśvarāṇām /
kiṃ va ābhaviṣyad-aruṇas tamasāṃ vibhettā
taṃ cet sahasra-kiraṇo dhuri na akariṣyat //
mātali  sadṛśaṃ tava etat / (stokam antaram atītya) āyuṣmann itaḥ paśya nākapṛṣṭhapratiṣṭhitasya saubhāgyam ātmayaśasaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: That is befitting of you. (Having gone a little distance) Long-lived one, look this way at the glory of your own fame, established upon the crest of heaven:

children.text: mātali -- sadṛśaṃ tava etat / (stokam antaram atītya) āyuṣmann itaḥ paśya nāka-pṛṣṭha-pratiṣṭhitasya saubhāgyam ātma-yaśasaḥ /
vicchittiśeṣaiḥ surasundarīṇāṃ varṇair amī kalpalatāṃśukeṣu /
children.translated_text: With remnants of pigments from the divine maidens, upon garments of celestial wishing-creepers,

children.text: vicintya gītakṣamam arthajātaṃ divaukasas tvaccaritaṃ likhanti //
children.translated_text: the celestials, having conceived a subject worthy of song, are inscribing your deeds. //

children.text: vicchitti-śeṣaiḥ sura-sundarīṇāṃ varṇair amī kalpa-latā-aṃśukeṣu /
vicintya gīta-kṣamam artha-jātaṃ divaukasas tvac-caritaṃ likhanti //
mātale asurasaṃprahārotsukena pūrvedyur divam adhirohatā mayā na lakṣitaḥ svargamārgaḥ / katamasmin marutāṃ pathi vartāmahe /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s>, yesterday, when I was ascending to heaven eager for the battle with the <s>Asuras</s>, I did not observe the heavenly path. In which path of the <s>Maruts</s> (winds) are we traveling?

children.text: mātale asura-saṃprahāra-utsukena pūrvedyur divam adhirohatā mayā na lakṣitaḥ svarga-mārgaḥ / katamasmin marutāṃ pathi vartāmahe /
mātali
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>:

children.text: mātali --
trisrotasaṃ vahati yo gaganapratiṣṭhām
jyotīṃṣi vartayati ca pravibhaktaraśmiḥ /
children.translated_text: and which sets the luminaries in motion with its divided rays —
That [wind] which carries the triple-streamed [<s>Gaṅgā</s>], established in the sky,

children.text: tasya dvitīyaharivikramanistamaskam
vāyor imaṃ parivahasya vadanti mārgam //
children.translated_text: where the darkness was dispelled by the second stride of <s>Hari</s> (<s>Viṣṇu</s>). //
this is called the path of that <s>Parivaha</s> wind,

children.text: trisrotasaṃ vahati yo gagana-pratiṣṭhām
jyotīṃṣi vartayati ca pravibhakta-raśmiḥ /
tasya dvitīya-hari-vikrama-nistamaskam
vāyor imaṃ parivahasya vadanti mārgam //
rājā  mātale ataḥ khalu sabāhyāntaḥkaraṇo mamāntarātmā prasīdati / (rathāṅgam avalokya) meghapadavīm avatīrṇau svaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s>, it is for this reason that my inner self, together with its external and internal faculties, becomes tranquil. (Looking at the chariot wheel) We have descended to the region of clouds.

children.text: rājā -- mātale ataḥ khalu sabāhya-antaḥ-karaṇo mama antar-ātmā prasīdati / (ratha-aṅgam avalokya) megha-padavīm avatīrṇau svaḥ /
mātali  katham avagamyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: How is that known?

children.text: mātali -- katham avagamyate /
rājā  ayam aravivarebhyaś cātakair niṣpatadbhir haribhir acirabhāsāṃ tejasā cānuliptaiḥ /
children.translated_text: King: This [is evident]: from the chariot-spokes, <s>Cātaka</s> birds fly out; the horses are anointed with the radiance of fleeting lightning;

children.text: rājā -- ayam ara-vivarebhyaś cātakair niṣpatadbhir haribhir acira-bhāsāṃ tejasā ca anuliptaiḥ /
gatam upari ghanānāṃ vārigarbhodarāṇām //
children.translated_text: we have passed above the clouds whose interiors are wombs of water. //

children.text: piśunayati rathas te śīkaraklinnanemiḥ //
children.translated_text: Your chariot, with its rims wet with spray, reveals [our descent]. //

children.text: gatam upari ghanānāṃ vāri-garbha-udarāṇām //
piśunayati rathas te śīkara-klinna-nemiḥ //
mātali  kṣaṇād āyuṣmān svādhikārabhūmau vartiṣyate /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: In a moment, your honor will be in the realm of your own dominion.

children.text: mātali -- kṣaṇād āyuṣmān sva-adhikāra-bhūmau vartiṣyate /
rājā  (adho 'valokya) mātale vegāvataraṇād āścaryadarśanaḥ saṃlakṣyate manuṣyalokaḥ / tathā hi /
children.translated_text: King: (Looking down) <s>Mātali</s>, through the speed of descent, the human world appears wondrous to behold. For indeed —

children.text: rājā -- (adho 'valokya) mātale vega-avataraṇād āścarya-darśanaḥ saṃlakṣyate manuṣya-lokaḥ / tathā hi /
śailānām avarohatīva śikharād unmajjatāṃ medinī
parṇābhyantaralīnatāṃ vijahati skandhodayāt pādapāḥ /
children.translated_text: trees shed the concealment of their foliage as their trunks rise into view;
The earth seems to emerge from descending mountain peaks;

children.text: saṃtānais tanubhāvanaṣṭasalilā vyaktiṃ bhajanty āpagāḥ
kenāpy utkṣipateva paṣya bhuvanaṃ matpārśvam ānīyate //
children.translated_text: see — it is as if someone lifts the world and brings it to my side! //
rivers, their waters thinned to invisibility by [the stretching of their] currents, become distinct;

children.text: śailānām avarohati iva śikharād unmajjatāṃ medinī
parṇa-abhyantara-līnatāṃ vijahati skandha-udayāt pādapāḥ /
saṃtānais tanu-bhāva-naṣṭa-salilā vyaktiṃ bhajanty āpagāḥ
kena apy utkṣipata īva paṣya bhuvanaṃ mat-pārśvam ānīyate //
mātali  sādhu dṛṣṭam / (sabahumānam avalokya) aho udāraramaṇīyā pṛthivī /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Well observed! (Looking with admiration) Ah, how noble and beautiful the earth is!

children.text: mātali -- sādhu dṛṣṭam / (sabahumānam avalokya) aho udāra-ramaṇīyā pṛthivī /
rājā  mātale katamo 'yaṃ pūrvāparasamudrāvagāḍhaḥ kanakarasanisyandī sāṃdhya meghaparighaḥ sānumān ālokyate /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s>, what is this mountainous [form] that is seen, plunging into the eastern and western oceans, streaming with golden radiance, like an evening cloud as its rampart?

children.text: rājā -- mātale katamo 'yaṃ pūrva-apara-samudra-avagāḍhaḥ kanaka-rasa-nisyandī sāṃdhya megha-parighaḥ sānumān ālokyate /
mātali  āyuṣmann eṣa khalu hemakūṭo nāma kiṃ puruṣaparvatas tapaḥsaṃsiddhikṣetram / paśya /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Long-lived one, this is indeed [the mountain] called <s>Hemakūṭa</s>, the mountain of the <s>Kiṃpuruṣas</s> (mythical beings), a field for the perfection of austerities. Behold —

children.text: mātali -- āyuṣmann eṣa khalu hema-kūṭo nāma kiṃ puruṣa-parvatas tapaḥ-saṃsiddhi-kṣetram / paśya /
svāyaṃbhuvān marīcer yaḥ prababhūva prajāpatiḥ /
children.translated_text: He who was born from <s>Marīci</s>, descended from the Self-born (<s>Svāyaṃbhuva</s>), a <s>Prajāpati</s> (lord of creatures) —

children.text: surāsuraguruḥ so 'tra sapatnīkas tapasyati //
children.translated_text: that guru of gods and demons performs austerities here together with his consort. //

children.text: svāyaṃbhuvān marīcer yaḥ prababhūva prajā-patiḥ /
sura-asura-guruḥ so 'tra sapatnīkas tapasyati //
rājā  tena hy anatikramaṇīyāni śreyāṃsi / pradakṣiṇīkṛtya bhagavantaṃ gantum icchāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Then the path of auspiciousness must not be transgressed! I wish to go, having circumambulated the blessed one.

children.text: rājā -- tena hy anatikramaṇīyāni śreyāṃsi / pradakṣiṇī-kṛtya bhagavantaṃ gantum icchāmi /
mātali  prathamaḥ kalpaḥ / (nāṭyenāvatīrṇau)
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: An excellent resolve! (They descend through dramatic action.)

children.text: mātali -- prathamaḥ kalpaḥ / (nāṭyena avatīrṇau)
rājā  (savismayam)
children.translated_text: King: (With wonder)

children.text: rājā -- (savismayam)
upoḍhaśabdā na rathāṅganemayaḥ pravartamānaṃ na ca dṛśyate rajaḥ /
children.translated_text: The chariot wheels produce no sound; no dust is seen rising;

children.text: abhūtalasparśanatayāniruddhatas tavāvatīrṇo 'pi ratho na lakṣyate //
children.translated_text: unimpeded by not touching the ground, your chariot, even as it has descended, is imperceptible. //

children.text: upoḍha-śabdā na ratha-aṅga-nemayaḥ pravartamānaṃ na ca dṛśyate rajaḥ /
abhū-tala-sparśanataya āniruddhatas tava avatīrṇo 'pi ratho na lakṣyate //
mātali  etāvān eva śatakrator āyuṣmataś ca viśeṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Such indeed is the distinction between <s>Śatakratu</s> (<s>Indra</s>) and your honor.

children.text: mātali -- etāvān eva śata-krator āyuṣmataś ca viśeṣaḥ /
rājā  mātale katamasmin pradeśe mārīcāśramaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s>, in which region is the hermitage of <s>Mārīca</s>?

children.text: rājā -- mātale katamasmin pradeśe mārīca-āśramaḥ /
mātaliḥ  (hastena darśayan)
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (Pointing with his hand)

children.text: mātaliḥ -- (hastena darśayan)
valmīkārdhanimagnamūrtir urasā saṃdaṣṭasarpatvacā
kaṇṭhe jīrṇalatāpratānavalayenātyarthasaṃpīḍitaḥ /
children.translated_text: his neck severely constricted by a necklace of withered creeper-tendrils,
His body half-submerged in an anthill, his chest girdled with shed serpent-skin,

children.text: aṃsavyāpi śakuntanīḍanicitaṃ bibhrajjaṭāmaṇḍalam
yatra sthāṇur ivācalo munir asāv abhyarkabimbaṃ sthitaḥ //
children.translated_text: there stands that sage, motionless as a post, facing the orb of the sun. //
bearing upon his shoulders a mass of matted locks filled with bird-nests,

children.text: valmīka-ardha-nimagna-mūrtir urasā saṃdaṣṭa-sarpa-tvacā
kaṇṭhe jīrṇa-latā-pratāna-valayena atyartha-saṃpīḍitaḥ /
aṃsa-vyāpi śakunta-nīḍa-nicitaṃ bibhraj-jaṭā-maṇḍalam
yatra sthāṇur iva acalo munir asāv abhyarka-bimbaṃ sthitaḥ //
rājā  namas te kaṣṭatapase /
children.translated_text: King: Salutations to you, O practitioner of severe austerity!

children.text: rājā -- namas te kaṣṭa-tapase /
mātaliḥ  (saṃyatapragrahaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā) etāv aditiparivardhitamandāravṛkṣaṃ prajāpater āśramaṃ praviṣṭau svaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (Having reined in the chariot) We have now entered the hermitage of <s>Prajāpati</s>, where the <s>Mandāra</s> trees are tended by <s>Aditi</s>.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- (saṃyata-pragrahaṃ rathaṃ kṛtvā) etāv aditi-parivardhita-mandāra-vṛkṣaṃ prajā-pater āśramaṃ praviṣṭau svaḥ /
rājā  svargād adhikataraṃ nirvṛtisthānam amṛtahradam ivāvagāḍho 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: I am immersed as if in a pool of nectar — a place of bliss surpassing even heaven.

children.text: rājā -- svargād adhikataraṃ nirvṛti-sthānam amṛta-hradam iva avagāḍho 'smi /
mātaliḥ  (rathaṃ sthāpayitvā) avataratv āyuṣmān /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (Stopping the chariot) Let your honor descend.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- (rathaṃ sthāpayitvā) avataratv āyuṣmān /
rājā  (avatīrya) mātale bhavān katham idānīm /
children.translated_text: King: (Descending) <s>Mātali</s>, and what about you now?

children.text: rājā -- (avatīrya) mātale bhavān katham idānīm /
mātaliḥ  saṃyantrito mayā rathaḥ / vayam apy avatarāmaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: The chariot has been secured by me. We too shall descend.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- saṃyantrito mayā rathaḥ / vayam apy avatarāmaḥ /
(tathā kṛtvā) ita āyuṣman / (parikramya) dṛśyantām atrabhavatām ṛṣīṇāṃ tapovanabhūmayaḥ /
children.translated_text: (Having done so) This way, long-lived one. (Walking about) Behold the grounds of the hermitage of these venerable sages.

children.text: (tathā kṛtvā) ita āyuṣman / (parikramya) dṛśyantām atra-bhavatām ṛṣīṇāṃ tapo-vana-bhūmayaḥ /
rājā  nanu vismayād avalokayāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Indeed, I gaze upon them with wonder.

children.text: rājā -- nanu vismayād avalokayāmi /
prāṇānām anilena vṛttir ucitā satkalpavṛkṣe vane
toye kāñcanapadmareṇukapiśe dharmābhiṣekakriyā /
children.translated_text: in water tinted with the golden pollen of lotuses, the rite of consecration in <s>dharma</s> [is performed];
In this forest of divine wishing-trees, breath subsists on air alone;

children.text: dhyānaṃ ratnaśilātaleṣu vibudhastrīsaṃnidhau saṃyamo
yat kāṅkṣanti tapobhir anyamunayas tasmiṃs tapasyanty amī //
children.translated_text: what other sages desire through their austerities, these [sages] perform their penance already possessing. //
meditation on jeweled stone platforms; self-restraint in the presence of celestial women —

children.text: prāṇānām anilena vṛttir ucitā sat-kalpa-vṛkṣe vane
toye kāñcana-padma-reṇu-kapiśe dharma-abhiṣeka-kriyā /
dhyānaṃ ratna-śilā-taleṣu vibudha-strī-saṃnidhau saṃyamo
yat kāṅkṣanti tapobhir anya-munayas tasmiṃs tapasyanty amī //

mātali  utsarpiṇī khalu mahatāṃ prārthanā / (parikramya / ākāśe) aye vṛddhaśākalya kim anutiṣṭhati bhagavān mārīcaḥ / kiṃ bravīṣi / dākṣāyaṇyā prativratārdham adhikṛtya pṛṣṭas tasyai maharṣipatnīsahitāyai kathayatīti /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Indeed, the aspirations of the great ever ascend upward. (Walking about; addressing the sky) O venerable <s>Śākalya</s>, what is the blessed <s>Mārīca</s> occupied with? What do you say? Being asked by <s>Dākṣāyaṇī</s> (<s>Aditi</s>) concerning the duty of a devoted wife, he is discoursing to her together with the wives of great sages?

children.text: mātali -- utsarpiṇī khalu mahatāṃ prārthanā / (parikramya / ākāśe) aye vṛddha-śākalya kim anutiṣṭhati bhagavān mārīcaḥ / kiṃ bravīṣi / dākṣāyaṇyā prativrata-ardham adhikṛtya pṛṣṭas tasyai maharṣi-patnī-sahitāyai kathayati iti /
rājā  (karṇaṃ dattvā) aye pratipālyāvasaraḥ khalu prastāvaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (Listening) Ah, the occasion must be awaited, for the moment is opportune.

children.text: rājā -- (karṇaṃ dattvā) aye pratipālya-avasaraḥ khalu prastāvaḥ /
mātaliḥ  (rājānam avalokya) asminn aśokavṛkṣamūle tāvad āstām āyuṣmān yāvat tvām indragurave nivedayitum antarānveṣī bhavāmi /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (Looking at the King) Let your honor rest at the foot of this <s>Aśoka</s> tree while I find an opportunity to announce you to the preceptor of <s>Indra</s>.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- (rājānam avalokya) asminn aśoka-vṛkṣa-mūle tāvad āstām āyuṣmān yāvat tvām indra-gurave nivedayitum antara-anveṣī bhavāmi /
rājā  yathā bhavān manyate (iti sthitaḥ)
children.translated_text: King: As your honor thinks fit. (He remains standing.)

children.text: rājā -- yathā bhavān manyate (iti sthitaḥ)
mātaliḥ  āyuṣman sādhayāmy aham / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Long-lived one, I shall proceed. (Exit.)

children.text: mātaliḥ -- āyuṣman sādhayāmy aham / (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
rājā  (nimittaṃ sūcayitvā)
children.translated_text: King: (Observing an omen)

children.text: rājā -- (nimittaṃ sūcayitvā)
manorathāya nāśaṃse kiṃ bāho spandase vṛthā /
children.translated_text: I dare not hope for a wish [fulfilled] — O arm, why do you throb in vain?

children.text: pūrvāvadhīritaṃ śreyo duḥkhaṃ hi parivartate //
children.translated_text: For good fortune once rejected returns only with difficulty. //

children.text: manorathāya nā aśaṃse kiṃ bāho spandase vṛthā /
pūrva-avadhīritaṃ śreyo duḥkhaṃ hi parivartate //
(nepathye)
children.translated_text: (Offstage)

children.text: (nepathye)
mā khalu cāpalaṃ kuru / kathaṃ gata evātmanaḥ prakṛtim /
children.translated_text: Do not be naughty! How, has he reverted to his own nature already?

children.text: mā khalu cāpalaṃ kuru / kathaṃ gata evā atmanaḥ prakṛtim /
rājā  (karṇaṃ dattvā) abhūmir iyam avinayasya / ko nu khalv eṣa niṣidhyate / (śabdānusāreṇāvalokya / savismayam) aye ko nu khalv ayam anubadhyamānas tapasvinībhyām abālasattvo bālaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (Listening) This is no place for unruliness. Who indeed is being restrained? (Looking in the direction of the sound; with wonder) Ah, who is this boy, attended by two female ascetics, possessing spirit beyond his years?

children.text: rājā -- (karṇaṃ dattvā) abhūmir iyam avinayasya / ko nu khalv eṣa niṣidhyate / (śabda-anusāreṇa avalokya / savismayam) aye ko nu khalv ayam anubadhyamānas tapasvinībhyām abāla-sattvo bālaḥ /
ardhapītastanaṃ mātur āmardakliṣṭakesaram /
children.translated_text: He drags by force a lion cub, its mane disheveled by rough handling,

children.text: prakrīḍituṃ siṃhaśiśuṃ balātkāreṇa karṣati //
children.translated_text: whose mother's breast is only half-suckled, wanting to play with it. //

children.text: ardha-pīta-stanaṃ mātur āmarda-kliṣṭa-kesaram /
prakrīḍituṃ siṃha-śiśuṃ balāt-kāreṇa karṣati //
(tataḥ praviśati yathānirdiṣṭakarmā tapasvinībhyāṃ bālaḥ)
children.translated_text: (Then enters the boy as described, with two female ascetics.)

children.text: (tataḥ praviśati yathā-nirdiṣṭa-karmā tapasvinībhyāṃ bālaḥ)
bāla  jṛmbhasva siṃha dantāṃs te gaṇayiṣye /
children.translated_text: Boy: Open your mouth, lion! I will count your teeth!

children.text: bāla -- jṛmbhasva siṃha dantāṃs te gaṇayiṣye /
prathamā  avinīta kiṃ no 'patyanirviśeṣāṇi sattvāni vikaroṣi / hanta vardhate te saṃrambhaḥ / sthāne khalu ṛṣijanena sarvadamana iti kṛtanāmadheyo 'si /
children.translated_text: First ascetic: Naughty child, why do you torment creatures that are no different from our own children? Indeed, your impetuousness grows! Rightly have the sages named you <s>Sarvadamana</s> (All-tamer)!

children.text: prathamā -- avinīta kiṃ no 'patya-nirviśeṣāṇi sattvāni vikaroṣi / hanta vardhate te saṃrambhaḥ / sthāne khalu ṛṣi-janena sarva-damana iti kṛta-nāma-dheyo 'si /
rājā  kiṃ nu khalu bāle 'sminn aurasa iva putre snihyati me manaḥ / nūnam anapatyatā māṃ vatsalayati /
children.translated_text: King: Why indeed does my heart feel affection for this boy as though he were my own son? Surely it is my childlessness that makes me tender.

children.text: rājā -- kiṃ nu khalu bāle 'sminn aurasa iva putre snihyati me manaḥ / nūnam anapatyatā māṃ vatsalayati /
dvitīyā  eṣā khalu kesariṇī tvāṃ laṅghayati yady asyāḥ putrakaṃ na muñcasi /
children.translated_text: Second ascetic: The lioness will pounce upon you if you do not release her cub!

children.text: dvitīyā -- eṣā khalu kesariṇī tvāṃ laṅghayati yady asyāḥ putrakaṃ na muñcasi /
bāla  (sasmitam) aho balīyaḥ khalu bhīto 'smi / (ity adharaṃ darśayati )
children.translated_text: Boy: (Smiling) Oh, how mighty! Indeed I am terrified! (Shows his lower lip.)

children.text: bāla -- (sasmitam) aho balīyaḥ khalu bhīto 'smi / (ity adharaṃ darśayati )
rājā  hamatas tejaso bījaṃ bālo 'yaṃ pratibhāti me /
children.translated_text: King: This boy appears to me as a seed of great power —

children.text: sphuliṅgāvasthayā vahnir edhāpakṣa iva sthitaḥ //
children.translated_text: like fire in the state of a spark, standing as if awaiting fuel. //

children.text: rājā -- hamatas tejaso bījaṃ bālo 'yaṃ pratibhāti me /
sphuliṅga-avasthayā vahnir edhā-pakṣa iva sthitaḥ //
prathamā  vatsa enaṃ bālamṛgendraṃ muñca / aparaṃ te krīḍanakaṃ dāsyāmi /
children.translated_text: First ascetic: Dear child, release this young lion. I shall give you another plaything.

children.text: prathamā -- vatsa enaṃ bāla-mṛga-indraṃ muñca / aparaṃ te krīḍanakaṃ dāsyāmi /
bāla  kutra / dehy etat / (iti hastaṃ prasārayati)
children.translated_text: Boy: Where is it? Give it here! (Stretching out his hand.)

children.text: bāla -- kutra / dehy etat / (iti hastaṃ prasārayati)
rājā  kathaṃ cakravartilakṣaṇam apy anena dhāryate / tathā hy asya /
children.translated_text: King: What — does he bear even the mark of a universal sovereign (<s>cakravartin</s>)? For indeed —

children.text: rājā -- kathaṃ cakra-varti-lakṣaṇam apy anena dhāryate / tathā hy asya /
pralobhyavastupraṇayaprasārito vibhāti jālagrathitāṅguliḥ karaḥ /
children.translated_text: His hand, outstretched with longing for the promised object, with fingers webbed together, shines

children.text: alakṣyapatrāntaram iddharāgayā navoṣasā bhinnam ivaikapaṅkajam //
children.translated_text: like a single lotus split open by the reddening glow of the early dawn, its petals barely distinguishable. //

children.text: pralobhya-vastu-praṇaya-prasārito vibhāti jāla-grathita-aṅguliḥ karaḥ /
alakṣya-patra-antaram iddha-rāgayā nava-uṣasā bhinnam iva eka-paṅkajam //
dvitīyā  suvrate na śakya eṣa vācāmātreṇa viramayitum / gaccha tvam / madīya uṭaje mārkaṇḍeyasya+ṛṣikumārasya varṇacitrito mṛttikāmayūras tiṣṭhati / tam asyopahara /
children.translated_text: Second ascetic: <s>Suvratā</s>, this one cannot be stopped by words alone. Go — in my hut there stands a clay peacock painted in various colors, belonging to <s>Mārkaṇḍeya</s>, the sage's son. Bring that for him.

children.text: dvitīyā -- suvrate na śakya eṣa vācā-mātreṇa viramayitum / gaccha tvam / madīya uṭaje mārkaṇḍeyasya+ṛṣi-kumārasya varṇa-citrito mṛttikā-mayūras tiṣṭhati / tam asya upahara /
prathamā  tathā / (iti niṣkrāntā)
children.translated_text: First ascetic: Very well. (Exit.)

children.text: prathamā -- tathā / (iti niṣkrāntā)
bāla  anenaiva tāvat krīḍiṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: Boy: I shall play with this one in the meantime!

children.text: bāla -- anena eva tāvat krīḍiṣyāmi /
rājā  spṛhayāmi khalu durlalitāyāsmai /
children.translated_text: King: I feel drawn indeed to this mischievous child.

children.text: rājā -- spṛhayāmi khalu durlalitāya asmai /
ālakṣyadantamukulān animittahāsair
avyaktavarṇaramaṇīyavacaḥpravṛttīn /
children.translated_text: whose speech, charming in its indistinct sounds, is just beginning —
Bearing sons whose tooth-buds are barely visible, who laugh without cause,

children.text: aṅkāśrayapraṇayinas tanayān vahanto
dhanyās tadaṅgarajasā malinībhavanti //
children.translated_text: blessed are those who become soiled with the dust of their limbs! //
who longingly seek the refuge of one's lap —

children.text: ālakṣya-danta-mukulān animitta-hāsair
avyakta-varṇa-ramaṇīya-vacaḥ-pravṛttīn /
aṅka-āśraya-praṇayinas tanayān vahanto
dhanyās tad-aṅga-rajasā malinī-bhavanti //

tāpasī  bhavatu / na mām ayaṃ gaṇayati / (pārśvam avalokya) ko 'tra ṛṣipumārāṇām / (rājānam avalokya) bhadramukha ehi tāvat / mocayānena durmocahastagraheṇa* ḍimbhalīlayā bādhyamānaṃ bālamṛgendram / (*durmoka)
children.translated_text: Ascetic woman: Well then! He pays me no heed. (Looking to the side) Is any of the sage's sons here? (Looking at the King) Good sir, come, please — free this young lion being tormented by this child's play, held in an inescapable grip.

children.text: tāpasī -- bhavatu / na mām ayaṃ gaṇayati / (pārśvam avalokya) ko 'tra ṛṣi-pumārāṇām / (rājānam avalokya) bhadra-mukha ehi tāvat / mocaya anena durmoca-hasta-graheṇa* ḍimbha-līlayā bādhyamānaṃ bāla-mṛga-indram / (*-durmoka-)
rājā  (upagamya / sasmitam) ayi bho maharṣiputra /
children.translated_text: King: (Approaching; with a smile) O son of a great sage!

children.text: rājā -- (upagamya / sasmitam) ayi bho maharṣi-putra /
evam āśramaviruddhavṛttinā saṃyamaḥ kim iti janmatas tvayā /
children.translated_text: How is it that you, from birth, conduct yourself contrary to the ways of the hermitage?

children.text: sattvasaṃśraya sukho 'pi dūṣyate kṛṣṇasarpaśiśuneva candanaḥ //
children.translated_text: Even the sandal tree, though a joy to creatures that seek its shelter, is sullied by the young of the black serpent. //

children.text: evam āśrama-viruddha-vṛttinā saṃyamaḥ kim iti janmatas tvayā /
sattva-saṃśraya sukho 'pi dūṣyate kṛṣṇa-sarpa-śiśuna īva candanaḥ //
tāpasī  bhadramukha na khalv ayam ṛṣikumāraḥ /
children.translated_text: Ascetic woman: Good sir, this is indeed not a sage's son.

children.text: tāpasī -- bhadra-mukha na khalv ayam ṛṣi-kumāraḥ /
rājā  ākārasadṛśaṃ ceṣṭitam evāsya kathayati / sthānapratyayāt tu vayam evaṃ tarkiṇaḥ / (yathābhyarthitam anutiṣṭhan bālasparśam upalabhya / ātmagatam)
children.translated_text: King: His behavior itself reveals [his nature] in accordance with his appearance. It is from confidence in his lineage that we thus surmise. (Complying with the request and perceiving the child's touch; to himself)

children.text: rājā -- ākāra-sadṛśaṃ ceṣṭitam eva asya kathayati / sthāna-pratyayāt tu vayam evaṃ tarkiṇaḥ / (yathā-abhyarthitam anutiṣṭhan bāla-sparśam upalabhya / ātma-gatam)
anena kasya api kulāṅkureṇa spṛṣṭasya gātreṣu sukhaṃ mamaivam /
children.translated_text: When this scion of some [noble] family has touched my limbs, such pleasure arises in me —

children.text: kāṃ nirvṛtiṃ cetasi tasya kuryād yasyāyam aṅkāt kṛtinaḥ prarūḍhaḥ //
children.translated_text: what joy then would fill the heart of that fortunate one from whose lap this child has sprung!

children.text: anena kasya api kula-aṅkureṇa spṛṣṭasya gātreṣu sukhaṃ mama evam /
kāṃ nirvṛtiṃ cetasi tasya kuryād yasya ayam aṅkāt kṛtinaḥ prarūḍhaḥ //
tāpasī  (ubhau nirvarṇya) āścaryam āścaryam /
children.translated_text: Hermitess: (Observing both) How wonderful, how wonderful!

children.text: tāpasī -- (ubhau nirvarṇya) āścaryam āścaryam /
rājā  ārye kim iva /
children.translated_text: King: Venerable lady, what is it?

children.text: rājā -- ārye kim iva /
tāpasī  asya bālakasya te 'pi saṃvādiny ākṛtir iti vismitāsmi / aparicitasya api te 'pratilomaḥ saṃvṛtta iti /
children.translated_text: Hermitess: I am astonished that this boy's form is so concordant with yours. And that, though unacquainted with you, he has become so agreeable.

children.text: tāpasī -- asya bālakasya te 'pi saṃvādiny ākṛtir iti vismita āsmi / aparicitasya api te 'pratilomaḥ saṃvṛtta iti /
rājā  (bālakam upalālayan) na cen munikumāro 'yam atha ko 'sya vyapadeśaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: (Caressing the boy) If he is not a sage's son, then what is his lineage?

children.text: rājā -- (bālakam upalālayan) na cen muni-kumāro 'yam atha ko 'sya vyapadeśaḥ /
tāpasī  puruvaṃśaḥ /
children.translated_text: Hermitess: The <s>Puru</s> dynasty.

children.text: tāpasī -- puru-vaṃśaḥ /
rājā  (ātmagatam) katham ekānvayo mama / ataḥ khalu madanukāriṇam enam atrabhavatī manyate / asty etat pauravāṇām antyaṃ kulavratam /
children.translated_text: King: (To himself) What! He is of my own lineage! That is indeed why this venerable lady considers him to be similar to me. For this is the final family vow of the <s>Pauravas</s>:

children.text: rājā -- (ātma-gatam) katham eka-anvayo mama / ataḥ khalu mad-anukāriṇam enam atra-bhavatī manyate / asty etat pauravāṇām antyaṃ kula-vratam /
bhavaneṣu rasādhikeṣu pūrvaṃ kṣitirakṣārtham uśanti ye nivāsam /
children.translated_text: They who first dwell in palaces surpassing in pleasures, for the sake of protecting the earth,

children.text: niyataikavratāni paścāt tarumūlāni gṛhībhavanti teṣām //
children.translated_text: afterward, observing a single vow, the roots of trees become their homes.

children.text: bhavaneṣu rasa-adhikeṣu pūrvaṃ kṣiti-rakṣā-artham uśanti ye nivāsam /
niyata-eka-vratāni paścāt taru-mūlāni gṛhī-bhavanti teṣām //
(prakāśam) na punar ātmagatyā mānuṣāṇām eṣa viṣayaḥ /
children.translated_text: (Aloud) But this domain [of forest-dwelling] is not attainable by mortals of their own accord.

children.text: (prakāśam) na punar ātma-gatyā mānuṣāṇām eṣa viṣayaḥ /
tāpasī  yathā bhadramukho bhaṇati / apsaraḥsaṃbandhenāsya janany atra devaguros tapovane prasūtā /
children.translated_text: Hermitess: What the good-faced one says is right. His mother gave birth to him here, in the <s>tapovana</s> (penance grove) of the divine preceptor, through a connection with an <s>Apsaras</s> (celestial nymph).

children.text: tāpasī -- yathā bhadra-mukho bhaṇati / apsaraḥ-saṃbandhena asya janany atra deva-guros tapo-vane prasūtā /
rājā  (apavārya) hanta dvitīyam idam āśājananam /
children.translated_text: King: (Aside) Ah, here is a second birth of hope!

children.text: rājā -- (apavārya) hanta dvitīyam idam āśā-jananam /
(prakāśam) atha sā tatrabhavatī kim ākhyasya rājaṛṣeḥ patnī /
children.translated_text: (Aloud) Then, of what named royal sage is that lady the wife?

children.text: (prakāśam) atha sā tatra-bhavatī kim ākhyasya rāja-ṛṣeḥ patnī /
tāpasī  kas tasya dharmadāraparityāgino nāma saṃkīrtayituṃ cintayiṣyati /
children.translated_text: Hermitess: Who would even think of uttering the name of that one who abandoned his lawful wife?

children.text: tāpasī -- kas tasya dharma-dāra-parityāgino nāma saṃkīrtayituṃ cintayiṣyati /
rājā  (svagatam) iyaṃ khalu kathā mām eva lakṣyīkaroti / yadi tāvad asya śiśor mātaraṃ nāmataḥ pṛcchāmi / atha vānāryaḥ paradāravyavahāraḥ / (praviṣya mṛnmayūrahastā)
children.translated_text: King: (To himself) This account indeed points to me. What if I ask the name of this child's mother? But then, it would be ignoble to inquire about another's wife. (A [hermitess] enters with a clay peacock in hand)

children.text: rājā -- (svagatam) iyaṃ khalu kathā mām eva lakṣyī-karoti / yadi tāvad asya śiśor mātaraṃ nāmataḥ pṛcchāmi / atha va ānāryaḥ para-dāra-vyavahāraḥ / (praviṣya mṛn-mayūra-hastā)
tāpasī  sarvadamana śakuntalāvaṇyaṃ prekṣasva /
children.translated_text: Hermitess: <s>Sarvadamana</s>, look at the beauty of this <s>Śakunta</s> (bird)!

children.text: tāpasī -- sarva-damana śakunta-lāvaṇyaṃ prekṣasva /
bāla  (sadṛṣṭikṣepam) kutra vā mama mātā /
children.translated_text: Boy: (Casting his gaze about) Where is my mother?

children.text: bāla -- (sadṛṣṭi-kṣepam) kutra vā mama mātā /
ubhe  nāmasādṛśyena vañcito mātṛcatsalaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: The child, longing for his mother, has been deceived by the similarity of the name.

children.text: ubhe -- nāma-sādṛśyena vañcito mātṛ-catsalaḥ /
dvitīyā  vatsa asya vṛttikāmayūrasya ramyatvaṃ paśyeti bhaṇito 'si /
children.translated_text: Second [hermitess]: Child, you were told: 'Look at the loveliness of this toy peacock.'

children.text: dvitīyā -- vatsa asya vṛttikā-mayūrasya ramyatvaṃ paśya iti bhaṇito 'si /
rājā  (ātmagatam) kiṃ vā śakuntalā ity asyā mātur ākhyā / santi punar nāmadheyasādṛśyāni / api nāma mṛgatṛṣṭikeva nāmamātraprastāvo me viṣādāya kalpate /
children.translated_text: King: (To himself) What — is his mother's name <s>Śakuntalā</s>? But then, there are similarities among names. Perhaps, like a mirage, this introduction of a mere name is destined to become a source of anguish for me.

children.text: rājā -- (ātma-gatam) kiṃ vā śakuntalā ity asyā mātur ākhyā / santi punar nāmadheya-sādṛśyāni / api nāma mṛga-tṛṣṭika īva nāma-mātra-prastāvo me viṣādāya kalpate /
bāla  mātaḥ rocate ma eṣa bhadramayūraḥ / (iti krīḍanakam ādatte)
children.translated_text: Boy: Mother, I like this fine peacock! (He takes the toy.)

children.text: bāla -- mātaḥ rocate ma eṣa bhadra-mayūraḥ / (iti krīḍanakam ādatte)
prathamā  (vilokya / sa udvegam) aho rakṣākaraṇḍakam asya maṇibandhe na dṛśyate /
children.translated_text: First [hermitess]: (Looking, with alarm) Ah, the protective amulet is not seen on his wrist!

children.text: prathamā -- (vilokya / sa udvegam) aho rakṣā-karaṇḍakam asya maṇi-bandhe na dṛśyate /
rājā  alam āvegena / nanv idam asya siṃhaśāvavimardāt paribhraṣṭam / (ity ādātum icchati)
children.translated_text: King: Do not be alarmed. Surely it fell off from his tussle with the lion cub. (He tries to pick it up.)

children.text: rājā -- alam āvegena / nanv idam asya siṃha-śāva-vimardāt paribhraṣṭam / (ity ādātum icchati)
ubhe  mā khalv etad avalambya  katham / gṛhītam anena /
children.translated_text: Both: Do not touch it! How — he has picked it up!

children.text: ubhe -- mā khalv etad avalambya -- katham / gṛhītam anena /
(iti vismayād uronihitahaste parasparam avalokayataḥ)
children.translated_text: (Placing their hands on their chests in astonishment, they look at each other.)

children.text: (iti vismayād uro-nihita-haste parasparam avalokayataḥ)
rājā  kim arthaṃ pratiṣiddhāḥ smaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Why were we prevented?

children.text: rājā -- kim arthaṃ pratiṣiddhāḥ smaḥ /
prathamā  śṛṇotu mahārājaḥ / eṣāparājitā nāmauṣadhir asya jātakarmasamaye bhagavatā mārīcena dattā /
children.translated_text: First [hermitess]: Let the great king hear! This is a herb called <s>Aparājitā</s> (the Unconquered), given by the venerable <s>Mārīca</s> at the time of his birth ceremony.

children.text: prathamā -- śṛṇotu mahā-rājaḥ / eṣa āparājitā nāma oṣadhir asya jāta-karma-samaye bhagavatā mārīcena dattā /
etāṃ kila mātāpitarāv ātmānaṃ ca varjayitvāparo bhūmipatitāṃ na gṛhṇāti /
children.translated_text: If it falls to the ground, no one other than his mother, father, or himself can pick it up.

children.text: etāṃ kila mātā-pitarāv ātmānaṃ ca varjayitva āparo bhūmi-patitāṃ na gṛhṇāti /
rājā  atha gṛhṇāti /
children.translated_text: King: And if someone does pick it up?

children.text: rājā -- atha gṛhṇāti /
prathamā  tatas taṃ sarpo bhūtvā daśati /
children.translated_text: First [hermitess]: Then it becomes a serpent and bites that person.

children.text: prathamā -- tatas taṃ sarpo bhūtvā daśati /
rājā  bhavatībhyāṃ kadācid asyāḥ pratyakṣīkṛtā vikriyā /
children.translated_text: King: Have your reverences ever witnessed its transformation?

children.text: rājā -- bhavatībhyāṃ kadācid asyāḥ pratyakṣī-kṛtā vikriyā /
ubhe  anekaśaḥ /
children.translated_text: Both: Many times.

children.text: ubhe -- anekaśaḥ /
rājā  (saharṣam / ātmagatam) katham iva saṃpūrṇam api me manorathaṃ nābhinandāmi /
children.translated_text: King: (With joy; to himself) Why do I not celebrate the fulfillment of my heart's desire!

children.text: rājā -- (saharṣam / ātma-gatam) katham iva saṃpūrṇam api me manorathaṃ na abhinandāmi /
