dvitīyā  suvrate ehi / imaṃ vṛttāntaṃ niyamavyāpṛtāyai śakuntalāyai nivedayāvaḥ / (iti niṣkrānte)
children.translated_text: Second [hermitess]: <s>Suvratā</s>, come! Let us report this event to <s>Śakuntalā</s>, who is occupied with her religious observances. (They exit.)

children.text: dvitīyā -- suvrate ehi / imaṃ vṛtta-antaṃ niyama-vyāpṛtāyai śakuntalāyai nivedayāvaḥ / (iti niṣkrānte)
bāla  muñca mām / yāvan mātuḥ sakāśaṃ gamiṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: Boy: Release me! I wish to go to my mother!

children.text: bāla -- muñca mām / yāvan mātuḥ sakāśaṃ gamiṣyāmi /
rājā  putraka mayā saha eva mātaram abhinandiṣyasi /
children.translated_text: King: Son, together with me you shall greet your mother.

children.text: rājā -- putraka mayā saha eva mātaram abhinandiṣyasi /
bāla  mama khalu tāto duṣyantaḥ / na tvam /
children.translated_text: Boy: My father is <s>Duṣyanta</s>! Not you!

children.text: bāla -- mama khalu tāto duṣyantaḥ / na tvam /
rājā  (sasmitam+eṣa vivāda eva pratyāyayati (tataḥ praviśaty ekaveṇīdharā śakuntalā)
children.translated_text: King: (With a smile) This very dispute confirms [it]. (Then <s>Śakuntalā</s> enters, wearing a single braid.)

children.text: rājā -- (sasmitam+eṣa vivāda eva pratyāyayati (tataḥ praviśaty eka-veṇī-dharā śakuntalā)
śakuntalā  vikārakāle 'pi prakṛtisthāṃ sarvadamanasyauṣadhiṃ śrutvā na me āśāsīd ātmano bhāgadheyeṣu /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Having heard that <s>Sarvadamana</s>'s herb remained in its natural state even at the time it should have changed, I did not dare hope in my own fortunes.

children.text: śakuntalā -- vikāra-kāle 'pi prakṛtisthāṃ sarva-damanasya oṣadhiṃ śrutvā na me āśā āsīd ātmano bhāgadheyeṣu /
atha vā yathā sānumatyākhyātaṃ tathā saṃbhāvyata etat /
children.translated_text: But then, as <s>Sānumatī</s> has described, this may indeed be so.

children.text: atha vā yathā sānumatyā ākhyātaṃ tathā saṃbhāvyata etat /
rājā  (śakuntalāṃ vilokya) aye seyam atrabhavatī śakuntalā yaiṣā
children.translated_text: King: (Seeing <s>Śakuntalā</s>) Ah, here is that lady <s>Śakuntalā</s>, who —

children.text: rājā -- (śakuntalāṃ vilokya) aye sa īyam atra-bhavatī śakuntalā ya aiṣā
vasane paridhūsare vasānā niyamakṣāmamukhī dhṛtaikaveṇiḥ /
children.translated_text: clad in a dusty garment, her face thin from ascetic observances, wearing a single braid,

children.text: atiniṣkaruṇasya śuddhaśīlā mama dīrghaṃ virahavrataṃ bibharti //
children.translated_text: of pure character, endures a long vow of separation from me, the exceedingly heartless one.

children.text: vasane paridhūsare vasānā niyama-kṣāma-mukhī dhṛta-eka-veṇiḥ /
atiniṣkaruṇasya śuddha-śīlā mama dīrghaṃ viraha-vrataṃ bibharti //
śakuntalā  (paścāt+tāpavivarṇaṃ rājānaṃ dṛṣṭvā) na khalv āryaputra iva / tataḥ ka eṣa idānīṃ kṛtarakṣāmaṅgalaṃ dārakaṃ me gātrasaṃsargeṇa dūṣayati /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Seeing the king, pale with sorrow, from behind) He does not look like my noble lord. Then who is this who now defiles my child, who bears the protective auspicious charm, with the touch of his body?

children.text: śakuntalā -- (paścāt+tāpa-vivarṇaṃ rājānaṃ dṛṣṭvā) na khalv ārya-putra iva / tataḥ ka eṣa idānīṃ kṛta-rakṣā-maṅgalaṃ dārakaṃ me gātra-saṃsargeṇa dūṣayati /
bāla  (mātaram upetya) mātaḥ eṣa ko 'pi puruṣo māṃ putra ity āliṅgati /
children.translated_text: Boy: (Going to his mother) Mother, some man is embracing me and calling me 'son'!

children.text: bāla -- (mātaram upetya) mātaḥ eṣa ko 'pi puruṣo māṃ putra ity āliṅgati /
rājā  priye krauryam api me tvayi prayuktam anukūlapariṇāmaṃ saṃvṛttaṃ yad aham idānīṃ tvayā pratyabhijñātam ātmānaṃ paśyāmi /
children.translated_text: King: Beloved, even the cruelty I showed you has turned to a favorable outcome, since I now see myself recognized by you.

children.text: rājā -- priye krauryam api me tvayi prayuktam anukūla-pariṇāmaṃ saṃvṛttaṃ yad aham idānīṃ tvayā pratyabhijñātam ātmānaṃ paśyāmi /
śakuntalā  (ātmagatam) hṛdaya samāśvasihi samāśvasihi / parityaktamatsareṇānukampitāsmi daivena / āryaputraḥ khalv eṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) Heart, be comforted, be comforted! Fate, having set aside its hostility, has shown me compassion. This is indeed my noble lord.

children.text: śakuntalā -- (ātma-gatam) hṛdaya samāśvasihi samāśvasihi / parityakta-matsareṇa anukampita āsmi daivena / ārya-putraḥ khalv eṣaḥ /
rājā  priye /
children.translated_text: King: Beloved —

children.text: rājā -- priye /
smṛtibhinnamohatamaso diṣṭyā pramukhe sthitāsi me sumukhi /
children.translated_text: By good fortune, O fair-faced one, you stand before me, the darkness of delusion shattered by memory,

children.text: uparāgānte śaśinaḥ samupagatā rohiṇī yogam //
children.translated_text: as <s>Rohiṇī</s> attains conjunction with the moon at the end of an eclipse.

children.text: smṛti-bhinna-moha-tamaso diṣṭyā pramukhe sthita āsi me sumukhi /
uparāga-ante śaśinaḥ samupagatā rohiṇī yogam //
śakuntalā  jayatu jayatv āryaputraḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Victory, victory to my noble lord!

children.text: śakuntalā -- jayatu jayatv ārya-putraḥ /
rājā  sundari /
children.translated_text: King: Beautiful one —

children.text: rājā -- sundari /
bāṣpeṇa pratiṣiddhe 'pi jayaśabde jitaṃ mayā /
children.translated_text: Though the word of victory was choked by tears, I have [indeed] conquered,

children.text: yat te dṛṣṭam asaṃskārapāṭalauṣṭhapuṭaṃ mukham //
children.translated_text: for I have seen your face, with lips naturally pink and unadorned.

children.text: bāṣpeṇa pratiṣiddhe 'pi jaya-śabde jitaṃ mayā /
yat te dṛṣṭam asaṃskāra-pāṭala-oṣṭha-puṭaṃ mukham //
bāla  mātaḥ ka eṣaḥ /
children.translated_text: Boy: Mother, who is this?

children.text: bāla -- mātaḥ ka eṣaḥ /
śakuntalā  vatsa te bhāgadheyāni pṛccha /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Child, ask your own fortune.

children.text: śakuntalā -- vatsa te bhāga-dheyāni pṛccha /
sutanu hṛdayāt pratyādeśavyalīkam apaitu te
kim api manasaḥ saṃmoho me tadā balavān abhūt /
children.translated_text: some powerful delusion of mind seized me then;
Slender one, let the pain of rejection depart from your heart —

children.text: prabalatamasām evaṃ prāyāḥ śubheṣu hi vṛttayaḥ
srajam api śirasy andhaḥ kṣiptāṃ dhunoty ahiśaṅkayā //
children.translated_text: even a blind man shakes off a garland cast upon his head, suspecting it to be a serpent.
such indeed are the ways of those wrapped in dense darkness regarding auspicious things —

children.text: sutanu hṛdayāt pratyādeśa-vyalīkam apaitu te
kim api manasaḥ saṃmoho me tadā balavān abhūt /
prabala-tamasām evaṃ prāyāḥ śubheṣu hi vṛttayaḥ
srajam api śirasy andhaḥ kṣiptāṃ dhunoty ahi-śaṅkayā //
śakuntalā  uttiṣṭhatv āryaputraḥ / nūnaṃ me sucaritapratibandhakaṃ purākṛtaṃ teṣu divaseṣu pariṇāmābhimukham āsīd yena sānukrośo 'py āryaputro mayi virasaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Let my noble lord arise. Surely some deed done by me in a past life, obstructing my merit, was reaching its fruition in those days — whereby my noble lord, though compassionate by nature, became cold toward me.

children.text: śakuntalā -- uttiṣṭhatv ārya-putraḥ / nūnaṃ me sucarita-pratibandhakaṃ purā-kṛtaṃ teṣu divaseṣu pariṇāma-abhimukham āsīd yena sānukrośo 'py ārya-putro mayi virasaḥ saṃvṛttaḥ /
(rājottiṣṭhati)
children.translated_text: (The king rises.)

children.text: (rāja ūttiṣṭhati)
śakuntalā  atha katham āryaputreṇa smṛto duḥkhabhāgy ayaṃ janaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: But how did my noble lord come to remember this unfortunate person?

children.text: śakuntalā -- atha katham ārya-putreṇa smṛto duḥkha-bhāgy ayaṃ janaḥ /
rājā  uddhṛtaviṣādaśalyaḥ kathayiṣyāmi /
children.translated_text: King: When the thorn of sorrow has been extracted, I shall tell you.

children.text: rājā -- uddhṛta-viṣāda-śalyaḥ kathayiṣyāmi /
mohān mayā sutanu pūrvam upekṣitas te
yo baddhabindur adharaṃ paribādhamānaḥ /
children.translated_text: which was formerly ignored by me in my delusion,
O slender one, the tear — clinging as a fixed drop on your lip —

children.text: taṃ tāvad ākuṭilapakṣmavilagnam adya
bāṣpaṃ pramṛjya vigatānuśayo bhaveyam //
children.translated_text: and become free from regret.
let me now wipe away that tear, still caught on your uncurled lashes,

children.text: mohān mayā sutanu pūrvam upekṣitas te
yo baddha-bindur adharaṃ paribādhamānaḥ /
taṃ tāvad ākuṭila-pakṣma-vilagnam adya
bāṣpaṃ pramṛjya vigata-anuśayo bhaveyam //
(iti yathoktam anutiṣṭhati)
children.translated_text: (He does as described.)

children.text: (iti yathā-uktam anutiṣṭhati)
śakuntalā  (nāmamudrāṃ dṛṣṭvā) āryaputra idaṃ tad aṅgulīyakam /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (Seeing the signet ring) Noble lord, this is that ring!

children.text: śakuntalā -- (nāma-mudrāṃ dṛṣṭvā) ārya-putra idaṃ tad aṅgulīyakam /
rājā  asmād aṅgulīyopalambhāt khalu smṛtir upalabdhā /
children.translated_text: King: It was indeed through the recovery of this ring that memory was recovered.

children.text: rājā -- asmād aṅgulīya-upalambhāt khalu smṛtir upalabdhā /
śakuntalā  viṣamaṃ kṛtam anena yat tadāryaputrasya pratyayakāle durlabham āsīt /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: It dealt unfairly, in that it was unattainable when my noble lord needed a token of proof.

children.text: śakuntalā -- viṣamaṃ kṛtam anena yat tadā ārya-putrasya pratyaya-kāle durlabham āsīt /
rājā  tena hi ṛtusamavāyacihnaṃ pratipadyatāṃ latā kusumam /
children.translated_text: King: Then let the creeper accept its flower as the mark of the season's union.

children.text: rājā -- tena hi ṛtu-samavāya-cihnaṃ pratipadyatāṃ latā kusumam /
śakuntalā  nāsya viśvasimi / āryaputra evaitad dhārayatu / (tataḥ praviśati mātaliḥ)
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: I do not trust it. Let my noble lord himself keep it. (Then <s>Mātali</s> enters.)

children.text: śakuntalā -- na asya viśvasimi / ārya-putra eva etad dhārayatu / (tataḥ praviśati mātaliḥ)
mātali  diṣṭyā dharmapatnīsamāgamena putramukhadarśanena cāyuṣmān vardhate /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: By good fortune, the long-lived one prospers through reunion with his lawful wife and through seeing his son's face!

children.text: mātali -- diṣṭyā dharma-patnī-samāgamena putra-mukha-darśanena cā ayuṣmān vardhate /
rājā  abhūt saṃpāditasvāduphalo me manorathaḥ / mātale na khalu vidito 'yam ākhaṇḍalena vṛttāntaḥ syāt /
children.translated_text: King: The fruit of my heart's desire has been brought to sweetness. <s>Mātali</s>, surely this event must already be known to <s>Ākhaṇḍala</s> (<s>Indra</s>)?

children.text: rājā -- abhūt saṃpādita-svādu-phalo me manorathaḥ / mātale na khalu vidito 'yam ākhaṇḍalena vṛtta-antaḥ syāt /
mātali  (sasmitam) kim īśvarāṇāṃ parokṣam / etv āyuṣmān / bhagavān mārīcas te darśanaṃ vitarati /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: (With a smile) What is hidden from the lords? Come, O long-lived one. The venerable <s>Mārīca</s> grants you an audience.

children.text: mātali -- (sasmitam) kim īśvarāṇāṃ parokṣam / etv āyuṣmān / bhagavān mārīcas te darśanaṃ vitarati /
rājā  śakuntale avalambyatāṃ putraḥ / tvāṃ puraskṛtya bhagavantaṃ draṣṭum icchāmi /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Śakuntalā</s>, take the boy. I wish to see the venerable one, preceded by you.

children.text: rājā -- śakuntale avalambyatāṃ putraḥ / tvāṃ puras-kṛtya bhagavantaṃ draṣṭum icchāmi /
śakuntalā  jihremy āryaputreṇa saha gurusamīpaṃ gantum /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: I feel ashamed to go before the guru in the company of my noble lord.

children.text: śakuntalā -- jihremy ārya-putreṇa saha guru-samīpaṃ gantum /
rājā  apy ācaritavyam abhyudayakāleṣu / ehy ehi /
children.translated_text: King: But it is proper to do so on auspicious occasions. Come, come!

children.text: rājā -- apy ācaritavyam abhyudaya-kāleṣu / ehy ehi /
(sarve parikrāmanti) (tataḥ praviśaty adityā sārdham āsanastho mārīcaḥ) (ānasastho)
children.translated_text: (All walk about.) (Then <s>Mārīca</s> enters, seated [on a throne], together with <s>Aditi</s>.)

children.text: (sarve parikrāmanti) (tataḥ praviśaty adityā sārdham āsanastho mārīcaḥ) (ānasastho)
mārīca  (rājānam avalokya) dākṣāyaṇi /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: (Looking at the king) O <s>Dākṣāyaṇī</s> —

children.text: mārīca -- (rājānam avalokya) dākṣāyaṇi /
putrasya te raṇaśirasy ayam agrayāyī
duṣyanta ity abhihito bhuvanasya bhartā /
children.translated_text: called <s>Duṣyanta</s>, is the lord of the world,
This one, foremost in battle among your sons,

children.text: cāpena yasya vinivartitakarmajātam
tatkoṭimatkuliśam ābharaṇaṃ maghonaḥ //
children.translated_text: whereby the thunderbolt of <s>Maghon</s> (<s>Indra</s>), blunted at the tip, has become [merely] an ornament.
by whose bow the host of deeds [of the demons] was reversed —

children.text: putrasya te raṇa-śirasy ayam agra-yāyī
duṣyanta ity abhihito bhuvanasya bhartā /
cāpena yasya vinivartita-karma-jātam
tat-koṭimat-kuliśam ābharaṇaṃ maghonaḥ //
aditiḥ  saṃbhāvanīyānubhāvāsya ākṛtiḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s>: His form befits a person of revered prowess.

children.text: aditiḥ -- saṃbhāvanīya-anubhāva āsya ākṛtiḥ /
mātaliḥ  āyuṣmann etau putraprītipiśunena cakṣuṣā divaikasāṃ pitarāv āyuṣmantam avalokayataḥ / tāv upasarpa /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Long-lived one, the two parents, companions of the celestials, gaze upon the long-lived one with eyes that betray their delight in [their] son. Approach them.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- āyuṣmann etau putra-prīti-piśunena cakṣuṣā divaikasāṃ pitarāv āyuṣmantam avalokayataḥ / tāv upasarpa /
rājā  mātale /
children.translated_text: King: <s>Mātali</s> —

children.text: rājā -- mātale /
prāhur dvādaśadhā sthitasya munayo yat tejasaḥ kāraṇam
bhartāraṃ bhuvanatrayasya suṣuve yad yajñabhāgeśvaram /
children.translated_text: which gave birth to the lord of the three worlds, the master of sacrificial shares,
That which the sages declare to be the cause of the radiance stationed twelve-fold,

children.text: yasminn ātmabhavaḥ paro 'pi puruṣaś cakre bhavāyāspadam
dvandvaṃ dakṣamarīcisaṃbhavam idaṃ tat sraṣṭur ekāntaram //
children.translated_text: this pair, born of <s>Dakṣa</s> and <s>Marīci</s>, is but one step removed from the Creator.
in which even the Self-born one, that supreme Being, established the ground of existence —

children.text: prāhur dvādaśadhā sthitasya munayo yat tejasaḥ kāraṇam
bhartāraṃ bhuvana-trayasya suṣuve yad yajña-bhāga-īśvaram /
yasminn ātma-bhavaḥ paro 'pi puruṣaś cakre bhavāyā aspadam
dvandvaṃ dakṣa-marīci-saṃbhavam idaṃ tat sraṣṭur eka-antaram //
mātali  atha kim /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Indeed so.

children.text: mātali -- atha kim /
rājā  (upagamyobhābhyām api vāsavaniyojyo duṣyantaḥ praṇamati /
children.translated_text: King: (Approaching) <s>Duṣyanta</s>, appointed by <s>Vāsava</s> (<s>Indra</s>), bows to both [of you].

children.text: rājā -- (upagamya ubhābhyām api vāsava-niyojyo duṣyantaḥ praṇamati /
mārīca  vatsa ciraṃ jīva / pṛthivīṃ pālaya /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Son, live long! Protect the earth!

children.text: mārīca -- vatsa ciraṃ jīva / pṛthivīṃ pālaya /
aditiḥ  vatsa apratiratho bhava /
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s>: Son, be invincible!

children.text: aditiḥ -- vatsa apratiratho bhava /
śakuntalā  dārakasahitā vāṃ pādavadanaṃ karomi /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: Together with my child, I offer obeisance at your feet.

children.text: śakuntalā -- dāraka-sahitā vāṃ pāda-vadanaṃ karomi /
mārīca  vatse /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Daughter —

children.text: mārīca -- vatse /
ākhaṇḍalasamo bhartā jayantapratimaḥ sutaḥ /
children.translated_text: May your husband be the equal of <s>Ākhaṇḍala</s> (<s>Indra</s>), may your son be like <s>Jayanta</s>;

children.text: āśīr anyā na te yogyā paulomīsadṛśī bhava //
children.translated_text: no other blessing is fitting for you — be like <s>Paulomī</s> (<s>Śacī</s>)!

children.text: ākhaṇḍala-samo bhartā jayanta-pratimaḥ sutaḥ /
āśīr anyā na te yogyā paulomī-sadṛśī bhava //
aditi  jāte bhartur bahumatā bhava / ayaṃ ca dīrghāyur vatsaka ubhayakulanandano bhavatu / upaviśata / (sarve prajāpatim abhita upaviśanti)
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s>: Daughter, be held in high esteem by your husband. And may this dear child, long-lived, bring joy to both families. Be seated. (All sit down near <s>Prajāpati</s>.)

children.text: aditi -- jāte bhartur bahu-matā bhava / ayaṃ ca dīrgha-āyur vatsaka ubhaya-kula-nandano bhavatu / upaviśata / (sarve prajā-patim abhita upaviśanti)
mārīca  (ekaikaṃ nirdiśan)
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: (Pointing to each one)

children.text: mārīca -- (eka-ekaṃ nirdiśan)
diṣṭyā śakuntalā sādhvī sadapatyam idaṃ bhavān /
children.translated_text: By good fortune — the virtuous <s>Śakuntalā</s>, this fine offspring, and you —

children.text: śraddhā vittaṃ vidhiś ceti tritayaṃ tat samāgatam //
children.translated_text: faith, wealth, and proper rite — this triad has come together.

children.text: diṣṭyā śakuntalā sādhvī sad-apatyam idaṃ bhavān /
śraddhā vittaṃ vidhiś ca iti tritayaṃ tat samāgatam //
rājā  bhagavan / prāgabhipretasiddhiḥ / paścāddarśanam / ato 'pūrvaḥ khalu vo 'nugrahaḥ / kutaḥ /
children.translated_text: King: Venerable one, first came the fulfillment of my desire, and then your audience. Hence your grace is truly unprecedented. For —

children.text: rājā -- bhagavan / prāg-abhipreta-siddhiḥ / paścād-darśanam / ato 'pūrvaḥ khalu vo 'nugrahaḥ / kutaḥ /
udeti pūrvaṃ kusumaṃ tataḥ phalaṃ ghanodayaḥ prāk+tadanantaraṃ payaḥ /
children.translated_text: First the blossom appears, then the fruit; first the cloud rises, then the rain;

children.text: nimittanaimittikayor ayaṃ kramas tava prasādasya puras tu saṃpadaḥ //
children.translated_text: such is the order of cause and effect — but your favor preceded the attainment.

children.text: udeti pūrvaṃ kusumaṃ tataḥ phalaṃ ghana-udayaḥ prāk+tad-anantaraṃ payaḥ /
nimitta-naimittikayor ayaṃ kramas tava prasādasya puras tu saṃpadaḥ //
mātaliḥ  evaṃ vidhātāraḥ prasīdanti /
children.translated_text: <s>Mātali</s>: Thus do the creators bestow their grace.

children.text: mātaliḥ -- evaṃ vidhātāraḥ prasīdanti /

rājā  bhagavann imām ājñākarīṃ vo gāndharveṇa vivāhavidhinopayamya kasyacit kālasya bandhubhir ānītāṃ smṛtiśaithilyāt pratyādiśann aparāddho 'smi tatrabhavato yuṣmatsagotrasya kaṇvasya / paścād aṅgulīyakadarśanād ūḍhapūrvā tadduhitaram avagato 'ham / tac citram iva me pratibhāti /
children.translated_text: King: Venerable one, I married this woman, your servant, by the <s>Gāndharva</s> rite of marriage, and after some time, when she was brought by her kinsmen, I rejected her due to a failure of memory. In this I have offended against the venerable <s>Kaṇva</s>, who is of the same lineage as yourselves. Later, upon seeing the ring, I realized that she, whom I had married before, was indeed his daughter. That seems wondrous to me:

children.text: rājā -- bhagavann imām ājñā-karīṃ vo gāndharveṇa vivāha-vidhina ūpayamya kasyacit kālasya bandhubhir ānītāṃ smṛti-śaithilyāt pratyādiśann aparāddho 'smi tatra-bhavato yuṣmat-sagotrasya kaṇvasya / paścād aṅgulīyaka-darśanād ūḍha-pūrvā tad-duhitaram avagato 'ham / tac citram iva me pratibhāti /
yathā gajo neti samakṣarūpe tasminn apakrāmati saṃśayaḥ syāt /
children.translated_text: Just as, when an elephant is before one's very eyes, one might deny it and say 'it is not,' and doubt arises as it departs,

children.text: padāni dṛṣṭvā tu bhavet pratītis tathāvidho me manaso vikāraḥ //
children.translated_text: but upon seeing its footprints, conviction would arise — such was the transformation of my mind.

children.text: yathā gajo na iti samakṣa-rūpe tasminn apakrāmati saṃśayaḥ syāt /
padāni dṛṣṭvā tu bhavet pratītis tathā-vidho me manaso vikāraḥ //
mārīca  vatsa alam ātmāparādhaśaṅkā / saṃmoho 'pi tvayy anupapannaḥ / śrūyatām /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Son, enough of self-reproach for the offense. Even the delusion was inappropriate for you. Listen —

children.text: mārīca -- vatsa alam ātma-aparādha-śaṅkā / saṃmoho 'pi tvayy anupapannaḥ / śrūyatām /
rājā  avahito 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: I am attentive.

children.text: rājā -- avahito 'smi /

mārīca  yadā evāpsarastīrthāvataraṇāt pratyakṣavaiklavyāṃ śakuntalām ādāya menakā dākṣāyaṇīm upagatā tadā eva dhyānād avagato 'smi durvāsasaḥ śāpād iyaṃ tapasvinī sahadharmacāriṇītvayā pratyādiṣṭā nānyatheti / sa cāyam aṅgulīyakadarśanāvasānaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: When <s>Menakā</s>, bringing <s>Śakuntalā</s> — visibly distressed from her descent at the <s>Apsaras</s>' <s>tīrtha</s> (sacred ford) — came to <s>Dākṣāyaṇī</s> (<s>Aditi</s>), at that very time I perceived through meditation that this ascetic woman had been rejected by you, her lawful husband, due to the curse of <s>Durvāsas</s>, and not otherwise. And that [curse] was to end upon seeing the ring.

children.text: mārīca -- yadā eva apsaras-tīrtha-avataraṇāt pratyakṣa-vaiklavyāṃ śakuntalām ādāya menakā dākṣāyaṇīm upagatā tadā eva dhyānād avagato 'smi durvāsasaḥ śāpād iyaṃ tapasvinī saha-dharma-cāriṇītvayā pratyādiṣṭā na anyatha īti / sa ca ayam aṅgulīyaka-darśana-avasānaḥ /
rājā  (socchvāsam) eṣa vacanīyān mukto 'smi /
children.translated_text: King: (With a sigh) Thus I am freed from reproach.

children.text: rājā -- (sa-ucchvāsam) eṣa vacanīyān mukto 'smi /

śakuntalā  (svagatam) diṣṭyākāraṇapratyādeśī nāryaputraḥ / na punaḥ śaptam ātmānaṃ smarāmi / athavā prāpto mayā sa hi śāpo virahaśūnyahṛdayayā na viditaḥ / ataḥ sakhībhyāṃ saṃdiṣṭāsmi bhartur aṅgulīyakaṃ darśayitavyam iti /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) By good fortune, my noble lord did not reject me without cause! But I do not remember having been cursed. Or perhaps I did receive that curse, but, with my heart emptied by the sorrow of separation, I did not perceive it. That is why my friends instructed me: 'You must show the ring to your husband.'

children.text: śakuntalā -- (sva-gatam) diṣṭya ākāraṇa-pratyādeśī nā arya-putraḥ / na punaḥ śaptam ātmānaṃ smarāmi / athavā prāpto mayā sa hi śāpo viraha-śūnya-hṛdayayā na viditaḥ / ataḥ sakhībhyāṃ saṃdiṣṭa āsmi bhartur aṅgulīyakaṃ darśayitavyam iti /
mārīca  vatse caritārthāsi / tad idānīṃ sahadharmacāriṇaṃ prati na tvayā manyuḥ kāryaḥ / paśya /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Daughter, your purpose is fulfilled. Now you must not harbor anger toward your husband. See —

children.text: mārīca -- vatse carita-artha āsi / tad idānīṃ saha-dharma-cāriṇaṃ prati na tvayā manyuḥ kāryaḥ / paśya /
śāpād asi pratihatā smṛtirodharūkṣe bhartary apetatamasi prabhutā tava eva /
children.translated_text: By the curse you were thwarted, when your husband's memory was harshly obstructed; but now that the darkness has lifted, your glory is indeed restored.

children.text: chāyā na mūrchati malopahataprasāde śuddhe tu darpaṇatale sulabhāvakāśā //
children.translated_text: A reflection does not appear on a mirror-surface dulled by grime, but on a clean mirror-face it finds easy scope.

children.text: śāpād asi pratihatā smṛti-rodha-rūkṣe bhartary apeta-tamasi prabhutā tava eva /
chāyā na mūrchati mala-upahata-prasāde śuddhe tu darpaṇa-tale sulabha-avakāśā //
rājā  yathā āha bhagavān /
children.translated_text: King: As the reverend one says.

children.text: rājā -- yathā āha bhagavān /
mārīca  vatsa kaccid abhinanditas tvayā vidhivad asmābhir anuṣṭhitajātakarmā putra eṣa śākuntaleyaḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Son, has this son of <s>Śakuntalā</s>, for whom we have duly performed the birth-rites, been welcomed by you?

children.text: mārīca -- vatsa kaccid abhinanditas tvayā vidhivad asmābhir anuṣṭhita-jāta-karmā putra eṣa śākuntaleyaḥ /
rājā  bhagavann atra khalu me vaṃśapratiṣṭhā / (iti bālaṃ hastena gṛhṇāti)
children.translated_text: King: Reverend sir, in him indeed rests the continuity of my lineage. (He takes the boy by the hand.)

children.text: rājā -- bhagavann atra khalu me vaṃśa-pratiṣṭhā / (iti bālaṃ hastena gṛhṇāti)
mārīca  tathābhāvinam enaṃ cakravartinam avagacchatu bhavān / paśya /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Let your honor know that he will indeed become a <s>cakravartin</s> (universal monarch). Behold —

children.text: mārīca -- tathā-bhāvinam enaṃ cakra-vartinam avagacchatu bhavān / paśya /
rathenānuddhātastimitagatinā tīrṇajaladhiḥ
purā saptadvīpāṃ jayati vasudhām apratirathaḥ /
children.translated_text: he shall conquer the earth of the seven continents, without rival;
Having crossed the ocean in a chariot moving with steady, unshaken pace,

children.text: ihāyaṃ sattvānāṃ prasabhadamanāt sarvadamanaḥ
punar yāsyaty ākhyāṃ bharata il lokasya bharaṇāt //
children.translated_text: he shall again bear the name <s>Bharata</s> from his sustaining of the world.
here called <s>Sarvadamana</s> (All-Tamer) because of his forceful subduing of creatures,

children.text: rathena anuddhāta-stimita-gatinā tīrṇa-jaladhiḥ
purā sapta-dvīpāṃ jayati vasudhām apratirathaḥ /
iha ayaṃ sattvānāṃ prasabha-damanāt sarva-damanaḥ
punar yāsyaty ākhyāṃ bharata il lokasya bharaṇāt //
rājā  bhagavatā kṛtasaṃskāre sarvam asmin vayam āśāsmahe /
children.translated_text: King: Having had the sacraments performed by your holiness, we hope for all things from him.

children.text: rājā -- bhagavatā kṛta-saṃskāre sarvam asmin vayam āśāsmahe /
aditi  bhagavann asyā duhitṛmanorathasaṃpatteḥ kaṇvo 'pi tāvatśrutavistāraḥ kriyatām / duhitṛvatsalā menakā ihaiva upacarantī tiṣṭhati /
children.translated_text: <s>Aditi</s>: Reverend sir, let <s>Kaṇva</s> also be informed at length of the fulfillment of this daughter's heart's desire. <s>Menakā</s>, fond of her daughter, is waiting here in attendance.

children.text: aditi -- bhagavann asyā duhitṛ-manoratha-saṃpatteḥ kaṇvo 'pi tāvat-śruta-vistāraḥ kriyatām / duhitṛ-vatsalā menakā iha eva upacarantī tiṣṭhati /
śakuntalā  (ātmagatam) manorathaḥ khalu me bhaṇito bhagavatyā /
children.translated_text: <s>Śakuntalā</s>: (To herself) The revered lady has spoken my very heart's wish.

children.text: śakuntalā -- (ātma-gatam) manorathaḥ khalu me bhaṇito bhagavatyā /
mārīca  tapaḥprabhavāt pratyakṣaṃ sarvam eva tatrabhavataḥ /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: By the power of his austerities, all is already directly known to the venerable one.

children.text: mārīca -- tapaḥ-prabhavāt pratyakṣaṃ sarvam eva tatra-bhavataḥ /
rājā  ataḥ khalu mama nātikruddho muniḥ /
children.translated_text: King: That is why the sage was not overly angry with me.

children.text: rājā -- ataḥ khalu mama na atikruddho muniḥ /
mārīca  tathāpy asau priyam asmābhiḥ praṣṭavyaḥ / kaḥ ko 'tra bhoḥ / (praviśya)
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Nevertheless, we should send him a pleasant message. Who is here? (Entering)

children.text: mārīca -- tatha āpy asau priyam asmābhiḥ praṣṭavyaḥ / kaḥ ko 'tra bhoḥ / (praviśya)
śiṣya  bhagavann ayam asmi /
children.translated_text: Disciple: Reverend sir, here I am.

children.text: śiṣya -- bhagavann ayam asmi /
mārīca  gālava idānīm eva vihāyasā gatvā mama vacanāt tatrabhavate kaṇvāya priyam āvedaya yathā putravatī śakuntalā tatśāpanivṛttau smṛtimatā duṣyantena pratigṛhīteti /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: <s>Gālava</s>, go now through the sky and on my behalf convey this good news to the venerable <s>Kaṇva</s>: that <s>Śakuntalā</s> has a son, and that <s>Duṣyanta</s>, his memory restored upon the lifting of the curse, has accepted her.

children.text: mārīca -- gālava idānīm eva vihāyasā gatvā mama vacanāt tatra-bhavate kaṇvāya priyam āvedaya yathā putravatī śakuntalā tat-śāpa-nivṛttau smṛtimatā duṣyantena pratigṛhīta īti /
śiṣyaḥ  yad ājñāpayati bhagavān (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
children.translated_text: Disciple: As the reverend one commands. (He exits.)

children.text: śiṣyaḥ -- yad ājñāpayati bhagavān (iti niṣkrāntaḥ)
mārīca  vatsa tvam api svāpatyadārasahitaḥ sakyur ākhaṇḍalasya ratham āruhya te rājadhānīṃ pratiṣṭhasva /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Son, now mount the chariot of your friend <s>Ākhaṇḍala</s> (<s>Indra</s>) together with your wife and son, and proceed to your capital.

children.text: mārīca -- vatsa tvam api sva-apatya-dāra-sahitaḥ sakyur ākhaṇḍalasya ratham āruhya te rāja-dhānīṃ pratiṣṭhasva /
rājā  yad ājñāpayati bhagavān /
children.translated_text: King: As the reverend one commands.

children.text: rājā -- yad ājñāpayati bhagavān /
mārīca  api ca /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: And also —

children.text: mārīca -- api ca /
tava bhavatu viḍaujāḥ prājyavṛṣṭiḥ prajāsu
tvam api vitatayajño vajriṇaṃ prīṇayasva /
children.translated_text: and may you, performing extensive sacrifices, please the Thunderbolt-wielder.
May <s>Viḍaujas</s> (<s>Indra</s>) send abundant rain upon your subjects;

children.text: yugaśataparivartān evam anyonyakṛtyair
nayatam ubhayalokānugrahaślāghanīyaiḥ //
children.translated_text: praiseworthy for their benefit to both worlds, may you both spend your time.
Thus, for hundreds of cycles of ages, with such mutual duties

children.text: tava bhavatu viḍaujāḥ prājyavṛṣṭiḥ prajāsu
tvam api vitata-yajño vajriṇaṃ prīṇayasva /
yuga-śata-parivartān evam anyonya-kṛtyair
nayatam ubhaya-loka-anugraha-ślāghanīyaiḥ //
rājā  bhagavan yathāśakti śreyase yatiṣye /
children.translated_text: King: Reverend sir, I shall strive for the good to the best of my ability.

children.text: rājā -- bhagavan yathā-śakti śreyase yatiṣye /
mārīca  vatsa kiṃ te bhūyaḥ priyam upakaromi /
children.translated_text: <s>Mārīca</s>: Son, what further favor may I do for you?

children.text: mārīca -- vatsa kiṃ te bhūyaḥ priyam upakaromi /
rāja ataḥ param api priyam asti / yadīha bhagavān priyaṃ kartum icchati tarhi idam astu / (bharatavākyam)
children.translated_text: King: Is there any favor beyond this? But if the reverend one wishes to do something pleasing, let it be this: (The concluding verse — <s>bharatavākya</s>)

children.text: rāja ataḥ param api priyam asti / yadi iha bhagavān priyaṃ kartum icchati tarhi idam astu / (bharata-vākyam)
pravartatāṃ prakṛtihitāya pārthivaḥ
sarasvatī śrutamahatāṃ mahīyatām /
children.translated_text: may <s>Sarasvatī</s> be exalted among those great in learning;
May the king conduct himself for the welfare of his subjects;

children.text: mama api ca kṣapayatu nīlalohitaḥ
punarbhavaṃ parigataśaktir ātmabhūḥ //
children.translated_text: destroy my cycle of rebirth!
and may <s>Nīlalohita</s> (<s>Śiva</s>), the Self-born, possessed of full power,

children.text: pravartatāṃ prakṛti-hitāya pārthivaḥ
sarasvatī śruta-mahatāṃ mahīyatām /
mama api ca kṣapayatu nīla-lohitaḥ
punar-bhavaṃ parigata-śaktir ātma-bhūḥ //
(niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
children.translated_text: (All exit.)

children.text: (niṣkrāntāḥ sarve)
iti saptamo 'ṅkaḥ /
children.translated_text: Thus ends the Seventh Act.

body.translated_text: Here ends the play called <s>Abhijñāna-Śākuntala</s> (The Recognition of <s>Śakuntalā</s>).
